Malizia Ocean Challenge. Educational program teaching children about ocean-climate interconnection. Racing yacht Malizia III measures CO2 and ocean variables during global races (2022-2025), covering 70,000 nautical miles, contributing to carbon cycle research.

Building SeaBase: A Bioinformatic Infrastructure for Marine Genomes. Creating SeaBase, an open bioinformatics platform integrating genome, transcriptome, and microbiome data for marine species to monitor ocean health and biodiversity through molecular analysis of organisms like coral, sponges, and fish.

Satellite Monitoring of High Sea Fisheries. Satellite monitoring of tuna fisheries in high seas to assess closure impacts on stocks, legal framework for satellite data use in maritime law, and develop global monitoring model to combat illegal fishing and rebuild ocean ecosystems.

Restoration Techniques for Mediterranean Red Coral. Developing red coral restoration protocol using sexual reproduction in artificial underwater caves at 30-40m depth. Testing larval settlement conditions in aquariums to counter IUCN-listed species decline in Mediterranean.

ACCOBAMS Survey Initiative. Pilot initiative establishing integrated monitoring of cetacean populations across Mediterranean/Black Sea. Synoptic survey combining visual observation and acoustic monitoring to improve conservation, create MPAs, integrate fishing activities.

Tracking the movements and status of marine top predators in the Mediterranean Sea and Black Sea. Advancing ecological knowledge on elasmobranchs and seabirds to document conservation strategies. Tracking migration corridors, breeding and feeding areas of threatened species in Mediterranean and Black Sea.

Sustainable Seas in Mozambique. Protecting whale sharks & manta rays in Inhambane Province through sustainable fishing practices & marine protected areas. Addresses 98% decline in manta sightings while ensuring livelihoods for local communities in biodiversity hotspot.

Dissemination of Innovative Experiences: Mangroves and Territories. Builds capacity for sustainable mangrove management in Senegal, Guinea Bissau & Guinea through local governance, product valorization & conservation. Addresses deforestation via community engagement & transboundary cooperation.

Sea'ties. Facilitates public policies & adaptation solutions for coastal cities threatened by rising sea levels. Analyzes responses across France, Pacific, West Africa, USA through regional workshops & stakeholder feedback (2021-2023).

Conservation of the Mediterranean Monk Seal at the Wider Area of the National Marine Park of Alonissos Northern Sporades (NMPANS). Protecting endangered monk seals in NMPANS Greece through awareness campaigns, volunteer schemes, eco-friendly fishing tourism, scientific monitoring, and conservation measures to promote human-seal coexistence.

Creation and Management of the First Marine Protected Areas Network in Cambodia. Creating Cambodia's first MPA network across Koh Rong, Koh Sdach & Northern Koh Kong. Protecting 68,485 ha of coral reefs, seagrass & mangroves through participatory management with local fishing communities by 2025.

STOECHAS Project: Improving Knowledge of the Biodiversity of the Port-Cros National Park to Optimise its Management. Biodiversity inventory of Port-Cros National Park's expanded territory (2012). Taxonomic surveys produce management recommendations for preservation, feeding national databases and awareness tools. 2021-2026.

Mediterranean Monk Seal Conservation Program at Cap Blanc. Improving conservation status of endangered Mediterranean monk seals at Cabo Blanco peninsula, Mauritania through monitoring and protection efforts.

Sustainable Management of Tuna Fisheries in the Solomon Islands. Improving tuna fishery sustainability in Solomon Islands through fleet compliance monitoring, bycatch reduction training for fishermen, and technology-based data analysis to protect sea turtles, sharks, rays and marine ecosystems.

Multiannual Monitoring of 3D Printed Artificial Reefs in the Marine Protected Area of the Larvotto. 3D-printed Dolomite reefs immersed in Larvotto MPA (2017) to mimic natural habitats. 4-year study using hyperspectral camera monitored benthos colonization, comparing eco-material to concrete. Results showed colonization comparable to natural rock.

Hammerhead Shark (Sphyrna lewini) Nursery Areas in the Colombian Pacific Coast. Protecting critically endangered hammerhead sharks by identifying nursery areas in Tribugá Gulf using acoustic telemetry, installing 4 receivers, and tagging 20 juvenile sharks to establish conservation strategies.

Conservation of Monk Seal and its Habitats along Mugla and Antalya Provincial Coasts in Turkey. Enhances AFBIKA coastal network for monk seal protection in Turkey. Monitors seal sightings, prevents illegal cave penetrations, mitigates human-seal interactions. Unites stakeholders for endangered species conservation along Mugla-Antalya coasts.

Creating a Protected Swimway for the Endangered Sharks of Galapagos. Protecting migratory sharks & sea turtles between Galapagos & Cocos Islands through tagging studies & advocacy. Tagged 33 species to map migration routes. Led to Ecuador expanding marine reserve by 60,000 km² at COP26.

Survey of the Antarctic Ice Sheet Grounding Line. Mapping Antarctic grounding line retreat via satellite to track ice loss & sea level rise. First comprehensive survey in 15 years of where land ice detaches into ocean, providing vital climate change data.

Local Community Involvement in Coral Reefs Reforestation in the Barú Peninsula Colombian Caribbean National Park. Training local fishermen in coral restoration & ecotourism at Barú Peninsula to restore degraded reefs, reduce harmful fishing practices, create sustainable income through certified guide work with ecohotel partnership.

Ocean Acidification and Hypoxia Impacts on High Latitude Marine Coastal Ecosystems: The Case of the Beagle Channel. Studies how glacier melt & CO2 cause acidification & hypoxia in Beagle Channel, affecting calcifiers & fish. Field/lab experiments + long-term monitoring system. Argentina-Chile collaboration on artisanal fisheries species.

Edinburgh Ocean Leaders Program. Why: Ocean at risk from extractive industries, pollution, overfishing. What: Leadership program for young professionals. How: Connect global young leaders with expert mentors. When: 2020-2022. Where: University of Edinburgh, UK

Addressing the Shark Crisis: Reducing Demand for Shark Fin in Asian Market. WWF expands shark fin demand reduction program to China & Thailand. Engages hotels, restaurants, e-commerce platforms using behavioral study. Tackles illegal trade, tourist consumption. 160+ venues banned shark fin since 2007.

Supporting Research and Strengthening Knowledge of the Port-Cros National Park and Pelagos Sanctuary Territory. Port-Cros National Park supports doctoral research to strengthen biodiversity knowledge across expanded marine/land territory (11 communes) and coordinates French Pelagos Sanctuary. Aims to boost fundamental/applied research.

Narwhal Translational Technologies Expedition. Studies narwhal sensory abilities, especially electric field detection, in Arctic Canada. Combines scientific research with Inuit traditional knowledge to understand tusk function and climate adaptation.

Securing Gyaros MPA Sustainability Through Pioneer Remote Surveillance System. Protects Mediterranean Monk seal habitat on Gyaros island, Greece through remote surveillance system preventing illegal activities. Monitors breeding sites, posidonia beds, coralligenous formations. Builds on CYCLADES project since 2013.

Health Status for Saint-Laurent's Belugas. GREMM studies St. Lawrence belugas via drone photogrammetry & necropsy to understand behavior, habitat, health. Aims to rescue stranded whales, identify threats, prevent extinction through public awareness & adoption program.

Preventing the Extinction of Penguins. 18-month project across Southern Hemisphere (Antarctica, Falklands, South Africa, NZ) to track penguin populations, identify 12 new IBAs, restore habitat for Cape & antipode penguins, expand protected zones by 30km.

Académie de la Mer for a Sustainable Development of the Shark Fin Bay Coral Triangle. Restoring biodiversity in Coral Triangle, Palawan Philippines through community marine protected areas, ending unsustainable fishing, physical reef restoration. Located in world's richest reef area with 80% coral species.

From Science to Solutions: Ocean Acidification Impacts on Ecosystem Services - Case Studies on Coral Reefs. Workshop bringing together natural & social scientists to study ocean acidification impacts on coral reef ecosystem services. Organized by CSM & IAEA, producing policy recommendations presented to Prince of Monaco.

Call for Small Projects geared towards Mediterranean MPAs. MedPAN supports Mediterranean MPA managers with funding for 20 field projects (2017-2019). Focus: integrated coastal management, sustainable funding, climate change adaptation, sustainable tourism/fishing. Priority to replicable multi-MPA initiatives

Building Resilience of Cambodia's Marine Resources and Coastal Communities. Supports Cambodia's first Marine Fisheries Management Area in Koh Rong & Koh Sdach archipelagos. Implements IUU fishing surveillance, sustainable financing, climate adaptation for communities. Protects coral reefs, mangroves, seagrass.

ACCOBAMS Survey Initiative - Cetacean Monitoring. Establishes integrated monitoring of cetacean populations across Mediterranean/Black Sea. Synoptic surveys using ships, aircraft, passive acoustics. Improves conservation via MPAs, fishing integration. 2017-2022.

Launching SIKU across the Canadian Arctic: An Inuit-driven platform for climate change resiliency and self-determination. Inuit-led app/platform for Arctic communities to share environmental observations (ice thickness, tides, satellite data) for climate resilience. Co-developed by Arctic Eider Society with northern communities. Jan 2000, Canadian Arctic.

Mapping & Assessing Global Biodiversity Threats from Climate-Driven Sea Level Rise. Assesses global threats to IUCN Red List species from sea level rise & coastal flooding through habitat submergence & human displacement. Improves elevation data, maps exposed areas under emission scenarios, calculates species range impacts.

Advancing a Network of Marine Protected Areas in the Arctic. Advancing ecologically connected MPAs in Arctic Ocean. Bolstering resilience against warming, sea ice loss, ocean chemistry changes. Leveraging Arctic Council momentum, US/Canada commitments, Russian MPAs, high seas fishing agreement.

Bluefin Tuna in the Mediterranean Sea: Stock Management, Market Supply and Consumer Behaviour. WWF project ensuring sustainable bluefin tuna management at MSY levels, promoting MSC certification for Mediterranean fisheries, improving supply chain traceability, and influencing consumer behavior in European and Japanese markets.

Satellite Monitoring of High Seas Fisheries. Satellite surveillance study examining tuna fishery response to spatial closures in high seas. Legal assessment of satellite data for marine enforcement. Collaboration between Oxford Martin School and OceanMind to monitor MPAs.

Management of the Marine Protected Area of Mohéli. Mohéli National Park protects marine & terrestrial habitats. Monitors marine life, establishes reserves, eliminates destructive fishing, implements sustainable fisheries, tracks climate impacts. 12 coastal villages participate.

High-level Event on Climate-Induced Migration. Oct 2015 conference in Kiribati with leaders from Kiribati, Tuvalu, Tokelau, Monaco. Signed joint environmental protection agreement. Focused on climate migration solutions, calling for global warming action & support for climate refugees.

Monitoring of the Posidonia Meadow in Corsica. Monitoring Posidonia seagrass meadows (55,230 ha) across 6 sites in Corsica using RSP and TEMPO networks. Tracks vitality, conservation status every 3 years. Assesses impacts from anchoring, trawling, piling.

Aquaculture Sustainable Development in Madagascar. Integrating community-based seaweed & sea cucumber aquaculture with locally-managed marine areas to reduce fishing pressure, enhance food security & protect coastal ecosystems in Madagascar through Blue Ventures-University partnership.

Expedition on the Step of Captain G. de Long in the Russian Arctic. Eco-scientific Arctic expedition documenting climate change, following historic explorers' routes. Scientists & artists film rarely visited regions, dive on 1881 Jeannette shipwreck. Sep-Oct 2017.

Revue Marine et Océans. Quarterly publication featuring Prince Albert II Foundation's ocean protection actions in 'Cahier de l'Environnement' section. Digital archives available on Foundation website.

WCRP-FPA2 Polar Challenge. Deploy underwater gliders 2000km+ beneath Arctic/Antarctic ice to measure temperature, salinity, ice thickness. Revolutionize polar ocean observation for climate research, environmental protection, biodiversity, safety.

Coverage of the Second Preparatory Session on BBNJ. UN PrepCom2 on marine biodiversity beyond national jurisdiction, Aug-Sep 2016, NYC. IISD provided information service to raise awareness of outcomes, ensuring transparent access to negotiations on conservation & sustainable use.

Vendicari Nature Reserve. Establishing marine protected area in Sicily's Vendicari Reserve. Ship patrols prevent illegal fishing, pollution, turtle nest disturbance. Educational programs engage residents/tourists in coastal biodiversity conservation.

Proposed Introduction of Seahorses. Institut Paul Ricard reintroduces 2 seahorse species (H. guttulatus & H. hippocampus) into Larvotto Reserve, Monaco. 10-month-old captive-bred seahorses released at 5-15m depth in Posidonia/Cymodocea beds. Monitoring tracks adaptation & offspring.

2016 Forum of Mediterranean MPAs. Forum held Nov-Dec 2016 in Tangier, Morocco with 300 delegates from 35 countries. Reviewed MPA progress, updated roadmap to protect 10% of Mediterranean by 2020, produced Tangier Declaration addressing climate change and sustainable development.

Development and Management of Ponta do Ouro Partial Marine Reserve. Protects turtles & marine resources in Ponta do Ouro reserve through sustainable management, research, community development, eco-tourism & UNESCO World Heritage nomination. Boosts resources, monitoring & local self-sufficiency.

Advancing Conservation of the Arctic Marine. NRDC develops international Arctic MPA network via Arctic Council. Enriches scientific data on biologically active areas, updates species maps, seeks UNESCO World Heritage nomination to protect Arctic marine ecosystems.

Investigation, Protection and Potential Growing of the Shellfish Palasture. Study & protect Pinna Nobilis (fan mussel) in Kotor estuary, Montenegro. Research population in Posidonia meadows, develop conservation regulations, conduct comparative studies in Monaco/France/Spain, raise public awareness.

Wild Touch Expeditions Antarctica. Artists & scientists documented Antarctica's biodiversity & climate change impacts through films, exhibitions, books & e-learning. Laurent Ballesta, Vincent Munier & Christophe Barbraud created multimedia to educate public on polar threats.

MPAs and Climate Change Island Adaptation. IUCN develops adaptation reports for island territories to manage marine protected areas effectively against climate change impacts, analyzing current knowledge, future scenarios, and recommended MPA management procedures.

Solar Arctic Passage. First Northwest Passage crossing attempt using solar-powered kayaks. 3,000km expedition by Raphaël Domjan & Anne Quéméré to demonstrate solar energy potential in polar regions despite adverse weather.

The Map to Paradise. Documentary by Danielle Bryan & James Sherwood exploring underwater paradise, encouraging ocean protection. Features personalities protecting oceans, landscapes reviving hope through unparalleled images & stories. Mar-Dec 2017.

Are Mediterranean MPA efficient against warming effects. Multidisciplinary study of coral species in 3 Mediterranean MPAs (Medes, Scandola, Zembra) developing innovative management methods based on genetics, physiology & positioning to improve conservation of corallogenic species against climate change

Whale Shark Tagging with Satellite Telemetry in the Santuario de Fauna y Flora Malpelo. Tagged 10 whale sharks with satellite trackers in Malpelo Sanctuary, Colombia to study migratory routes and congregation areas, generating data for national/international conservation measures in the Pacific.

The Ocean Solutions Initiative. Evaluates solutions to mitigate climate change & ocean acidification impacts. Creates comprehensive list of mitigation, protection, adaptation & repair solutions with implementation procedures for scientists & climate negotiators.

Tara Corail - Coral Reefs Facing Global Changes. Scientific expedition across Pacific coral reefs studying biodiversity, health, and resilience to climate change from genes to ecosystems, exploring resistance and adaptation of reefs remote from human disturbance.

Sanctuaire Marin National des Palaos. Supporting Palau government to create large-scale marine sanctuary protecting tuna schools and 10% of ocean/coastal areas by 2020. Builds on existing 21 protected sanctuaries and shark sanctuary network.

Pirates des Abysses. Transmedia environmental awareness project using app, comic & series to educate youth on ocean conservation & human impact on marine environment through digital media & fictional storytelling in Monaco

The Oceans 2015 Initiative: An Impact Scenario for COP 21. Expert group translating GHG emissions trajectories into ocean impact scenarios for COP21 Paris. Assessed acidification & warming effects on marine ecosystems to inform climate negotiations & raise awareness.

Operation Basking Shark. Public observation program collecting sightings, photos from coast guards, fishermen to improve scientific knowledge of endangered basking shark distribution in Mediterranean Sea and implement conservation practices. Oct 2011-Jun 2015.

Organisation of a Conference on Aquatic Waste. Conference on plastic pollution in Mediterranean (March 2015, Monaco). 200+ participants from 10 countries discussed solutions, leading to Monaco Declaration & BeMed Task Force creation for awareness & field actions.

Identifying Candidate Marine World Heritage Sites in the Arctic. IUCN & partners evaluate Arctic ecologically significant areas against World Heritage criteria to identify candidate marine sites for enhanced protection, encouraging States to nominate them for formal designation.

Improving the performance of Mediterranean marine protected areas. Why: gaps in MPA performance. What: quantitative synthesis of 20 Mediterranean MPAs. How: questionnaires, site visits analyzing organizational features. When: 2015-2017. Where: Mediterranean Sea

Predicting Human Vulnerability to Ocean Acidification. Integrated spatial assessment identifying global ocean acidification hotspots & vulnerable communities. Maps critical points where OA chemistry is extreme, organisms sensitive, or coastal communities dependent on marine resources.

Towards International Regulation of the Exploitation of Off-Shore Energy. Why: offshore oil accidents threaten marine environment. What: regulatory framework study. How: expert committee producing technical/legal report. When: 2012. Where: global focus, Arctic & West Africa regions.

Smithsonian Deep Reef Observation Project (DROP). Explores Caribbean coral reefs to 300m depth using manned submersible. Discovered 30+ new species of fish/invertebrates. Monitors temperature changes and reef sediments. Aims to document deep reef biodiversity comprehensively.

Marine Protected Areas: Understanding How Levels of Protection Mediate the Flow of Marine Ecosystem Services. Study examining UK Marine Protected Areas protection levels, assessing ecosystem services flows, analyzing interdependence, determining benefits, and studying service supply across MPA networks to conserve habitats and species.

Publication of the Photographic Book on Mediterranean Marine Protected Areas. 272-page photographic book promoting Mediterranean Marine Protected Areas across 15 countries. Showcases MPAs and historic sites to raise public awareness of their role in marine biodiversity conservation and sustainable resource management.

Promoting a High Seas Legal Regime for the Conservation of Biodiversity. Campaign to ensure UN initiates negotiations for international legal instrument under UNCLOS enabling Marine Protected Areas on High Seas, following Rio+20 commitment. Coalition of 27 organizations targeting decision by Sept 2015.

Which Aquaculture for Which Marine Protected Areas. Why: Analyze aquaculture-MPA coexistence. What: Study relationship between aquaculture types (fish, molluscs, algae) and MPA categories. How: Analysis per IUCN management objectives. When: 2015-2016. Where: Worldwide MPAs.

An alternative way of discovering the underwater fauna and flora of the Mediterranean. Augmented reality guidebook for Mediterranean marine species. 150 species with 3D images via smartphone app. Interactive tool for citizen science data collection on marine biodiversity. Monaco-based project.

Develop and implement a responsible tourism campaign to protect Palau's extraordinary biodiversity. Sustainable tourism campaign in Palau archipelago raising awareness about biodiversity fragility, minimizing environmental impact, monitoring tourism development, guaranteeing customer experience while maximizing benefits for local communities.

Creating Cambodia's First Marine Fisheries Managed Area. Establishing Cambodia's first Marine Fisheries Management Area in Koh Rong Archipelago to protect coral reefs, mangroves, and marine life while supporting sustainable livelihoods through capacity building and community engagement.

Tara Méditerranée. Tara expedition studying plastic pollution impact in Mediterranean Sea (May-Nov 2014). Scientific research, public awareness, school visits, artist residencies. Promotes Marine Protected Areas development.

The Crown Jewels. Arctic Ocean ecosystem management project identifying biodiversity-rich areas, ensuring fishing compliance with protective measures, and fostering international scientific cooperation to establish marine protected area networks during critical Arctic

Advancing Conservation of the Arctic Marine Environment. NRDC advances Arctic marine protected areas network during US-Finland Arctic Council chairmanships (2015-2019). Ecosystem-based management to protect Arctic biodiversity facing climate change. Only tiny fraction protected.

Reducing vulnerability of coastal communities in northwestern Madagascar through the creation of marine protected areas. Creating 2 MPAs covering 370,000ha in Nosy Be to protect marine ecosystems & support 4,000 people through sustainable livelihoods & community resource management against climate change impacts.

Call for Small Projects from MedPAN to Support Marine Protected Areas in the Mediterranean. MedPAN supports Mediterranean MPA managers with funding for field projects. Why: improve MPA management. What: small grants for 28 projects. How: financial/technical support. When: 2011-2016. Where: Mediterranean Basin MPAs.

Deep-Sea Trench Landers. Building autonomous underwater vehicles to explore hadal/abyssal zones in Western Pacific trenches. Collecting samples and photos of deep-sea biodiversity. First DOV completed Sept 2012, tested Oct 2012.

Phoenix Islands Protected Area. Research expedition analyzing climate change effects on coral reef biodiversity in PIPA's remote reefs. Studies coral bleaching through sample analysis from 2012 expedition, marking start of 10-year research program in pristine area.

Film: Une réserve, des hommes: quel avenir pour Scandola?. Documentary film highlighting threats to Scandola Reserve, a UNESCO World Heritage marine protected area in Corsica created in 1975, now jeopardized by excessive media coverage and tourism pressure.

Book Atlas des pêcheries du monde. Atlas documenting global marine fish catches, correcting flawed FAO data. Addresses fisheries crisis, food security & overfishing. Research by Sea Around Us project at UBC over 10 years.

Protection of Sea Turtles in the Ponta Ouro Partial Reserve. Protecting endangered sea turtles in Ponta do Ouro Marine Protected Area, Mozambique. Combating population decline from pollution and illegal hunting. Supporting MPA development and UNESCO World Heritage candidacy for Lubombo reserve.

Sea Turtle Release Programme and Community Income Generating Activity (CIGA) for Coastal Villages. Fishermen release accidentally caught sea turtles in exchange for net repair equipment, saving 1,500+ turtles/year. Eco-tourism funds community projects. Testing new nets to reduce bycatch in Kouilou Region, DR Congo.

Ocean Acidification International Reference User Group. Develop IOA-RUG to coordinate international ocean acidification research, capitalize on national programs, and communicate scientific progress to private sector. Based in Monaco under Ocean Acidification Association.

Dispersion, Migration and Connectivity of Osprey Populations. Study osprey migration/dispersion in Mediterranean to assess connectivity between critically endangered populations (Corsica, Balearics, Morocco, Algeria). Track movements to inform conservation measures for this aquatic bird of prey.

Students on Ice. Annual educational expedition to Arctic/Antarctic for Monaco students. Winners of photography/writing competition join 15-day polar trip with scientists to learn about climate change impacts on vulnerable polar ecosystems.

Time bombs beneath the sea. Documentary on 1M tonnes of chemical weapons (mustard gas, nerve agents) dumped in oceans 1912-1972 by industrial/military regimes. Examines current dangers to ecosystem and human health from WWI, WWII, Cold War ammunition.

Arctic Regional Management Approaches. International workshop uniting economic & scientific experts to identify sustainable management measures for Antarctic ecosystems, determine ecologically important areas, and provide policy recommendations.

State and Trends of the Mediterranean Marine Protected Areas System. Study assessing state and trends of Mediterranean MPA system in 2012. MedPAN network promotes exchange between Mediterranean MPAs to improve management efficiency across the region.

Exhibition Méditerranée: Splendide, Fragile, Vivante. Exhibition showcasing Mediterranean biodiversity (10% of marine species in <1% ocean surface) & threats: pollution, overfishing, coastal development. Raises awareness of this fragile sea's exceptional fauna/flora.

The Polar Bear. Scientific symposium & exhibition on polar bears, Arctic sea ice loss & climate change impacts. Experts assessed species status, habitat threats & human interactions. Public awareness event in Monaco opened by Prince Albert II.

Ocean North Campaign: Protecting the Arctic. Campaign to designate Lancaster Sound as National Marine Conservation Area, prohibiting undersea mining, offshore oil, limiting industrial fishing. Protects narwhals, belugas, bowhead whales in nutrient-rich Arctic waters.

Mediterranean Coral Response to Global Change (MEDCORAL). Study of ocean acidification and warming effects on deep-water Mediterranean corals. Research on unique deep-sea ecosystems to predict environmental changes and propose preservation solutions for fragile coral habitats.

Community Marine Protected Area at Helen Reef: Designing a Long-term Sustainable Financing Mechanism. CI supports Hatohobei community in managing Helen Reef atoll as MPA through marine conservation agreement with direct incentives. Designing trust fund mechanism within Micronesia Conservation Trust for long-term financing.

Tara Ocean Polar Circle. Study Arctic marine ecosystems & climate change impacts. Tara ship sailed Arctic Ocean May-Nov 2013, researching polar biodiversity, plastic pollution, & pollutants. Identified fragile areas, promoted protective measures for fishing.

Monk Seal Conservation Promoted Through the Participatory Ecosystem-Based Management in the Aegean Sea. Protecting Mediterranean monk seals (450-510 remaining) at Gyaros Island through Marine Protected Area establishment, ecosystem-based management, and fishermen engagement to reduce threats from fishing interactions and habitat degradation.

Kalabia Initiative on Environmental Education. Floating educational centre 'Kalabia' sails to 100+ villages in Raja Ampat to teach marine conservation to children and young adults, rallying local population to preserve their environment through educational programmes.

Ross Sea Creation of a Marine Protected Area. Lobbying CCAMLR to establish MPA covering Ross Sea continental shelf/slope (2% Southern Ocean). Multi-channel campaign targeting resistant countries (Russia, China) to protect biodiversity-rich Antarctic waters.

Tara Oceans. French expedition analyzing diversity of coral ecosystems & marine plankton (viruses to metazoans) across global oceans. International team of oceanographers, biologists, ecologists studying marine biodiversity since 2009.

Identifying Potential Marine Protected Areas in South Georgia. Using birds & marine predators as indicators to identify & classify biodiversity hotspots in South Georgia & Scotia Sea waters to define management approaches for future marine protected areas in Southern Ocean.

Tropicalization of the Mediterranean Sea. Why: Track climate warming effects. What: Monitor warm/cold water species, mass mortalities. How: 20+ research teams, satellite data, temperature loggers. When: 2008-2014. Where: Mediterranean basin-wide.

Evaluation of the impact of climate change on king penguins by a biologging system. Why: Monitor climate change effects on penguins. What: GPS/biologgers on king penguins. How: Non-disruptive tracking of seasonal/inter-annual environmental variations. When: Jun 2009-Apr 2012. Where: Crozet, sub-Antarctica

The Protection of Endangered Albatross and Petrel Species in the South Indian Ocean. Modeling albatross/petrel sensitivity to climate change & fisheries in Southern Ocean. Analyzing distribution data to suggest offshore conservation measures & marine protected areas for critically endangered seabirds.

Conservation of the Toliara Reef Complex. WWF project to establish marine protected area in Toliara Reef Complex, Madagascar. Protects barrier reefs, mangroves, lagoons. Addresses local socio-economic pressures. Builds on 2005 initiatives for sustainable marine resource use.

The Bluefin Tuna - Save the Mediterranean Bluefin Tuna from Ecological Extinction. Protecting endangered Mediterranean bluefin tuna through sustainable fishing, DNA labeling, tagging research, establishing high seas sanctuaries, and working with ICCAR for quota compliance. Location: Mediterranean Basin & East Atlantic.

800 young people from Marseilles social centers will discover marine environment. CMA CGM initiative enabling 800 youth from Marseilles social centers to discover and learn about the marine environment through educational programs in the Mediterranean coastal city.

Ending Illegal Fishing Project. Pew worked 12+ years building global systems to combat illegal fishing through government partnerships, enforcement, and international agreements. Addressed unreported catches, illegal gear, unlicensed fishing. Merged 2019.

Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy - Kermadec Islands. Establishing large-scale MPA around Kermadec Rangitāhua region (1,000km NE of New Zealand) to protect unique underwater volcanoes, ocean trench, marine life & honor Maori cultural significance. Awaiting Parliamentary debate since 2010s.

Conserving Life in Canada's Oceans. Protected Canada's Atlantic, Pacific, Arctic ocean biodiversity through marine protected areas, Arctic safeguards, fisheries conservation. Partnered with Indigenous communities, scientists, government. Ended 2023, continued as Conservation Canada.

South Georgia and South Sandwich Islands Marine Protection. Enhancing marine protections around South Georgia & South Sandwich Islands to protect world's largest concentration of marine species, including 95% of Antarctic fur seals, 100M seabirds, whales in nutrient-rich Antarctic waters.

Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy - Eastern Tropical Pacific Marine Corridor. Supporting transboundary marine protections across Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Panama. Creating 500,000 sq km biosphere reserve connecting MPAs to protect migratory species, sharks, turtles, whales in biodiversity hotspot.

Arctic Ocean International. Treaty closing Central Arctic Ocean to commercial fishing for 16+ years. Protects ecosystem while scientists study changing environment and marine life to determine if sustainable fishing possible. Signed 2018, enforced 2021.

Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy - Revillagigedo. Created 148,087 km² Revillagigedo Archipelago National Park off Mexico in 2017. Protected 4 volcanic islands with 366 fish species, 28 shark species, sea turtles, whales. Provided technical support for reserve establishment.

Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy - French Southern Lands and Antarctic Territories. Supporting expansion of marine protections in TAAF to preserve wilderness areas hosting largest concentrations of marine birds/mammals including albatross, bigeye tuna, sharks, whales, penguins in Indian and Southern oceans.

Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy - Ascension Island. Protecting 443,000 sq km of Ascension Island's waters in South Atlantic. Safeguards endemic species, green turtles, seabirds. UK committed to MPA designation March 2019. Supports fisheries and tourism.

Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy Northern Mariana Islands. Working with Northern Mariana communities to improve management and enhance protections for Mariana Trench Marine National Monument, established 2009. Includes Islands, Volcanic, and Trench units protecting rare marine life.

Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy French Polynesia. Collaborated with Austral & Marquesas Islands communities to establish large-scale marine reserves in French Polynesia's 5M km² EEZ. Proposed 1M km² Austral reserve & 430K km² Marquesas reserve, working with locals, scientists & govt since 2013.

Protecting Antarctica's Southern Ocean. Establishing large-scale marine protected areas around Antarctica through CCAMLR to protect unique species and ecosystems threatened by climate change. Network of MPAs to safeguard penguins, krill, and endemic wildlife.

Pew Marine Fellows Program. Global fellowship supporting 7 leading scientists in marine conservation research. Projects span coral restoration, fisheries management, plastic pollution, kelp forests, harmful algal blooms, seafood traceability, and international fisheries law.

Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy New Caledonia. Advocating for highly protected marine reserve in New Caledonia's Natural Park of the Coral Sea to preserve 1.3M km² EEZ with 1,700+ fish species and 473 coral species for future generations.

Conservation Canada. Pew works with Indigenous leaders and policymakers to conserve ocean areas and boreal forest in Canada, protecting marine and terrestrial habitats through partnerships like Enduring Earth and Blue Nature Alliance.

Reducing Harmful Fisheries Subsidies. Advocates for WTO fisheries subsidies agreement ratification to reduce $22B annual harmful subsidies promoting overfishing. Works with members, scientists to reform payments enabling unsustainable industrial fishing globally.

Seabed Mining Project. Advocates for environmental safeguards to protect deep ocean ecosystems from seabed mining. Focuses on International Seabed Authority regulations for mining beyond national jurisdiction. Protects biodiversity in deep-sea habitats.

Ocean Governance. Pew works with governments and stakeholders to develop global ocean policies addressing fisheries subsidies, high seas protection, 30x30 biodiversity targets, and deep-sea mining regulation through international cooperation.

International Fisheries. Combating overfishing and IUU fishing globally. Works with governments, RFMOs, and partners to improve fisheries management, protect marine biodiversity, and ensure sustainable fishing through science-based strategies.

Orpheus: The First Steps Towards Exploring Ocean Worlds. Deep sea vehicle deployment to Northeast Canyons and Seamounts Marine National Monument. Testing otherworldly exploration technology for ocean floor research in Fall 2018.

Protecting Ocean Life on the High Seas. UN treaty adopted June 2023 to create high seas marine protected areas network. Pew partners with governments, scientists to implement treaty, establish first MPAs by 2030, protect biodiversity, combat climate change and overfishing.

Hunting for the Humboldt Squid. Marine expedition tracking Humboldt squid behavior and distribution in Chilean waters to understand their ecology and role in ocean ecosystems through scientific observation and documentation.

Mission Antarctica. Antarctic marine research expedition exploring ocean ecosystems, marine life, and environmental conditions in Antarctic waters through scientific investigation and storytelling to drive ocean conservation.

The Maiden Voyage: Illuminating The Red Sea. OceanX's maiden mission investigating how species in the Red Sea thrive in extreme conditions where others would die. Oceanographers and scientists explored unique marine adaptations in this challenging environment.

Mission: Galapagos. OceanX reveals the Galapagos Archipelago to the world over a century after Darwin's Beagle journey. Partnership with WHOI and Atlantic Productions to explore and document marine ecosystems.

United Arab Emirates (UAE) 2023. Multidisciplinary survey of UAE waters using eDNA, seafloor mapping, and submersibles to establish biodiversity baselines for MPA design and sustainable fisheries management in Abu Dhabi and Fujairah.

Azores 2023. OceanX explored Azores seamounts, mapped 5,000 sq km seafloor, conducted 46 ROV dives, collected 38 eDNA samples. Data informed 3 MPA designations (Princess Alice Bank, Dom João de Castro, Pico Island) in Oct 2024, protecting 287,000 sq km.

Environmental DNA in Ocean Exploration. Using DNA to crack the case of the deep sea. Partnership with Gloucester Marine Genomics Institute to analyze environmental DNA samples for ocean exploration and marine life detection in Massachusetts waters.

New Depths, New Discoveries - 2024 Annual Report. OceanX 2024 exploration missions across Indonesia, Malaysia, Seychelles, and Singapore. Marine research and discovery expeditions documenting ocean life and ecosystems through science and storytelling.
Tagging a Bluntnose Six-Gill Shark. Deep-sea shark tagging project to study bluntnose six-gill shark behavior and movement patterns through scientific tracking technology in ocean environments.

Brine Pools. Exploring underwater brine pools - unique extreme environments on the ocean floor that host specialized marine life and provide insights into deep-sea ecosystems and astrobiology research.

Red Sea 2022 Expedition. OceanX explored Red Sea mesophotic reefs, brine pools, canyons. Discovered new species, shark behaviors, coral-algae symbiosis. Mapped 69,254 sq km seafloor. Partnered with Saudi researchers to inform conservation and fisheries.

Seychelles 2024 Deep-Sea Exploration and Marine Conservation. Deep-sea mapping & biodiversity research in Seychelles using ROVs, submersibles, BRUVS, eDNA. Mapped 22,555 km² seafloor, conducted deepest dives (4,603m), trained local scientists. Supports MPA planning & fisheries management. Jan-Feb 2024.

Search For The Giant Squid. Expert team captures first live images of giant squid in deep waters off Japan's Ogasawara Archipelago. Partnership with Japan's National Museum of Nature and Science to document this elusive deep-sea species.
Coral Core Drilling. Mission to understand climate change impact on coral reef ecosystems in Western Pacific Warm Pool through core drilling. Partnership with WHOI in Micronesia, Fall 2012.

Sperm Whale Research. Groundbreaking complete study of Kaikoura sperm whales. Partnership with Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution to research sperm whale populations and behavior in New Zealand coastal waters.

Creatures of Light: Biofluorescence. Marine biofluorescence research project studying light-emitting organisms. OceanX explores ocean creatures that glow, documenting and analyzing biofluorescent marine life to advance scientific understanding.

Indonesian Coastal Communities Lead Efforts to Protect Thriving Oceans. West Papua communities establish marine protected areas, seasonal closures, and local patrols to protect coral reefs and fisheries. Women's groups manage resources, earning funds for education while preserving traditional fishing grounds.

New Marine Sanctuary in Galapagos Islands. 39,000 sq km no-take zone around Darwin & Wolf islands protects world's highest shark concentrations, sea turtles, whales. Supports dive tourism. Created 2016 with CI technical assistance after decade of Foundation support.

Gulf of California Fishing Refuges Network. Niparajá creates no-take fishing refuges with local fishermen in Gulf of California. 30% more biomass in refuges after 5 years. Expanding model nationally through policy development. Protects small-scale fisheries and communities.

Protect Habitat. Oceana campaigns to protect ocean habitats from destructive fishing like bottom trawling. Works toward 30% ocean protection by 2030. Has protected 4M+ sq miles of habitat across coastal ecosystems globally.

Transparency in Fisheries - Combating Illegal Fishing. Global campaign to stop illegal, unreported, unregulated fishing through transparency & traceability. Launched Global Fishing Watch in 2016 to track 80,000 vessels in near-real time, deterring illegal activity worldwide.

Responsible Aquaculture Campaign. Campaign to ensure responsible ocean-based fish farming globally. Addresses seafloor habitat damage, pollution from pesticides/waste, harmful algal blooms, fish escapes, and sea lice outbreaks documented since 2000.

Responsible Fishing Campaign. Oceana campaigns for science-based policies to stop overfishing in countries controlling 25% of global wild fish catch. Works to increase fisheries with management plans and catch limits to rebuild ocean abundance.

Feed the World. Oceana partners with small-scale fishing communities to protect livelihoods, increase local fish access, and amplify their voices in policy. Addresses illegal fishing, limited management, and climate impacts on fisheries.

Climate and Energy - Protecting Oceans from Offshore Drilling. Oceana campaigns to stop offshore drilling expansion, protect 75,000 miles of US & Belize coastline, promote offshore wind, rebuild fisheries, reduce single-use plastics. Targets 30% of oil/gas production from offshore areas.

Deep-Sea Coral Gardens Protected in U.S. State of California. Sur Ridge off Monterey, CA protected from bottom fishing. Home to deep-sea corals, rockfish, sea stars. New regulations support coral research and restoration. Victory achieved Dec 2025 via Oceana campaign.

Deep-Sea Mining Moratorium and Ban Campaign. Oceana advocates for complete ban on mining hydrothermal vents/cobalt crusts and moratorium on polymetallic nodule mining until robust regulations exist. Protects fragile deep-sea ecosystems from irreparable damage in high seas areas.

Oceana Plastics Campaign - Reducing Single-Use Plastic Pollution. Oceana campaigns to reduce 33B lbs annual ocean plastic by passing policies eliminating 1.46M metric tons single-use plastics by 2033, targeting production at source through refillable systems globally.

Refillables Campaign. Oceana campaigns for major beverage companies to increase refillable bottles to combat ocean plastic pollution. 21-34B plastic bottles enter oceans yearly. 10% increase in refillables by 2030 could eliminate 1T single-use bottles.

U.S. State of California Approves Pop-Up Gear to Reduce Whale Entanglements. California approved ropeless pop-up gear for Dungeness crab fishing (Apr 1-Jul 15) to protect humpback whales from entanglement. Oceana campaigned for years, testing whale-safe alternatives to conventional vertical line gear.

Protect Species - Reduce Bycatch and Save Endangered Ocean Wildlife. Oceana campaigns to protect endangered ocean species by reducing bycatch from fishing gear. Banned shark fin trade in US/Canada. Protects whales, dolphins, sea turtles, sharks. 75+ victories won globally.

Amazon Plastic Packaging Reduction Campaign. Oceana advocates for Amazon to eliminate single-use plastic packaging globally. Campaign targets 33B lbs annual ocean plastic pollution. Amazon reduced plastic 11.6% (2021-22), eliminated air pillows, but must commit to reuse systems.

Spain Strengthens Rules on Fishing Vessel Engines to Protect Fisheries. Spain approved new law strengthening fishing vessel engine regulations to combat power fraud. Improves oversight, requires technical verification, enables accurate capacity reporting after 94% of Mediterranean vessels found with illegal engines.

AADIA - Recyclage plastique et éducation environnementale. AADIA promotes sustainable development education and plastic recycling through manual processes. Targets schools, associations, local authorities, and businesses to reduce marine plastic pollution in Togo.

ACPCR - Cantonnement de Pêche du Cap Roux. Implements fishing reserve at Cap Roux, Saint-Raphaël (Var). Develops surveillance, awareness, communication projects to promote the reserve's ecological, tourist & economic value. Created Feb 2016.

Association pour la Pêche et les Activités Maritimes (APAM). Promotes sustainable small-scale coastal fishing in Mediterranean. Created 2009 to balance economic development with marine ecosystem preservation through integrated coastal zone management.

Association Théo Mavrostomos. Marine conservation association supported by Fondation de la Mer's 'Un Geste pour la Mer' program. Details on specific activities, location and timeline not provided on page.

AXA Atout Coeur. Marine conservation initiative supported by AXA Atout Coeur foundation. Part of 'Un Geste pour la Mer' program promoting ocean protection through partnerships with engaged organizations in France.

Association Hirondelle - Action Littoral. Cleanup operations on beaches, lakes, rivers in Pays de Retz Atlantique. Raises awareness about aquatic waste from human activity. Participates in World CleanUp Day, European Waste Reduction Week, World Oceans Day.

AVATH - Beach Cleanup Program. AVATH organizes beach cleanups in Toulon area for social inclusion of disabled residents. Multiple events at La Seyne-sur-Mer, Carqueiranne, and Toulon beaches collecting marine debris.

Agirrr - Weekly Beach Cleanup Plogging Events. Weekly citizen plogging cleanups at Opéra Beach, Nice. Accessible to all, provides gloves & bags. Raises awareness about waste pollution through action. Sundays 10-11am at Quai des Etats-Unis.
ARVIK Ocean. Sailing missions for ocean protection, coastal cleanup, and public awareness. Activities at sea, on shore, and educational workshops about human impact on marine environment.
Atelier des Recycleurs Fous. Marine conservation project supported by Fondation de la Mer focusing on ocean plastic pollution reduction through recycling initiatives and environmental education.

Aggloplast. Marine conservation association listed in Fondation de la Mer's directory of engaged actors fighting plastic pollution in oceans. Part of 'Un Geste pour la Mer' program supporting marine protection initiatives.

Apprentis d'Auteuil Mayotte. Youth education & training program in Mayotte for ages 8-29. Provides schooling, social cohesion, educational assistance & prevention for young people & families in difficulty. Part of Un Geste pour la Mer network.

Agence de Recherche pour la Biodiversité à La Réunion. Marine & terrestrial biodiversity monitoring in Réunion & Indian Ocean. Conducts inventories, scientific research, database contributions, beach cleanups & public awareness workshops. Feeds national biodiversity databases.

Association AL LARK - Protection des baies du Mont-Saint-Michel et de Saint-Malo. Découverte du patrimoine naturel des baies du Mont-Saint-Michel et Saint-Malo, suivi scientifique des cétacés en Bretagne nord, nettoyages de plages. 3200 adhérents, nombreux bénévoles. Basée à Cancale.

Association Recyclerie Maritime. Circular economy hub for maritime sector. Extends nautical equipment life through upcycling and awareness. Social, ecological, solidarity-focused. Beach cleanups in Le Croisic.

Association Estuairez-vous. Promotes Loire estuary & coast through free guided tours, conferences, exhibitions. Educational activities for public & children year-round. Environmental education & heritage awareness for all ages since 2016.

Association Saalum Recyclean. Promotes eco-responsible practices in Kaolack, Senegal. Provides sustainable solutions to plastic waste management through beach cleanups and citizen engagement. Active in national waste reduction efforts.

Association Sauvegarde du Littoral des Orpellières et du Biterrois. Protection & valorization of Mediterranean coastal biodiversity through environmental education & scientific monitoring of wildlife in Hérault wetlands. Focus on coastal zone conservation & sustainable development.

Association Al Marjane pour la Plongée et Sports Nautiques. Professional divers remove plastic waste from Atlantic seabed in Salé, Morocco. Youth education in diving, swimming & ocean protection. Part of B7arBlaPlastic campaign since 2019. Awards from Princess Lalla Hasnaa.

Atelier Bleu – CPIE Cote Provencale. Environmental education & sustainable development since 1984. Organizes beach cleanups, educational programs for schools, public events, professional training. Focus on reducing environmental impact through eco-responsible behaviors.

Autrement Plastique Marseille. Marseille plastic reduction project. Installs collection points, educates on reducing/reusing/recycling plastic waste. Transforms plastic waste into resources, giving second life to marine & urban plastic pollution.

Audencia Voile - Navigation Éco-Responsable Zéro Déchet. Student sailing association organizing eco-responsible zero-waste navigation in Greece (Oct 23-30, 2021) using anti-pollution trawls and waste collection missions at sea and on land to promote responsible sailing.

BLUE Sea & Océan. Network preserving Mediterranean seas via beach cleanups, recycling marine plastics into eco-products, and publishing So.BLUE newsletter. Started 2020, focuses on coastal depollution and circular economy for blue sustainability.

Batela Mokili. Marine conservation project supported by Fondation de la Mer through 'Un Geste pour la Mer' program. Details on specific activities, location and timeline not available from provided page content.

BEST RUN. Student-led association at La Réunion University since 2018. Organizes beach cleanups, natural site restoration, and educational outings to protect tropical biodiversity. Activities include waste collection and awareness conferences.
Babidi Boo. Youth association fighting pollution & animal abandonment. Participates in public events. Based in La Teste-de-Buch, France. Focuses on ecology, animal welfare & events.

Blue Project. Engineering students' sailing mission (July 2024) for ocean protection awareness. Focuses on scientific research, environmental action, and social engagement through maritime education and coastal conservation.

Bulle de Mer. Installing tech in ports (pollution robots), retention nets at stormwater outlets, waste baskets in drains across NW France to capture, quantify, sort & recycle waste before ocean entry, preserving marine biodiversity.

Bleu Gorgone. Preserves marine environment through underwater, buried & beached waste collection operations. Conducts awareness campaigns for marine preservation & supports participatory science projects. French Riviera coastal cleanups.

Breizh Ocean Cleaner. Preserves ocean & Brittany coasts via waste cleanups on foot, SUP & freediving. Organizes events at Keremma, La Palue, La Torche beaches. Part of Un geste pour la Mer network.

Bural de l'Hydro. Marine conservation association listed in Fondation de la Mer's directory of engaged actors. Part of 'Un Geste pour la Mer' program supporting marine protection initiatives in France.

Capp Environnement. Marine conservation association listed in Fondation de la Mer's directory of engaged actors. Part of 'Un Geste pour la Mer' program supporting organizations protecting ocean biodiversity and fighting pollution.

CERBEREA JAMAIS. Environmental protection group in Cerbère organizing beach cleanups and awareness campaigns. Part of Sentinelles de la Mer Occitanie network. Fights for zero waste and plastic-free seas through community events and education.

CIETM. Collective coordinating marine & terrestrial biodiversity projects from Toulon to Saint-Tropez. Focus: sustainable development, environmental education, public policy support for coastal territories.
CHAUVE PROPRE. Cleanup operation in Chauvé commune (44) France during World Cleanup Day on September 19, 2020. Community-led waste collection initiative supported by Fondation de la Mer's network.

Clean Up The Waves. Surf & ecology project combining e-bike trips along French coast with beach cleanups. Shows off-season beach pollution tourists don't see. Hossegor to Vielle-Saint-Girons route, 2-week official journey planned.

COALLIA - Surf Pour Tous. Surf Pour Tous project by COALLIA's specialized care home in Dinan. Promotes connection between the sea and people with disabilities through surfing activities, respecting human dignity and solidarity values.

COCO AN DLO. Marine education for children 4-17 through swimming lessons and environmental awareness. Teaches ocean discovery, pollution impacts on wildlife, and nature protection through innovative playful programs in aquatic environments.

CPECD - Conservation Project. Marine conservation association supported by Fondation de la Mer through 'Un Geste pour la Mer' program. Details on specific activities, location and timeline not provided on page.

CÔTE À CÔTE. 2025km Atlantic coast journey (Hendaye-Zuydcoote) via 10 sports, Aug-Oct 2025. Supports seabird conservation (LPO partnership), waste collection, disability causes. 50 athletes, citizen engagement, media campaign, documentary.

CPIE Bassin de Thau. Network promoting sustainable development in Thau Basin through environmental education, biodiversity protection, beach cleanups, and marine waste collection. Activities include BioLit surveys and underwater debris removal.

Cearcall. Cearcall fights ocean plastic crisis & land pollution in Perpignan. Individual actions collectively change the world. Public interest company committed to ending plastic waste through cleanup & awareness.

Centre de découverte de la baie - Baie Propre. Baie Propre organizes waste collection in Mont Saint Michel Bay. Created within the Maison de la Baie, it manages cleanup operations to protect this coastal ecosystem.

Centre Virginie Heriot - Marine Education and Conservation. Marine education center hosting students year-round for sea classes. Teaches ocean protection through waste collection, sorting activities, and marine knowledge to protect oceans.
Citeco 66. Volunteer beach cleanup operations in Canet-en-Roussillon. Organizes regular cleanups of sensitive coastal sites to remove marine debris and protect Mediterranean biodiversity.

CleanMyNature. Association founded by young people from Var organizing regular cleanups to fight pollution in natural environments. Part of 'Un geste pour la Mer' network. Active in coastal Mediterranean region.
Collectif Les Argonautes. Ocean education & awareness through visual content & field actions. Meets marine actors (NGOs, scientists, fishers) to give voice to the sector & build ocean community.
Collecta Coll. Startup collecting aquatic waste using biomimetic aquadrone technology. Targets pollution in water bodies through innovative autonomous collection systems.

CleanMyIsland. Guadeloupe waste cleanup. Organizes beach/coastal cleanups across archipelago to protect marine flora/fauna and tourism. Mobilizes citizens via social media. Events in Le Moule, Sainte Rose, Désirade since 2019.

Collège Albert Camus Grâces - Classe à Enjeux Maritimes. Maritime awareness class for 9th graders in Grâces (Guingamp). Educates 420 students about France's maritime power and ocean challenges: ecological, economic, geopolitical. Develops ocean literacy for future citizens.

Projet Tangaroa - Collège de Yaté. Students in New Caledonia conduct marine science aboard catamaran Nautilus 360°, analyzing environmental DNA and underwater observation to develop practical skills and environmental awareness.
Clean my Calanques. Marseille coastal cleanup org. Hiking cleanups in calanques since 2017, waste valorization partnerships, youth education. 84 events, 50+ tons collected, 70k+ social followers.

Comité départemental des pêches maritimes et des élevages marins des Alpes-Maritimes. Private law organization managing maritime fisheries and marine aquaculture in Alpes-Maritimes. Represents fishing professionals and co-manages sector with French State through elected industry representatives.

Crab'océan. Student project deploying autonomous crab-shaped robots to collect and sort beach litter at Huveaune beach, Marseille. Robots operate at night or during public events with human collaboration.

Coral Restoration St Barth. Restoring damaged coral reefs in St. Barthélemy with genetically diverse corals. Installing tide pools for marine debris collection, researching invasive species, tracking drifting FADs from African seiners impacting cetaceans and reefs.

Commun vivant - River Plastic Pollution Awareness. Pau-based association organizes river cleanup events to raise awareness about plastic pollution in waterways. Focuses on environmental education through hands-on waste collection activities along rivers.

Corsica Clean Nature. Beach & trail cleanup in Corsica. Public awareness campaigns on nature conservation. Organizes regular coastal cleanups at locations like Stagnola, Terre Sacrée, Port Tino Rossi beaches.

c'est ma nature. Environmental education in Narbonne region: raises awareness about coastal biodiversity, waste, climate change, sea level rise through workshops, nature outings, beach cleanups for schools and public.

DEMAIN C'EST AUJOURD'HUI. Association protecting environment, biodiversity & fighting pollution. Focus on sustainable development & marine conservation. Part of Un geste pour la Mer network supported by Fondation de la Mer.

Club Nautique de la Croisette. Encourages sailing & nautical activities, develops love for recreational navigation. Builds friendship among people interested in the sea. Part of Un geste pour la Mer network.

DECOS ENVIRONNEMENT - Nettoyage du littoral. Beach cleanups since 2014 in Le Croisic, Batz-sur-mer, Le Pouliguen. Removes waste to protect water quality and marine ecosystems. Raises awareness among residents and tourists about ocean pollution impact.

E.S.T.R.A.N.. Norman maritime heritage education & conservation. Museum welcomes 35k visitors/year. Beach cleanups, coastal erosion monitoring, biodiversity tracking, natural site maintenance. Social integration workshops. Dieppe, France.
Dunkerque Clean Up. Student-founded association fighting plastic pollution in Dunkerque through beach, port & street cleanups, plus prevention & awareness programs in schools & businesses.

ECOSCIENCE PROVENCE. Scientific association for environmental preservation since 2005. Focuses on circular economy, sustainable consumption & tourism in Provence. Aims to reduce waste & preserve resources through community projects.

ENGIE - Un geste pour la Mer. ENGIE accelerates carbon-neutral transition through energy-efficient solutions. Partners with Fondation de la Mer for marine waste collection events, combining economic performance with positive environmental impact.

ECOWAVE - Roca Cup. Eco-responsible wingfoil competition promoting marine preservation through low-tech, zero-waste events. Includes workshops on nautical equipment recycling, beach cleanups, and public awareness activities.

Echo-Mer. Ocean conservation through collection of used materials (boat sails, corks, oyster bags, neoprene). Educational programs for schools and public. Founded 2001 in La Rochelle after transatlantic voyage.

ESCALE BRETAGNE. Marine education programs on Brittany & Normandy coasts since 2013. Activities: discovery classes, beach cleanups, intertidal zone studies, plankton workshops. Serves children, teens, adults. Active in REEB network.

Explore & Preserve - Marine Debris Collection & Awareness. Collective organizing aquatic waste cleanups, awareness campaigns in Hyères-les-Palmiers. Targets plastic pollution, engages local actors (sailing schools, divers, fishermen). Summer focus in fragile coastal area.

Ecole G. Brassens - Classe de mer à Leucate. 85 élèves de CP de Baillargues (10km du littoral) en classe de mer à Leucate du 13-17 mai 2024. Sensibilisation au milieu marin pour responsabiliser et inciter à la protection de l'environnement côtier.

Eaux Cristallines - Lutte contre les déchets marins. Fights marine debris at source through education, beach cleanups, corporate CSR actions, and digital awareness. Promotes circular economy in schools, sports/cultural events. Shares expertise on effective pollution prevention strategies.

Ecolo'Jade - Protection du littoral brévinois. Beach & city cleanups, awareness campaigns on marine ecology in Saint-Brévin. Organizes public debates on environmental issues, eco-friendly events (races, flea markets) to combat climate change & preserve coastal areas.

Échos d'Océans. Cleans inaccessible coastal zones where pollution accumulates. Organizes impactful cleanup actions in Marseille & St Florent to raise awareness. Focuses on hard-to-reach areas ignored by others.

Ensemble pour la Protection du Littoral Antibois. Since 2015, coastal & seabed cleanup in Antibes mobilizing hundreds annually. Educational programs with schools, businesses. Removes significant waste volumes, promotes marine conservation through citizen action.

Environat - Marine Education and Waste Monitoring. Environmental education & scientific monitoring in Charente Maritime. Beach cleanups & waste characterization with schools/families on Gironde estuary to Côte Sauvage coast, tracking waste from land to sea.

Explore Océan - Expéditions Cétacés. Whale watching expeditions collecting plastic waste at sea. Passengers discover cetaceans in natural habitat while crew removes marine debris, protecting these animals from plastic pollution threats.

Expédition MED. Scientific research expeditions studying plastic pollution in Mediterranean since 2010. Citizen science lab, educational exhibitions, identifying waste sources to develop sustainable solutions across Mediterranean countries.

Expédition Pelagos par Alban Mauzac. 750km kayak expedition through Pelagos Sanctuary collecting marine debris with local NGOs. Raises awareness about consumption impact on marine environment. Started July 2021 in Mediterranean.
Expedition 7° Continent. Marine expeditions researching ocean plastic pollution & ecosystem impact. Studies marine populations affected by plastic waste through scientific field research at sea.
Ethic Ocean. Environmental org preserving oceans & resources. Works with ocean professionals to initiate & support sustainable practices. Part of Un geste pour la Mer network.

Exocéan. Network uniting marine project leaders since 2015. Facilitates exchange of scientific, educational & maritime skills. Focuses on protection, awareness, research & education for marine environment & coastlines.
Fils & Plastic. Sensibiliser à la pollution plastique via ateliers ludiques de recyclage et éco-conception. Collecter et ramasser déchets plastiques. Réseau upcycling pour protéger l'océan.

FRIOUL TERRE DES ARTISTES. Guided discovery walks on Frioul islands (Marseille) focusing on endemic flora, wildlife, military/sanitary history. Aims to defend fragile island environment through education and cultural events for schools, groups, enterprises.

Fondation de la Mer. Protects marine ecosystems, fights ocean pollution, supports research & innovation, educates public. Programs include biodiversity protection, plastic pollution reduction, research grants, waste collections.

GAIA FIRST - Ocean Plastic Cleanup & Upcycling. International NGO collecting floating plastic from oceans, transforming waste into green energy via self-sustaining system. Organizes cleanup events like Paris 2022. Aims to restore oceans from pollution.

Guyane Plages Propres. Volunteer association in French Guiana acting on 4 axes: depollution, development, awareness, and advising local authorities to preserve the region's exceptional marine biodiversity.

Generation Recycleur Nautisurf. Transform beach plastic waste into everyday objects. Monthly beach cleanups, waste sorting, school awareness programs. Recycle 100% local plastic into durable products, reducing virgin plastic demand.

HORIZONS Naviguer et Partager. Sailing French coasts from Lorient to raise ocean awareness. 24 coastal cities, 4-day events on waste management & 5R rule. Targets families & professionals for responsible consumption. Beach cleanups & community engagement.

Green Sailing Generation. Eco-responsibility program for young sailing competitors in Marseille. Monitors pollution, organizes sea/land cleanups, minimizes ecological impact of competitive sailing. Active since 2023 with regular cleanup events in Marseille bay.

Imarinair. Marine conservation through beach cleanups and youth education in Fréjus. Imagining sustainable future for marine ecosystems. Organizes waste collection events and awareness campaigns along French Mediterranean coast.

Hô-üt - Coastal Cleanup and UNESCO Heritage Protection. Preserves UNESCO World Heritage coastal areas in Touho, New Caledonia through beach cleanups. Organizes waste collection events in tribal areas of Koé, Pouiou, and Ponandou bay to protect marine biodiversity.

I Clean My Sea Association. Fights marine plastic pollution via mobile apps for real-time waste detection, small cleanup vessels for river mouths, drone tools, citizen mobilization, and data collection to inform policy. Active since Jan 2025 in estuaries.

Herocean. Association created 2023 by 3 women for ocean preservation & environmental wellbeing. Mobilizes community to support concrete initiatives protecting marine biodiversity & building sustainable future.

Heol Expedition. Scientific sailing expeditions studying ocean ecosystems and threats. Educational program for schools. Shares findings via social media to raise awareness about marine preservation. Past beach cleanup Sept 2024.

Instinct Durable. Marine conservation association listed in Fondation de la Mer's directory of engaged actors. Part of 'Un Geste pour la Mer' program supporting ocean protection initiatives in France.

Hurakaan Eco-Tactica. Mexican NGO conserving marine ecosystems via coral restoration, water treatment, and environmental education for vulnerable youth in Riviera Maya. Combines reef restoration with job training in marine tourism.

J'❤️ ma mer - 30h pour la Méditerranée. Corsican association fighting Mediterranean pollution through school education programs and beach cleanup bins. Engages primary schools, college students in beach cleanups, and installs collection bins along coast.

Victory Group - Un Geste pour la Mer. French law firm supporting marine conservation through Un Geste pour la Mer network. Promotes ecological initiatives aligned with firm's ethics and human values. Paris-based partner in ocean protection efforts.
Iodysséus. Sailing oceanographic program conducting scientific research, education & environmental actions for ocean knowledge & preservation. Combines sailing expeditions with scientific mediation.

ITLAW Avocats - Un Geste pour la Mer. Legal support for marine conservation through ITLAW Avocats, part of Fondation de la Mer's network of engaged actors protecting ocean biodiversity and fighting plastic pollution.

KEENAT - Keeping our Nature. Social enterprise collecting & recycling urban plastic waste (cigarette butts, masks, chewing gum) to raise awareness about plastic pollution & drive behavior change in Talence, France.

Kiosques à Eau. Installing water kiosks in France to eliminate single-use plastic bottles. Each kiosk prevents 900k bottles/year from reaching waterways and oceans. Pilot project testing Italian concept since 2010.

L'Expédition Bleue. 2-year sailing expedition collecting microplastics, water data, ichthyoplankton samples & cetacean recordings for French labs. Educational workshops on ocean pollution in schools globally. Founded 2020.

LES MARCHEURS CUEILLEURSASsociation. Organizes collective & family waste cleanups with schools, businesses & communities. Acts as pollution watchdog. Part of Un geste pour la Mer network.

La Consigne Maintenant. Citizens' collective advocating for beverage container deposit-return system in France to prevent plastic bottles, metal cans, glass bottles from polluting aquatic environments. Aims for 2023 implementation.

L'Odyssée Bleue. Stéphane Mifsud explores seas/oceans aboard sailboat 11-35, collaborating with scientists on underwater research. Conducts voyages, training stages, environmental missions to study marine life and raise public awareness.

La Transat AG2R LA MONDIALE. Double-handed sailing race since 1992 on equal Figaro Bénéteau 3 boats. 2020 edition starts April 19 from Concarneau, promoting mixed crews for Paris 2024 Olympics preparation where offshore racing debuts.

La Tribu Maritime. Protects coastal environment by reducing ecological footprint of maritime activities through 3R approach (Reduce/Reuse/Recycle). Creates maritime resource center in Port Saint-Louis-du-Rhône for collection, valorization of nautical waste.

Le Plastique C'est Dramatique. Prevents 80% of ocean plastic pollution from land sources. Collects waste from waterways before reaching oceans. Protects biodiversity through field cleanups in southern France coastal areas.

Loumé - Bijoux en Plastique Recyclé. French jewelry brand transforms recycled plastic into refined ocean-inspired pieces. Reduces plastic pollution, gives waste second life. Future profits support planetary preservation associations.

la Tortue qui secoue le Monde. Environmental protection movement organizing coastal cleanups and actions for nature conservation and biosphere balance. Part of 'Un geste pour la Mer' network supporting marine ecosystem protection.

MANTA L'EAU DIVING - Nettoyage sous-marin et terrestre. Underwater & beach cleanups on Nice's Promenade des Anglais. Diving club promotes marine education & subaquatic sports while organizing coastal cleanup operations at Ruhl & Carras beaches.

MÉDITERRANÉE 2000. 35-year-old association promoting eco-citizenship in Mediterranean Sea. Educates 25,000+ youth/adults yearly on marine preservation through workshops, beach cleanups in Cannes region. Active since 1989.

Les Amis de la Presqu'île de Giens. Protection & education for Giens Peninsula environment. Created 1995. Environmental center in Hyères since 2016 with themed rooms (marine life, flora, geology). Year-round conferences & excursions for all ages.

les PEUPLES de la MER. Leucate-based NGO conducting marine biodiversity surveys (POINT ZERO missions), waste collection preventing ocean pollution (TOUT PART A LA MER), and educational programs with local children since 2 years ago.

Lords of the Ocean. Four friends sailing from Brest to meet 5 most dangerous sharks, filming to combat prejudices and preserve them. Raising awareness on ocean threats: plastic pollution and overfishing.

Maison Pour Tous Léo Lagrange. Socio-cultural association in Cherbourg-en-Cotentin promoting youth activities, environmental education, and community engagement through leisure, cultural exchange, and international mobility programs.

MALINE - Mouvement d'Actions pour le Littoral, la Nature et l'Environnement. Beach cleanup & awareness in Presqu'île d'Arvert (17). Educates citizens on environmental law, reduces human impact through volunteer actions. Goal: zero waste collected through prevention.
Malezi. Develop solidarity, protect marine & terrestrial environments. Educate population & schoolchildren on sea & coastal preservation through awareness programs.

Mare Vivu. Corsican youth association fighting plastic pollution in Mediterranean. Organizes beach cleanups, promotes zero waste, climate awareness & marine biodiversity. Based in Pinu since 2016, trains young environmental experts.

Menos Plástico es Fantástico en Mahahual. Reducing plastic consumption & mitigating marine plastic pollution in Mahahual, Quintana Roo, Mexico. Protecting sea turtle nesting zones from ocean current-borne plastic waste through community action.

MER VEILLE - Sorties-nages de ramassage de déchets sous-marins. Snorkeling cleanup swims along Marseille coast. 1h-1h15 sessions collecting underwater debris. Year-round free events (12 participants max). Partners: Parc National des Calanques, Marseille city. Requires swimming ability.

Médit-action. Reconnect people with nature through marine awareness films, storytelling shows, sea discovery outings, and youth emotional learning projects. Promotes cultural exchange and social integration via Mediterranean marine education.

Malakio - Recyclage de coquillages en composite. Recycling shellfish waste from Atlantic coast producers into composite material (60% shells, 38% French stone, 2% acrylic). Creates tableware & furniture, prevents incineration & illegal dumping harmful to aquatic biodiversity.

My Lady Blue. Protects Mediterranean biodiversity through plastic collection and closed-loop recycling. Creating artisan factory to transform recovered plastics into free raw material for circular economy and accessible object creation.
Moana by Reef Protect. Underwater pollution cleanup & species monitoring. Specialized scuba divers conduct reef biotope surveillance & forest maintenance operations.

Mordus Spearfishing. Eco-responsible freediving fishing association organizing underwater & beach cleanups (#1plongée1déchet challenge), marine preservation awareness, discovery trips in France & overseas. Reduces aquatic waste pollution.

Miaro Natiora. Conservation of biodiversity in Madagascar through marine protected areas, reforestation, habitat restoration, and environmental education. Works with local communities to promote sustainable practices for harmonious coexistence.
Mouvement du Focolari de Wallis et Futuna. Association preserving terrestrial and marine biodiversity in Wallis and Futuna, South Pacific. Works on conservation of local ecosystems.

NAUTIK N/BT - Préservation de la biodiversité du Grand Cul Sac Marin. Since 2020, preserves biodiversity in Grand Cul Sac Marin, Guadeloupe. Combines nautical activities access for disadvantaged with marine conservation. Active since 2011 in Nord Basse Terre.

Plastoctoc - Mobile Plastic Recycling Micro-Factory. Milvi reduces plastic waste through Plastoctoc: a mobile micro-factory with machines to grind and remelt plastic. Educational project promoting eco-design and waste reduction through innovative, playful solutions.

NaturDive - Préservation de la biodiversité marine en Méditerranée. Preserves Mediterranean marine biodiversity through citizen science health assessments, ecosystem research, youth education, and coastal restoration. Focus on understudied ecosystems needing protection.

Nature Peinture - Coastal Cleanup Activities. SCIC accelerating ecological transition through waste collection events. Organized beach cleanups in Marseille coastal areas (Mar-Oct 2023). Aims to build massive construction tools for tomorrow's world.

Nature Libre - Beach Cleanup and Marine Debris Education. Beach cleanup org since 2007. Organizes public cleanups, educates schools/public on marine debris impact. Hosts national gatherings, World Oceans Day events. Regional leader in wild waste management along French coasts.

Nerrivik. Scientific sailing expeditions studying ocean threats. Integrates disadvantaged youth into crew. Educational program 'Petit explorateur Nerrivien' raises ocean protection awareness in schools.

OCEAN SCIENCES & LOGISTIC. French Guiana-Caribbean association promoting marine/river conservation through environmental education, scientific mission logistics, and research programs. Organizes beach cleanups (Mo Peyi Propr) in Cayenne, Kourou, Macouria.

Ocean Peak - Social Integration Through Marine Conservation. Combines environmental action with social integration for at-risk youth through sailing, climbing, hiking. Uses immersive learning in marine and mountain environments to build awareness and preservation values.

OCEANIUM - Marine Ecosystem Protection and Sustainable Development. Senegalese NGO protecting marine ecosystems since 1984. Conducts waste characterization, supports local communities impacted by marine degradation. Led by Youssef El Ali in Senegal and neighboring countries.

Nettoyeurs Subaquatiques. Diving club organizing underwater cleanup in Arcachon Bay, training divers in debris recovery, educating schools on aquatic protection, and conducting citizen science projects on seahorses and flat oysters.

No Plastic In My Sea. Fights plastic pollution at source through advocacy, education of consumers/children/businesses, promotes alternatives to single-use plastics, addresses environmental and health impacts of plastic waste in marine environments.

Objectif Zéro Plastique. Fund managing local Zero Plastic committees in Orléans, Paris, Clermont, Morlaix, Lille, Nice, Mayotte, Bordeaux & abroad to fight plastic pollution in oceans through community action & awareness campaigns.

Océan Protection France. Founded 2018 in Palavas-les-Flots. Fights ocean plastic pollution through beach cleanups, youth education, zero-waste workshops, and engaging businesses in plastic reduction along Mediterranean and Atlantic coasts.

Observatoire du Plancton. Educational association studying plankton in South Brittany. Conducts public awareness, school programs, plankton monitoring, water analysis in coastal zones (Gulf of Morbihan, Etel Ria, Lorient). Active since 2003.

ObsMeP (Observatoire Méditerranéen du Phoque). Study and protection of Mediterranean monk seals. Francophone team monitors seal populations and prepares for potential return to French coasts. Active in France and Eastern Mediterranean.

Odysseus 3.1. Exploration & research on wildlife, preservation of natural habitats, public awareness through conferences, educational interventions, documentaries. Terrestrial, aquatic, subaquatic, aerial & spatial exploration.
Ocean Blue Project. Coastal preservation, species reintroduction, eco-responsibility & marine pollution fight. Organizes beach cleanups in Corsica (Furiani). Part of Un geste pour la Mer network.

Operation Mer Propre. Preservation and rehabilitation of seabeds, lakes and rivers through underwater waste collection by divers. Organizes cleanup events along French Mediterranean coast including Fréjus, Vallauris, Antibes.
