Octop'us. ONG protecting oceans via 3 axes: coral reef preservation in Corfu Greece, pollution cleanup with recycling workshop in Strasbourg, awareness programs in schools. Clean walks, cap collection & local recycling.

PHOENIX EXPEDITION. Atlantic crossing expedition (Feb-Jun 2022) to meet ocean regeneration projects: mangrove, coral reef, seagrass & kelp forest restoration. Learning, connecting & developing these initiatives.

Planète Actions - Lutte contre la pollution plastique en Méditerranée. Association varoise créée en 2021 contre pollution plastique. Nettoyages plages/ports/mer, clean-ups rivières, éco-randos. Déchets caractérisés et revalorisés avec partenaires méditerranéens (Recyclop, Sauvage Méditerranée).

BioLit - Planète Mer. National participatory science program with Natural History Museum. Citizens observe coastal biodiversity during beach walks, sending data to researchers. 12,000 participants, 200 annual outings on Atlantic/Mediterranean coasts.

Palana Environnement - Net Sea Project. Collaborative project fighting marine pollution by recovering ghost fishing nets through scuba diving with fishermen, marine protected area managers, dive clubs. Secondary goal: recycle plastic for circular economy. Est. 2016.

PONANT - Responsible Cruise Tourism. PONANT operates French-flagged luxury cruise yachts, committed to responsible and sustainable tourism. Part of 'Un geste pour la Mer' network promoting marine conservation through eco-friendly cruising.

Patrouilleur polaire L'Astrolabe. Polar patrol vessel operated by French Navy, TAAF & IPEV. Supplies French Antarctic bases & monitors French EEZ in Indian Ocean. Joint marine surveillance & logistics mission.

Participe Futur - Expedition Fata Morgana. Marine biodiversity research & education in Mediterranean aboard sailboat Alcyon. Eco-volunteer stages for natural environment observation, scientific programs, public awareness through conferences, school activities for environmental protection.

Paddle Cleaner. Nice-based association collecting marine debris via Stand Up Paddle. Organizes cleanups, school awareness campaigns, and poster campaigns along French Riviera coastal areas including Villefranche-sur-Mer and Théoule.
Pacha Kleaner. Waste collection to depollute the planet and educate youth. Organizes cleanup events in Ville-la-grand area. Part of Un geste pour la Mer network.

Projet Azur. Women's collective organizing adventures across France (kayak, swimming, cycling) for environmental awareness. 76 beach cleanups collected 5+ tons of waste with 2,635 participants. Focus: Mediterranean, Loire, Alps 2019-2022.

Phœnix Expédition. Sailing expedition from Brittany to California documenting and supporting marine ecosystem regeneration projects (corals, mangroves, seagrass, kelp forests) as biodiversity reserves and carbon sinks.

Pickitup40. Citizen movement organizing beach/forest/urban cleanups, conferences, zero-waste workshops in Capbreton. Raises awareness on plastic pollution, promotes local commerce alternatives. Active since 2020.

Plastic Pickup. Nantes-based association organizing citizen waste cleanups since 2013. Fights plastic pollution in nature and oceans through public events, World Clean Up Day, and corporate RSE programs. Promotes social links.

Project Rescue Ocean. NGO protecting marine environment & biodiversity. Founded 2015 by ex-Paris firefighter & diver. Organizes beach & waterway cleanup operations & awareness campaigns against pollution.

Plombkemon Upcycle. Fights marine pollution by collecting lost fishing lead weights from coastlines. Organizes annual #plombkemonchallenge summer event for public to collect lead, preventing contamination of marine life and food chain.

Planète Perle. Beach & coastal cleanups, environmental education in schools (1000hrs), reforestation with seed bombs (5300 jets), eco-responsible event supplies. Active since 2012 on Côte Bleue with 2600 volunteers.

PropRéunion - Lutte contre la pollution marine. PropRéunion fights pollution at Réunion Island. Organizes coastal cleanups to protect land, air and sea. Conducts regular cleanup events like at Sainte-Suzanne River mouth. Active environmental advocacy.
Projet Origine. Fights plastic pollution through water-related sports achievements, highlighting aquatic environment fragility. Organizes beach cleanups and clean walks in France.

RASTOMA - Réseau pour la sauvegarde des tortues marines en Afrique Centrale. Network protecting sea turtles across 6 Central African Atlantic countries through annual congresses, coordinated conservation strategy, capacity building, and technical support. Active since 2012 with 10 NGO members.

REEF CHECK FRANCE. Citizen science program monitoring coral reef health in French overseas territories. Conducts awareness, education, ecological surveys, and capacity building for marine protected areas with IFRECOR support.

Régénération The beach attitude. Eco-engaged artistic movement recycling beach plastics into furniture, jewelry & art. Creates chairs, tables, bracelets, pendants from ocean waste. Raises awareness on plastic overconsumption through creative innovation.

Rehab. Breton collective recycling ocean & land plastic into everyday objects. Collects from professionals, associations, individuals & ocean. Runs workshops to educate public on plastic pollution & recycling.

Repêchons les océans - Port de Douarnenez. Marine debris recovery program with fishermen in Douarnenez. Collects ocean waste, protects marine life, promotes circular economy through upcycling, and raises awareness about plastic pollution.

Repêchons les océans - Port de Erquy. Marine debris recovery program with fishermen in Erquy port. Collects waste damaging ecosystems, promotes circular economy through upcycling, data collection, and awareness on plastic pollution.

Repêchons les océans - Port de Dieppe. Marine debris recovery program with fishermen in Dieppe port. Removes waste damaging ecosystems, promotes circular economy & upcycling, collects data, raises awareness on plastic pollution.

Repêchons les océans. Marine debris recovery program with French fishing industry. Fishermen collect ocean waste for upcycling, protecting marine ecosystems and promoting circular economy. Part of Upcycling The Oceans initiative.

Repêchons les océans - Port de Boulogne-sur-Mer. Marine debris recovery program with fishing industry. Involves fishermen collecting ocean waste, protects marine life, promotes circular economy & upcycling. Part of Upcycling The Oceans initiative.

Repêchons les océans - Port de Lorient. Marine debris recovery program with fishermen in Lorient. Collects ocean waste, protects marine life, promotes circular economy through upcycling. Part of Fondation de la Mer & Ecoalf initiative.

Repêchons les océans - Port de Saint-Quay-Portrieux. Marine debris recovery program with fishermen in Saint-Quay-Portrieux. Collects ocean waste, protects marine life, promotes circular economy through upcycling, and raises awareness about plastic pollution.

Repêchons les océans. Marine debris recovery program with French fishing industry. Engages fishermen to collect ocean waste, protect marine life, promote circular economy & raise awareness on plastic pollution. Part of Upcycling The Oceans initiative.

Repêchons les océans - Port de Sète. Marine debris recovery program with fishermen in Sète port. Collects waste damaging ecosystems, promotes circular economy & upcycling, gathers data, raises awareness on plastic pollution.

Repêchons les océans - Port du Grau du Roi. Marine debris recovery program with fishermen at Grau du Roi port. Collects waste damaging ecosystems, promotes circular economy through upcycling, data collection and awareness on plastic pollution.

Repêchons les océans - Port-la-Nouvelle. Marine debris recovery program with fishers in Port-la-Nouvelle. Collects ocean waste, protects marine life, promotes circular economy through upcycling. Part of Fondation de la Mer & Ecoalf initiative.

Resak - Revalorisation des déchets plastiques marins au Pays Basque. Resak fights plastic waste invasion in Basque Country & South Landes by upcycling non-recycled marine, household & industrial plastics into innovative materials & durable objects. Runs public awareness workshops on plastic pollution.

Repêchons les océans - Port de Saint-Guénolé. Marine debris recovery program with fishermen at Saint-Guénolé port. Collects ocean waste, protects marine life, promotes circular economy through upcycling, and raises awareness about plastic pollution.

Roots of the Sea (Rasin Lanmè). Martinique youth-led conservation restoring mangroves, coral reefs, seagrass. Programs: Mangwov Bòkay Nou (mangrove restoration) & Blue Wanakaera (eco-volunteering for 15-20yr olds: diving, cleanups, planting).

Reseacle - Réseau Upcycling. ReSeacle tackles plastic pollution through research, awareness campaigns, and concrete depollution/upcycling actions in France and abroad. Organizes cleanup events like Grenoble riverbank depollution.

Réunionnais Volontaires. Marine conservation association in Réunion Island focusing on coastal protection and ocean awareness through volunteer actions. Part of 'Un Geste pour la Mer' program by Fondation de la Mer.

SATIF - Société d'Acclimatation et de Transformation des Invertébrés et du Frai. Marine conservation association focused on acclimatization and transformation of invertebrates and spawn, listed in Fondation de la Mer's directory of engaged actors for ocean protection.

SWIM FOR THE PLANET. Sports & citizen association organizing inclusive swimming events in natural coastal waters, conducting awareness & education actions for ocean & aquatic preservation by federating communities, associations & citizens.

SEA Plastics. Student-led oceanographic expeditions conducting scientific research on plastic pollution. Annual missions combine marine research with partner labs and citizen outreach in ports and schools along Mediterranean coast.

SeaConnect+ - Marine Education and Social Insertion. Var-based association using electric-solar boats for marine biodiversity education, professional maritime training, and social insertion programs. Offers coastal excursions, cetacean observation, sustainable fishing workshops.

SPI Dauphine. Student sailing regatta in Mediterranean promoting eco-responsibility through waste collection, sustainable practices, and environmental awareness. Annual week-long event combining sports competition with ecological initiatives.

SGDF Compagnons VLC. Marine conservation project by SGDF Compagnons VLC, part of Fondation de la Mer's 'Un Geste pour la Mer' program supporting organizations protecting ocean biodiversity and fighting marine pollution.

Saalum Recyclean. Plastic waste collection, treatment, recycling & transformation into manufactured products to reduce ocean pollution. Addresses 21st century environmental challenges through ecological waste management.

STAND UP FOR THE PLANET. Beach cleanup actions from Menton to Nice on French Riviera to raise awareness about Mediterranean Sea state. Training and awareness programs on climate, biodiversity and circular economy for citizens and organizations.
Scout EEUDF Nîmes - Beach Cleanup Prado Marseille. Beach cleanup at Prado beach, Marseille's busiest beach. Scouts from Nîmes organize waste collection to make the city cleaner. July 28-30, 2023.

SOS laisse de mer. Environmental education through art & science. Raises awareness about marine debris via beach cleanups, workshops, and traveling exhibition. Based in Cayeux-sur-Mer, Somme Bay. Targets all ages 7+.

Sauvage Méditerranée. Eco-designed jewelry from Mediterranean marine debris (plastics, fishing nets, sea glass) made in Aix-en-Provence. Sales fund local environmental groups fighting Mediterranean pollution.

SAVE LA MERMAID. Ocean preservation through beach cleanups, art exhibitions from collected microplastics, and school education programs in Seignosse, France. Founded 2021 by pro surfer Maud Le Car to combat marine plastic pollution.

Scouts et Guides De France (SGDF). 4 youth (18-19) creating awareness documentary on aquatic pollution, tracking waste from Mer de Glace glacier to Marseille sea (July 10-27, 2023), interviewing cleanup actors and scientists along the route.

Sailing Hirondelle. Brest-based association developing ocean knowledge, raising marine environmental awareness, promoting sustainable human-ocean relations through new narratives that connect citizens to complex ecological concepts and local solutions.

Sea Shepherd - Défense des océans. ONG combative fondée en 1977 par Paul Watson. Intervient contre atteintes illégales à vie marine, expose abus, sensibilise public au lien avec océan via conférences, festivals, écoles.
Surf Océanides. Marine conservation association listed in Fondation de la Mer's directory of engaged actors. Part of 'Un Geste pour la Mer' program supporting ocean protection initiatives.

Samji - Upcycling Network. Creates furniture & objects from recycled plastic. Raises awareness on plastic pollution & waste treatment through playful, social recycling workshops. Past cleanup: Fontenay-sous-Bois (Sept 2023).

Seaklean. Tunisian startup deploying floating bins in ports/marinas to collect & sort plastic waste. Uses advanced tech to clean oceans, preserve marine biodiversity. Focuses on recycling awareness & global expansion.

Shark Education Club - Sensibilisation à la préservation des requins. Education on shark conservation & marine ecosystems via school workshops, conferences, exhibitions. Labeled by Ministry of Ecological Transition, referenced in Pass Culture. Changes public perception of sharks.

Syndicat mixte Vigipol. Created 1980 post-Amoco Cadiz. Supports Brittany/Normandy coastal communities against maritime pollution before/during/after incidents. Monitors shipping pollution, plastic pellets, container spills via public reporting.

Snorclean. Promotes plastic waste collection during aquatic leisure activities using reusable nets. Anyone 7-77 can participate where/when they want, combining water sports with marine cleanup to tackle growing ocean plastic.
Solda Lanmè. Young association defending environment, raising awareness about marine and mangrove ecosystems for all ages through discovery and education programs.

Swim For Change. Swim For Change tackles cigarette butts, the #1 ocean pollutant. Through extreme challenges, they raise French awareness to properly dispose of cigarette butts, preventing marine pollution.

Société des Régates St Pierre Quiberon SRSP. Sailing association promoting nautical activities while respecting the environment. Operates a sailing school and raises awareness among members about environmental protection in Quiberon.

Société Nautique Corniche - Marine Cleanup Program. Regular underwater & coastal cleanup in Marseille. Since 2019, removed 1200+ electric vehicles (scooters, bikes) from sea. Focus on Corniche Kennedy, Vieux-Port, Mucem. Preserves marine fauna/flora at Fausse-Monnaie port.

Syndicat de bassin de l'Elorn - Preventing Plastic Pollution. INTERREG program collecting & analyzing all waste from Elorn river source to estuary in Finistère, tracking contamination pathways over 3 years to prevent plastic pollution in marine waters.
TAF – The Animal Fund. Protects ocean, dolphins & whales through education, campaigns & advocacy against pollution, overfishing & animal testing. Active in Monaco, France, UK & Denmark since 2015.

Sustainable Sea Transport Initiative. Develops low-carbon sailing vessels with electric motors for inter-island transport in Fiji. 24m prototype under construction to test sustainable freight/passenger routes between remote coastal communities using traditional designs.

TEAM OXYGEN. Freediving club in Marseille organizing marine cleanup operations in calanques, ports & Berre lagoon. Monthly waste collection events combining apnea practice with ocean preservation since 2025.

Team Malmousque. Marseille open water swimmers association organizing coastal cleanups. What: beach/sea cleanups. How: volunteer collections. Where: Marseille coast (Malmousque, Frioul). When: regular events (past 2023).

Te mana o te moana - Marine Conservation in French Polynesia. Founded 2004, protects Polynesian marine life, especially sea turtles through discovery, education & protection. Organizes lagoon cleanup campaigns in Tahiti communities (Nuutania, Vaitupa, Vaiaha).
The Next Exploration. Expeditions & adventures for environmental education. National & international projects raising awareness on ecology & marine conservation through communication campaigns.

The Blue Odyssey Initiative. Science-tech expeditions detecting marine pollution, observing coastal biodiversity, collecting data on plastic waste. Awareness campaigns in Marseille & Corsica. Ongoing coastal monitoring missions.

Tia'i fenua / nana sac plastique. Environmental association fighting single-use plastic, promoting local sustainable alternatives and food autonomy in French Polynesia since 2017. Reduces marine plastic pollution through community action.
Trans Océans Tortues Marines. Created 2019 to support GTMF. Develops actions for study & conservation of sea turtles, manages funding for implementation. Focus on marine turtle protection & research.

Travel Green Teens. Youth association in Arcachon Basin organizing clean walks and waste collection to raise environmental awareness. Created 2019, engages young people in marine ecology through coastal cleanup actions.

Tri-Center - Collecte automatisée de bouteilles plastiques. Automated plastic bottle collection using solar-powered Solarcube. Compresses recyclables into 30kg cubes, reducing CO2 by 25x. 15% of bottles collected from mangroves and beaches in coastal areas.

Tous à la ramasse?!. Volunteers collect beach waste every Wednesday on Île d'Oléron beaches year-round. Open to all, children welcome with adults. Part of 'un geste pour la mer' program supported by La Fondation De La Mer.

UMAI - La Route de l'Océan. Atlantic coast awareness tour (Basque to Normandy) July 13-24, educating beachgoers on plastic pollution & ocean preservation. Promoting concrete plastic alternatives to save marine ecosystems.

Unu Mondo Expédition. Arctic sailing expedition (May-Sept 2020) collecting plastic data, documenting climate change impacts, installing weather stations in South Greenland, involving 20 French schools and scientists from Liège, Rennes, Saint Malo.

UYD - Upcycling Marine Plastic into Clothing. UYD creates eco-designed clothing from recycled plastic bottles in Quimper, France. 100% made in France, 100% recyclable sweats combat ocean plastic pollution through upcycling since 2020.

Une bouteille pour la mer. Sensibilizes consumers on environmental issues by rewarding eco-citizen actions. Organizes coastal cleanups and awareness campaigns in France to protect marine ecosystems from pollution.

Velella - Marine Ecology Research and Citizen Science. Marine ecology research association initiating collaborative projects, developing citizen science protocols, and fostering research-public connection through education and awareness in France.

Proj'Azzura. Student project collecting marine debris from inaccessible beaches between Marseille-Saint-Florent. 2-week sailing expedition targeting 10,000L waste collection & public awareness. June 2024, renewed 2025.

Watch the Sea - Seatrekking & Coastal Cleanup. Multi-day aquatic treks combining adventure & ocean preservation. Cleans hard-to-reach coastal zones (underwater & terrestrial), collects waste data & biodiversity observations along French coastline since 2019.

VentDebout - Preservation of Brittany Coasts. Brittany coast preservation via beach cleanups & onboard plastic recycling (shredder/injector) creating flowerpots. Summer sailboat tours (8 communes). 2020: mobile recycling caravan to reach inland sources (80% marine waste origin).

Water Life Community. Surf-inspired org by engineers/scientists making water sports accessible to all while fighting plastic pollution to preserve aquatic ecosystems. Connects people to ocean through sport.
Wave for the Planet. Marine conservation association supported by Fondation de la Mer through 'Un Geste pour la Mer' program. Details on specific activities not available from page content.

Yana-Recycle. Fights plastic pollution through education & workshops. Participants recycle plastic waste into objects using low-tech machines (shredder, injection press). Activities in schools, companies, public events year-round.
Women for Sea. Community engaging women in marine protection. Gathers, supports & showcases women acting for ocean conservation. Based in Marseille, France. Upcycling network initiative.
Wings of the Ocean. Ocean cleanup at sea & coasts across France & Europe since 2018. Removes plastic pollution, raises awareness, promotes zero-waste lifestyle for individuals & businesses.

WeOcean. Sailing vessel-based project connecting ocean initiatives globally. Conducts scientific expeditions, environmental education, and promotes sustainable ocean projects through community building, documentaries, and conferences.

WePhare. Artivism protecting oceans & forests. Creates artistic murals, colored messages at storm drains, waste bags for schools. Organizes Seine River cleanups in Paris region. From city to sea conservation.

Ystopia - Initiative citoyenne pour la protection de l'océan. Initiative citoyenne pour faire émerger des solutions durables et collaboratives pour la protection de l'océan depuis le territoire maritime de Douarnenez (Finistère). Organise des collectes de déchets.

Cap Corail - Éco-récifs de mouillage innovants. Protects Guadeloupe's seagrass & corals via eco-reefs from recycled washing machines. Provides fish habitat & boat moorings to prevent anchor damage. Brigade cleans seabeds, raises awareness since 5 years.

STALIS - Suivi du récif corallien. Monitoring turbid plumes impact on coral reefs in Thio Bay, New Caledonia. Uses drones, buoys to map sediment exposure from mining runoff. Protects 36km of reefs, 9 vulnerable coral species. Develops methodology guide.

Le Guide des Coraux de Guadeloupe. Coral reef awareness guide for Guadeloupe. 24-page publication on coral ecology, threats, protection. 20,000 copies distributed to 110 local businesses. 85% of reefs degraded. Includes species ID sheets.

Les Iles Éparses, sentinelles de l'évolution de l'océan (ISEO). Study & protect Iles Eparses ecosystems (reefs, mangroves, seagrass) via sentinel stations. Monitor climate change impacts on 800km² reefs, 725ha mangroves, 40km² seagrass. Partners: CNRS, Ifremer, CEDRE.

Un Œil sur le Corail. Citizen science network monitoring coral bleaching in French Polynesia. Trains locals (fishers, tourism workers) to detect bleaching, diseases, invasive species. 3 annual trainings, web/app development, data analysis.

A la découverte des mangroves calédoniennes. Improve educational trail in Touho mangrove, New Caledonia. Install walkways, communication tools, visitor exchange space. Protect 11 mangrove species across 1km trail. Preserve UNESCO heritage coastal ecosystem.

Préservons la Mangrove de Guyane. Protect French Guiana's mangroves through education. 30 classes, 12 guided nature tours, 3 teacher trainings. Shares scientific knowledge on mangrove ecosystems and carbon balance to students and public.

Act4Reefs - Super Coraux. Developing climate-resistant 'super corals' via asexual reproduction in nurseries at Moorea, French Polynesia. Creating cryo-preserved coral bank. 1500 cuttings, 2 nurseries installed, 15 people trained.

Ensemble pour la mangrove de Mayotte. Mangrove conservation in Majicavo Koropa, Koungou. Cleanup operations, waste monitoring, ecological health studies. 13.5 ha cleaned, 400 people involved, 6 cleanups, 3 crab burrow surveys. Local community engagement.

Programme Animlagon en Nouvelle-Calédonie. Educational program for New Caledonia youth about UNESCO-listed coral reefs. Scientists & teachers deliver 2-hour sessions on reef biodiversity & conservation. 50 animations reached 1,500 students in 9 months since 2008.

Jeu Pictum - Educational Marine Species Recognition Game. Interactive AI game for identifying 2328 marine species in New Caledonia. Includes underwater photography, app development, 65 school interventions across 3 provinces, and aquarium deployment to educate 1300+ people.

Coup de pousse pour la mangrove martiniquaise. Restore 5,448m² of degraded mangroves in Martinique by planting 6,000 mangrove trees (4 species). Includes environmental study, local training, and awareness campaigns to protect associated ecosystems (seagrass, reefs).

Merci-cor. Digital tool to quantify ecological impacts of coastal developments on coral reefs. Helps project developers avoid, reduce, compensate losses. Developed by Montpellier University. Applied in Mayotte airport extension.

10 000 enfants pour les coraux. Traveling coral reef exhibition across New Caledonia to educate 10,000 children and communities about coral biodiversity. Reaches remote tribes, collects citizen proposals for reef preservation. Operated by Pala Dalik association.

Formation des animateurs terrain. Training program for New Caledonia volunteers in environmental education. 36h core curriculum + thematic modules on reefs, forests, invasive species. Equips 12 people/year to preserve exceptional ecosystems.

Des Récifs et des Hommes. Citizen science monitoring of 9 coral reefs in New Caledonia's Grand Sud. Trained volunteers use standardized protocols to assess reef health, tracking target species. Engages local communities since 2013.

Zones Humides Educatives. Students manage wetlands in French overseas territories (Guadeloupe, Martinique, Mayotte, Réunion) through field trips, cleanups, and awareness events to protect mangroves and tropical biodiversity.

Réseau d'Observation des Mangroves (ROM). Citizen science mobile app to protect mangroves in French overseas territories. Users report threats, observe species, provide data to managers. Training, awareness, app development. Covers Antilles, Guyana, Mayotte, New Caledonia, Wallis-Futuna, Pol

Protégeons la mangrove de Guyane. Protect French Guiana mangroves through education, training, monitoring. Targets students, managers, volunteers. Uses ROM app for participatory surveillance. 53,347 ha mangroves, 650 mobilized, nursery for marine life.

Mangroves Urbaines Oasis de Biodiversité. Restoring 500m of mangroves along Rivière Monsieur in Volga-Plage, Martinique. Combines ecological restoration, community education, and social inclusion through cleanup, replanting, and eco-tours.

Restaurer les coraux préférés des poissons-demoiselles Année 1. Restoring Acropora cervicornis coral in Martinique via coral gardening. Underwater nurseries with dome structures. Protects juvenile fish, coastlines. Started 2015. 40km² repopulated, 9 nursery domes created.

Investing in Coral Reef and the Blue Economy (ICRBE) - Fiji. Catalyzing change in Fijian coral reefs through private/public investment, developing bankable projects with grants and capital. Targets 45K ha reef conservation, $50M+ investment, benefiting 70K community members.

CONNECT'Iles - CONstructioN Eclairée et Concertée de la gesTion des Iles. Protects 7 islets near Nouméa from human impact through participatory management: vegetation restoration, waste collection, ecological monitoring, and user awareness. 56ha with 20km reefs, 50+ native plants, 10+ seabird species.

Restaurons les mangroves - Phase 2. Mangrove restoration in Mayotte & Madagascar. Replanting, training volunteers, waste management, erosion prevention. Involves local communities for sustainable coastal protection & biodiversity. 15 Ha protected.

Cool the Reef. Cooling coral reefs in French Polynesia using deep-sea water (900m depth) at 14°C from hotel SWAC systems. Pilot at The Brando Hotel, Tetiaroa atoll. Creates biodiversity conservation zones. Studies thermodynamics & ecosystem impact.

Gulf of Aqaba Resilient Reefs Programme. Catalyze private investment in reef-positive enterprises to protect Aqaba's climate-resilient coral reefs through blended finance, sustainable management, and blue economy innovation in ecotourism and aquaculture.

Indonesia Coral Reef Conservation Programme. TeKSI & KORALESTARI programmes protect 408K ha of coral reefs in Coral Triangle through MPA financing, sustainable tourism, seaweed mariculture, reef-positive enterprises. Targets $128M+ investment, benefits 110K people by 2030.

Maldives Coral Reef Conservation. Coral reef conservation in Addu & Fuvahmulah Atolls UNESCO Biosphere Reserves. UNDP convenes with Ministry of Tourism/Environment, local councils, marine research institutes for reef protection & sustainable development.

Kenya and Tanzania Coral Reef Conservation. Miamba Yetu programme protects climate-resilient coral reefs in Kenya-Tanzania TBCA through reef-positive businesses, ecotourism, sustainable fisheries. Targets 104K+ ha coral conservation, $70M investment, 51K beneficiaries by 2030.

Parley for the Oceans - Global Ocean Plastic Upcycling. Global network removing 1M+ kg marine plastic annually from coral reef areas, upcycling debris into premium materials. Partners with communities, brands to end ocean plastic pollution cycle.

Mesoamerican Reef Region. MAR+Invest programme launched 2022 to develop enterprises protecting 60+ coral species. GFCR invests in Carbonwave to transform sargassum into biomaterials, restoring ocean health in Caribbean reef region.

Micronesia Region Coral Reef Conservation Programme. Sustainable blue economy investments supporting 50% marine resource management across FSM, RMI, and Palau. Focuses on ecotourism, sustainable fisheries, aquaculture, waste/water management. Builds on Micronesia Challenge foundation.

Mamuhunan sa mga MPAs programme (Responsible Investment in MPAs). 8-year project enhancing 80+ MPAs financial sustainability through reef-positive businesses (ecotourism, aquaculture, blue carbon). Regenerates 1.5M ha coral reefs in North Mindoro & NE Palawan, impacting 250k fishers. 2022-2030.

Coral Vita Restoration as a Service (RaaS) - Ecotourism-Based Coral Farming. Land-based coral farm in Freeport grows climate-resilient corals for reef restoration. Revenue via RaaS, ecotourism, sponsorships. Uses microfragmentation, assisted evolution, BrainCoral tech for tourism, fisheries, coastal protection.

Gutpela Solwara, Gutpela Bisnis - Papua New Guinea Blue Economy. Develops Blue Investment Strategy & Enterprise Incubation Facility in Kimbe Bay & Louisiade Archipelago to create sustainable livelihoods, protect Coral Triangle reefs, and empower women-led SMEs in marine conservation.

Elizabeth Harbour Conservation Partnership (EHCP). Eco-friendly mooring field in Elizabeth Harbour, Bahamas protecting seagrass & coral from anchor damage. 64 moorings installed, expanding by 40 more. Generates revenue through fees, transitioning to hybrid finance model.

Fundación Faro Nautilus. Converts sargassum & organic waste into biofertilizer using biological chambers. Prevents beach pollution, reduces emissions. Partners with hotels, communities. Creates jobs, supports women entrepreneurs in MAR region.

ASH Limited - Reef-Safe Cosmetics Production. Belizean social enterprise producing reef-safe cosmetics from organic aloe vera to prevent coral bleaching from harmful chemicals in imported sunscreens. Addresses marine conservation through sustainable alternatives.

Empowering Women in Reef-Dependent Communities through Seaweed Culture in the Bar Reef Seascape of Sri Lanka. Seaweed farming empowers women in Sri Lanka's Bar Reef area, reducing fishing pressure on coral reefs. Kappaphycus cultivation provides income in 45-50 days, linking communities to carrageenan markets while supporting reef conservation.

Kunawa Getaway Beach Site. Community eco-tourism at Lelehudi's Kunawa Point funding reef stewardship, mangrove restoration & monitoring through visitor revenue. Upgrading infrastructure, nursery & monitoring kits via US$46,866 grant.

Ocean Gardener. Indonesia-based NGO founded 2016, operates first legal commercial coral mariculture farm. Educates communities, protects & restores reefs via farming. 7 farms in Bali, Sumbawa, Madura, Java. CITES-certified sustainable coral trade.

King Crab Restorative Mariaculture. Caribbean King Crab mariaculture to control macroalgae overgrowth on Mesoamerican Reef while generating income for fishers and MPAs. Integrates crabs into coral restoration programs across Mexico, Belize, and Honduras.

Bayside Cooperative Society. Solar cold-storage & ice facility in Milne Bay cuts fish spoilage, stabilizes prices, raises fisher incomes, eases reef pressure through order-based sales. Women participate in processing/sales.

Connas Trading. Solar cold storage & ice-making in Kimbe Bay strengthens fisheries, cuts spoilage, trains 10 fishers in sustainable practices across 4 villages. Woman co-founded, supports 14 jobs, reduces reef pressure through better value chain.

Biorock Indonesia. Coral reef rehabilitation using Biorock technology across 16 sites in 8 Indonesian provinces. Programs include Scholar Reef for students, public tours, and shore protection. Restored 200km² coral and 5km beach since 2015.

Nuli Sapi Retreat. Community eco-lodge on Logea Island channeling tourism into marine stewardship. US$47,705 grant funds kitchen, bungalow & training in eco-hospitality & reef-safe fishing. Exploring formal LMMA in gwala no-take area.

Sea2Carbon. Climate-tech venture transforming invasive sargassum seaweed into biostimulants, carbon-rich materials & clean water via portable biorefineries. Targets Caribbean sargassum blooms, creating economic opportunities for coastal communities.

Ocean World of Sound. WOS Solutions uses passive acoustic monitoring, scientific communication, and sustainable tourism to generate accessible reef health data while engaging communities in marine-coastal ecosystem protection.

Del Puerto al Huerto. Transforms fish waste from coastal communities into organic fertilizers. Promotes circular economy, reduces overfishing impacts, supports coastal restoration. Community gardens create alternative livelihoods through vegetable sales.

Saving Our Sharks. Fishers' cooperative in Isla Mujeres transitioning from shark fishing to sustainable tourism. Offers snorkeling, diving, photo safaris & education. MAR+Invest 2025 program participant.

tideMéxico. Circular economy initiative collecting marine plastic for reusable products, operating coastal Eco-Hubs with waste collection, clean-ups, and H2OLA Water stations addressing pollution and water scarcity in Mexico.

Caribbean Reef Guardians. Coral reef restoration in Roatán, Honduras via nurseries, biobank, education center. Hybrid funding: adoptions, eco-tourism, courses, grants. Trains divers/youth, partners schools/dive centers for community-led conservation.

MAR Wisdom Center (CEMarin). Blue economy hub at Mesoamerican Reef combining coral/mangrove nurseries, community tourism at Río Dulce, and regenerative business incubation. Delivers reef restoration, coastal protection, biodiversity conservation.

CORUA Reef-Safe Sunscreen. Mexican company producing reef-safe sunscreen to protect coral reefs. Manufactures biodegradable products, distributes in coastal communities, and runs educational campaigns with NGOs and schools.

Implementation of a Material Recovery and Recycling Center in Providencia and Santa Catalina Islands. Waste management project preventing marine pollution through recycling center, collection routes, and education in Providencia. Protects coral reefs, creates jobs, supports circular economy and eco-tourism.

LionFish Gem. Raizal enterprise transforms invasive lionfish into artisanal jewelry in San Andrés, Colombia. Empowers women as producers while protecting coral reefs through increased lionfish harvesting and circular economy principles.

Plastic Waste Transformation for Coral Reef Conservation and Community Capacity Building in San Andrés Island. Transforms plastic waste into coral reef conservation tools through circular economy. Strengthens waste management, creates recycling value chains, trains Raizal women/youth in sustainable practices on San Andrés Island.

Village-Based Ecotourism Business in MPA Bomberai. Community-owned dive tourism in Bird's Head Seascape MPA Bomberai. Creates jobs in guiding, boats, hospitality. Links local income to healthy reefs, embedding conservation into coastal economies.

Six Senses Grand Bahama. Ecotourism resort in Grand Bahama boosting local tourism, creating jobs, and promoting marine & terrestrial sustainability through regenerative activities while protecting adjacent oceans for future generations.

Local Seaweed Hatchery Business in East Sumba. Reef-positive seaweed seedling hatchery in Kaliuda village, East Sumba, Indonesia. Develops climate-resilient seed varieties with UNRAM and BRIN to strengthen sustainable seaweed production and enhance coastal livelihoods.

Blueyou Indonesia Sustainable Seafood and Fisheries Improvement. Blueyou Indonesia supports sustainable seafood sourcing, fisheries improvement projects, and aquaculture certification in Indonesia, connecting local producers to premium markets through eco-labeling and traceability.

Parley for the Oceans. Global network addressing ocean pollution via AIR Strategy (Avoid, Intercept, Redesign). Creates Ocean Plastic® from upcycled marine debris, supports coastal communities, develops biofabricated materials since 2012.

BLUD Establishment and Surf Fee Enablement in FMA 572. Establishes BLUD (Regional Public Service Agency) for MPA management in Indonesia's FMA 572, enabling surf fee collection to fund sustainable coral reef protection and production-protection strategies in Eastern Indian Ocean.

Water Offsets - Circular Water Management for Marine Protection. WaterTECH company using nanomaterials, AI & onsite treatment to cut wastewater discharge, achieve water neutrality & protect coral reefs/coastal ecosystems. 4,000+ water-neutral homes delivered in UK since 2020.

Dumpsite Remediation Western Sanitary Landfill Project. Fiji waste mgmt project converting dumpsite to Material Recycling Facility via PPP model. Stops leachate entering rivers/coast, protecting Mamanuca, Yasawa reefs, Nadi Bay, Great Sea Reef. Blended finance model.

Community-Led Seaweed First Handling Facilities. Establishes community seaweed processing unit in Indonesia's Lesser Sunda to improve drying/storage techniques, increase farmer income, create jobs, and ensure sustainable reef-positive seaweed production practices.

Symbiotic Tourism: A Business Model Linking Star-Class Hotels and Local Communities in Kayankerni. Links fishing communities with hotels for eco-tourism (snorkeling, cultural tours). Revenue funds Conservation Trust for reef restoration. Provides alternative income, reduces fishing pressure, promotes coral conservation in Kayankerni.

Oceanpick Sustainable Aquaculture. GFCR invests in Sri Lanka's offshore barramundi farm to scale sustainable aquaculture, protect coral reefs from blast fishing, create local jobs, and reduce carbon footprint through best practices in Trincomalee.

Living Seas Aquafeed. Indonesia-based company produces sustainable crustacean feed from mangrove leaf extract and seaweed, reducing conventional feed needs while enhancing shrimp health at Living Seas Lab in Northern Lombok.

Birufinery. Indonesian blue economy startup upcycling seaweed & ocean biomass into biodegradable packaging & skincare. Empowers coastal communities through fair trade while reducing marine waste via circular economy principles.

Entrance Fee Implementation in Bomberai MPA. Tourist vehicle entrance fee for Bomberai MPA supporting administrative management, biodiversity monitoring, and local livelihoods. Part of Indonesia's Healthy Coral Reefs program in Bird's Head Seascape.

Business and Technology Incubator (BTI) - Seychelles. SeyCCAT's BTI supports coral-positive businesses in Seychelles through business model refinement, funding access, partnerships & technical skills to expand investment-ready coral reef initiatives.

Coral Positive Ecotourism Growth in Seychelles. Eco-mooring strategy in Sainte Anne Marine Park to prevent coral damage from anchoring. Installs eco-friendly buoys, educates tourists/operators, implements mooring fees for sustainable reef conservation funding.

Seychelles Coral Reef Parametric Insurance. Parametric insurance for Seychelles coral reefs triggered by ocean temperature thresholds. Enables rapid response funding for reef recovery and conservation measures managed by SeyCCAT.

Blue Investment Arc Expansion. SeyCCAT expands blue financing in Seychelles to support SMEs addressing coral reef degradation through fisheries, tourism, waste management. Provides financial/technical support via Business & Technology Incubator and Blue Enterprise Fund.

Coral Reef Funding Facility (CRFF). Deploys grants and recoverable grants into reef-positive businesses to build sustainable enterprises and leverage philanthropic capital for coral reef conservation globally.

Eco-Label Membership in Kupang and Sumba FMA 573. Secures resource access for small-scale fishers in Savu Sea. Ensures sustainability standards for snapper/grouper fisheries. Develops co-management framework with local authorities, communities, private sector.

Seaflower Fund. Dual-fund mechanism (sinking+endowment) for Colombia's Seaflower Biosphere Reserve. Targets US$5M endowment to close 72% MPA financing gap. Supports biodiversity, restoration, livelihoods. Launched COP16, managed by Fondo Acción.

Module for the Establishment and Strengthening of Conservation Area Management Institutions. YKAN develops learning module & certification for MPA management units as BLUD in Indonesia, supporting government's 30x45 vision of 100M hectares MPA by 2045. Based on successful Raja Ampat model.

Agrata Sustainable Mud Crab Aquaculture. Pioneering sustainable mud crab aquaculture via world's first RAS hatchery. Transitions production from wild catch to industrial aquaculture, equipping SE Asian farmers with tech & skills for profitable, eco-friendly operations.

Fi Wi Riif Blue Carbon Projects. Restores coastal/marine ecosystems in Seaflower Biosphere Reserve, Colombia. Develops blue carbon projects to generate credits funding MPA conservation and reef-positive businesses. Phase I: consultations. Next: feasibility studies.

Fi Wi Riif Investment Account. Blended finance mechanism in Colombia promoting reef-positive businesses through grants, technical assistance, and investment de-risking for enterprises supporting coral reef conservation in San Andrés and Providencia.

Great Fringing Reef Mooring Systems Upgrade. Installing mooring infrastructure at Egypt's Red Sea priority sites to reduce anchor damage from tourism. Expands HEPCA's existing systems to protect the Great Fringing Reef while maintaining tourism access.

Organic Waste Upcycling for Urban Farming. Hurghada waste mgmt project converting organic waste to compost for urban farming, reducing nutrient runoff & marine pollution affecting Red Sea coral reefs. Partners with HEPCA for waste collection & upcycling.

Egyptian Coral Reef Fund. Blended finance mechanism mobilizing public/private capital for Red Sea coral reef protection via sustainable tourism, waste management, and aquaculture. Addresses financing gaps and builds reef-positive investments.

Innovative Risk Financing. Parametric insurance in Colombia pays out when hurricanes hit reef sites, enabling rapid coral recovery by organized brigades. Benefits coastal communities dependent on reefs in San Andres & Providencia.

Facilitated Finance for a Sustainable Fishing Fleet. Blended finance rebuilds fishing fleet in Providencia & Santa Catalina Islands post-Hurricane Iota. US$220k loan + US$100k debt relief funds sustainable vessels, no-take zones, responsible fishing practices to restore coral reefs.

Sustainable Community Ecotourism in and around Wadi El Gemal. Develops community ecotourism in Wadi El Gemal, Egypt, shifting from reef-dependent to desert/cultural tourism. Builds local partnerships, creates alternative experiences, reduces coral reef pressure while increasing community benefits.

Beqa Adventure Divers: Shark Reef Marine Reserve. Fiji's first National Marine Park combining shark conservation, sustainable dive tourism, and community engagement. Includes anti-poaching patrols, coral farming, mangrove restoration, and marine research at patch reef off Viti Levu.

Escuela del Mar. Educational & cultural centre in Isla Fuerte, Colombia for community engagement & environmental education addressing unsustainable tourism. Part of Fi Wi Riif (Our Reef) programme. Concept/design stage.

Investing in Fiji's Blue Future: Financing the Protection of Coral Reefs and Coastal Livelihoods. Blended finance facility mobilizing USD 920K credit guarantee to support 10 reef-positive enterprises in Fiji's LMMAs through sustainable fisheries, eco-tourism, aquaculture & reef restoration loans up to USD 200K each.

Oceanworks. Oceanworks ethically harvests coastal plastic waste, preventing ocean pollution. Creates jobs in underserved communities while providing 100% recycled ocean plastic to brands. Tracks chain of custody from collection to product.

Coral Reef Business Incubator. Incubator supporting reef-positive enterprises in Egypt's Red Sea through technical assistance and business development in sustainable tourism, waste management, and aquaculture to unlock investment and strengthen coastal livelihoods.

Seaweed Carbon Farming. Developing carbon offset methodology for seaweed farms across 5 continents. 15-month study quantifying CO2 sequestration at 19 farms in 12 countries to create voluntary carbon protocol, enabling farmers to monetize climate impact.

Reef Credit Initiative. Environmental market paying landholders for reducing pollutants (nutrients, pesticides, sediment) entering Great Barrier Reef. Tradable credits fund water quality improvements while maintaining farm productivity.

Blue Barriers - SEADS Sea Defence Solutions. Recycled polyethylene barriers collect plastic & microplastics in rivers before reaching oceans. Pilot on Lamone River, Italy (2019). Partnerships with universities. Seeking partners to upscale technology.

Ocean Outcomes Triple Impact Fisheries. Business-driven approach for small-scale fishers in Latin America (Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Costa Rica, Mexico) using Environmental, Social & Financial assessment tools to improve livelihoods, ecosystem health & seafood supply.

Coral Husbandry Automated Raceway Machine (CHARM). Automated coral farming robot by Beyond Coral Foundation reduces costs & labor for reef restoration. Uses AI camera, brush & software to clean, cultivate & catalog corals in aquaculture raceways globally.

Terra Conscious. Marine conservation social enterprise in North Goa offering sustainable tourism: ethical dolphin watching, mangrove kayaking, capacity building for operators. Promotes zero-waste experiences, protects biodiversity since 2017.

Coral Reef Aquaculture for Resilience and Aquarium Trade. Expands reef aquaculture in Port Ghalib, Egypt cultivating corals & sea cucumbers for restoration & sustainable aquarium trade, reducing wild harvest pressure while creating local economic opportunities.

Aquahub Mangrove Crab Tanzania. Vertically integrated mangrove crab aquaculture in Tanzania. Breeds crablets in hatchery, partners with local farmers for grow-out in fishponds. Reduces wild crab fishing pressure, supports livelihoods.

AquaVitae. Consortium of 35+ partners developing sustainable Atlantic aquaculture for low-trophic species (macroalgae, mussels, sea cucumbers, oysters, abalone). Launched prototypes May 2020. EU Horizon 2020 funded.

IntelliReefs. Bio-inspired artificial reef structures using Oceanite mineral matrix for coral restoration. Pilot in St. Maarten showed more biodiversity than natural reefs in 14 months. Scalable, customizable to nanoscale for species-specific goals.

Cellana. Hawaii-based algae biorefinery developing Omega-3 oils, animal feed, and biofuel from marine microalgae using patented ALDUO photosynthetic production system combining photobioreactors with open ponds.

Reefy Netherlands. Startup restoring marine habitats using modular artificial reef blocks. Boosts biodiversity, protects coastlines from erosion/flooding. Built from local/recycled sediments. Adaptable from North Sea to Caribbean waters.

Blue Economy Guarantee Facility. Risk guarantee facility for coral reef-positive MSMEs. USD 1M guarantee leverages USD 4M in microfinance loans. Includes technical assistance for funding access and sustainability.

ProCoReef. Ecotourism-based coral reef restoration in Colombian Caribbean. Enables individuals/companies to finance reef restoration through tourism activities. Developing Blue Fund & blue carbon credits. Pilot in Isla Fuerte.

BIOCEANOR Underwater Monitoring System. IoT underwater weather station monitoring 15+ water parameters in real-time. Deployed in Moorea with CRIOBE for coral monitoring. Predicts water quality changes to protect reefs and marine biodiversity.

Reef Cubes®. Eco-friendly concrete blocks mimicking natural reefs. Stackable cubes create marine habitats for biodiversity, coastal defense, offshore infrastructure. Made from low-carbon cement, recycled materials. Global application.

NEMO - Coral Restoration System. 360° coral restoration system using drone tech, transport boxes & interactive network to help municipalities restore reefs efficiently at scale. Transports 100 corals, 3D scans reefs, made from recycled materials.

Seaboost. French company rehabilitating marine biodiversity through bio-inspired structures, artificial reefs, and coastal defense systems. Provides ecological audits, R&D, and customized solutions for marine ecosystems in maritime infrastructures.

ReefSystems. Modular systems (MOSES & SPECTER) restore marine ecosystems & boost biodiversity. Projects in Panama, Netherlands, Kenya restore coral reefs damaged by dynamite fishing. Installed in waterways & oceans as habitat.

Sea Green. Enhances seaweed aquaculture value chains in Southeast Asia through digital platform, blockchain traceability, and microfinance. Empowers coastal communities with capacity building, economic growth, and climate resilience.

SeaAhead. Benefit Corp supporting bluetech startups at innovation+sustainability+oceans intersection. Identified 850+ ventures in sustainable food, low-carbon shipping, renewable energy, marine debris, resilient waterfronts via BlueSwell Incubator.

Ocean Purpose Project (OPP). Singapore-based initiative converting ocean plastics to fuel via innovative tech, cultivating seaweed/mussels for bioplastics, conducting coral reforestation, beach cleanups & community education across SE Asia

ReShore - Floating Living Breakwater. Netherlands startup developing floating breakwaters combining mussel/kelp cultivation with traditional technology. Reduces wave energy, prevents erosion, builds habitats, removes pollutants. Targets ports, marinas, fish farms.

Coastruction Innovation. Netherlands-based 3D concrete printing system using powder bed tech to create zero-waste biomimetic coral reefs on-site with natural materials, reducing carbon footprint for remote reef restoration.

Earthjustice: Stop the USA's Largest Factory-Farm Aquaculture Project. Legal research to counter Rose Canyon Fisheries aquaculture factory-farm off San Diego. Addresses regulatory gaps, pollution discharge, endangered species impacts. First major offshore finfish project in West Coast federal waters.

MARI Oceans. Community seaweed farming in Indonesia using sustainable harvesting, blockchain traceability, farmer training, and hatchery services. Provides superior seeds, technical assistance, and business support for coastal communities.

Ocean Farmers. Sustainable seaweed aquaculture in Madagascar providing alternative livelihoods to 3,000 coastal households, reducing destructive fishing while restoring coral reefs and seagrass beds through community-based farming model.

Water Insight. Satellite remote sensing platform monitoring coastal waters: eutrophication, turbidity, seagrass, algae, phytoplankton. Supports aquaculture, dredging, harmful algal bloom detection with real-time reporting.

Ocean Scientific International - Marine Environmental Monitoring Systems. UK company manufactures integrated systems for real-time marine monitoring: data buoys, sensors, oil spill detection, salinometers. Deployed globally in coastal regions including India, USA, UK, Saudi Arabia for water quality analysis.

Chicago Zoological Society: Assessment of Fur Seals and Sea Lions. Community engagement at Punta San Juan reserve, Peru. Protects endangered fur seals, sea lions, Humboldt penguins. Monthly tours, teen guide training, events develop local conservation leaders, connect residents with wildlife.

Association for Animal Protection and Inventory: 1st MPAs in Bosnia. Establishing 3 MPAs in Bosnia-Herzegovina waters to protect skates, rays & spawning sites. Field studies provide scientific data for MPA designation, published in journals & discussed with Ministry/stakeholders.

IPNLF: Mapping the Roles of Women in the Maldives Tuna Fishery. Research mapping women's roles in Maldives tuna supply chains, developing gender indicators for social/economic monitoring. Addresses data gaps on female seafood workers to improve small-scale fisheries management.

AIDA: Protecting Magellanes Environment from Salmon Aquaculture. AIDA combats destructive salmon aquaculture in Magallanes, Chile through scientific reports, media advocacy, and legal complaints to protect pristine Patagonian waters from pollution and ecosystem collapse.

Los Cabos Coastkeeper: Flora and Fauna Protection Area. Cabo San Lucas Flora & Fauna Protection Area lacks management plan despite 1974 establishment. LCCK completes critical steps for drafting plan to address overfishing, habitat destruction, pollution, ensuring sustainable fisheries & tourism.

Sea Shepherd: Vaquita Protection and Removal of Illegal Fishing Gear. Protecting vaquita porpoises from extinction in Gulf of California by removing illegal gillnets and longlines. Partnership with Mexican Navy removed 42 gillnets, 16 longlines during Operation Milagro II (Nov 2015-May 2016).

Provita: The Venezuelan Coral Reef Monitoring Network. Monitors Venezuelan coral reefs across 3 MPAs (21 sites) to assess health, track climate impacts, engage communities, and inform conservation. Collects baseline data on coral/fish communities annually for 3 years, contributing to GCRMN.

Sea Shepherd Legal: Fighting Against IUU Fishing in Peru. Training Peru's prosecutors, judges & enforcement personnel to combat illegal fishing in biodiversity hotspot waters. Builds government capacity to address IUU fishing & prepare for marine protected areas.

MARE: Performance of MPAs in Portugal. Evaluates Portuguese MPA performance via new classification system. Creates inventory, assesses management effectiveness, develops performance index. Provides guidelines to managers and global conservation community.

Organization for the Conservation of Cetaceans. OCC-Uruguay protects marine life along Uruguay's Atlantic coast through the Whale & Dolphin Sanctuary. #OceanoSanos campaign addresses threats: Chinese mega-port, illegal fishing, pollution, by-catch. Uses legal action & public awareness.

CUNY Brooklyn College: Population Collapse and Coastal Warming. Studying 95% seahorse decline in Ria Formosa using genetic analysis of archived material to track demographic changes during coastal warming and evaluate census data accuracy for marine protected area monitoring.

Wild Me: Wildbook-Computer Vision for Dolphins. Develops AI software to identify individual dolphins from dorsal fin photos. Uses computer vision to track US bottlenose & NZ common dolphins. Open-source platform integrates citizen science data for population monitoring.

Ocean Alliance: SnotBot, Drones for Whale Research. Drone-based whale research collecting respiratory samples, photo-ID, photogrammetry from humpback whales in SE Alaska (2017). Non-invasive data collection to advance whale conservation globally.

Mision Tiburon: Scalloped Hammerhead Shark Conservation. Protecting endangered scalloped hammerhead sharks in Golfo Dulce, Costa Rica (700km2 nursery). Training fishermen in better practices, implementing fishing management actions with local stakeholders and government.

Expedition surveying coastal marine habitats in Tongan waters. Scientists survey coral reefs & fisheries in Tongatapu, 'Eua, Ha'apai & Vava'u to assess impacts from Jan 2022 volcanic eruption. Support recovery, evaluate Special Management Areas, inform 30% ocean protection plan.

Marine Megafauna Foundation: Genomic tools for Yellowfin Tuna. Genomic study using SNPs to assess yellowfin tuna population structure in eastern Pacific. Compares microsatellite vs SNP analysis to inform management strategies for this near-threatened, heavily traded species.

CCRD: Improve the Fisheries Protected Areas in Vietnam. Training for 23 community fisheries protected areas in Tam Giang lagoon, Vietnam. Builds capacity for adaptive management, fishery protection, and conservation through participatory learning to maintain nursery grounds.

Bahamas National Trust: Sustainability of the Queen Conch Fishery. Conchservation Campaign improves Queen Conch fishery sustainability in Bahamas through awareness, behavioral change, engaging fishermen/restaurants/policymakers via music video PSA, petition for juvenile protection legislation.

University of Cape Town: ABALOBI – Small-Scale Fisheries. Mobile app empowering 150K South African small-scale fishers with catch monitoring, traceability, and co-management tools. Promotes social justice, poverty alleviation, and marine stewardship through user-generated data.

University of Miami: Hurricane Matthew Impacts on The Bahamas. 8-month study documenting Hurricane Matthew impacts on New Providence coral reefs, mangroves & coastal resources. High school students assess erosion, water quality & biodiversity in/outside protected areas to improve storm resilience.

IUCN: Debt for Adaptation Swap Expansion. Debt restructuring mechanism financing marine spatial plans & MPAs in Small Island Developing States. Seychelles pilot: USD21.6m swap protecting 400,000 km2. Expanding to Palau, Marshall Islands, Jamaica, Grenada, FSM.

EcoViva: Coastal Resources Management in El Salvador's Mangroves. Protects Bay of Jiquilisco mangroves through community-based management. Expands Local Sustainable Resource Use Plans for 4,000 acres. Supports local livelihoods, fisheries, sea turtles. Ongoing project in El Salvador.

MarViva: Public Policy of the High Seas in the Costa Rica Dome. Protecting Costa Rica Dome biodiversity through marine spatial planning with Central American governments. Awareness campaign for high seas governance, fisheries & traffic regulations to protect whales, turtles, sharks in critical habitat.

VEPA: Conservation Monitoring and Assessment in Tonga. Monitoring zooplankton, cryptobenthic fish, coral in Vava'u Archipelago SMAs. Develops baseline data & training manuals for Tongan Ministry of Fisheries & VEPA to assess reef ecosystem health & support marine spatial planning.

Island Reach: Developing the MPA Network in Makelula, Vanuatu. Supporting 6 villages in SW Bay, Malekula to create community-managed MPA network. Training in monitoring, building floats/signage, applying biophysical principles for effective design to protect declining fish stocks & reefs.

Seacology: Drafting a Management Plan for an MPA in Chile. Communities develop management plan for 12,630-acre MPA near Koldita Island. Seacology funds experts and surveillance equipment. Communities monitor reserve, protect traditional fisheries, dolphins, and marine otters by Dec 2017.

Maldives Expedition 2021. Jan 2020 expedition surveyed coral reef health, fish/benthic populations, water quality across 16 Maldives atolls over 26 days. Led by MMRI, Waitt Institute, Scripps. Data informs Marine Spatial Plan for ocean protection.

Pacific Wild Alliance: Herring Recovery in British Columbia. Supporting Heiltsuk Nation's co-management of Pacific Herring fishery on BC's central coast through monitoring, media coverage, and communications to promote sustainable herring stock recovery and cultural preservation.

Lesser Antilles Expedition. Nov 2016 rapid coral reef assessment across Sint Maarten, Sint Eustatius, Saba, Redonda & Saba Bank. 65 sites surveyed, 325 fish/benthic transects, 38 photomosaics. Partnership with Scripps & regional governments.

Palau Expedition. Marine expedition in Palau, Micronesia (Jan-Feb 2022) partnering with One Reef and Scripps to study 300+ limestone islands. Supports traditional 'bul' fishing closures for habitat regeneration and food security.

Great Barrier Reef Expedition. Surveyed Great Barrier Reef using 360° photography & camera sleds. Partnered with U of Queensland & Catlin Seaview Survey. Monitored coral health, retrieved loggers. Data contributed to Netflix's Chasing Coral.

Curaçao Blue Halo Initiative Expedition. Nov 2015: Waitt Foundation marine survey expedition in Curaçao, Lesser Antilles. 475 dives around island with international scientists to assess coastal ecosystems for Blue Halo marine protection program.

Tonga Expedition. June 2017 expedition to Tonga's Vava'u archipelago. Scientific dive surveys collected baseline reef data for Marine Protected Areas. Partnership with Tongan Government & VEPA. 3D photographic reef mosaics created.

Fiji Vatu-i-Ra Expedition. Marine research expedition in Vatu-i-Ra Seascape, Fiji (March 2014) with Wildlife Conservation Society. Studied seascape ecology, culminating multi-year research efforts in the region.

Galápagos to Cocos Island Expedition. Study of high seas zone between Galápagos & Cocos Island using BRUVs to understand marine connectivity. Deployed baited cameras at depths, recorded hammerhead sharks. Ecuador & Costa Rica signed protection agreement.

Solomon Islands Marine Scientific Assessment Expedition. Scientific marine assessments in Western Province, Solomon Islands. Partnership with local conservation groups and Scripps Institute. Results delivered to Ministry of Fisheries for resource management.

Santa Elena Expedition. May 2018 marine survey in Santa Elena Bay, Costa Rica to support protection gaps in Nature Preserves. 302 species documented via 25 dives, turtle/shark tagging, DNA sampling. Partnership with Mar Viva & UCR.

Selvagens Islands Expedition. 10-day expedition to Selvagens Islands, south of Madeira, conducting first underwater ecosystem surveys from shallow to deep waters. Results advise Portuguese government on expanding Marine Protected Area beyond 200m depth.

Cashes Ledge Expedition. June 2016 Blue Parks expedition documenting Cashes Ledge in Gulf of Maine. Scientists & photographer Brian Skerry collected visual & scientific evidence of this ecologically significant habitat to advocate for marine protections.

Vava'u Tonga Expedition. BIORAP scientific surveys of Vava'u island group, Tonga. Ship & land-based teams conducted marine biodiversity assessments with SPREP. Led to ongoing conservation talks with Kingdom of Tonga.

Seychelles Expedition. March 2015 expedition to Seychelles outer islands (Aldabra, Assumption, Cosmoledo). Scientists & filmmakers surveyed & explored ocean environments, documenting biodiversity & ecosystem health over 2 weeks.

Pulley Ridge Expedition. ROV expedition documenting deep-sea fauna/flora near Dry Tortugas, Florida Keys to support marine protection recommendations. Science team from FSU and Harbor Branch with National Geographic photographer.

Researchers Return from 8 Day Expedition to Study Samoa's Marine Life. 8-day expedition studying Samoa's coral reefs. Local & international researchers surveyed marine biodiversity. Completed Sept 2022. Supports marine conservation planning in Samoan waters.

Montserrat Expedition. Oct 2015 marine expedition to Montserrat for Blue Halo Initiative. 600 dives, 44k fish counted, 188 species, 43 coral species. Scientific assessment around entire island to support marine conservation planning.

Andaman Sea Expedition. Jan 2015: Waitt Foundation & Wildlife Conservation Society trained local teams in Myanmar's Andaman Sea on science diving, survey methods & BRUV construction to establish baseline marine data collection & build capacity.

Albania Marine Baseline Survey Expedition. June 2015 dive surveys along Albanian coast to collect baseline data for Marine Protected Area creation. Led by U. Tirane & Centre d'Estudis Avançats de Blanes, presented to local stakeholders.

Fiji Sharks Expedition. April 2014 shark research expedition in Fiji deploying cameras and satellite transponders to study local shark populations, ecology, and movement patterns. Led by Jessica Cramp with Dr. Demian Chapman.

Applying Science to Improve MPA Management. Bertarelli Programme supports BIOT MPA management through research on IUU fishing, compliance improvement, and global collaboration on marine reserve best practices and enforcement.

Pitcairn Islands Marine Protected Area. 850,000 km² MPA in central South Pacific protecting pristine coral reefs, seamounts, endangered whales. 99.5% no-take zone with community-led monitoring. Established to preserve near-pristine ecosystems and climate refugia.

French Polynesia Marine Protection. Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy collaborates with Austral & Marquesas Islands communities to create 1.7M km² marine reserves protecting sharks, coral, tuna in French Polynesia's EEZ, respecting traditional rāhui practices. Started 2014.

Kermadec Islands Marine Protection. Advocacy for highly protected marine reserve in Kermadec Islands, safeguarding biodiversity along 2,500km underwater volcanic arc, respecting Maori cultural heritage, and building climate resilience in temperate-tropical waters.

Bertarelli Programme in Marine Science - Communicating Marine Science. Makes marine conservation mainstream through public platform sharing MPA research, annual symposiums presenting findings, and building ocean-friendly society awareness globally.

Sea of Cortez Marine Protection. Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy & Beta Diversidad work with communities to create MPA in Sea of Cortez & Pacific off Baja California, protecting sharks, whales, turtles, dolphins & 900 fish species in Cousteau's 'world's aquarium'

Coral Reef Resilience in British Indian Ocean Territory. Monitoring coral reef recovery after 2015-16 bleaching in BIOT. Studies coral biology, reef structure, biodiversity, fish communities, and disease resilience over 4 years in near-pristine conditions.

British Indian Ocean Territory Marine Protected Area. 640,000km2 no-take MPA in Chagos Archipelago protecting coral atolls, pelagic species. Partnership since 2010 supports enforcement, scientific research on reef and migratory species to improve ocean sanctuary management.

Easter Island (Rapa Nui) Marine Protection. 720,000km² marine park protecting 142 unique species, hydrothermal vents. Scientific assessment, illegal fishing monitoring, community education. Rapa Nui Rāhui decree signed Feb 2018, preserving indigenous fishing traditions.

Natural Park of the Coral Sea - New Caledonia. Creating highly protected marine reserves within New Caledonia's 1.3M km² EEZ. Protecting pristine ecosystems, 1,700+ fish species, coral reefs, and deep-sea habitats. Partnership advocacy since 2014, MPAs established 2018.

High Seas Marine Protection. Partnership with governments to protect waters beyond national jurisdiction (2/3 of ocean). Supports UN process for international MPAs to preserve biodiversity, protect whales, tuna, sharks, corals from fishing impact.

Sentinel Species - Bertarelli Programme in Marine Science. Studies top predators & mobile species in BIOT marine reserve: turtles, seabirds, reef sharks, manta rays, tunas. Tagging & acoustic monitoring reveal habitat use, connectivity, ecosystem links across Indian Ocean.

Revillagigedo Archipelago National Marine Park. Mexico's largest fully protected marine reserve (148,087 km²) off Pacific coast. Protects 366 fish species, 37 shark/ray species, sea turtles. Designated Nov 2017. Supports migration, breeding of whales, dolphins, tuna.

Ascension Island Marine Protected Area. 443,000 km² MPA in South Atlantic protecting endemic species, green turtles, seabirds. Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy supports designation of entire EEZ. UK Government committed March 2019 to safeguard marine life, improve fisheries, create tourism.

Turneffe Atoll Marine Reserve. Bertarelli Foundation partnered with Belize to create 1,300km2 reserve protecting nursery habitat for 30+ species. Supports sustainable fishing and tourism for local communities while protecting marine ecosystem.

South Sandwich Islands Marine Protection. Protecting 529,000 km2 marine reserve around South Sandwich Islands. Home to penguins, whales, seals, albatrosses. Study climate impact at biogeographic boundary. Pew Bertarelli Ocean Legacy supports full protection from fishing.

Tristan da Cunha Marine Protection Zone. 687,000 km² marine reserve protecting 91% of Tristan da Cunha's waters. Safeguards endangered penguins, albatrosses, seals in South Atlantic. Designated Nov 2020, legislation 2021. 4th largest fully protected reserve globally.

Shipbuilding Loan Program - Supporting Japan's Maritime Industry. Long-term, low-interest financing for shipbuilding and related industries to strengthen operational foundations. Supports equipment modernization, working capital, and zero-emission vessel construction using LNG/ammonia/hydrogen fuel.

海と日本PROJECT ~CHANGE FOR THE BLUE~. Marine debris reduction project addressing plastic pollution. Partners across sectors develop evidence-based model solutions for ocean waste management, raising public awareness through nationwide cleanup campaigns (May-June, Sept). Japan-wide initia

海のそなえプロジェクト (Umi no Sonae Project). Aims to reduce annual water accidents in Japan through new safety knowledge and measures. Consortium led by Nippon Foundation with Japan Lifesaving Association, Japan Water Rescue Association, and Umirai Environmental Foundation since 2024.

Ocean Acidification Adaptation Project. Monitors ocean acidification in Japanese coastal waters since 2020. Observes oyster larvae, water quality at multiple sites. Collaborates with universities, fisheries to predict impacts, develop mitigation strategies for shellfish aquaculture.

Zero Emission Ship Project 2050. Developing hydrogen-fueled ships to achieve carbon neutrality in domestic shipping by 2050. Three consortia building fuel cell offshore wind vessels and hydrogen engine ships for world-first demonstrations in 2024-2026.

The Nippon Foundation-Nekton Ocean Census. Global initiative to discover 100,000 new marine species in 10 years. Explores biodiversity hotspots worldwide using advanced tech, analyzes samples at centers globally, shares open-source data for scientists and public.

Ocean Innovation Consortium - Marine Technology Development. Platform to train 10,000 ocean development engineers by 2030. Supports university students in offshore oil/gas, renewable energy, methane hydrate development. Established 2016, involves 22 companies, 27 universities, 6 institutions.

SPOGOMI World Cup. Global competition of SPOGOMI (sport trash pickup) to reduce marine debris. 80% of ocean waste originates from land. 21 countries participated in 2023, collecting 9,000kg. Promotes ocean conservation through competitive cleanup events.

Nippon Foundation-GEBCO Seabed 2030 Project. Global project to complete 100% accurate seabed mapping by 2030. Collects bathymetric data from governments/companies, supports mapping technology research. Contributes to UN Ocean Decade. Started 2018, increased coverage from 6% to 19%.

Back to Blue. Nippon Foundation & Economist Impact collaboration addressing ocean plastic, chemical pollution, acidification. Publishes country rankings, white papers, hosts international conferences. Launched 2021, covers 25 countries globally.

洋上風力人材育成プロジェクト. Japan's offshore wind power sector faces severe workforce shortage. Nippon Foundation supports training centers in Nagasaki for technicians and engineers to meet 2030 target of 15,700 personnel for renewable energy development.

Global Marine Human Resource Development Program. Nippon Foundation provides scholarships to develop global marine professionals addressing ocean issues. Programs train maritime administrators, ocean law experts, seafloor mapping technicians, and marine observation specialists worldwide since 1988.

海の地図プロジェクト (Sea Map Project). 10-year aerial survey mapping 90% of Japan's 35,000km coastal shallow waters (0-20m depth) using ALB technology. Aims to prevent water accidents, support tsunami preparedness, ecosystem monitoring. 2B yen budget, 25% complete as of Jan 2025.

海と日本PROJECT. Why: 40% of Japanese teens lack ocean connection. What: All-Japan initiative raising ocean awareness. How: Educational programs, cleanup campaigns, surveys. When: Ongoing since 2016. Where: Nationwide Japan coastal areas.

海洋環境変化対応プロジェクト. Japanese coastal ocean monitoring project. Fishers collect data (water temp, unusual catches) at 13 sites nationwide. Tokyo Univ analyzes data to understand environmental changes & develop responses. Started 2025.

日本財団・瀬戸内オーシャンズX. Setouchi Sea marine debris reduction project by 4 prefectures & Nippon Foundation. Aims 70% reduction in new debris inflow, 10% increase in recovery by 2025. Includes research, corporate partnerships, education, policy formation.

渚の交番プロジェクト (Nagisa no Koban Project). Network of 18 coastal hubs across Japan promoting marine safety, environmental conservation, ocean education, and community engagement. Provides marine activities, lifesaving, beach management, and cross-sector collaboration since 2009.

無人運航船プロジェクト「MEGURI2040」. Autonomous ship project addressing maritime labor shortage, aging workforce, and safety. Developing unmanned navigation systems for container ships, ferries, and island routes. Aims for 50% unmanned ships by 2040,実用化 by 2025.

Reef Reborn. Lipid nanoparticle cocktail to boost coral larvae survival on Great Barrier Reef. Lab & in-situ trials adapting feeding to water temp. Aims genetic renewal vs adult fragmentation for climate resilience 2022-2024.

SYMBIOSWAP. Transplanting symbiotic algae between Mediterranean and tropical corals (2025-2027) to study their role in resistance to water warming and coral bleaching. Novel approach for assisted acclimatation.

SYNSEN - Plasticose Impact on Seabird DNA. Study characterizing consequences of plasticose (disease from microplastic ingestion) on seabird DNA. Research on marine pollution impact on wildlife health. 2024-2026.

Une aquaculture terrestre durable pour préserver la biodiversité. Develop land-based Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture (IMTA) in Yucatan using underground saltwater to protect Caribbean marine ecosystems (mangroves, coral reefs, seagrass) from traditional aquaculture impacts.

AQUAMAP. Restoring Sundarbans mangroves (India/Bangladesh) using bio-inspired sediment capture and silvopisciculture to combat sea-level rise and erosion, protecting biodiversity and local communities (2025-2027).
Bycatch Beyond. Bangladesh artisanal fishers monitor ray/shark bycatch using low-tech radio-GPS devices to quantify accidental catches and better protect threatened species. 2024-2027.

Protection Aegean Coralligenous. Map & monitor coralligenous reefs in Aegean Sea using multibeam sonar, ROV & biomass scanner. Scientific expedition around Fourni Island involving local fishers to enforce trawling ban on biodiversity hotspots. 2021-2023

Buffer. Genetic study of heat-resistant gorgonian colonies to restore marine ecosystems in Parc National des Calanques. Combines genetics with symbiotic microorganism research for innovative marine habitat protection, 2024-2026.

PANTHER. Restoring degraded marine habitats on a Mediterranean island through collaborative approach with fishermen and researchers. Uses 3D photogrammetry to measure restoration impacts and reintroduce key ecosystem engineer species.

Plastidrugs. Study microplastics as pollutant carriers in marine environments. Research how plastic particles exchange pollutants, forming toxic rafts that accumulate in organisms. Aims to provide recommendations to combat microplastic pollution 2023-2026.

Etude des mouvements des raies manta et des pressions de pêche au Mozambique. Satellite tracking of manta rays in Mozambique to identify overlap with industrial fishing, evaluate marine protected area effectiveness, and study illegal fishing through citizen science and artisanal fisher observations.

Floating Reef. Artificial floating reef project in Frioul archipelago, Marseille, Calanques National Park. Testing buoy models in various coastal environments to study wave/current impacts and marine habitat development for biodiversity.
Unknown.

MicroPOW. Study microplastic ingestion impact on seabird organs, tissues, cells in Australia. Links plastic pollution to cellular mechanisms and wildlife health using biomedical and field ecology tools (2021-2023).

BIOSSA. Study marine noise pollution impact on whales & dolphins. Analyze how human activities (motors, sonars, cables) interfere with cetacean communication & navigation, causing strandings. Develop recommendations 2023-2025.

Regen Ocean Farms. Revitalizing traditional Brazilian seaweed farming with modern biotech to restore coastal ecosystems. 4 new cultivation sites opened in northern Brazil, balancing economic development with marine conservation.

Birds on Sticks. Installing secure offshore nesting boxes to attract seabirds back to atolls. Bird droppings provide nutrients to restore coral reef resilience against marine heatwaves. Natural, cost-effective ecosystem restoration 2025-2027.

Yaf Keru. Coral reef restoration in Raja Ampat combining ecological monitoring, fishermen collaboration & socio-economic surveys. Protects 1/4 marine biodiversity & local food security through community management 2023-2025

Fish on the Move. Models fish egg/larva dispersion using ocean currents and fisher knowledge to map migration corridors and optimize marine protected areas by connecting juvenile and adult habitats for effective conservation (2025-2027).

POLARIS - Plateforme d'Observation du Littoral Appliquée à la Recherche, à l'Information et à la Sensibilisation. Mobile app for amateur divers to collect marine biodiversity data in Mediterranean Sea. Links citizen science with climate research. Marseille-based collaborative platform for marine ecosystem protection.

Le ferry scientifique des Inuits, sentinelle du changement climatique. Installing sensors on Inuit ferry to monitor ocean changes (temperature, chlorophyll, oxygen, salinity, CO2, pH) across Arctic-Atlantic transition zone. Supports climate adaptation strategy for Nunatsiavut communities facing rapid warming.

MICROCEAN. Sequencing plankton genomes to understand biological carbon pump. Explores molecular links between plankton species and their role in climate regulation and deep ocean preservation. 2024-2026.
