Un robot pour comprendre la biodiversité des monts sous marins. MECOPO studies benthic mesophotic communities (60-350m depth) on seamounts and oceanic islands in SE Pacific using ROV. Creates species database to understand biological links and identify vulnerable zones for marine protection.

IDEFIX. Study nitrogen fixation dynamics during monsoon seasons in Indian Ocean. Combines oceanographic campaigns, biogeochemical analyses, and microbiology to link diazotroph activity to climate conditions and discover new species.

Citizen into Science. Collecting high-sea microclimate and current data via pleasure boats (14,000/year vs 100 scientific campaigns). Data shared with GOOS international databases. Engages recreational sailors in ocean science. 2023-2025.

3D-4-SEAC. 3D photogrammetry mapping of Mediterranean key habitats (Posidonia, coralligenous, hermelles) in Latium coast & Tuscan archipelago, Italy. Creates high-res 3D models to monitor vulnerable ecosystems. 2022-2024.

SHAMA. Bottom-up coral reef monitoring in Shark Fin Bay, Philippines. Local fishers trained in scientific surveys, creating inclusive research structure with NGOs, researchers, authorities to develop adapted management decisions (2022-2024).

GENESIS. Study marine animal forests (sponges) along North-South transect from Svalbard to Caribbean via deep dives. Create first global DNA map of sponges for bio-inspired medicine and green chemistry. 2023-2025.

Coastal Ocean Watch. Evaluates European coastal water quality using satellite remote sensing. Analyzes 20-year trends in biogeochemical parameters to inform biodiversity conservation decisions. European coasts.

Antarctic Biolum. Study deep Antarctic macrofauna evolution using innovative 360° bioluminescence emission/detection technology in deep-sea environments. Research focuses on documenting bioluminescent organisms in Antarctic waters.

Oceana Global Ocean Conservation Partnership. Oak Foundation's 21-year partnership with Oceana supporting global ocean conservation. Transformed Oceana from startup to global powerhouse protecting marine ecosystems worldwide through advocacy and policy.

Quantifying small-scale fisheries for policy and planning. Free online training course teaching policymakers to collect data on small-scale fisheries' contributions to sustainable development, food security, and livelihoods. Developed by Duke Marine Lab and WorldFish.

Protecting small-scale fishers to sustain food, livelihoods, and marine nature. Oak Foundation supports 108M small-scale fishers globally through orgs like CAOPA, GNCFC, HOMEF. Fights industrial trawling, saiko trade, promotes sustainable fishing, women's empowerment, food security in coastal communities.

Securing marine biodiversity in the high seas through a global treaty. Supporting High Seas Alliance & Oceans 5 to establish UN High Seas Treaty protecting marine biodiversity beyond national waters. Aims for 30% ocean protection by 2030 through MPAs, regulating overfishing & deep-sea mining.

East Maui communities protecting coastline and restoring marine life. Nā Mamo O Mū'olea manages 70 acres at Mū'olea Point, East Maui. Created Hawaii's first limpet rest area, hosts annual Hāna Limu Festival since 2009. 2-year grant from HCF Marine 30x30 Fund supports nearshore ecosystem restoration.

One Billion Oyster Project and One Million New Yorkers. Restoring NY Harbor's oyster reefs to clean water, support biodiversity, protect shorelines. Goal: 1B oysters by 2035 via artificial reefs from recycled shells, engaging 1M New Yorkers through education & volunteering.

Indonesia's Seagrass and Coral Nursery. Coral & seagrass restoration in Balabalakang Archipelago, West Sulawesi to protect sea turtles. Transplanting coral (13%→43% coverage) & seagrass (26→30 hectares), training locals in monitoring, establishing MPA 650km N of Bali.

Saving the Spotted Greenshank. Protecting wintering Spotted Greenshank in Thailand's coastal mudflats through surveys, habitat management with local stakeholders, and community education. Focus on Inner Gulf of Thailand and Peninsular coast.

Community Conservation of Sea Turtles. Protects endangered Hawksbill, Green & Olive Ridley turtles on Katrack Island, Guinea. Community-led nest protection, anti-poaching patrols, DNA analysis. Supports local school & dispensary. 20km beach hotspot.

Dolphin Quest Guinea. Assessing Atlantic humpback dolphin distribution, habitat, and abundance in Guinea's coastal waters through boat surveys and community collaboration to reduce bycatch threats and protect this critically endangered species.

Oceans Collaborative. Supporting Oceans Collaborative durability through environmental conservation funding. Multi-year initiative focused on ocean sustainability and collaborative marine conservation efforts. Oct 2024-Oct 2026.

Ocean Protection. $3M grant for ocean protection over 36 months. Moore Foundation Environmental Conservation funding. Nov 2025-Nov 2028. Global ocean conservation initiative. Limited details on specific interventions or geography.

Ocean Conservation Storytelling. Supporting ocean conservation through storytelling to raise awareness and promote marine environmental protection. 24-month grant awarded Oct 2019 for $239,253 by Moore Foundation's Environmental Conservation program.
Ocean Conservation Storytelling. Supporting ocean conservation storytelling to communicate marine environmental issues and conservation efforts through high-quality reporting and media outreach.

Oceans Collaborative. Moore Foundation grant supporting Oceans Collaborative for marine conservation work. 15-month project awarded Oct 2018, $770K funding. Part of Environmental Conservation program with continued support through 2024.

Ocean Policy Education. 6-month journalism education program on ocean policy. Supports training journalists to report on marine conservation and ocean governance issues. Sep 2021-Mar 2022. Location unknown, general ocean policy focus.

Ocean Habitat Communications Project. Ocean conservation communications project. What: communications initiative. How: public outreach and messaging. When: May 2022, 12 months. Where: unspecified location. Why: support ocean habitat conservation.

Ocean Species Dynamics and Biodiversity Revealed Through eDNA Analysis. eDNA research to collect geospatial & dynamic species data in 3 California marine protected areas spanning major species gradients. Aug 2022-Aug 2025.

Ocean Planning Support in Canada. Ocean Keepers network supports marine spatial planning across Canada. 24-month project for ocean conservation outcomes through strategic planning and coordination. Mar 2015-Mar 2017.

Ocean Mapping and Data Management in the Mid-Atlantic. Mapping and assessment of marine resources in Mid-Atlantic region to foster public understanding of ocean planning. 22-month project awarded March 2016.

Ocean Project Outreach. Sustainable fisheries management education project funded by Moore Foundation. $200K grant over 14 months starting Jun 2017 to support outreach and education on science-based fisheries conservation practices.

Ocean planning in the Mid-Atlantic region. Supporting Mid-Atlantic Regional Council on the Ocean in mapping/assessing marine resources and facilitating public dialogue about ocean planning. Feb 2014-Feb 2016, Mid-Atlantic US coast.

Ocean Planning Films. Film screenings promoting ocean planning on US Mid-Atlantic and British Columbia coasts. Educational outreach to support marine spatial planning through documentary distribution. 12-month project funded Jan 2015.

Ocean Planning Films. Film screenings across US & Canada to educate public on ocean planning & marine spatial planning. Funded by Moore Foundation for 16 months starting Oct 2015. Supports environmental conservation through educational outreach.

Seafood Collaboration for Oceans and Seafood Markets Initiative. Implements seafood collaboration for the Oceans and Seafood Markets Initiative to promote sustainable seafood practices and marine conservation through market-based approaches.

Ocean policy and National Security. Ocean policy dialogues with National Security community. Oct 2012-Oct 2013, 12-month initiative linking marine conservation with national security interests through policy engagement.

Ocean Acidification Funding Landscape Analysis. Research and synthesize funding by private foundations and international sources for science, policy, communications, and adaptation actions on ocean acidification impacts. 6-month project awarded Mar 2011.

Ocean Acidification Funding Landscape Analysis. Research and synthesize US government funding for ocean acidification science, policy, communications, and adaptation actions. Analyzes real and projected impacts, relationship between existing funding streams and needs.

Ocean Systems Exhibits for Observatory and Life Sciences Galleries. Developing innovative ocean systems exhibits for new Observatory and Life Sciences galleries at Exploratorium, plus public programs to raise awareness of oceans and San Francisco Bay science.

Ocean Policy Partnership in Massachusetts. 5-year strategic plan for MA ocean zoning mandate. Engaging stakeholders, synthesizing scientific data for nation's first comprehensive state ocean management plan. Forming Ocean Policy Partnership.

Ocean Science Imaging Informatics. Advances imaging informatics in oceanography. Supports new knowledge about marine ecosystems through innovative informatics approaches, infusing data integration into ocean sensor systems via scientist-informaticist partnerships.
Oceans Caucus Foundation. Support bi-partisan Oceans Caucus creation and educational activities for marine policy advocacy in US Congress. Nov 2011-Jan 2014, $250k grant.

Ocean Acidification/Marine Microbes Workshop. Workshop convening scientific experts to discuss ocean acidification effects on marine microbes. Develops white paper identifying research priorities to advance understanding of acidification impacts on marine microorganisms.

Conservación ConCiencia. Science-based conservation in Puerto Rico & Cuba: shark research with seafood industry, parrotfish supply chain analysis, fisheries management exchange. Promotes sustainable development through community collaboration.

SeaGrass Grow. Restoring seagrass beds in Jobos Bay, Puerto Rico to sequester carbon, reduce wave action, improve water quality, and provide hurricane resilience. Offsets carbon footprints while protecting coastal ecosystems and manatee habitat.

The Live Blue Foundation. Supports Blue Mind Movement connecting people with water for wellness. Provides tools to organizations worldwide that reconnect people with water throughout their lives based on two decades of research.

Friends of Sawfish Conservation Society. Global sawfish conservation through collaboration. Provides education, research tools, and policy enforcement support for threatened sawfish species worldwide. Connects researchers, policymakers, and enthusiasts.

SEVENSEAS. Free publication promoting marine conservation via community engagement, online media, eco-tourism. Features conservation issues, field stories, research, campaigns, travel, expeditions, job opportunities, spotlighting conservation leaders.

Tourism Action Coalition for a Sustainable Ocean. Coalition uniting businesses, NGOs, IGOs for sustainable marine tourism. Drives coastal protection, ecosystem restoration via Nature-based Solutions, stakeholder engagement, policy change. Aims for regenerative tourism benefiting communities.

Friends of Organizacion SyCOMA. Conservation in Los Cabos & Mexico through sea turtle/tern protection, habitat restoration, research, education & community involvement. Founded 2015, operates in Baja California Sur, Veracruz, Oaxaca, Cozumel promoting sustainability.

Georgia Strait Alliance. Protecting Strait of Georgia/Salish Sea through advocacy, stewardship & legal action. Focuses on water quality, species protection, community empowerment & climate action in BC's biologically rich marine ecosystem.

Pro Esteros. Bi-national org protecting Baja California coastal wetlands since 1988. Studies wetlands for education, science, conservation. Works with communities on environmental education, research, resource conservation, capacity-building.

Friends of Bello Mundo. Advocacy collective advancing global ocean conservation. Works with governments, scientists, and stakeholders to protect 30% of oceans by 2030 through marine protected areas, halt biodiversity loss, and rebuild marine ecosystems.

Boyd Lyon Sea Turtle Fund. Annual $2,500 scholarship for marine biology students researching sea turtle behavior, habitat, abundance, distribution & diving safety. Established 2008 by Boyd N. Lyon's family through The Ocean Foundation.

earthDECKS.org Ocean Network. Meta-level platform reducing plastic in waterways/ocean. Connects organizations, tracks initiatives, enables collaborative action. Features PLASTIC portal, CIQ social platform, PETRI learning app for global network.

Redfish Rocks Community Team. Community team supporting Redfish Rocks Marine Reserve through research, engagement, and partnerships with Oregon Dept of Fish Wildlife. Develops management recommendations, evaluates reserve success, and serves as liaison.

Ocean Acidification Day of Action. Annual awareness campaign on Jan 8th educating public on ocean acidification (pH 8.1). Interactive website forecasts impacts on tourism, fisheries, biodiversity. Launched 2019 by The Ocean Foundation.

Friends of Havenworth Coastal Conservation. Conservation research of endangered smalltooth sawfish, sharks, and rays in Tampa Bay, Florida. Studies occurrence, distribution, habitat use, movements through research and public outreach since 2010.

The Wise Laboratory Field Research Program. Research on environmental toxicants affecting marine animals. Collects samples, conducts toxicology studies, establishes cell cultures, investigates contaminant impacts on endangered species & invertebrates, creates tissue repository.

La Tortuga Viva. Conserving Olive Ridley, Leatherback & Green sea turtles at Playa Icacos, Guerrero, Mexico. 10-14 local volunteers protect nests & release hatchlings. 500,000+ turtles released since 2010. Part of ReSiMar watershed program.

Friends of The Nonsuch Expeditions. Conservation expeditions on Nonsuch Island Nature Reserve, Bermuda & Sargasso Sea. Develops tech for conservation, protects critically endangered Cahow seabirds via CahowCam. Partners with local orgs for marine research & outreach.

Grupo Tortuguero. Works with local communities to recover migratory sea turtles. Builds conservation networks, studies human-caused threats, develops solutions, and promotes turtle conservation throughout the region.

Deep Green Wilderness. Sailboat-based education program using historic vessel Orion as floating classroom. Students explore estuarine ecosystems under sail, learning critical thinking, problem solving, and stewardship through hands-on marine curriculum.

The Ocean Project. Catalyzes collective action for ocean health and climate stability by collaborating with youth, zoos, aquariums, museums to grow a global network that engages public, informs policymakers, and protects the ocean.

SURMAR/ASIMAR. Understanding natural processes in central Gulf of California to conserve resources. Research on marine ecology, education with ITESME students, monitoring rocky intertidal invertebrates, reef fishes, jumbo squid. Since 2011.

World Ocean Day. Annual global event on June 8 raising ocean conservation awareness. The Ocean Project coordinates worldwide network supporting youth engagement, leadership, and advocacy for ocean protection year-round.

Shark Advocates International. Conserves vulnerable sharks/rays through science-based policies. Limits fishing/trade, strengthens finning bans globally. Builds stakeholder coalitions, advocates to governments. Nearly 2 decades of achievement.

New Central Arctic Ocean Protections. Establishing moratoriums on deep-sea mining and transpolar shipping in the 1.1M sq mile Central Arctic Ocean high seas area. Building on 2021 fishing agreement to protect climate regulation and ecosystems.

Blue Climate Solutions. Promotes ocean/coastal conservation as climate solution via Blue Carbon policy. Focuses on seagrass, mangroves, salt marshes as carbon sinks. Advocates at US govt & UNFCCC. Created Blue Climate Coalition.

Eastern Pacific Hawksbill Initiative (ICAPO). Promotes hawksbill turtle recovery in eastern Pacific through research, conservation, awareness. Collaborates with fishermen, scientists, policymakers from US to Peru. Established 2008.

The Marine Protection Atlas: A Global Accountability Tool for Tracking Marine Protected Area Progress. Global tool tracking marine protected areas effectiveness and progress toward 30% ocean protection by 2030. Publishes Marine Protection Atlas, assesses MPAs against MPA Guide framework, monitors nations' 30x30 targets.

Deep Sea Mining Campaign. NGOs and citizens from Australia, PNG, and Canada working to protect marine ecosystems from deep sea mining impacts. Seeks informed consent from communities and precautionary approach to DSM in Pacific region.

Tag-A-Giant Fund (TAG). Electronic tagging of 1,800 bluefin tuna to study migration, habitat, behavior. Scientists, policymakers, fishermen collaborate to rebuild Atlantic & Pacific populations through research-informed conservation policy.

The Science Exchange. Two-month hands-on field research internships training next generation in sea turtle conservation at Latin America and Caribbean sites. Released 250,000 hatchlings, removed 18,000+ trash pieces from beaches.

Ocean Revolution. Multi-cultural global initiative mentoring Indigenous communities and youth to protect oceans. Combines ancient knowledge with modern science, providing funding skills and infrastructure for marine justice and sustainable ocean use.

High Seas Alliance. Alliance of 40+ NGOs working to protect high seas biodiversity beyond national jurisdiction. Advocating for UN treaty (2018-2020) to establish marine protected areas and environmental impact assessments for threatened ecosystems.

Coastal Coordination. Protecting US coasts from offshore drilling via Adopt an Ocean project. Coordinates National Outer Continental Shelf Coalition advocacy for Gulf, Atlantic, Pacific, Arctic waters. Post-Deepwater Horizon policy work.

Inland Ocean Coalition. Building land-to-sea stewardship across inland North America. Engaging communities in IL, AZ, UT, CO, MI, NY, Manitoba on ocean/watershed conservation through education and activism, connecting inland actions to ocean health.

International Fisheries Conservation Program. Catalyzes sustainable global fisheries management through science-based harvest strategies, enforcement systems, and protection of vulnerable species like sharks and sea turtles across Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans since 2019.

Gray Whale Research in Mexico. Monitoring gray whales in Laguna San Ignacio & Bahia Magdalena, Baja California Sur. Studies breeding/calving whales, dolphins, sea turtles, sea lions, fish, shellfish & migratory birds. Trains future marine biologists.

St. Croix Leatherback Project. Conserves sea turtles on Caribbean/Pacific nesting beaches using genetics to study age, paternity, nest success & fishery bycatch. Partners with NOAA at Sandy Point NWR, St. Croix. Led by Dr. Kelly Stewart.

Ocean Connectors. Educates youth in San Diego & Nayarit about migratory marine life (turtles, whales, seabirds) through field trips, habitat restoration & binational exchange. Promotes conservation stewardship since 2007.

Removing Barriers to Effective Fisheries Transparency in the EU and Beyond. EU IUU Coalition campaigns to improve EU fleet transparency, minimize flags of convenience impacts, and raise international fisheries standards through cooperation with NGOs in Brussels, USA, and Japan.

Australia and Southern Ocean Protected Areas. Expanding Australia's marine sanctuary protection to 30% of EEZ by 2030 through marine park reviews and network expansion, leveraging political momentum and scientific standards for habitat protection.

Establishing the Joint Analytical Cell. TMT, GFW & IMCSN collaborate to detect/deter IUU fishing, increase transparency, build MCS capacity in developing countries, and support global fisheries policy through shared intelligence tools and databases.

Improving Fisheries Transparency in Fiji. WWF collaborates with Fiji stakeholders to combat illegal, unreported, and unregulated fishing through improved fisheries transparency and traceability systems for sustainable fisheries management.

Global Transparency Coalition. Oceana & EJF build multinational coalition to coordinate transparency advocacy in fisheries. Aims to connect progress in vessel tracking, licensing & enforcement globally to advance marine sustainability & science-based mgmt.

Pacific Remote Islands Expansion. Expanding Pacific Remote Islands Marine National Monument by 685,000 sq km to protect threatened species, study climate resilience in pristine ecosystems, and preserve cultural voyaging seascapes in the U.S. EEZ.

Antarctic MPAs Campaign. ASOC advocates for 3 Southern Ocean MPAs (East Antarctic, Weddell Sea, Antarctic Peninsula) via CCAMLR consensus. Targets 3.8M km² protection through member outreach, meetings, public awareness. Ongoing campaign since 2009 commitment.

Three High Seas Protected Areas: Steering the Course to 30x30. Greenpeace drives 30x30 ocean protection via Global Oceans Treaty, targeting Sargasso Sea, Emperor Seamounts, South Tasman Sea MPAs. Arctic Sunrise expeditions conduct research, expose exploitation, mobilize support. 2024-2027.

Supporting Sustainable Fisheries and Protected Areas in Fiji. Building transparent processes to increase sustainable fisheries management and MPAs in Fiji. Implementing science-based size limits, identifying offshore MPAs for 30% protection goal, executing Lau Seascape Strategy.

Supporting the High Seas Alliance Biodiversity Treaty. Supporting UN treaty development (2018-2020) for high seas protection. Aims to establish marine protected areas and environmental assessments in areas beyond national jurisdiction covering 50% of planet.

Ending the Unsustainable Shark Trade. IFAW regulates global shark/ray trade via CITES to protect threatened species from fin/meat demand. Identifies illegal shipments, drives fisheries management to reduce mortality and enable population recovery worldwide.

Seychelles Protected Areas Implementation and Fisheries Reforms. Seychelles expanded MPAs from <1% to 32.6% (441,000 km²) in 2020. Project supports implementation, adaptive management of Marine Spatial Plan through capacity building and enabling activities.

30x30 Ocean Alliance. Alliance working to protect 30% of global ocean through MPAs by advocating within CBD processes. Aims to increase ocean protection in national waters and high seas to tackle climate change and preserve biodiversity.

Australia Import Controls. McKell Institute convenes Intergovernmental Council to stop IUU fishing seafood imports into Australia. Builds consensus with industry, civil society, policymakers through evidence-based approach to protect environment and workers.

Ending Bottom Trawling on Seamounts in New Zealand. Campaign to ban destructive bottom trawling on NZ seamounts. Protects ancient corals & ecosystems from nets dragging seafloor. 50k+ petition urges govt action. Shifts industry to lower-impact fishing methods.

Plastic Solutions Fund. Funder collaborative reducing single-use plastic & packaging at supply chain source. Targets companies, Asian cities' waste mgmt, cultural shift. 80% ocean plastic comes from land. Goal: make single-use exception, not norm.

Constraining Offshore Oil and Gas in Australia. AMCS & EDO campaign to stop offshore oil/gas expansion in SE Australia. Mobilizes coastal communities & marine stakeholders through legal support, advocacy & communications to oppose new fossil fuel developments threatening climate & biodiversity.

Strengthening High Seas Governance. Global Ocean Commission advocates for high seas protection beyond 200-mile zones through 8 proposals including SDG goals, ending illegal fishing, reducing plastic pollution, and establishing accountability boards. Implementation phase 2014+.

Improving Transparency and Accountability at RFMOs. Pew reforms Regional Fisheries Management Organizations globally through transparent compliance mechanisms, harvest strategies, and accountability coalitions to ensure sustainable international fisheries management.

Campaign for a Global Moratorium on Deep Seabed Mining. Deep Sea Conservation Coalition advocates for halting deep seabed mining globally until environmental risks are understood, biodiversity protection ensured, and ISA governance reformed. Targets ISA regulations.

Protected Areas in the Mediterranean. Med Sea Alliance campaigns for 30% Mediterranean protection (10% highly protected) by 2030 to restore ecosystems, recover fish stocks, and build climate resilience through coordinated policy action.

Truly Protected Marine Areas in France. BLOOM works to ensure French MPAs are truly protected from high-impact fishing gear like bottom trawling. France claims 30% EEZ protection but actually protects <4% from mobile gears. Project aims to improve MPA effectiveness.

European Fisheries Litigation Energy Transition. ClientEarth uses law to end EU overfishing, hold governments accountable for fishing limits above scientific advice, and support fisheries sector in nature-positive energy transition to protect marine biodiversity.

Protected Areas in Greece. WWF Greece works to achieve 30% marine protection by 2030 through establishing ecologically representative MPAs (10% strictly protected) and biodiversity-inclusive marine spatial planning across Greek waters.

Protecting Micronesian Waters. Expanding commercial fishing exclusion zones from 12nm to 24nm around FSM and RMI islands, achieving 10% water protection. Developing Protected Areas Networks and sustainable financing for Micronesia Challenge goals.

Turning Germany into a True Ocean Champion. Strengthening German ocean governance & EU marine policy post-coalition agreement. Balancing offshore wind expansion with biodiversity protection while preventing fossil fuel projects justified by energy security concerns.

Protecting Mediterranean Vulnerable Marine Ecosystems. Promoting Fisheries Restricted Areas network across Mediterranean Sea to protect essential fish habitats and vulnerable ecosystems through stakeholder engagement, spatial measures, and fishing effort reduction since 2016.

Ending Overfishing is Climate Action. Campaign to end EU overfishing, restore ocean health & mitigate climate change through science-based fisheries management. Amplifies climate/biodiversity benefits, builds public support, influences EU fisheries managers.

Protected Areas in Israel. Establishing marine reserves in Israeli Mediterranean EEZ based on scientific evidence. Protecting deep-water corals, chemosynthetic communities, sharks. Promoting legislation, spatial planning, expanding bottom trawling ban by 2030.

Protected Areas in France. BLOOM works to achieve true protection of French marine areas. France protects <4% of its EEZ, with only 0.005% of Channel/Atlantic/North Sea waters protected from industrial fishing, despite being world's 2nd largest maritime nation.

Indigenous Conservation in Greenland (Kalaallit Nunaat) Protected Areas. Oceans North Kalaallit Nunaat supports Inuit-led marine conservation through community engagement, research, and stewardship. Builds knowledge of marine environments, advances Indigenous rights, and develops sustainable conservation initiatives.

Ending Trawling in Protected Areas in the Mediterranean Sea. International campaign to stop illegal bottom trawling in Mediterranean protected areas through investigation, legal action, and advocacy. Aims to enforce existing MPAs and expand no-trawl zones across the world's most overfished sea.

Fisheries Transparency in the Mediterranean. Med Sea Alliance works with EU & non-EU states to increase transparency & anti-IUU measures in Mediterranean fisheries through GFCM, partnering with Morocco, Tunisia, Turkey, Albania, Egypt to improve implementation.

Establishment of Marine Managed Areas in Papua New Guinea and Solomon Islands. WCS works with communities & govt in Bismarck-Solomon Seas to create 30,000 km² of marine managed areas with tiered zoning to protect biodiversity & sustain fisheries amid growing population & fishing pressure by 2020.

Protected Areas Treaty Ratification in South Korea. Enhance Korea's role in marine conservation with international leverage while aligning national policies with global ocean conservation goals through treaty ratification efforts.

Reforming Fisheries in St. Helena. Creating world's first one-by-one tuna fishing zone in St Helena's 447,000 km2 maritime area, banning destructive gear, protecting marine life, supporting sustainable small-scale fishery and local community.

Turning the Tide for EU Fisheries. EU-wide advocacy to end overfishing by 2020, reduce bottom trawling impacts (35% shelf area disturbed), mitigate cetacean bycatch. Coordinated push targeting EU Commission, Parliament, 27 Member States. Focus: Germany, France, Spain.

Future of European Fisheries. EU-wide advocacy campaign to transform fisheries policies toward low-impact, regenerative practices. Targets EU policy initiatives, Nature Restoration Law, and phase-out of bottom trawling. Focus on Germany, France, Spain.

Republic of Ireland Protected Areas. Fair Seas coalition campaigns to expand Ireland's MPAs from 2% to 30% by 2030. Identifies 16 priority areas along Irish coast to protect endangered sharks, seabirds, whales. Addresses habitat decline, fisheries management gaps.

Japan Anti-IUU Forum Project. Supporting Japanese govt to implement Catch Documentation Scheme & Import Control Rules to eliminate illegal fishing in seafood trade. Engaging stakeholders to transform Japan's fisheries system post-2018 reform.

Small Grant Supporting Indonesian Fisheries Reform. Indonesian think tank supports government with evidence-based fisheries policy, combating IUU fishing, harmful gear, and modern slavery while strengthening small-scale fishing communities through 2024.

Improving Human Rights in Indonesia and Taiwan. Campaign to end debt bondage of Indonesian migrant fishers in Taiwan's distant water fishing industry through bilateral migration agreement, union collaboration, and policy solutions against recruitment fees and forced labor.

Reducing IUU Fishing in Cambodia and Vietnam. Mitigating illegal fishing & improving co-management of marine protected areas in Cambodia & Vietnam through collaboration with government & civil society to protect fisheries & coastal livelihoods.

Protected Areas and OECMs in Japan. Expanding Japan's MPAs to 30% by 2030 through effective biodiversity conservation, monitoring, and stakeholder engagement with fishermen and citizens in model areas across Japan's EEZ.

Strengthening Partnerships Towards Philippines National 30x30. Multi-NGO partnership supporting Philippines' 30x30 conservation target. Develops roadmap with Biodiversity Management Bureau to set national targets and identify priority marine areas through participatory approach.

Combating IUU in Indonesia. Combating illegal fishing & wildlife trade in Indonesia's FMA 712-713 through anti-money laundering enforcement, mapping criminal networks, strengthening law enforcement capacity, and tracing financial flows.

Advancing Yellow Sea Conservation Efforts and Creating an MPA Network in China. WWF creates MPA network in Yellow Sea Ecoregion, China, targeting 30% protection by 2030 through stakeholder partnerships, blue economy principles, and community support for effective marine conservation.

Jeju Marine Protected Area Management. Green Korea United works to strengthen Jeju Island's MPA management through diagnosis, stakeholder consultation, and introducing no-take zones to address climate change impacts, pollution, and sea desertification.

Advancing Equitable, Effective Protection of Marine and Coastal Areas in Indonesia. Supporting Indonesia's goal to protect 30% of waters by 2045. NGO consortium develops coordination mechanisms, criteria, and guidelines for functional MPAs and OECMs, piloting innovative approaches at 4 MPA and 5 OECM sites.

Declaration of Coto Island MPA to Strengthen the MPA Network in Vietnam. Establishing Coto archipelago (40 islands near Halong Bay) as official MPA. MCD facilitates Quang Ninh province through zoning, planning, socio-economic assessment to achieve full operational status by 2020, strengthening Vietnam's MPA network.

Improving Transparency and Fisheries Reform in Taiwan. Establish responsible fisheries in Taiwan through advocacy, research & investigations. Ensure effective regulatory management & implement marine conservation & sustainable fisheries concepts over 3 years.

Building a National Alliance of Fishers for Policy Advocacy on Sustainable Fisheries and Livelihoods. 18-month project uniting small-scale fishers across Philippines to combat illegal fishing & advocate policy reform. Builds national alliance through consultations, creating unified agenda against IUUF threatening $1.3B annually.

Establishing an Indo-Pacific Bottlenose Dolphin Protected Area in Jeju, South Korea. Protect 10km2 Daejung coastal area as Marine Life Protected Area for Indo-Pacific Bottlenose Dolphins through government advocacy, expert workshops, community engagement, and public campaigns by end of 2023.

New Brazil Fisheries Law. Reform Brazil's Fisheries Policy by 2025 to create stable management framework, prevent overfishing, rebuild depleted stocks, establish monitoring systems, and require management plans for sustainable fisheries.

Sustainable Fisheries and Protected Areas in Sri Lanka. Protecting Sri Lanka's oceans by 2030 through coastal resource management, increasing MPA coverage from 0.46% to 2.0%, declaring new marine sanctuaries, and implementing action plans against illegal fishing.

Improving South Korea's Marine Conservation. CIES & KFEM strengthen Korea's MPA commitment through stakeholder dialogue with government, evidence-based awareness campaigns targeting National Assembly, ministries, academia & public to align domestic standards with global norms.

Combatting Illegal Unregulated Squid Fisheries. Addresses IUU fishing by distant water fleets targeting squid in international waters, focusing on South American coasts. Tackles illegal, unregulated & unreported fishing to protect keystone squid species & marine ecosystems.

Creating the Patagonic Marine Protected Areas Corridor. 3-year project to explore, protect & restore kelp forests along Santa Cruz & Tierra del Fuego coasts in Argentina, creating MPA corridor for long-term ecosystem & biodiversity conservation.

Timor-Leste 30x30 Strategy. Supporting Timor-Leste to protect 30% of marine waters by 2030 through MPA network expansion, management effectiveness tools, capacity building, and science-based policies integrating traditional Tara Bandu practices.

A Policy-Oriented Toolkit for Reducing Illegality in Small-Scale Fisheries in Chile. Develops standardized tools to estimate, monitor IUU fishing in Chile's small-scale fisheries. Co-designed with government to improve enforcement and guide policy for new fisheries law, transferable to Latin America.

Protected Areas and Fisheries in the Pribilof Islands Alaska. Indigenous-led ocean stewardship model in Alaska. First Alaskans Institute & Ocean Conservancy strengthen Indigenous authority over marine resources through Self-Determination & Self-Governance in Pribilof Islands.

Small-Scale Fisheries in South Africa. Improving sustainability of small-scale fisheries in South Africa while building positive relationships between MPAs and vulnerable rural fishers dependent on marine resources for livelihoods and food security.

Bahamas Offshore Oil & Gas Moratorium. Coalition led by Waterkeeper Alliance resists offshore drilling in Bahamas since 2020, advancing permanent ban to protect marine resources and climate-vulnerable economy dependent on ocean health.

Western St. James Bay National Marine Conservation Area. Establishing 90,000 km² NMCA in Western James Bay/SW Hudson Bay by 2025. Protects polar bears, beluga whales, 170+ bird species, wild rivers. Mushkegowuk Council & Parks Canada complete feasibility by July 2024.

Protected Areas in the Congo Republic. Create 3 new MPAs in Republic of Congo with science-led management strategies. Provide institutional support, capacity building, and increase awareness among local communities and government for marine protection.

Northeast Canyons and Seamounts Marine National Monument and Antiquities Act Defense Initiative. Legal campaign to reverse 2020 rollback opening NE Canyons monument to commercial fishing. Multi-org effort to protect Atlantic's only marine monument and set precedent for 30x30 ocean conservation goals.

Un Solo Mar: Building Protected Areas in Uruguay & Brazil. Establishing 2 adjacent MPAs (150,000+ km2) in Southwest Atlantic covering La Plata River estuary. Improving Brazil-Uruguay marine biodiversity conservation, ecosystem connectivity, IUU fishing control. 3-year project.

Conservation of the Patagonian Sea. Protecting Patagonian Sea ecosystems in Argentina & Chile through MPA expansion, eco-regional planning & governance. Safeguards whales, albatrosses, penguins & seals in unique Pacific-Atlantic convergence zone.

Campaign to Restore U.S. Sharks. Coalition advancing policy reforms for shark/ray conservation in US. Targets Congress & Biden Admin to restore international leadership, improve fisheries management, leverage litigation. 2/3 of 34 US shark stocks unsustainably low.

Combatting IUU Fishing in Guyana, Suriname and French Guiana (The Guianas). WWF reduces illegal fishing in the Guianas by developing National Plans, strengthening regional cooperation, improving artisanal fisheries management, and building capacity of fisheries departments across Guyana, Suriname, French Guiana.

Bermuda Ocean Prosperity Programme - Protected Areas. Partnership creating 90,000km² marine protected areas (20% of Bermuda waters) through community-driven marine spatial planning to develop Blue Economy, improve fisheries management, and sustainably manage ocean resources.

Partnering to Advance Hawaii's Marine 30x30 Initiative. Supporting Hawaii to effectively manage 30% of nearshore waters as marine management areas by 2030 through community stewardship, science, and governance to restore abundance and protect marine resources.

The Bahamas Offshore Drilling Campaign Phase Two. Coalition educates Bahamians on offshore oil drilling impacts. Launched Apr 2020 by Waterkeepers Bahamas & BREEF. Pressures government through advocacy, petitions, stakeholder engagement to prevent drilling in Bahamas waters.

Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary Designation Campaign. Indigenous-led campaign to designate 150-mile sanctuary off California coast protecting kelp, marine life, cultural sites from oil/gas extraction. NOAA review launched 2021, completion expected 2023 in San Luis Obispo-Santa Barbara.

Supporting Marine Spatial Planning under the Bermuda Ocean Prosperity Programme. Bermuda govt, Waitt Institute & BIOS collaborate on Blue Economy via Marine Spatial Planning. Stakeholder-led process to optimize marine industries, protect 20% of 465,000 km² EEZ through science & public input.

Cayman Crown: The Jewel of the Mesoamerican Reef. Protecting Cayman Crown reef on Guatemala-Belize border as no-take zone. Establishes legal protection, monitors fish spawning aggregations, strengthens sustainable finance. Aims to replenish commercial fish stocks across MAR.

Fisheries Subsidies in Latin America. AIDA advocates for reforming harmful fisheries subsidies in Latin America through governance and policy work to protect depleted fisheries, promote coastal livelihoods, and conserve marine ecosystems.

Rebuilding Cuban Fisheries. Why: Overfishing threatens coral reefs & fish populations. What: Science-based fishery management. How: Build capacity, strengthen institutions, policy reform, integrate MPAs. Where: Cuba. When: Ongoing

Strengthening & Expanding Protected Areas in Canada. SeaBlue Canada coalition works to protect 25% of Canada's ocean by 2025, 30% by 2030 across all three coasts through science-based marine protection, Indigenous partnerships, and community engagement.

Cape Verde Marine Protected Areas Network. Strengthening Cape Verde's MPA network to protect migrant megafauna (whales, sharks, turtles) and local species from fishing pressure. Creating safe corridors with participatory management involving local communities.

Improving Fisheries Governance in Ghana and the Wider Sub-Region. Strengthens fisheries governance in Ghana & West Africa through transparency, law enforcement & collaborative management to combat illegal fishing & prevent collapse of small pelagic fisheries critical to 2.7M livelihoods.

Fish Meal Plants in West Africa. Prevent fishmeal/fish oil industry from destroying West African fish stocks via 3-year research, investigation & advocacy program. Secure legislative changes to protect ecosystems & food sovereignty through civil society engagement.

New Regional Transparency Policy in Southern Africa. Reduce illegal fishing in SADC region by developing regional transparency policy aligned with Global Charter. Demonstrate benefits through vessel assessment/inspection, gain support for SADC fishing vessel register standards.

Strait of Magellan Marine Reserves. Rewilding Chile creates marine parks in Chilean Patagonia, removing salmon farms from protected waters. Aims to increase coastal protection from <1% to 10% through no-take zones in the Route of Parks.

Scaling Community-Based Fisheries Management in Mozambique. Rare's Fish Forever program establishes managed access areas and no-take marine reserves in 6 coastal communities, reaching 8,000 fishers to combat overfishing and protect biodiversity through community-led management.

Marine Biodiversity Protection in Mozambique and Tanzania. WCS enhances protection of Western Indian Ocean biodiversity hotspots (mangroves, coral reefs, seagrass) through community-based MPA design in Mozambique and Tanzania, addressing threats from unregulated fishing and development.

Sustainability and traceability of small-scale fisheries in São Paulo, Brazil. Establishes market incentives for sustainable fishing in North Coast MPA, São Paulo. Uses traceability tech on vessels to track catch origin, gear, practices. Connects fishers to restaurants via QR codes, rewarding sustainability.

Ending Destructive Industrial Fishing in Madagascar and the Western Indian Ocean. Blue Ventures combats IUU fishing in Madagascar's waters, supporting authorities to monitor fisheries, improve transparency, and protect small-scale fisher rights. Addresses $80M annual losses from illegal industrial fleets.

Small Grant MPA Workshop to Aid the Establishment of a New Large MPA in the Dutch Caribbean. Workshop in Aruba bringing Dutch Caribbean islands together to share MPA best practices, explore management options, and expand MPA network across the region with government officials, NGOs, and international experts.

Improving Fishery Management and Stopping IUU Fishing in Cameroon. Combat illegal fishing in Cameroon by strengthening governance, legal frameworks, and monitoring systems. Revise legislation, enhance control systems, and develop fishery management plans. Started March 2022 for 3 years.

An NGO Alliance to Protect and Extend European MPAs. 4-year project by Oceana & Seas At Risk to protect European MPAs from destructive fishing, establish EU restoration law targets (10% strict protection, 15% restoration), and create no-take zones in 4+ countries.

Protected Areas and Transparency in Cameroon. Supports Douala-Edea MPA management covering 10% EEZ, combats illegal industrial fishing in mangroves/territorial waters, strengthens community surveillance and advocacy to protect endangered species and artisanal fisheries.

Effective Management of the Marine Protected Areas of the Comoros Archipelago. Strengthens management of 4 coastal MPAs in Comoros to protect marine biodiversity, restore fisheries, support Blue Economy Plan. Enhances resilience of coastal communities dependent on ocean assets in Western Indian Ocean.

Namibia Marine Protected Areas. Supporting Namibia's NIMPA (10,000km² MPA) management plan development and future MPA designation to reach 10% EEZ protection. Addressing lack of enforcement, regulations for Africa's 2nd largest MPA along Benguela Current.

Protecting the Sea of Okhotsk and Northern Kuril Islands. Building on WWF Russia's conservation planning to protect bowhead whales and sea otters in the Sea of Okhotsk through creating a conservation action plan and supporting MPA designation in priority biodiversity areas.

Reinforcing Fisheries Governance in Guinea. Combats illegal fishing in Guinea through policy reform, transparency improvement, and technical capacity building. Strengthens fisheries governance and sustainable management of marine resources along Guinea's coast.

New Policies to Combat IUU Fishing in Taiwan. Shaping Taiwan's fishing industry from within by promoting transparency, legal enforcement & self-discipline measures as indicators toward sustainable fisheries, exploring alternatives to surface-level policy demands.

Reinforcing the Fight Against IUU Fishing in Senegal. Combats illegal fishing in Senegal through improved governance, transparency, and enforcement. Strengthens fisheries management, builds stakeholder capacity, implements FiTI standards, and enhances regional cooperation to protect overexploited stocks

Protect the Protected Area of Baía do Inferno, Cabo Verde. Protecting seabird colonies & marine biodiversity in Baía do Inferno MPA through management plan development, sustainable fishing practices, community engagement with fishermen, and conservation of sea turtles, sharks & endemic species.

Transparency in New Zealand Fisheries. WWF NZ designs full transparency model to eliminate illegal/unethical fishing in NZ waters. Partners with industry/government to shift fisheries policy, enable traceability, create global benchmark for sustainable practices.

Korea Coalition Against IUU: Towards Sustainable and Ethical Fisheries in Korea. Coalition addresses IUU fishing in Korea through legal reform, labor rights protection, port/flag state compliance with international standards, and public education to transform fisheries practices.

Africa-China Distant Water Fishing Transparency Track II Dialogue. Track II dialogue between West African states and China to increase transparency in distant water fishing, combat IUU fishing, and develop recommendations for better fisheries management in West Africa.

Indonesia Ocean Justice Initiative. Policy advocacy promoting sustainable ocean governance in Indonesia through enforcement support, international advocacy, policy reform & access to justice. Addresses plastic pollution, illegal fishing & climate impacts.

EU Transparency and Control Regulation. Coalition strengthening EU fisheries Control Regulation through Remote Electronic Monitoring, electronic reporting for all vessels, and transparency requirements to ensure compliance and sustainable fisheries across EU waters.

Advancing Effective Co-Management of Marine Ecosystems in Cambodia's Kampot and Kep Provinces. Protecting Cambodia's coral reefs, seagrass meadows & marine life through co-management. Creating new MPA in Kampot & operationalizing Kep MFMA to combat destructive fishing & coastal development threats.

Our Islands, Our Future. Coalition campaign to stop Bahamas Petroleum Company offshore drilling through advocacy, stakeholder engagement, and litigation. Aims to protect Bahamas' tourism and fisheries from oil pollution risks.

Who Stole Our Oceans: Empowering Local Communities to Protect Our Oceans. Empowers South African coastal communities to protect ocean ecosystems through skills training and network building. Addresses overfishing, climate change, and oil/gas threats while advocating for MPAs and sustainable livelihoods.

Advocating for the passing of shark conservation policies and preparation for their implementation. Establish legal frameworks for shark conservation in Philippines, support CITES listings for threatened shark/ray species, promote sustainable fisheries and protect marine biodiversity through policy advocacy.

Standard for Ultimate Beneficial Ownership Reporting. Establishing global standard for beneficial ownership reporting in fishing industry to combat IUU fishing. C4ADS, Pew & TMT define UBO, analyze fleet ownership networks to enable better regulation & enforcement.

Technological Tools and Policy Innovation as a Tool to Eliminate and Prevent IUU Fishing. Colombia combats illegal fishing through vessel registry platform, environmental jurisdiction, judicial capacity building for Port State Measures Agreement compliance and sustainable fisheries.

MPA Guide - CBD Post-2020 Ocean Protection Campaign. Coordinates grantees to secure 30% ocean protection by 2030 through CBD negotiations. Partners with UN agencies, scientists, NGOs via OneOcean flotilla. Targets quantitative/qualitative MPA goals in post-2020 agenda. March 2020-2021.

Joint Campaign on IUU Fishing Transparency and Human Rights. Oceana, WWF, CSIS combat illegal fishing in US seafood imports via trade sanctions, supply chain reform, AIS transparency, and linking IUU fishing to human rights abuses. Targets $1B annual illegal catch.

Protecting Japan's Seafood Market from IUU Fish: Establishing Traceability and Transparency Systems. Anti-IUU Forum Japan works to eliminate illegal seafood from Japanese markets through import controls, catch documentation, and transparency in fishery management. Builds on 2016-2019 momentum to transform systems.

Arctic Ocean Protection in Canada. Protecting Canadian Arctic marine ecosystems threatened by industrial development and climate change through Indigenous partnerships, research, and policy to ensure resilient oceans for future generations.

Charting a Course to Sustainable Fisheries Post-Brexit. RSPB, MCS & WWF-UK collaborate to influence UK post-Brexit fisheries legislation for sustainable, climate-positive regulations. Advocacy for binding commitments: 30% protected seas by 2030, end overfishing, REM on vessels, net zero strategy.

Taiwan Flags of Convenience. Supports Taiwan's control of foreign-flagged vessels with Taiwanese ownership to combat IUU fishing and labor abuses. Partners provide data tools, intelligence, and global cooperation to implement Taiwan's FOC vessel governance act.

Combating IUU Fishing in South American Squid Fisheries. Engaging Latin American producers and global supply chains to combat illegal fishing in jumbo flying squid and Argentine shortfin squid fisheries through transparency tools and market-based approaches.

Increasing Transparency and Accountability in the EU. ClientEarth holds EU accountable to end overfishing by securing sustainable catch limits, enforcing no-discards rule, closing subsidy loopholes, and preventing weakening of Common Fisheries Policy across 27 member states.

Supporting Vietnamese Fisheries Reform. Builds on Vietnam's revised fisheries law to scale co-management practices across 6 coastal sites in Binh Dinh, Quang Nam & Khanh Hoa provinces, developing national guidelines & training 35 champions for sustainable fisheries.

To Support Establishment of MPAs in Antarctic Waters. Campaign to establish marine protected areas in Antarctic waters through CCAMLR. Built international coalition to advocate for conservation, resulting in creation of Ross Sea MPA, the largest on Earth.

To Support New MPA Policies from Arctic Council. Coalition developing interconnected MPA network across circumpolar Arctic. Addresses climate change impacts & human activity threats. Leverages Arctic Council meetings to establish ecologically significant protection network.

Improving Traceability Policy Work in Japan. Seafood Legacy designs traceability models for imported & domestic seafood in Japan to combat IUU fishing, working with NGOs & industry. CEO advises Cabinet Office on robust regulation & transparent supply chains.

Support Establishment of Seafood Traceability Regulations. Combat illegal fishing by developing US regulations ensuring all seafood is legally sourced and traceable from bait to plate, closing major market to illegal imports and driving global traceability standards.

Curbing Destructive Fishing in Nicaragua. Eliminated blast-fishing & bottom trawling on Nicaragua's Pacific coast to protect sea turtles (Olive Ridley, Hawksbill, Leatherback). Established MPAs, strengthened fisheries compliance, enabled sustainable artisanal fishing & tourism.

Transparency and Fish Refuges in Mexico. COBI creates science-based fish refuges through community participation while Causa Natura uses data platforms to increase transparency in fisheries policy, subsidies, and combating illegal fishing across Mexico's waters.

National Marine Monument Coalition. Coalition of 30+ NGOs coordinated advocacy for U.S. marine monument designations. Resulted in Papahanaumokuakea expansion (2016) and Northeast Canyons monument creation, protecting 2.1M km² of ocean.

Protecting Russia's Arctic. WWF Russia works to establish 6 new Arctic marine reserves from Beringia to Victoria Island through scientific assessments and community consultations, building on Putin's 2013 commitment to expand conservation areas.

Advancing Marine Protected Areas in The Bahamas. Expanding Bahamas MPA network from 10% to 20% by 2020 across 700 islands. Developing management plans, by-laws, and sustainable finance for protected areas covering nearshore and deep ocean habitats.

To Strengthen Fisheries Enforcement in Eastern Tropical Pacific Ocean. Combat IUU fishing in Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, Ecuador marine reserves (Cocos, Coiba, Malpelo, Galapagos). Strengthen enforcement, radar facility, vessel registries, Port State Measures Agreement. 2012-2015.

Improving Fisheries in the Mesoamerican Reef. Improves fisheries data collection and marine surveillance in Honduras and Belize through electronic licensing, vessel tracking, and catch documentation systems to enhance sustainable fisheries management in the Mesoamerican Reef.

Electronic Monitoring for Pacific Tuna. TNC assists Pacific Island govts to deploy video cameras, sensors & GPS on longline tuna vessels in Western & Central Pacific Ocean to combat illegal fishing that costs $7B annually & threatens sustainability

Expanding Pacific Remote Islands Monument. Expanded Pacific Remote Islands Marine Monument from 225,000 to 1.2M sq km, protecting pristine tropical marine environments around 7 islands. Built public support through advocacy. Completed Sept 2014.

Establishing an MPA Network in South Africa. Building public support for MPAs to achieve 10% ocean protection by 2020. 20 new/expanded MPAs approved (50,000 km2, 5% EEZ). Countering oil/mining threats, promoting ecosystem services, food security, climate resilience.

Protecting the Phoenix Islands. Supporting implementation of Phoenix Islands Protected Area (PIPA), 400,000 km² marine reserve in Kiribati. Fully protected since Jan 2015. Funds support management, surveillance, enforcement of pristine Pacific waters.

Coordinating Compliance Management in the Central ETP. PACIFICO supports ministers to develop Regional Marine Strategy for compliance management across 2.15M km² Central Eastern Tropical Pacific, coordinating Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Panama via data sharing & transparency.

Marine Spatial Planning in the Eastern Caribbean. Debt-for-nature swap enabling Grenada, Dominica & Saint Lucia to create 22,000 km² marine managed areas & no-take zones through marine spatial planning, addressing conservation & climate adaptation needs.

Northern Bering Sea Protected Area. Bering Sea Elders Group protects northern Bering Sea ecosystem & tribal culture. Addresses climate change, sea ice loss, increased shipping/fishing. Builds community resilience, ensures food security for 60+ tribes.

Improving China's Domestic Fisheries. NRDC provides legal/technical support for China's fisheries law revision (first since 2000). Promotes sustainable management, catch monitoring systems to restore depleted species and reduce distant water fishing pressure.

Controlling Illegal Fishing in Europe. Advocacy campaign to improve EU IUU Regulation implementation, combating illegal fishing through transparency in seafood supply chains. Four NGOs work in Brussels and EU states to protect marine biodiversity and legal fishers.

Expanding the Ring of Life for the Russian Marine Arctic. WWF-Russia expands marine protected areas in Russian Arctic since 2014. Protects biodiversity from shipping, unsustainable fishing. New Siberian Islands designated as largest reserve, 4 more MPAs pending approval.

Support Identification of Beneficial Owners of Purse Seine Fleet. C4ADS maps ownership of global tuna purse seine vessels using open-source data and corporate network analysis to identify beneficial owners, increasing transparency to combat IUU fishing and support industry accountability.

Shark Conservation Fund. Halts overexploitation of sharks and rays globally through trade regulation, legal protections, and sustainable fishing measures. Focuses on CITES listings, preventing extinctions, and policy advocacy.

Protecting and Financing Cuba's Marine Protected Areas. WCS strengthens Cuba's MPA system covering 15,000 km2 (21.5% territorial waters). Focus on Gardens of the Queen, Zapata Swamp, and Los Colorados. Develops sustainable financing and protection mechanisms.

Evaluating Distant Water Fishing Fleets. Research by Stimson Center mapping top 10 distant water fishing fleets globally, analyzing their geostrategic impacts, operations, hotspots, and role in food/economic/geopolitical security and international tensions.

Increasing Fishing Transparency and Combating IUU Fishing in West Africa. TMT & Global Fishing Watch track industrial fishing in West African waters, expose illegal operations, strengthen regional enforcement capacity, and improve fisheries intelligence sharing to combat IUU fishing.

Combatting IUU Fishing in Japan. Combat illegal fishing in Japan (13-31% of catches). Research economic impacts of IUU imports, engage government & industry stakeholders to accelerate Japan's fight against IUU fishing & protect depleted fish stocks.

Accelerating Marine Reserves. Compiling lessons learned and analyzing challenges in establishing marine reserves globally. Aims to accelerate protection toward 30% ocean coverage through expert consultation and identifying opportunities for effective no-take zones.

Protecting the Seychelles. Debt-for-nature swap creating Indian Ocean's 2nd largest marine reserve & climate resilience trust fund in Seychelles archipelago. TNC & Island Conservation Society work with govt on science-based conservation.

Support Establishment of Cook Islands Marine Park. Supporting traditional Maori leaders & local groups to create 1.1M km² marine park in Southern Cook Islands through community consultations, legal frameworks & communications. Started 2013, 3-year funding.

Protecting the South Atlantic from IUU Fishing and Human Rights Abuses. Combat illegal fishing & human rights abuses in Southwest Atlantic via Port of Montevideo controls, dialogue, sustainable fishing promotion & youth awareness in Uruguay's rich marine environment.

To Establish Marine Reserves in the UK Overseas Territories. Great British Oceans campaign calling for UK to protect 1.75M km² across Pitcairn, Ascension, South Georgia & South Sandwich Islands. Safeguards penguins, whales, turtles, sharks in pristine waters.

Transforming Tonga's Ocean Management. Supporting Tonga's first marine spatial plan covering 700,000 km2 with 30% MPA network. Includes national consultations, awareness programs, and regulatory implementation by 2020 for sustainable ocean development.

Protecting the Adriatic Sea. Limiting overfishing and protecting habitat in the Adriatic Sea through Fisheries Restricted Areas, vessel tracking, and fishing capacity controls. Targets bottom-dwelling species recovery in Mediterranean's most productive area.

Transshipment Governance in the Western and Central Pacific Ocean. Reform transshipment governance in WCPO to combat $142M annual IUU fishing. Pew, WWF, ANCORS & FFA review monitoring gaps, develop standards for tuna transfer oversight at sea and in port across Pacific nations. 2017-2020.

To Support Establishment of MPAs in Antarctica. Supporting Antarctic and Southern Ocean Coalition to create marine protected areas in East Antarctic, Weddell Sea, and Antarctic Peninsula by 2020, protecting penguins, whales, seals through CCAMLR consensus-building.

Protecting Canada's Marine and Coastal Environment. Collaborative project to achieve 10% marine protection by 2020 in Canada's Pacific/Atlantic coasts. Focuses on high biodiversity areas, Indigenous Protected Areas, improving Oceans Act processes, engaging stakeholders.

To Support Development of Protective Deep Sea Mining Regulations. 3-year project to enhance transparency and regulate deep sea mining through ISA. Strengthens seabed mining regulations, improves ISA decision-making, secures no-take areas to protect deep sea biodiversity hotspots.

To Support Listing of Shark Species at CITES. Coalition secured CITES Appendix II listing for 5 threatened shark species (porbeagle, oceanic whitetip, 3 hammerheads) at 2013 meeting through research, advocacy. Makes trade sustainable, legal, transparent via export permits.

Improving Transparency in South Korea and Taiwan. Coalition addressing IUU fishing in South Korea through legal reforms, transparency improvements in distant water/domestic fleets, labor rights protection, and industry due diligence on fishing practices.

Restoring Seagrass to Protect from Coastal Erosion. Why: Protect village from coastal erosion. What: Seagrass replanting. How: Local teenagers led by resident & marine scientist. Where: West Yensawai, Raja Ampat, Indonesia. When: 2022

Aqaba Marine Park Project. Jordan's first marine reserve in Gulf of Aqaba to protect unique heat-resistant coral reefs, establish marine biology research center, and promote ecotourism. Launched 2021 with international advisory board.

Kuriat Islands Tunisia - Environmental Police Training. Notre Grand Bleu trained environmental police on Kuriat Islands, Tunisia (April 2019) to strengthen capacity for preserving the marine environment and protected island ecosystem.

Sandy Island Oyster Bed Marine Protected Area. 787-hectare MPA in Carriacou protecting coral reefs, mangroves, seagrass beds. Launched after 10 years of community consultation. Co-managed to balance conservation with local fishing, employs community wardens, installed moorings.

Karaburun-Sazan Marine Protected Area Surveillance. RAPA Vlora team increased patrolling by 50% in Karaburun-Sazan, Albania to control illegal fishing and raise awareness about marine protection rules since 2017.

BULA Reef. World's largest underwater coral nursery (16x45m) transplanting 1000+ heat-resistant coral colonies rescued from stressed areas. Part of UNESCO-endorsed Reefs of Hope program to prevent coral extinction and reef collapse in Fiji.

Lancement d'un nouveau partenariat de cogestion de cinq ans pour l'AMP de Ras Rmel en Tunisie. 5-year co-management partnership for Djerba Ras Rmel MPA. $287k funding for governance, stakeholder engagement, scientific monitoring, gender equality & sustainable economic activities. APAL, Jlij NGO & MedFund collaboration.

Alonissos Marine Protected Area Conservation. MedFund supports Alonissos-Northern Sporades National Marine Park (2300 km²) protecting Mediterranean monk seals through scientific monitoring, surveillance, stakeholder engagement. Oct 2025, Greece.

Connected by the Reef – Te firi a'au. Global observation of Porites rus coral spawning to determine reef connectivity. 426 observations across 18 islands show synchronized spawning from French Polynesia to La Réunion. Mobilizing observers in 47+ countries.

Stari Ulcinj Marine Protected Area Support. Why: Protect marine biodiversity. What: 9.29 km² MPA. How: $287k over 5 years for management, monitoring, awareness. When: April 2024-2029. Where: Stari Ulcinj, Montenegro coast.

Suivis scientifiques à Karaburun-Sazan, Albanie. Long-term scientific monitoring in Albania's first marine park. Mapping seagrass, water quality tests, tracking Cystoseira algae, Posidonia meadows, lithophyllum formations. Training local teams for autonomous monitoring.

Karaburun Sazan Marine Protected Area Surveillance. Flag Pine & RAPA Vlore increased patrols by 50% at Karaburun Sazan MPA in Albania to control illegal fishing and raise awareness of regulations among users.

Exploration d'un nouveau partenariat avec l'Égypte pour la conservation de la mer Méditerranée. MedFund explores partnership with Egypt's EEAA to support Mediterranean MPAs. Goal: 40 MPAs in 10 countries by 2030. Discussions at COP24 Cairo on Egypt's coastal MPA network expansion and governance models.

Automating Coral Reef Transect Analysis. Developing automated analysis methods for coral reef transect data collected during the Global Reef Expedition to improve efficiency and accuracy of reef monitoring and assessment.

Creation of a New Protected Area in Southwestern Haiti. Haiti created Protected Area of Natural Resources Management of Port Salut/Aquin in Aug 2013, covering 150,000 hectares of mixed marine/terrestrial sites in southwestern Haiti to protect coastal and marine resources.
Iles Kuriat – Tunisie. Training for environmental police to strengthen capacity for environmental preservation in Kuriat Islands, Tunisia. Organized by Notre Grand Bleu on April 3-4, 2019.

At the Water's Edge (AWE) - Grenada Coral Reef Restoration. Hybrid submerged breakwater with coral restoration in Grenville Bay to reduce coastal erosion and flooding. Combines engineering with reef ecology to protect communities from climate impacts.

Coral Reef Ecology Curriculum. Free online educational platform with 14 units on coral reef ecology, quizzes, videos, and lesson plans for global STEAM education. Expanding to Living Oceans Academy covering reefs, mangroves, and seagrass.

Assessing Coral Reef Health and Resiliency. Global coral reef survey mapping health & resilience. Uses satellites, field data to assess biodiversity, bleaching, stressors. Covers Pacific, Indian Ocean, Red Sea reefs. Informs conservation strategies.

J.A.M.I.N. - Jamaica Awareness of Mangroves in Nature. 10-year mangrove education program empowering Jamaican students through hands-on restoration. Students propagate & plant thousands of seedlings, collect data, learn coastal protection & biodiversity value at sites like Jobson Bay.

Reefs at Risk Activity and Coloring Book. Educational coloring book teaching children about coral reef ecosystems, threats from climate change, overfishing & pollution through interactive STEAM activities. Aims to inspire understanding of reef conservation.

Philanthropie bleue : protéger les mers et les océans. Multi-foundation initiative supporting ocean conservation: depollution (Wings of Ocean), biodiversity (coral reefs), research (Tara Ocean), coastal adaptation. French coasts & global. 2018-ongoing. Collective action model.

Mapping the World's Coral Reefs. Global coral reef mapping using satellites & field surveys. Created 65,000+ km² high-res habitat maps via Global Reef Expedition (2011-ongoing). Assesses reef health, biodiversity & resilience worldwide.

Science Without Borders®: Conserving the Tropics. UN-endorsed project addressing ocean stressors on tropical ecosystems. Combines research, community engagement, and monitoring in Pacific regions like Fiji's Beqa Lagoon to protect coral reefs from bleaching and cyclones.

Ocean Action 2030 - Sustainable Ocean Plans. Global initiative supporting coastal nations in developing Sustainable Ocean Plans for 100% marine area management by 2030. Combines research, policy, public-private partnerships for ocean conservation and sustainable blue economy.

Littoral & mer - Programme pionnier pour des territoires résilients et solidaires. 15-year program (2011-2024) supporting 226 coastal/marine projects across France & overseas territories. Focus: climate adaptation, ecosystem restoration, participatory governance, coastal erosion prevention. €23M invested.

Créer du lien pour une pêche locale durable. Pleine Mer links artisan fishers with consumers via participatory map (530 points, 1M+ uses). Launches 'Mer de Liens' solidarity fund to buy boats/quotas for young fishers. Advocacy against industrial fishing.

Science Without Borders. Financial sponsorship of marine conservation programs and scientific research to promote public awareness of preserving, protecting, and restoring the world's oceans and aquatic resources globally.

Agir ensemble pour l'océan. Collective call to protect ocean & coastal biodiversity, sustainable fishing, marine pollution reduction. 220+ participatory research projects funded since 2011. Launched for UN Ocean Conference 2025 in Nice.

Red Sea Coral Reef Conservation and Mapping. KSLOF maps & assesses Red Sea coral reefs, partners with Saudi authorities on restoration, COTS management & blue hole research. Ongoing since 2005 across Saudi Arabian Red Sea to protect heat-tolerant reefs.

Océan 2025. Why: Oceans threatened by climate change, pollution, overfishing. What: Fund marine conservation projects. How: Grants to NGOs (Surfrider, SMILO), nature-based solutions, sustainable fishing. When: 2025. Where: France coastal & overseas

Sea'ties - Aider les villes du littoral à s'adapter à l'élévation du niveau de la mer. International program helping 40 coastal cities adapt to sea level rise through sharing scientific data and best practices. Covers protection, accommodation and relocation strategies across 6 global regions.

Global Reef Expedition. Worldwide coral reef mapping & characterization to assess health, resiliency, threats. Data shared with communities to inspire conservation. Examines coral resistance to disturbances.

Dastum - Interactive Coastal Plastic Collection App. Mobile app for interactive coastal walks combining environmental awareness and plastic waste collection on Brittany coastlines. Free download, gamified cleanup experience, expanding to new coastal sites.

Océan mon amour ! - Protection des fonds marins. Fondation Léa Nature/Jardin BiO' funds marine conservation projects protecting seabeds through citizen campaigns. 2015-2017 call for projects supporting associations in ocean floor protection, based in La Rochelle.

Journées Littoral et Mer 2022. Conference in La Rochelle (June 9-10, 2022) bringing together 130+ stakeholders to share best practices on coastal adaptation to climate change, erosion, and sea level rise through science-society partnerships.

Islands Environmental and Social Challenges Program. Multi-island program addressing climate change impacts, water scarcity, biodiversity preservation, sustainable fishing, and economic development across French islands from Brittany to Polynesia through community participation

Programme Littoral et Mer - Adaptation des territoires côtiers au changement climatique. Program supporting coastal adaptation projects through participatory research, ecological restoration, nature-based solutions, and citizen mobilization. 2022 edition in La Rochelle focused on sea level rise, erosion, and climate resilience.

PALIMMA - Patrimoine Lié à la Mer aux Marquises. Marquesas Islands UNESCO bid: 50 workshops documented 900 cultural-marine heritage elements (fishing, navigation, traditional knowledge) linking land-sea-people. Created inventory for marine protected area 2013-2014.

Eau et Océan - Réveil Climat de la Coalition Française des Fondations. Coalition addresses ocean climate impacts: carbon absorption, acidification, plastic pollution. Actions: scientific data sharing, Mediterranean cleanup, river-to-ocean pollution prevention, youth education. 135k+ youth reached 2021.

The Sea Cleaners - Ocean Plastic Pollution Protection. Solutions to protect oceans from plastic pollution. Supported by Fondation Nos étoiles pour l'avenir. Family united by climate urgency after witnessing Asia's environmental challenges. Focus on preserving planet for future.

Projet ODySéÎles - Trouver des solutions pour lutter contre l'érosion côtière. Participatory project engaging islanders from Yeu, Ouvéa, Mayotte & Noirmoutier islands to address climate change & sea level rise impacts through scientific workshops with students seeking coastal erosion solutions.

Protéger les océans pour protéger la planète. Multi-project initiative protecting oceans & coasts through research, sustainable fishing, plastic cleanup, art, VR mapping. Supports Atlantiles, Pleine Mer, Wings of Ocean, ADAPTO. France & overseas.

De la Terre à la Mer, la Jeunesse s'Engage Pour l'Eau. 3-year program engaging 12-25 year-olds in coastal ecosystem preservation through immersive activities: species monitoring, invasive species removal, water quality tracking. 10 projects across France & Réunion combining education & action.

Nouvelle Vague - Programme d'insertion par la mer. 3-year program for 20 youth/year in La Rochelle & Brest. Social-professional insertion through maritime careers, sailing, marine biodiversity workshops, ecosystem studies & beach cleanups. Targets youth in social/educational rupture.

ADELE - Microbiomes in Mangroves: a hotspot of biodiversity yet to be explored. IRD explores microbial biodiversity in mangroves across French Guiana, Senegal, Vietnam. Inventories microorganisms in water, sediments, and aquatic species to identify environmental determinants. 3-year transdisciplinary research.

La Fondation TotalEnergies renouvelle son partenariat avec la SNSM pour cinq ans. 5-year partnership renewal supporting French sea rescue volunteers with training, safety equipment (helmets, communication systems, medical devices), and operational gear to secure maritime rescue interventions along French coasts.

Le Grand Bleu - Centre de formation aux métiers aquatiques et protection du littoral. Training center in Marseille teaching aquatic professions to 400 youth by 2025, integrating marine biodiversity protection modules. Responds to Olympic sailing needs while promoting coastal conservation awareness.

La Clé du Littoral. Educational program for priority network students to discover coastal ecosystems and maritime professions through week-long immersive stays at Notre-Dame-de-Monts, Vendée. Inaugurated Oct 2024.

La Clé du Littoral - Classes de Mer. Educational marine program for priority schools at Notre-Dame-de-Monts, Vendée. Students discover coastal ecosystems, dunes, marine life through beach observations, nautical activities (canoe, paddle, catamaran), and climate workshops.

Littoral, attention fragile - Programme de conservation du littoral et de la mer. Fondation de France funds 85+ research projects since 2011 to protect fragile coastal/marine areas. Focus: climate change impacts, biodiversity, sustainable coastal living. Camargue flamingo study & coastal retreat planning included.

Concours Oceano pour Tous 2023-2024. Educational contest by Institut océanographique de Monaco rewarding 9 classes for ocean protection projects. 1000+ students created collective, creative projects. EU-labeled 'European Maritime Day in My Country 2024'.

Projet Adapto - Gestion souple du trait de côte. Adapto explores soft coastal management solutions to address climate change effects on French coastlines. Experimental actions on 10 pilot sites across French maritime facades restore natural coastal equilibria and protective capacities.

Préserver l'écosystème des roselières avec la Maison de l'Estuaire. Restoration of aging reed beds in Seine estuary reserve through eco-grazing, vegetation export, species monitoring. Youth training via nature workshops. Protects habitat for specialized birds like bittern.

Deep Sea Protection and Mining Moratorium Advocacy. Minderoo advocates for deep-sea protection from mining. Highlights biodiversity, climate regulation, Pacific Island impacts. Calls for precautionary pause on seabed mining until science-based safeguards exist.

Oceano pour Tous 2022-2023. Youth ocean education contest where 600 students from 25 classes created concrete actions for ocean protection through video reports, webinars with scientists, and hands-on marine conservation activities.

Coral Spawning Research and Reef Resilience at Ningaloo. Scientists at Minderoo Exmouth Research Lab study coral spawning and test heat-tolerant Gulf corals to strengthen Ningaloo Reef resilience against marine heatwaves and climate change.

Coastal and Ocean Forest Conservation - ONF Partnership. 7 projects preserving coastal forests & marine biodiversity: dune restoration in Gironde/Landes, sargassum removal in Martinique, mangrove education in Guadeloupe, beetle inventory in Vendée, reforestation in Mayotte. 2024.

Formez-vous et embarquez pour des métiers de la mer. CMQ IndMer Bretagne helps 2500 youth discover maritime careers through PRO BREIZH events, training visits, technical workshops, and sailing aboard 'Le Français'. Focuses on job insertion and ecological transitions in Brittany's maritime sector.

Oceano pour tous - Ocean Education Program. Educational contest by Monaco Oceanographic Institute for disadvantaged youth (12-25) to understand and protect oceans through video projects. 30 classes/year across France and overseas territories. Renewed 2025-2027.

ADELE - Microbiomes in Mangroves: a hotspot of biodiversity yet to be explored. IRD explores microbial biodiversity in mangroves across French Guiana, Senegal, Vietnam. Inventories microorganisms in water, sediments, aquatic species to identify environmental determinants. 3-year transdisciplinary research.

Whale Shark Environmental DNA Research at Ningaloo Reef. Researchers use environmental DNA to track whale shark migration patterns at Ningaloo Reef, Western Australia. The project studies ecosystem health and pressures facing the world's largest fish to strengthen conservation efforts.

Community eDNA Collection in the South Pacific. Sailors collect environmental DNA samples across remote South Pacific waters to help scientists monitor marine species, ecosystems, and conservation pressures through citizen science network.

Australian Right Whale Research Program. 35-year monitoring program tracking southern right whales at Head of Bight, Great Australian Bight. Photo-ID research shows declining calving rates since 2015 due to climate change impacts on Southern Ocean feeding grounds.

Coral Reef Conservation and Climate Change Research. Marine biologist Zoe Richards studies coral reef biodiversity across Pacific and Indian Ocean sites. Research documents climate impacts on reefs including 60% coral death at Ningaloo 2024/25. Advocates nature-positive action.
