Exuma Cays Land and Sea Park. Protects Caribbean spiny lobster, Nassau grouper, queen conch & seabirds. No-take reserve enhances fish biomass, larval transport & spillover to fisheries. Important Bird Area with tropicbirds & shearwaters.

Malpelo Fauna and Flora Sanctuary. Platinum Blue Park 500km off Colombia. Largest no-fishing zone in Eastern Tropical Pacific protecting massive shark aggregations, marine mammals & hundreds of fish species. Expanded twice, pledged to double in size.

Revillagigedo National Park. Gold-level Blue Park protecting unique ecosystems from volcanoes to coral reefs. Focuses on surveillance and monitoring to conserve sharks, manta rays, turtles, and endemic species in the Mexican Pacific.

Wilsons Promontory Marine National Park. Australia's largest Victorian MPA protects biodiversity hotspot where warm eastern & cold Bass Strait waters mix. Shelters white sharks, whales, seals across reefs, kelp forests & sponge gardens since 2002.

Papahānaumokuākea Marine National Monument. Protects 7,000+ marine species in Northwestern Hawaiian Islands through strict no-take policy (2006) and limited-use buffer zone (2016). Safeguards 22 endangered species including monk seals in pristine coral reefs and seamounts.

Cocos Island National Park. Protects 300+ marine fish species & hammerhead sharks at intersection of Pacific currents. UNESCO site since 1997. Established 1978, expanded for marine habitat. Gold Blue Park 2019, Platinum 2025.

Brijuni National Park Blue Parks Award. Croatian MPA protecting 14 islands with seagrass meadows, sea caves, reefs. Hosts dolphins, sea turtles, endemic species. Uses climate-adaptive management via Mediterranean MPA platforms. Blue Parks Award recipient.

Galapagos Marine Reserve Blue Park. UNESCO World Heritage Site protecting 2,900+ marine species including sharks, sea turtles, penguins at intersection of 3 major currents. Established 1998 via Organic Law for Galápagos conservation.

Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park. Marine protected area in Philippines protecting 1,200+ species including endangered sea turtles and seabirds. No-take protections since 1988 maintain exceptionally healthy reef ecosystem. Platinum Blue Park award winner.

Misool Marine Reserve Protection. Protects coral reefs & deep waters in Raja Ampat, Indonesia. Partnership since 2005 between Misool Foundation & local communities. Safeguards endemic species, mangroves. No-take zones show highest reef fish biomass in region.

Torre Guaceto Marine Protected Area. Italian MPA protecting Mediterranean biodiversity: seagrass meadows, coral formations, endemic species. Established 1991, managed by consortium since 2000. Includes Ramsar wetland site.

Apo Reef Natural Park. 34 km² no-take zone protecting world's 2nd largest coral atoll in Coral Triangle. Sanctuary for overfished species, sea turtles, sharks, rays. Supports local transition to sustainable dive tourism. Occidental Mindoro, Philippines.

Old Providence McBean Lagoon National Park. Protects Caribbean barrier reef with 109 fish species, coral, mangroves. Created with indigenous Raizales after grassroots protest against tourism development. 90% Raizal staff manage conservation respecting traditional practices.

Raja Ampat Islands Marine Conservation Area. Network of 7 MPAs across 1400+ islands in Indonesia's Bird's Head Seascape protecting 75% of world's coral species, 1000+ fish species, mangroves & seagrass. Integrates traditional Sasi management with local communities.

Channel Islands Marine Protected Areas. 11 no-extraction Marine Reserves off Southern California protect kelp forests, coral gardens, 5000+ species. Managed by National Park, Sanctuary & CA Fish/Wildlife since 1980-2007.

Jardines de la Reina National Park. Cuba's Coral Garden MPA protecting 600+ cays with 30+ coral species. Fish increased 50% since 1996 protection. Gold Blue Park 2021 for pristine reefs, mangroves, sharks, turtles. Benefits fishers via spillover.

Kisite-Mpunguti Marine Park & Reserve. Kenya's largest MPA protecting 250 fish species, dolphins, corals, mangroves & turtles. Gold Blue Park Award for effective management using SMART tech. Supports sustainable tourism & local fishing since 1978.

Selvagens Islands Marine Reserve. Portugal's 1971 reserve protects North Atlantic's last intact marine ecosystems. Safeguards IUCN red-listed species, endemic mollusks, commercial fish. Manages tourism, research, habitat preservation across diverse marine zones.

Gitdisdzu Lugyeks Marine Protected Area. 33.5 km² Indigenous-led MPA protecting herring spawning grounds, kelp forests & eelgrass in Kitasu Bay, BC. Managed by Kitasoo Xai'xais using traditional knowledge. Designated June 2022, management plan Oct 2023.

Siete Pecados Marine Park. 1.8 km² MPA in Coral Triangle, Philippines protecting reefs, mangroves, seagrass. Established 2005 by Barangay Tagumpay community to combat overfishing. Conserves endangered species, highest fish diversity in Calamianes network.

Kaho'olawe Island Reserve. Hawaiian MPA protecting biodiversity-rich waters around Kaho'olawe Island. Managed by KIRC, combining ecological restoration with Native Hawaiian cultural preservation. Monitors fish, removes debris, controls invasive species.

Gorgona National Natural Park. Protects Eastern Tropical Pacific's most diverse coral reef ecosystem, breeding grounds for sharks, turtles, marine mammals. Managed since 1984 by Colombia's National Parks, 35km off Colombian coast with local community involvement.

Cocos-Galapagos Swimway. Protecting Cocos Ridge migration corridor for sharks & marine species between Galapagos, Cocos Island & Malpelo. First transboundary MPA in Latin America spanning Ecuador & Costa Rica waters.

Cahuita National Park. Costa Rica's Caribbean coast park protects coral reefs, mangroves, seagrass. Co-managed by local community & SINAC since 1970. 31 coral species, 90 fish species, sea turtles. Balances conservation, tourism, food security.

Bazaruto Seascape Marine Conservation. 20-year research program protecting marine megafauna (manta rays, wedgefish, sharks, dolphins) in Bazaruto Archipelago & San Sebastian Peninsula, Mozambique. Evidence-based conservation strategies for threatened species.

Tristan da Cunha Marine Protected Area. 750,000 km² EEZ protection in South Atlantic. 91% no-take zone. Protects seamounts, kelp forests, deep ocean. Whale sanctuary since 2001. High endemism, seabird nesting. Community-led by 245 residents. Declared by Island Council.

Cabo Pulmo National Park. 70 sq km marine park in Baja California protected 25 years ago by local community. Ecosystem recovery brought back corals, fish, sharks. Now supports tourism and fishing via spillover effects.

Piedra del Viento Marine Sanctuary. Protecting Chile's O'Higgins coast where algueros harvest kelp & surfers ride waves. Campaign restored beach access blocked by development, established 10,000-acre sanctuary for biodiversity, fishing communities & sustainable recreation.
PIHMNM Project. Marine conservation project in Pacific Islands. Details on specific conservation activities, timeline, and objectives not provided in available page content.

California Seamounts Protection Project. Protecting 60+ seamounts off California coast supporting deep-sea corals, fish, sharks, marine mammals. Co-founded CA Seamount Coalition (2015), designated Hope Spot (2019). Fighting destructive fishing, mining threats.

Reserva Marina Hermandad. Expansion of Galápagos Marine Reserve protections to safeguard migratory species (sharks, turtles, seabirds) from fishing fleets. Creates buffer zones and responsible fishing areas in Ecuador's EEZ.

Palau National Marine Sanctuary. World's largest no-take MPA protecting 80% of Palau's waters (475,077 km²). Safeguards 800+ species including endangered turtles, sharks, whales. Enacted 2015, effective Jan 2020. Combines indigenous 'bul' tradition with modern conservation.

Parque Nacional Coiba. UNESCO World Heritage Site protecting 2000+ km² of coral reefs, mangroves & pelagic species in Eastern Tropical Pacific. Part of CMAR network. Community-involved management with participatory workshops for conservation planning.

Inhambane Bay Community Conservation Network (IBCCN). 9 no-take MPAs in Inhambane Bay, Mozambique protecting seagrass & mangrove habitats. Established 2017 by village elders reviving traditional 'ocean rules'. Covers 6.69 km2, managed by 5 coastal communities for fish nurseries & endangered species.

Shark Fin Bay MPA Network. Network of 5 MPAs (9 km²) in northern Palawan, Philippines protecting coral reefs, seagrass, mangroves. Community-led conservation since 2011 restoring ecosystems degraded by destructive fishing, protecting threatened species.

Caño Island Biological Reserve. Protecting Costa Rica's most resilient coral reefs & breeding grounds for whales, sharks, manta rays & sea turtles in the Eastern Tropical Pacific. Designated 1978, serves as coral refugia during El Niño events.

Sustainable Seas Programme. Improves marine resource mgmt in Mozambique through community-led LMMAs, reducing destructive fishing, protecting megafauna, educating Ocean Ambassadors, creating marine corridor along Inhambane coast (Tofo, Pomene, Bazaruto)

Migration Corridor Protection Project. Protecting critical shark & ray migration corridor between Loreto & Cabo Pulmo National Parks, Baja California. Focuses on scalloped hammerheads & mobula rays using seamounts as refuges & nursery grounds in productive waters.

Manta & Devil Rays. Studying manta & devil ray movement ecology in Mozambique to identify critical habitats, map threats, protect core areas. 20-year research led to legal protection in 2021. Province-wide monitoring along Inhambane coast.

Ocean Guardians. UNESCO-recognized marine education program teaching 3,800+ Mozambican youth about ocean conservation, climate change impacts, swimming & water safety since 2012 in Inhambane Province through school curriculum & community outreach.

Leopard Shark Conservation Mozambique. Why: Endangered leopard sharks face extinction from overfishing. What: Population research in data-deficient East Africa. How: Study aggregation sites along Inhambane coast. Where: Southern Mozambique reefs. When: Ongoing

Madagascar Whale Shark Project. Research, education & conservation project studying whale sharks off Nosy Be, Madagascar since 2016. Uses photo-ID, satellite tracking & acoustic tags to understand population ecology & movements. Established tourism code of conduct.

Bull Shark Conservation Project. Studies bull shark ecology, migrations, and habitat use in Mozambique to address population threats from fisheries (220% catch increase), habitat degradation, and human-shark conflicts through research and conservation.

Mafia Island Whale Shark Research Project. Long-term whale shark study in Tanzania tracking movements, feeding, genetics, population trends, behavior, health via acoustic telemetry, tissue samples, photo-ID. Informs protection measures since 2016.

Palau Hope Spot Expedition. Mission Blue explored Palau's protected waters (Nov 2018) to document marine biodiversity, meet conservationists, and showcase successful ocean conservation in this Pacific island nation with vast no-take zones.

Balearic Islands Hope Spot Expedition. Mission Blue expedition to document and raise awareness about MPAs, overfishing, illegal anchoring, and plastic pollution in Balearic Islands. Focus on Posidonia oceanica meadows protection and marine conservation.

Mozambique Wedgefish Conservation Project. Researching critically endangered wedgefish in Mozambique's Inhambane Province. Monitoring aggregation sites, tracking movements, collecting genetic samples to develop science-based conservation strategies.

Smalleye Stingrays. Study rare smalleye stingrays in Mozambique's Inhambane Province. Photo-ID, telemetry & genetics reveal distribution, movement & habitat use. 100 individuals identified since 2008. Protects world's largest marine stingray from fishing threats.

Mozambique Elasmobranch Census. Census of sharks & rays in Inhambane Province using BRUVs, camera traps & eDNA to establish baseline diversity, abundance & critical habitats for threatened species conservation & effective management.

Galapagos National Park Expedition. Mission Blue expedition to Galapagos Islands studying migratory sharks, newly-discovered deep kelp forests, and marine biodiversity. Used submersibles at Wolf/Darwin Islands. Supported marine reserve expansion and species protection.

Florida Manta Project. First dedicated study of Florida's manta rays since 2016. Studies nursery habitat in south Florida and adult aggregation in central Florida using photography, drones, telemetry. Identifies critical habitats, mitigates fishing impacts.

Mozambique Whale Shark Conservation Program. Monitoring endangered whale sharks in southern Mozambique's key feeding area since 2005. Photo-ID tracking 600+ individuals, satellite tagging, threat assessment. Led to 2021 legal protection & IUCN Important Shark Areas.

Oman Whale Shark Research Project. Studies whale shark distribution, abundance & threats in Gulf of Oman hotspots (Musandam, Daymaniyat Islands). Tracks sharks to identify migratory corridors & areas vulnerable to gillnet capture & ship strikes. Started 2010.

Malpelo Island Hope Spot Expedition. Mission Blue expedition to Malpelo Island, Colombia (Aug 2019) to study shark migration, document MPA enforcement challenges, and protect whale sharks, hammerheads, and groupers through tagging and DNA sampling.

Svalbard Archipelago Hope Spot Expedition. Mission Blue documented climate change impacts in Arctic Norway's Svalbard, including melting glaciers and effects on polar bears, walruses, seabirds. June 2018 expedition created multimedia content to raise awareness.

Black Marlin Research Project. Studies black marlin movements and spawning in Bazaruto Seascape using satellite tagging and genetics. Launched Oct 2022, collected 21 tissue samples, tagged first marlin Nov 2022. Aims to identify Indian Ocean's first spawning ground.

Galapagos Whale Shark Project. Studies whale shark ecology at Darwin Island, Galapagos. Tracks adult females via satellite tags, conducts ultrasound/blood sampling for reproduction research. 700+ sharks identified. Expanded marine reserve protection.

Guitarfish and Devil Rays Research - Florida Manta Project. Research on Atlantic Guitarfish & devil rays in Florida waters using photo ID, acoustic telemetry & behavioral observation. Started 2020. Fills knowledge gaps in distribution, life history & critical habitats for conservation.

Microplastics & Megafauna - Indonesia. Studies microplastic impacts on manta rays & whale sharks in Indonesia's Coral Triangle. Estimates ingestion rates, analyzes plastic exposure, engages communities on waste management. Started 2016 in key feeding grounds.

Balearic Islands Hope Spot. First Mediterranean Hope Spot protecting Posidonia seagrass, loggerhead turtles, bluefin tuna spawning areas, and Balearic shearwater nesting sites across Mallorca, Menorca, Ibiza and Formentera archipelago.

Cocos Island Costa Rica Expedition. Mission Blue expedition to Cocos Island to highlight marine biodiversity, conduct deep-sea dives to 1,000ft, document bait balls, and campaign for Costa Rica to ban hammerhead shark fin exports. Partnership with Fusion/Univision.

Costa Rica Thermal Dome Expedition. Mission Blue & MarViva expedition to Costa Rica Thermal Dome Hope Spot. Tagged sharks & turtles, sampled plankton, documented biodiversity. Apr 2-7, 2017. Building case for regional UNEP conservation framework for this upwelling zone.

Cashes Ledge Gulf of Maine Expedition. Mission Blue expedition to document Cashes Ledge, largest cold-water kelp forest on US Atlantic seaboard, nursery for cod, pollock, halibut. Partnership with CLF, Nat Geo, Google, NRDC calling for permanent protection.

South African Coast Hope Spots Expedition. Mission Blue expedition established 6 Hope Spots along South African coast with Sustainable Seas Trust. Areas include False Bay, Cape Whale Coast, Knysna, Plett, Algoa Bay, and Aliwal Shoal to advance ocean conservation.

Costa Rica Dome Playa Grande Expedition. Mission Blue & MarViva expedition documenting Costa Rica Dome's ecological & commercial value. Filmed with Dr. Sylvia Earle to raise awareness for protecting unique species & habitats in this High Seas area. Jan 22-28, 2014.

Swan Islands Honduras Expedition. Expedition to explore and document marine biodiversity at Swan Islands, the 'Galapagos of the Caribbean,' to support designation as marine protected area. 500+ fish species, 350+ mollusks surveyed at Mesoamerican Reef Hope Spot.

Gulf of California Hope Spot Expedition. Mission Blue expedition to Gulf of California/Sea of Cortez to highlight marine protection needs, engage stakeholders, and support local conservation groups protecting this UNESCO World Heritage Site's rich biodiversity.

Exuma Cays Bahamas Expedition. Expedition to Exuma Cays Land and Sea Park, Caribbean's first marine fishery reserve (1958). Documented pristine marine habitats, thriving populations of queen conch, Nassau grouper, spiny lobster, and invasive lionfish species.

Revillagigedo Archipelago Expedition. Expedition to document shark science and migratory patterns in Mexico's 'little Galápagos', 300 miles south of Cabo San Lucas. Filmed shark tagging to support MPA protection and marine corridor conservation.

KIME Akva. Integrated cod farming in Northern Norway. Founded 2020, scaling from 12.8k to 24k tonnes/year by 2030 across nine locations. Addresses declining wild cod quotas through sustainable aquaculture.

AquaExchange. Tech platform using IoT devices & data analytics to improve shrimp/fish aquaculture in India. Automates feeding, monitors aerators, manages finance & procurement. Founded 2020, serves 12% of local industry with transparency solutions.

aquaManager. Software solution for fish aquaculture from hatchery to harvest, using IoT and smart equipment for cage/pond farming, RAS, and hatcheries. Deployed across Mediterranean, Africa, Middle East, Latin America.

Sofar Ocean. Deploys global network of ocean sensors (Spotter platform) providing real-time ocean data for climate research. Wayfinder platform optimizes ship routes using accurate weather forecasts, reducing fuel and emissions in maritime shipping.

MITO - European Clam Hatchery and Breeding. MITO breeds and hatches high-quality clam juveniles to boost sustainable bivalve farming in Europe, reducing dependency on depleted wild stocks while providing low-impact, restorative protein in Italian lagoons.

SyAqua - Shrimp Genetics and Alternative Feeds. Singapore-based supplier of shrimp genetics (broodstock, nauplii, post-larvae) and micro-encapsulated feeds to hatcheries across Asia and US. 20+ years experience, advanced P. Vannamei breeding program with 10% YoY genetic improvement.

The Kingfish Company. Land-based RAS aquaculture producing yellowtail kingfish in Europe & US. 3,500 tonnes capacity, 100% renewable energy, no antibiotics, seawater-based, zero fish escape risk. Sustainable protein for $2.1T global market.

WellFish Tech. Aquaculture diagnostics using blood biomarkers & AI to assess fish health, enabling farmers to monitor welfare & optimize production. Spun out from University of West Scotland in 2021, first sales same year.

Bureo - Fishing Net Recycling Program. Collects discarded fishing nets in Chile, Argentina, Peru, Ecuador, Mexico & US. Recycles 1,000+ tonnes yearly into NetPlus® materials for brands like Patagonia. 4,500+ tonnes collected since 2013 to end net pollution.

Operation Octopus - Greece. Sea Shepherd removes illegal octopus traps from Greek waters. 75-day campaign launched July 2025 in Eastern Macedonia & Thrace. 4,650 traps removed in 4 days. Replicating Italy success where 7,672 traps removed led to octopus rebound.

Ava Ocean - Low-Impact Seabed Harvesting Technology. Ava Ocean developed precision seabed harvesting tech to collect scallops in Barents Sea without dredging, protecting ecosystems. Reopened Arctic scallop fishery after 30yr closure. Expanding to other species globally.

Scorpion Reef Protection Operation. Sustained patrol operation protecting Alacranes Reef & Bajos del Norte breeding grounds from industrial poaching. Two ships patrol 6,300 sq mi of protected Gulf of Mexico waters, supporting fish nurseries & sea turtle nesting sites.

Vaquita Refuge Protection. 24/7 patrols remove illegal totoaba gillnets threatening vaquita porpoise (<10 remain) in Upper Gulf of California. Navy coordination, thermal drones, fast launches. 1,200+ nets removed since 2015. Active operation.

Antarctica Krill Protection Campaign. Sea Shepherd confronts industrial krill supertrawlers in Antarctic waters competing with whales for food. Operates in Gerlache Strait & South Orkney Islands. 2025 fishery hit seasonal limit early; one whale killed in trawl net.

Stop the Grind - Faroe Islands Cetacean Defense. Sea Shepherd opposes grindadráp whale/dolphin hunts in Faroe Islands since 1983. Documents slaughter, advocates internationally, challenges tradition killing 745 cetaceans in 2024. Active ground presence.

Sea Lion Protection in the Upper Gulf of California. Protecting sea lions from gillnet entanglement in vaquita refuge. Removes illegal fishing gear that drowns sea lions, sharks, rays. Permanent vessel patrols with Mexican authorities monitor and respond to threats.

Kenya Marine Conservation Project. Blue Ventures supports community-led marine conservation in Kenya, working with coastal fishing communities to protect coral reefs and marine ecosystems through locally-managed conservation initiatives.

Community-Based Fisheries Management in Indonesia. Supporting 17 Indonesian orgs in community-based coral reef & mangrove conservation across 81 communities in 14 provinces since 2016. Peer learning network promotes fishing community rights, temporary fishery closures, mangrove forest mgmt.

GEM - Community-led Marine Conservation in Indonesia. Supporting 17 Indonesian orgs in community-based coral reef & mangrove conservation across 81 communities in 14 provinces since 2016. Focus on fishery closures, mangrove forest mgmt, & traditional fishing rights in Coral Triangle.

Blue Forests - Community-led Marine Conservation in Indonesia. Supporting 17 Indonesian orgs in coral reef & mangrove conservation across 81 communities in 14 provinces since 2016. Focus on community-based fisheries mgmt, temporary closures, mangrove forests in Sumatra & Kalimantan. Reaches 80,000+ people.

Transform Bottom Trawling Coalition. Global movement uniting fishing communities to tackle bottom trawling - the most destructive industrial fishing method that destroys seabeds, threatens food security, and contributes to climate crisis.

Secure Rights - Indonesia Community-Led Marine Conservation. Supporting 17 Indonesian orgs in community-based coral reef & mangrove conservation across 81 communities in 14 provinces since 2016. Promotes traditional fishing rights, temporary fishery closures, mangrove forest management.

Climate REEFS: Integrating Risks, Evolution, and socio-Economics for Fisheries Sustainability. Climate adaptation project for coral reefs in Philippines & Indonesia. Uses remote sensing to identify adaptive reefs, studies gender/social vulnerabilities, strengthens community fisheries capacity & MPA management in Coral Triangle.

SMART Technology for Illegal Fishing Prevention in Western Caribbean. CORAL partners use SMART app to track illegal fishing, protect marine areas. Roatan Marine Park & Bay Islands Conservation patrol waters, monitor fish populations critical for reef health in Western Caribbean.

Empowering Artisanal Fishers in Micos Lagoon, Honduras. CORAL established first marine territorial use right system in Micos Lagoon, Honduras to regulate artisanal fishing. Increased fish biomass 600% through sustainable management, protecting sea turtles, manatees, crocodiles.

CORAL 2024 Global Coral Reef Conservation Programs. Multi-region coral reef conservation: clean water programs in Western Caribbean & Hawaii, sustainable fisheries in MPAs, climate adaptation research via satellite monitoring, sediment reduction in Maui watersheds. Aims for 80% coastal wastewater trea

2023 Year in Review: Coral Reef Conservation Projects. Multi-region coral conservation: bleaching toolkit, water quality protocol for Mesoamerican Reef, lobster/conch preservation, Molokai fishpond restoration, Coral Triangle expansion in Philippines/Indonesia. 2023.

Climate REEFS Initiative. Identifies adaptive coral reefs via satellite, analyzes social vulnerabilities, and develops equitable climate adaptation pathways for coastal communities in Indonesia and Philippines dependent on reef resources.

CORAL Joins Maui Nui Makai Network. CORAL joins community network in Maui Nui to protect marine ecosystems. Provides technical expertise, implements projects reducing local reef threats. Partnership combines biocultural approach with community collaboration since 2021.

Tela Bay Closed Fishing Season Increases Fish Biomass in Coastal Lagoons. 2-month closed fishing season in Tela Bay, Honduras coastal lagoons achieved 500% fish biomass increase. Collaborative effort with local partners enforces sustainable fishing, allowing reef recovery and supporting fisher communities.

New Management Plan Will Protect Coral Reefs in Tela Bay, Honduras. CORAL collaborated with local partners to create a management plan for Tela Bay Wildlife Refuge MPA. Plan guides sustainable fishing, tourism, and enforcement to protect critically endangered corals along the Mesoamerican Reef.

Using Lessons Learned in Puakō, Hawaii to Tackle Wastewater Pollution Worldwide. CORAL fights wastewater pollution in Puakō, Hawaii where 53M gallons of raw sewage enter ocean daily. Partners with community to advocate for treatment plant, monitors water quality, and shares methods globally through RRN course.

Tela Bay Closed Fishing Season Success. Los Micos Lagoon closed fishing season (May-June 2021) showed 483% increase in fish biomass. Protects juvenile fish migrating to coral reefs, addresses overfishing through patrols and local fishing rights in Tela Bay, Honduras.

Sustainable Fisheries and Marine Protected Areas - Puerto Castilla, Honduras. Combating overfishing in Puerto Castilla through marine protected areas, community scientist programs, aquaculture support, and fisher education to restore fish populations and protect coral reef ecosystems.

Partnering with the Belize Tourism Board to Save Coral Reefs. CORAL partners with Belize Tourism Board to reduce water pollution and expand sustainable tourism in Belize City and Caye Caulker. Building wastewater treatment systems, monitoring water quality at 90 sites, and establishing sustainable tourism progr

Aquaculture as Alternative to Overfishing in Tela Bay, Honduras. Testing small-scale aquaculture systems using native copetona fish to reduce fishing pressure on reefs, increase fisher income, and address food insecurity in Tela Bay. Training fishers to build home systems.

Aquaponics System for Coastal Communities in Tela Bay, Honduras. Aquaponics system combining fish farming and organic vegetable growing to reduce overfishing pressure on Los Micos Lagoon and Mesoamerican Reef. Provides food security and income for fishers in Tela Bay, Honduras. Started 2022.

Cleaner Water Farewell for Coral Disease - Roatán, Honduras. CORAL partnered with West End community since 2013 to revitalize wastewater treatment plant. Reduced bacteria 98% by 2020, coral disease dropped from 25% to 0% (2011-2016). Blue Flag beach certified.

Stony Coral Tissue Loss Disease Response in Bay Islands Honduras. Treating fast-spreading coral disease in Roatán, Guanaja, Utila reefs using topical antibiotics. 14 orgs collaborate on treatment, monitoring, rescue center. Detected Sept 2020. Addressing water quality threats.

New Coral Reef Discovery and Protection in Trujillo, Honduras. CORAL & HRI discovered new functional reefs in Trujillo with 12-16% coral cover. Monitoring & protecting these reefs through fisheries management & community engagement to establish healthy reef networks across Mesoamerica.

Supporting Marine Protected Areas During COVID-19 in Mesoamerican Reef. CORAL & MAR Fund supported tourism-dependent conservation orgs in Honduras & Belize during pandemic. RMP increased patrols, confiscated 905 illegal fishing items. TASA developed business plan for 342k acre reserve management.

Clean Water for Reefs - Puakō Wastewater Treatment Project. Addressing ocean sewage pollution in Puakō by transitioning 643 homes off cesspools. $1.8M allocated to develop wastewater system facilities plan, preventing 53M gallons daily sewage from entering groundwater and coral reefs.

Transitioning to co-management in Caribbean reef fisheries: Tela Bay case study. 5-year fisheries co-management study in Tela Bay, Honduras. Built trust between fishers, NGOs & government through community dialogues & collaborative planning. Lane snapper populations now sustainable. Started 2016 when fish stocks were critically l

First-Ever Fish Catalogs Created for Honduras Fisheries. CORAL partnered with local fishers in Tela Bay and Trujillo to document fish species, preserving local knowledge for conservation. Catalogs include names, photos, traits to inform fisheries management and empower communities.

Advancing Maui's Watershed Restoration Project. Ridge-to-reef restoration in Olowalu ahupua'a, Maui. Reforesting riparian zones, planting natives, stabilizing streambanks to reduce sediment runoff threatening coral reefs. Community-led, culturally-rooted conservation.

Sargassum Bloom Mitigation and Reef Protection in Mesoamerica. CORAL addresses massive sargassum blooms threatening Mesoamerican Reef coasts in Mexico, Honduras, Belize. Blooms fueled by climate change & nutrient runoff degrade water quality, smother corals, harm tourism & public health.

Cozumel Destination Management Organization for Coral Reef Protection. DMO unites government, civil society, and industry to protect Cozumel's Mesoamerican Reef through waste management, water sanitation, and climate initiatives while supporting sustainable tourism economy.

Cordelia Banks Staghorn Coral Conservation and Genetic Diversity Study. Study of staghorn coral genetic diversity at Cordelia Banks, Honduras to support reef restoration. 63,440 sq m of Acropora cervicornis with 30% clonality identified as source for restoration projects.

Income Diversification Projects Build Human and Ecosystem Resilience. CORAL's Healthy Fisheries for Reefs initiative helps coastal communities diversify income through handicrafts, beekeeping, and chicken farming, reducing overfishing pressure on coral reefs in Honduras and Fiji.

West Maui Watershed Restoration for Coral Reef Protection. Restoring native forest in Honokōwai and Wahikuli watersheds to prevent sediment runoff from reaching coral reefs. 200+ volunteers planted 8,000 native plants to stabilize soil and reduce pollution downstream.

Bay Islands Tourism Revitalization and Reef Conservation. CORAL partnered with Bay Island communities since 2005 to reduce tourism impact on Mesoamerican Reef. Created Tourism Revitalization Plan with biosecurity guidelines to safely reopen tourism post-COVID while protecting reef ecosystems.

Roatán Clean Water and Coral Reef Conservation Project. CORAL reduced wastewater pollution in West End and Half Moon Bay, Roatán by connecting 300+ homes/businesses to treatment facilities. Achieved 95% reduction in fecal bacteria, zero coral disease by 2018, and Blue Flag certification.

Clean Water for Reefs Initiative - West Maui. Prevents sediment/nutrient pollution from reaching ocean by replanting native vegetation near streams in fallow agricultural lands. Volunteers plant to restore ecosystems, slow stormwater, stabilize soil & reduce reef smothering.

Maui 10-Year-Old Grows 900 Native Plants to Protect Coral Reefs. 10-year-old volunteer grows 900 native plants from seed at home to restore Wahikuli stream slopes in West Maui. Plants trap sediment runoff that smothers coral reefs. Part of COVID-adapted community program with 100 volunteers growing 25,000 seeds.

Hawai'i Wai Ola Water Quality Monitoring Project. Collaborative water quality monitoring across Hawaii Island. 11 organizations & volunteers sample coastal waters in Kona, Hilo & South Kohala to track pollution & human impact, supporting strained government resources during COVID-19.

Local Leadership, Lasting Impact Across the Western Caribbean. CORAL reduces wastewater pollution and strengthens reef protection across Honduras, Belize, and Mexico. 9 projects prevent 34M gallons of sewage annually. Strengthens marine park management and community engagement.

Clean Water for Reefs - West Maui Watershed Restoration. Ridge-to-reef stormwater management in West Maui. Restores streams using vetiver grass & native plants to filter sediment/nutrients before reaching reefs. Combines modern tech with Hawaiian practices to prevent coral smothering.

From Ridge to Reef: Science to Action Across Maui Nui. Watershed-to-reef conservation across Maui Nui combining science and Indigenous knowledge. Removes invasive species, restores native ecosystems, monitors water quality to reduce land-based pollution reaching coral reefs.

Healthy Fisheries for Reefs - Income Diversification Projects. CORAL partners with fishing communities in Honduras and Fiji to reduce overfishing through income diversification (beekeeping, chicken farming). Helps 500+ fishers adapt to regulations while allowing reef ecosystems to recover.

Community Scientists Program - Honduras Fisheries Monitoring. CORAL employs local women as community scientists in Honduras to monitor fisheries data at Tela Bay and Trujillo Bay. They collect catch data, build trust with fishermen, promote sustainable practices, reducing illegal fishing from 100% to 10-20%.

Hawaiʻi Wai Ola Citizen Science Program. Collaborative water quality monitoring program across Hawaiʻi Island. 10 partner orgs train citizen scientists to test coastal water quality, collecting data on temperature, bacteria, nutrients to improve reef health.

Wahikuli Watershed Restoration Project. Planting native vegetation along West Maui dirt roads to trap sediment runoff that reduced coral cover from 30% to 10%. Monthly volunteer days have planted 8,000+ plants. Educational signs engage motorcyclists to protect seedlings.

Creating Win-Wins for Reefs and People - Tela Bay Honduras. CORAL reduces overfishing in Tela Bay's Laguna de Los Micos through managed-access fishery & alternative livelihoods. Protects 69% coral cover reefs & supports 13 communities since 2011.

Antarctica Expedition. Protecting Antarctic Peninsula waters, key foraging area for declining penguin species threatened by commercial fisheries. Documenting climate change impacts on ice stability and krill-dependent food chain including whales and seals.

Protecting Laguna de Los Micos and its People. CORAL works with local communities in Tela, Honduras to protect Laguna de Los Micos from overfishing. Ministerial Decree 108-2017 passed in April 2017 establishes stricter fishing regulations and priority access for local fishermen.

Tela Bay Marine Wildlife Refuge. 86,259 hectares MPA in Tela Bay, Honduras protecting 69% live coral cover, 46 coral species, 83 fish species. Includes managed-access fishery in Laguna de los Micos. Declared 2018 after 12+ years collaboration.

Coral Reef Alliance 2025 Global Impact Report. CORAL's global reef conservation through marine protected areas, pollution reduction, science-driven policy, and 100+ partner alliance. Addresses climate-driven bleaching affecting 80% of reefs worldwide.

The Bahamas Seagrass Discovery Expedition. Shark-led discovery of 92,000 km² seagrass beds, the world's largest. Mapping carbon-storing meadows to position ocean ecosystems as climate solutions. Jan-Apr 2021 in The Bahamas.

Canada Marine Conservation Expedition. Upcoming expedition to protect and rewild ocean ecosystems in Canada. Focuses on marine sustainability, climate regulation, and ocean health through community engagement and conservation efforts.

Cuba Expedition. Upcoming marine expedition to Cuba focused on ocean protection and rewilding. Part of Sea Legacy's global effort to protect ocean health and sustainability through community engagement and conservation action.

Revillagigedo Expedition. Upcoming marine expedition to Revillagigedo archipelago focused on ocean protection and rewilding. Aims to document and raise awareness about marine biodiversity in this remote Pacific location through Sea Legacy's conservation work.

Baja Sur Marine Biosphere Reserve. Establishing Dos Mares biosphere reserve in southern Gulf of California to protect marine biodiversity and support local communities through expanded MPAs, connecting Eastern Tropical Pacific corridor.

Dominica Marine Expedition. Upcoming expedition to Dominica focusing on sperm whale conservation and ocean protection. Aims to document and protect marine life while supporting ocean health and sustainability through community engagement.

Great Australian Bight. Protecting southern right whale calving grounds from seismic blasting for oil/gas exploration. Documenting mothers & calves in shallow waters of Western Australia where whales migrate to give birth & nurse in winter.

Auckland, New Zealand Marine Conservation Expedition. Documenting kelp forest degradation from snapper overfishing causing sea urchin barrens. Highlighting Goat Island Marine Reserve success as model for ocean protection and biodiversity restoration in New Zealand waters.
Timor-Leste Expedition. Upcoming SeaLegacy expedition to Timor-Leste focused on ocean conservation, protection and rewilding efforts through community engagement and marine documentation.

Guna Yala, Panama. Climate adaptation & plastic cleanup in Guna Yala. Relocating island communities threatened by rising seas while preserving cultural heritage. Removing marine debris & fishing gear via SeaLegacy 1 vessel to mainland recycling hubs.

Panama Expedition. Upcoming SeaLegacy expedition to Panama focused on ocean conservation and documentation. Aims to protect and rewild ocean ecosystems through community engagement and raising awareness about marine sustainability.

California Marine Expedition. Upcoming SeaLegacy expedition to document and protect California's marine ecosystems. Focuses on ocean conservation, rewilding efforts, and raising awareness about marine life sustainability through visual storytelling.

Patagonia Expedition. Upcoming SeaLegacy expedition to Patagonia focused on ocean conservation, rewilding, and protecting marine ecosystems. Community-driven initiative to restore ocean health and sustainability through documentation and advocacy.

Alaska Marine Conservation Expedition. Upcoming SeaLegacy expedition to Alaska focused on ocean protection and rewilding. Aims to document marine ecosystems, raise awareness about ocean health, and support sustainable practices through community engagement.

Falklands Expedition. Upcoming SeaLegacy expedition to Falklands focused on ocean conservation, documenting marine life and ecosystems to raise awareness and protect ocean health through community engagement and rewilding efforts.

French Polynesia Expedition. Upcoming SeaLegacy expedition to French Polynesia focused on ocean conservation, rewilding, and raising awareness about marine protection through documentation and community engagement.

South Georgia and South Sandwich Islands Marine Protected Area Expansion. Campaign to expand MPA protections in South Georgia & South Sandwich Islands from 284,000 to 449,000 sq km, protecting krill populations and marine biodiversity through storytelling and advocacy with conservation partners.

Great Barrier Reef Australia. Multi-year expedition documenting coral bleaching & resilient 'super corals' with Dr. Emma Camp. Aims to raise global awareness of mass bleaching events & support research on heat-tolerant corals for reef restoration.

Indonesia Marine Expedition. Upcoming SeaLegacy expedition to Indonesia focused on ocean protection and rewilding. Aims to document marine ecosystems and support ocean health through community engagement and conservation efforts.

Isla Beata Marine Protected Area Expedition. Visual storytelling expedition supporting Dominican Republic's marine sanctuary expansion. Established Beata Ridge MPA, achieving 30.8% ocean protection by 2030. Protects migratory species, coral reefs, marine mammals.

Bristol Bay, Alaska. Protecting world's largest salmon fishery from Pebble Mine through imagery and storytelling. Documenting bears, salmon runs, and marine estuaries to stop destructive mining and preserve ecosystem for future generations.

Reefgen Ocean Restoration. Restoring marine ecosystems using Grasshopper robot to mechanize seagrass and coral planting. Reduces costs, increases speed for large-scale ocean restoration. Partners with Dollar Donation Club for crowdfunding.

Galapagos Marine Conservation Expedition. Documenting marine species & migration routes in Galapagos to strengthen protections. Tagged whale sharks & tracked animal movements. Led to 60,000 km² reserve expansion & migratory corridor to Costa Rica.

Orcas of Lofoten. Protecting Lofoten's orcas, herring & fjords from oil drilling. Created imagery, mobilized 55K+ signatures to urge permanent protections. Temporary bans since 2001; ongoing advocacy for climate leadership over extraction.

Wave-Powered Sustainable Desalination Solution. Oneka uses wave-powered buoys for zero-emission desalination, converting seawater to freshwater for coastal populations. Mechanical buoys with reverse osmosis produce drinking water without electricity or fuel, serving communities globally.

Genevos Marine Fuel Cell Systems for Maritime Decarbonization. Genevos develops fuel-agnostic marine fuel cells (LNG, methanol, hydrogen) for maritime vessels, achieving 30-40% fuel savings. Projects include hydrogen retrofit vessels in Venice, America's Cup chase boat, and Baltic workboat.

SeaVoir Algae-Based Omega 3 for Ocean Restoration. Produces algae-based Omega 3 supplements to replace destructive krill/fish oil industries. Protects Antarctic krill populations critical for carbon sequestration & oxygen production. Founded by Cousteau family.

Vlinder Mangrove Reforestation. Restores mangroves with local communities across Africa and Asia. 1,600+ hectares restored, 5M+ trees planted, 3,000+ livelihoods supported. Generates carbon credits, reinvests in communities, creates sustainable impact.

Stream Ocean - AI-Powered Underwater Monitoring System. AI-driven underwater video monitoring delivering HD footage & daily ocean data for coastal hospitality, marine industries, research & conservation. Real-time analytics support coral restoration, aquaculture & environmental impact assessment.

bound4blue Wind-Assisted Propulsion for Shipping. Wind propulsion tech (eSAIL®) reduces ship emissions & fuel use. Combines rigid wing & rotor sails for profitable sustainability, helping achieve EEXI/CII compliance while generating carbon allowances for global shipping.

Urchinomics - Kelp Forest Restoration Through Sea Urchin Removal. Removes overgrazing sea urchins from degraded reefs to restore kelp forests, capture carbon, and rebuild marine biodiversity. Transforms wild urchins into premium uni through land-based ranching systems globally.

Photon Marine Electric Workboat Fleet. Photon Marine develops 300HP electric outboards for sustainable marine transport. Partners with boat builders to create silent, efficient vessels, reducing emissions in commercial maritime operations.

PierSight SAR & AIS Satellite Constellation for Maritime Surveillance. SAR & AIS satellite constellation providing persistent ocean monitoring. All-weather imaging, 100% ocean coverage, 30-min data intervals. Tracks maritime activity for conservation & industry at 1/6th cost.

TONTOTON Community Barrier - Coastal Plastic Pollution Prevention. Transforms coastal households & waste collectors into barriers stopping plastic pollution at source. Collects plastic from households before ocean entry, cleans shorelines/waterways, empowers vulnerable families with income.

Ocean Twist Biotechnology - Sustainable Aquaculture Feed. Develops fishmeal replacement proteins from agricultural side streams & insects for aquaculture. Serves 22 EU fish farms. Reduces marine ecosystem pressure while enhancing fish growth & health.

PlanBlue Seafloor Intelligence Platform. Automated seafloor mapping fusing RGB, hyperspectral & geospatial data for infrastructure integrity, anomaly detection & environmental assessments. Supports maritime surveys beyond camera/LiDAR/sonar capabilities.

Oceanium - Kelp the World. Develops functional seaweed ingredients for food, health & materials. Creates gut health supplements, skincare extracts & biodegradable ink from sustainably farmed seaweed to benefit people & ocean health.

Tēnaka Marine Ecosystem Conservation & Data Technology. Coral reef restoration & mangrove plantation using Tēnaka Station (360° underwater monitoring every 30sec + ML analysis). Projects in Malaysia & New Caledonia. G20 CORDAP Top 200 company for coral conservation.

CatchCam Technologies - Underwater Monitoring for Sustainable Fisheries. Develops durable underwater camera systems and sensors for commercial fishing and marine research to reduce bycatch, improve catch efficiency, conduct biodiversity assessments, and support sustainable fishing practices globally.

CalWave Wave Energy Converter Technology. Develops wave energy converters for coastal communities. Proprietary tech converts ocean waves to electricity, surviving extreme conditions. Targets reliable, cost-effective clean power with global reach.

Whale Seeker - AI Marine Mammal and Bird Detection. AI tools detect marine mammals & birds for conservation & mitigation. Monitors cetaceans, seals, walrus, sharks, penguins via drones, aircraft, satellite. 97% faster than manual detection. 165k+ animals detected.

Coral Vita - Commercial Reef Restoration Platform. Commercial coral reef restoration growing resilient coral in months vs decades using land-based aquaculture & BrainCoral tech. Restores reefs globally, creates eco-tourism, empowers communities. 50% corals dead, 90% at risk by 2050.

Finless Foods - Cell-Cultured Seafood for Ocean Conservation. Creating sustainable seafood alternatives using cell-cultured technology, starting with bluefin tuna. Aims to reduce pressure on overfished global tuna stocks and protect ocean ecosystems through lab-grown seafood products.

Aquaai - Fish-as-a-Service® Underwater Monitoring System. Bio-inspired robotic fish platform with cameras & sensors for subsurface data acquisition. Detects underwater infrastructure, security & environmental threats. AI-powered early warning system for water protection.

Navier Electric Hydrofoiling Vessel Platform. Navier develops zero-emission electric hydrofoiling vessels (N30 Platform) using aerospace-grade engineering, active hydrofoils, and autonomous systems for sustainable maritime transport across passenger, cargo, and defense operations.

Sustainable Ocean Alliance Tanzania Marine Conservation. Empowers youth & coastal communities in Tanzania via ocean conservation, blue economy, mangrove/seagrass/coral restoration. Projects: seagrass restoration, medical waste cleanup, Msimbazi River cleanup, mangrove planting, ocean bootcamp.

Seaforestation - Deepwater Irrigation for Seaweed Cultivation. Deepwater irrigation services accessing deep ocean nutrients to mitigate marine heatwaves, extend growing seasons, and increase seaweed cultivation yields for biostimulants, food and feed production.

FlyWire Digital Observer Service for Fisheries. Digital observer service using patented camera tech & automation to provide precise catch data for commercial fisheries. Reduces observer costs, unlocks fishing opportunities, ensures sustainability through cooperative research.

Ichthion Ocean-Bound Plastic Prevention. UK startup extracting up to 80 tons/day of ocean-bound plastic from rivers in Latin America & Africa using Azure system. Hyperion AI software analyzes pollution. Galapaxy promotes sustainable consumption. Active since 2020.

PlanetCare Microfiber Filter - Microplastic Prevention System. Why: Prevent microplastics from laundry entering oceans. What: Washing machine filter capturing 98% of synthetic fibers. How: Install on drain hose, cartridges recycled after 30 washes. When: Active since 2022. Where: Global (10,000+ users).

ARC Marine Nature-Inclusive Design Solutions. Designs, manufactures & deploys plastic-free reef systems for marine restoration. Enhances biodiversity via offshore energy, coastal defence, ports & aquaculture projects. 10+ years accelerating reef creation globally.

Blue Ocean Gear Smart Buoys. Smart buoy tech for real-time GPS tracking of fishing gear via satellite/radio. Helps fisheries locate gear faster, reduce ghost gear, monitor aquaculture farms. Used globally in wild capture fisheries and research.

Marulho Eco - Produtos de Redes de Pesca Recicladas. Transforma redes de pesca descartadas em produtos reutilizáveis. Previne danos à vida marinha. Opera da Ilha Grande, Angra dos Reis. Vende nacionalmente produtos sustentáveis feitos de materiais oceânicos recuperados.

West Coast Kelp - Kelp Cultivation and Restoration. Why: Regenerate coastal biodiversity. What: Kelp cultivation & restoration. How: Collaborate with First Nations, businesses, researchers. Where: West Coast Canada. When: Ongoing.

Sulubaai Foundation - Marine Ecosystem Restoration. Restoring coral reefs & mangroves in Shark Fin Bay, Palawan, Philippines. 80k trees planted, 2.5k corals transplanted, 250 artificial reefs. Community-based marine protected areas with local populations since 2011.

Ocean Data Action Coalition. Coalition building solutions to unlock ocean data from silos, advance industry sustainability through data sharing business models, and cultivate regulatory incentives for ocean data sharing to support ocean management.

Tides of Transparency: Mapping Industrial Ocean Biodiversity Data Sharing. Maps global industrial ocean biodiversity data sharing. Shows only 3% comes from private sector. Norway leads via mandatory policies. Aims to increase data from offshore industries for marine conservation.

Aker Biomarine Antarctic Krill Data Sharing. Aker Biomarine shares 10 years of acoustic krill data from Antarctic vessels via Ocean Data Platform. Enables scientists to study krill distribution, climate impacts on Southern Ocean ecosystem. MSC-certified sustainable harvesting.

UN Ocean Decade Corporate Data Group. Working group co-chaired by UNESCO IOC & Fugro unlocking industrial ocean data. Delivers guidelines for bathymetry & biodiversity sharing. Addresses gap: only 3% ocean biodiversity data from private sector in global repositories.

DNB and HUB Ocean Partner to Drive Innovation and Sustainability in Ocean Industries Through Data. DNB & HUB Ocean partner in Oslo to advance ocean sustainability using Ocean Data Platform for shipping, seafood & renewable energy sectors through data-driven insights for responsible investment decisions.

Ocean Data Action Day 2024. Annual event accelerating industrial ocean data sharing for ocean health. Unveiled 'Tides of Transparency' report mapping industrial ocean biodiversity data. Gathered industry, science & regulatory leaders. Oslo, Sept 2024.

ILIAD Digital Twin of the Ocean. EU flagship creating virtual ocean twin with 56 partners across 18 countries. Provides real-time ocean predictions via data fusion, supporting conservation, offshore wind, pollution monitoring, and blue economy through interoperable platform.

Ecowende Offshore Wind Farm Ecological Data Sharing. Ecowende shares ecological data from Hollandse Kust West VI wind farm, 53km off Dutch coast. Monitors birds, bats, fish, acoustic data via sensors. Tests innovations like bird corridors, tree reefs. Operational 2026. Data on HUB Ocean platform.

TGS Marine Data Sharing for Conservation. TGS shares marine mammal, turtle sightings, CTD, ocean current data (2008-2023) from Brazil coast via HUB Ocean platform. Supports SDG14, improves operational models, reduces emissions, aids scientific research.

Seabird Ventures - Ocean Impact Venture Capital Fund. VC fund investing Pre-Seed to Series A in ocean health startups. Focus: maritime decarbonization, pollution reduction, sustainable fisheries, ocean monitoring. Partnership with Sustainable Ocean Alliance.

Citizen Sea. Mobile app enabling seafarers and coastal residents to photograph and log marine wildlife and pollution sightings. Feeds world's largest open-source ocean database used by scientists to assess ocean health and close data gaps.

Aker BP Shares Ocean Data on HUB Ocean Platform. Aker BP contributes met ocean data (wave heights, currents, wind, sea temps) to HUB Ocean's platform, addressing 3% private sector gap in biodiversity repositories for ocean health & sustainable resource use.

Lusedata: Industry-Wide Data Sharing for Salmon Aquaculture. Norwegian initiative sharing data from 1,000+ aquaculture sites to monitor/manage salmon lice via Ocean Data Platform. Tracks lice counts, treatments, environmental parameters. Enables predictive analytics for fish health.

HUB Ocean and OceanPact Partnership for Brazil Ocean Protection. Partnership combining ocean data sharing with operational capabilities to protect Brazil's marine environment through Ocean Data Platform and Ocean Sensitive Areas tool development.

Seagrass Research Program. Restoring seagrass ecosystems in Bintan using cultivation methods. Seagrass absorbs CO2 35x faster than rainforests. Benefits coastal communities, supports marine life, and provides carbon storage.

Projeto TransforMAR. Ocean preservation & sustainability education in Brazil. Activities in indigenous communities, conservation units, educational materials production. Active 2018-2024 in coastal communities & marine ecosystems.

Marine protected areas in New Ireland, Papua New Guinea. Wildlife Conservation Society worked with Indigenous Peoples and government to create two nearshore MPAs spanning 16,000+ km2 in New Ireland Province, tripling PNG's ocean protections through 7-year community partnership.

Beat the Microbead - Campaign Against Microplastics in Cosmetics. Global campaign targeting 500+ microplastic ingredients in cosmetics. Started 2012, achieved microbead bans in 19 countries. Provides app to scan products, guide to microplastics, advocating for cleaner cosmetics to reduce marine pollution.

Plastic Fashion - Stop Microplastic Pollution from Textiles. Campaign to stop microplastic pollution from synthetic clothing. Textile industry causes 35% of oceanic microplastics. Advocates for EU legislation (ESPR) requiring material standards, quality rules, washing machine filters.

Macquarie Island Marine Park. Expanded sub-Antarctic marine park SE of Tasmania to size of Germany, banning fishing/mining in 93% of area. Protects 10% of world's elephant seals, 3.5m seabirds, whales. Public consultation led to increased protection.

Nurdles - Preventing Microplastic Pellet Pollution. Campaign to stop nurdle disasters like MSC Zoe spill (24M pellets). Addresses invisible microplastic pollution from industrial plastic granules washing into oceans, breaking into nanoplastics, entering food chain.

Plastic Soup Foundation Teaching Materials. Educational program teaching children about plastic pollution through lesson materials, guest lectures, kids website, and fundraising campaigns. Aims to inspire youth worldwide to combat ocean plastic.

Plastic Soup Foundation Business Community. Business partnership program combating plastic pollution. Companies commit to reducing plastic footprint through knowledge sharing, networking events, expert symposia, and peer learning. PSF provides strategic advice and scientific insights.

Implementing CITES Shark Listings in the Middle East and North Africa. Supporting Middle East and North Africa countries to implement CITES regulations for shark and ray species through capacity building and enforcement training.

Conservation of Three Critically Endangered Guitarfish Species in the Proposed MPA of Grand Bereby. Conserve guitarfish in Grand Bereby MPA, Côte d'Ivoire by collecting landing data and raising awareness with fishers and public to increase population and protect habitat.

Mapping Critical Habitats of Blacktip Reef Sharks and Guitarfish Using Acoustic Telemetry in Kenya. Uses acoustic telemetry to map habitat use and identify nursery/pupping grounds for blacktip reef sharks and guitarfish in Watamu Marine Park to support conservation of overfished species in Kenya's coastal waters.

Improving the Conservation Status of Threatened Shark and Ray Species in the South Western Indian Ocean Region. Protecting sharks/rays in SWIO hotspot via MPAs and ISRA process. Targets Kenya, Madagascar, Mozambique, Tanzania. Addresses overfishing, 41% species threatened. Focuses spatial management in critical habitats.

Gathering Fundamental Scientific Data for the Conservation of Guitarfish Species in the Marine Protected Area of Grand-Bereby, Southwestern Ivory Coast. Scientific research on guitarfish species in Grand-Bereby MPA, Ivory Coast. Collecting fundamental data to support conservation of threatened guitarfish populations in protected coastal waters.

Investigating Mating and Nursery Areas for the Reef Manta Ray, Mobula Alfredi, in Dongunab Bay and Makkawar Island. Survey reef manta aggregation sites in Dongunab Bay & Makkawar Island, Sudan using photo ID to track movements and investigate potential breeding/nursery areas in lagoons to conserve the species.

Implementing the National Plan of Action for Sharks in Kenya: Information, Awareness and Policy. Generates info for Kenya's NPOA-Sharks to manage ~100 shark/ray species threatened by fisheries bycatch. Improves management practices through research, awareness & policy implementation along Kenyan coast.

Strengthen Sharks and Rays Conservation in Donaten Marine Protected Area. Protect sharks/rays in Benin's Donaten MPA through community data collection (Siren/iNaturalist), awareness campaigns, strengthened MPA governance, and law enforcement partnerships to ensure thriving marine ecosystems.

Plastic Soup Foundation Kids - Global Plastic Pollution Education. Educational initiative engaging children worldwide to combat plastic pollution in oceans. Kids learn about plastic soup, become heroes through videos/actions, and discover global youth activists fighting marine plastic.

Swimming in Dangerous Waters: Sustainable Protection of Sharks and Rays in Bijagós MPAs. Protecting critically endangered sharks and rays in Bijagós Archipelago, Guinea-Bissau through MPA zoning, management plans, no-catch zones, and gill net bans across five marine protected areas.

Marine Witness Criminal Court Training. Training scientists & officials in courtroom testimony via mock trials to strengthen prosecutions of marine crimes in South Africa's 42 MPAs, protecting sharks, rays & 3,800+ endemic species.

Assessing the Diversity and Status of Elasmobranchs in Namibia. Collecting bycatch data on commercial vessels to evaluate elasmobranch species diversity, catch rates, and sustainability in Namibian waters. Creating species ID guide for future management strategies.

Recovering Populations of Sharks and Rays in the Gulf of Gabes, Tunisia. Reversing decline of sharks & rays in Gulf of Gabes through community-based recovery plans for sandbar sharks, common guitarfish & blackchin guitarfish in Mediterranean stronghold.

CITES Shark and Ray Work in West Africa. Building CITES implementation in West/Central Africa to recover shark & ray populations. Strengthens compliance, addresses listing criteria gaps, fosters regional collaboration with Latin America on shared conservation goals.

Shark and Ray Exploitation Status in the Manyange Na Elombo Marine National Park and its Periphery. Collecting data on shark/ray species, habitats, threats in Manyange Na Elombo marine park to create national conservation directive and park management plan in Cameroon.

Integrated Community-Based Protection of Sharks and Rays in Benin. Community-led shark/ray conservation in Benin addressing overfishing through socio-cultural engagement with fishermen. Holistic approach linking food security, cultural practices, and fisheries management in West Africa.

Securing Critical Habitat for Sharks & Rays in Southern Mozambique. Establishing Shark & Ray Protection Zone at Inhamambane Estuary to safeguard Critically Endangered wedgefish via science-based management & alternative fishing methods for local communities in Bazaruto Seascape.

Elasmobranch Research and Management in Namibian MPAs. Study sharks, skates & rays in Africa's 2nd largest marine reserve (NIMPA) using video, acoustic tags & angler collaboration. Develop management measures for unstudied elasmobranch populations in Namibian waters.

Participatory Management and Conservation of the Shark Sanctuary of Parda Bay. Protecting Lemon sharks & nursery in Baía de Parda through sustainable resource mgmt & shark-watching tourism. Community-focused project develops local livelihoods using best practices to ensure shark population health.

Identifying Key Habitats for Endangered Whale Sharks in Madagascar. Research project identifying 400+ juvenile whale sharks in NW Madagascar to integrate critical habitats into MPA management plans and support National Plan of Action for Sharks and Rays development.

Assessing the Scale of Exploitation of Sharks and Rays in West Africa. Surveys at processing sites in Senegal & Mauritania to assess shark/ray fisheries impact, estimate trade quantities, identify species composition, map trade flows, and inform policy on fisheries controls.

Conservation and Management of Sharks & Rays in Mozambique. Prevents extinction of manta rays & whale sharks through research, education & conservation. Addresses marine illiteracy, changes attitudes/behavior/policy to protect marine resources at local & national levels in Mozambique.

Protection for Threatened Sharks and Rays in South Africa. Improve protection of IUCN Red List threatened sharks/rays in South African waters through research, legal strengthening, enforcement, and public mobilization. Prioritizes endemic species.

Save the Maugean Skate. Film campaign to save critically endangered Maugean Skate in Macquarie Harbour, Tasmania, threatened by industrial aquaculture. Features Aboriginal voices, scientists, govt reps to build community support for conservation.

Improving Species Catch Data Collection for the Conservation and Management of Sharks and Rays in Kenya. Introduces species-level shark/ray identification at 3 landing sites to assess fishing threats and develop policy briefs for Kenya's National Plan of Action, enhancing conservation management and fisher awareness.

Improving Conservation of Sharks and Rays in Ghana Through Education and Sensitization. Training fishermen in data collection on sharks/rays to inform sustainable management measures in Ghana's waters. Educational campaigns promote conservation policies and community acceptance of management plans.

Biodiversity and Conservation of Elasmobranchs in Watamu Marine National Park, Kenya. Enhance conservation of sharks, rays & guitarfish in Watamu Marine National Park. Collect data on critically endangered species like Halavi guitarfish using park as nursery. Provide education in schools & community events.

Using Kinship to Investigate Population Status and Reproductive Behaviour of Largetooth Sawfish. Uses genetic techniques to assess kinship of 300 juvenile sawfish in NW Australia over 20 years, providing life-history data for fisheries management of this threatened species.

Assessment of the Extent of Shark Depredation in North Male and Baa Atolls, Maldives. Assessing shark-fishery interactions in Maldives shark sanctuary. Advocates for modified fishing gear with shark deterrents to reduce conflicts. Addresses fishermen concerns over catch reduction in North Male and Baa Atolls.

Creation of a Platform of Community-Based Conservation Advocates for Sharks and Rays in Liberia. Community-based shark and ray conservation platform in Liberia. Builds local advocacy network to protect elasmobranch species through community engagement and education along Liberian coast.

Survey of the Nursery Areas of Green Sawfish (Pristis zijsron) in the Sudanese Red Sea. Survey nursery areas of green sawfish in Sudanese Red Sea to assess juveniles, study ecology, collect genetic samples, use eDNA to detect presence, and train fishermen on sawfish protection. 12-month project by University of Bahri.

Mapping Critical Habitats to Safeguard the Critically Endangered Rhinorays of the Karimunjawa National Park Java Sea. Mapping and protecting critical habitats for endangered wedgefish and guitarfish species in Karimunjawa National Park, Java Sea, through research and bycatch reduction efforts with local fishing communities.

Use of Ancient Environmental DNA to Identify a Viable Site for Conservation of the Maugean Skate. Uses ancient DNA to assess if Bathurst Harbour is suitable for releasing captive-bred Maugean skates. Population halved in 7 years in degraded Macquarie Harbour. Urgent captive breeding needed for near-extinct species.

SharkTrack: Developing a Traceability System for Shark and Ray Products. Develops tagging system to track sharks/rays from capture through supply chain, enabling legal source verification, supporting CITES compliance, and reducing illegal catch in managed fisheries.

An Assessment of Sharks and Rays at a Critical Site in Mozambique. Assessing threatened sharks and rays in Zavora, Mozambique, focusing on reef manta rays after drastic decline. Protecting critical habitat where remaining individuals may have relocated over past decade.

Evaluating the Efficacy of a Marine Reserve for Endemic and Threatened Sharks off South Africa. Study evaluating if extending De Hoop Nature Reserve boundary 5km eastward will protect endemic/threatened sharks from longline fishing. Results inform Cape Nature's reserve design decisions. 12-month research on shark protection.

Germ Cell Transplantation as an Insurance Tool for the Conservation of the Endangered Maugean Skate. Using germ cell transplantation to preserve endangered Maugean skate genetics. Injecting skate germ cells into surrogate species to produce offspring from cryopreserved material. Located in Macquarie & Bathurst Harbours, Tasmania.

Unravelling Fishing and Trade of Endangered Guitarfish in the Bijagos Archipelago. Study guitarfish population status & fishing pressure in Bijagos Archipelago. Collaborate with IBAP to gather current/historical data via stakeholder involvement, establish evidence-based conservation agenda for endangered species.

Building Capacity of Emerging Shark Researchers in the Philippines. Training emerging shark researchers in the Philippines to build local conservation capacity through research skills development and knowledge transfer for shark and ray protection.

Sharks International 2026. World's largest shark/ray conference in Sri Lanka 2026, bridging science & policy. Enables Asian scientists/policymakers to attend, fostering partnerships for elasmobranch conservation through accessible venue.

Protecting Sharks and Rays in Australia Phase 2. Protecting endemic sharks, rays, and sawfish in Australia's tropical ecosystems by reducing threats from commercial fishing and shark control programs across eastern Australia's unmanaged waters.

Preventing Shark Extinctions from Australia's North to South. AMCS partners with SCF to prevent extinction of endangered sharks and rays across Australia, focusing on sawfish conservation in northern Australia, Maugean Skate protection, and safeguarding critically endangered species.

Save the Maugean Skate Campaign. Campaign to save <1,000 Maugean Skates in Macquarie Harbour, Tasmania from extinction due to industrial aquaculture. Science-based community engagement to implement conservation actions for survival.

Estimation of Acquisition Time of CITES-Listed Sharks: A Tool for Pre-Convention Specimens. Develops DNA tool to determine age of shark products via DNA fragmentation, enabling enforcement of CITES trade regulations for endangered sharks and rays in Hong Kong wildlife trade markets.

Global Shark Conservation Campaign South Asia & West Africa. Implements CITES shark/ray listings in Sri Lanka & Senegal through mortality controls. Supports additional species listings at 2019 CITES meeting. 12-month campaign for endangered species protection.

Southeast Asian Shark and Ray Research and Conservation Capacity Building Workshop 2019. Workshop bringing researchers from 6 nations to build capacity in shark/ray research in SE Asia, a diversity hotspot & fisheries center. Develops skills & networks for future conservation efforts.

Investigating the Past and Present of Sawfish in Bangladesh. Volunteer monitoring by trained coastal communities to report sawfish encounters and landings in Bangladesh. Data shared via open-access web portal to support national sawfish conservation and global assessment.

Developing Local Conservation Policy for Pelagic Thresher Shark in Alor, Indonesia. Establishing District and village-level conservation policy to stop unsustainable thresher shark fishing in newly identified hotspot. Working with fishing communities on livelihood mitigation strategies.

Developing Conservation Approaches for Sawfish and Rhino Rays in Papua New Guinea. Conservation project protecting critically endangered sawfish and rhino rays in PNG waters through research and community engagement to develop sustainable management strategies.

Restoring Manta and Devil Ray Populations in the Philippines. Identifying remaining manta/devil ray populations after fishery closure (2017). Creating first manta sanctuary, mapping priority areas/migration corridors, establishing protected area network for species recovery in Philippines.

CITES Shark and Ray Listings Implementation Capacity Building Fin Identification Workshops Taiwan. Capacity building workshops for Taiwan officials on visual ID of shark fins and mobular gill plates, trade document review, to increase regulation and monitoring of CITES-listed species and deter illegal trade.

Securing the Only Known Viable Population of the Ganges Shark (Glyphis gangeticus). Protect critically endangered Ganges Sharks in N Kalimantan estuaries. 17 individuals found 2023. Work with local govt/universities for national protection policy. Population <250 mature individuals globally.

Understanding Artisanal Fishing Activity and Data Collection on Sharks and Rays in Indonesia. Identifies shark/mobulid interactions with artisanal fisheries in Savu Sea through on-board/land observation to promote fishing regulation modifications and area management. Addresses lack of fishing data in Indonesian waters.

In Situ Conservation of Queensland's Sawfish. Sharks and Rays Australia works with fishers in Queensland to protect sawfish through capture reporting and best practice release methods for animals entangled in nets. 12-month project addressing conservation barriers.

Halting Extinction: Ensuring Live Release of Sawfish, Alleviating Barriers of Fishers in Bangladesh. Creating fisher networks to release sawfish live by breaking barriers. Collaborative model with stakeholders, policymakers & researchers to mitigate bycatch in developing countries & limit population decline.

Simplifying the CITES Non-Detriment Findings (NDF) Process: The Electronic NDF (e-NDF). Workshop to assess new software streamlining CITES NDF process for sharks/rays, making it accessible to Parties. Ensures sustainable trade of 30k species while promoting population recovery and sustainable livelihoods.

Towards a Sustainable Future for Sri Lankan Rhino Rays: Science Implementation in the Indian Ocean. Delivers critical data on threatened rhino rays in Sri Lanka to inform trade regulations and fisheries management. Addresses knowledge gaps in diversity and population structure to support Non-Detrimental Findings and action plans.

Saving Sharks in Indonesia Through Developing and Implementing Science-Based Management Reforms. WCS program delivering science-based fisheries/trade reforms in Indonesia (world's largest shark fishing nation). Enhances legal protection, tackles illegal trade, implements sustainable fishing, evaluates impact on species/communities.

Awakening of Public Opinion for Withdrawal of Japan's Reservation of CITES Shark Species Regulations. Raising public awareness in Japan about shark conservation and CITES trade regulations through symposiums and information campaigns to pressure withdrawal of Japan's reservations on shark species listings.

Implementing Outreach and Advocacy Activities for the Passage of the Philippine Shark Conservation Act. Advocacy for national shark/ray conservation policy in Philippines. Balances fishery use by coastal communities with tourism potential. Outreach campaign to support legal framework for sustainable utilization of 200+ species.

Building Capacity for Long-Term Shark Conservation in Myanmar. Fauna & Flora supports Myanmar govt to improve shark/ray conservation through science, advocacy, national planning. Reduces illegal landings, bycatch, protects Myeik archipelago habitats, reforms legislation.

Reduce Shark Mortality in the Arabian Sea Around Pakistan. WWF reduces shark bycatch in Arabian Sea via modified fishing gear, regional data sharing, and national management blueprint. Establishes coordinated shark/ray conservation strategy across Pakistan and neighboring waters.

Sabah Shark and Ray Initiative. Strengthens shark/ray conservation in Sabah through improved regulations, bycatch reduction, MPA effectiveness, and awareness. Supports Malaysia's National Plan of Action on Sharks via multi-org collaboration.

Shark Fin Demand Reduction. Multi-country study of shark fin consumption trends & trade dynamics in Asia to inform culturally specific demand reduction campaigns. Addresses manta/mobula ray gill plate demand. Partners: Traffic, WWF, ADMCF.

A Scoping Study for Traceability Improvements in Singapore, a Globally Significant Trading Hub for Shark and Ray Products. Research shark/ray supply chain in Singapore to combat IUU fishing. Maps product flow, stakeholders, legal requirements. Identifies gaps and recommends traceability improvements for CITES implementation in this major trading hub.

Angel Sharks: A Regional Action Plan for the Mediterranean. Protect 3 Critically Endangered angel sharks in Mediterranean via regional action plan. Increases profile, classifies threats, fosters collaboration, facilitates legislation adoption. 2-year core grant.

Rapid Assessment Toolkit for Sharks (RAT). WWF developed a Rapid Assessment Toolkit to help fisheries authorities understand shark/ray populations and stock health through simplified DNA data methods. Trials conducted in Papua New Guinea, Malaysia, Indonesia to improve species management.

Protecting Sharks and Rays in Australia. 3-year program to protect endemic sharks/rays through public campaigns, fisheries reduction, threatened species listings, and transitioning shark control programs to non-lethal methods in Australian waters.

Conservation of Angel Sharks (Squatina squatina) in Their Last Stronghold. Investigating nursery areas for Critically Endangered Angelsharks in Canary Islands. Research environmental characteristics, engage stakeholders, raise awareness to drive spatial protection in this unique stronghold.

Strengthening Angel Shark Conservation in the Southern Aegean Sea. Protecting 3 Critically Endangered angel shark species in Aegean Sea hotspot through Sub-Regional Action Plan implementation, addressing illegal fishing threats in Greek waters around Crete over 12 months.

Advancing Shark and Ray Conservation and Management in Indonesia. WCS supports Indonesian govt to develop policies for shark/ray protection, implement site-based conservation programs, and strengthen law enforcement capacity for elasmobranch regulations.

Protecting Critical Shark and Ray Habitat in Sabah. Conservation project in Sabah protecting critical habitats for sharks and rays as apex predators essential to ocean health. Addresses threats from overfishing killing 250,000+ sharks/rays daily.

Build a National Reporting System for Forest Officials to Protect Threatened Sharks and Rays. Training forest officials in Bangladesh to report shark/ray data, standardizing wildlife monitoring to enforce national laws and international commitments for elasmobranch protection through 12-month capacity building.

Protecting Sharks and Rays in the Spanish Mediterranean. Reversing shark/ray decline in Balearic Islands via MPAs, fisheries management, habitat protection. Collaborating with NGOs, researchers, fishermen to protect threatened species and establish conservation model.

SAW Search: Old Saws Shed New Light in Sawfish Conservation. Analyzing historic largetooth sawfish museum specimens from UK to quantify genetic diversity loss over ~100 years, assessing survival outlook for Critically Endangered populations affected by bycatch and habitat loss.

Hong Kong Policy Work for the Shark Fin Related Trade. Reviews policies/legislation on shark fin trade in Hong Kong (50% global imports hub). Enhances CITES enforcement, combats illegal trade through research and public engagement to classify wildlife crimes as serious offenses.

Reversing the Decline of Shark Populations in Indonesia by Transforming Fisheries and Trade. Protecting endangered sharks/rays in Indonesia through evidence-based fisheries management, CITES implementation, and community collaboration across 17,000+ islands with 2.3M fishers.

Securing the Long-Term Conservation of Angelsharks in their Stronghold of the Canary Islands. Protecting Critically Endangered Angelsharks in Canary Islands through government partnerships, data collection, fisher collaboration to reduce bycatch, and implementing the Angelshark Action Plan.

Strengthening Shark and Ray Protections in Sabah, Malaysia. Strengthening shark/ray conservation in Sabah through improved legal frameworks, CITES protection, policy research on landings/ecotourism, media campaigns, education, and hosting 2018 conference for regional collaboration.

Protecting Sharks in the Northwest Adriatic. Promotes spatial management for threatened sharks/rays in overfished NW Adriatic ISRA. Addresses declining populations where fisheries measures fail to protect vulnerable species in Croatia & Italy waters.

Blue Shark Regional NDF Guidance. Developing regional Non-Detriment Findings guidance for blue shark conservation to support sustainable fisheries management and CITES compliance across multiple jurisdictions.

Island Shark: Oceanic Islands as Nurseries for Migratory Sharks. Mapping nurseries of smooth hammerhead and tope sharks in Azores using traditional knowledge, tagging, and video census to inform marine protected areas. 12-month study of threatened migratory species.
