National Seabed Enhancement Programme. Senegal seabed mapping project using advanced techniques to protect marine resources, create MPAs, support sustainable fisheries & marine infrastructure. Aims to stimulate economic growth & improve coastal communities' lives.

Strengthening the Resilience of Coastal Communities in the Northeast Atlantic, Mediterranean Region to the Impact of Tsunamis and Other Sea Level-Related Coastal Hazards. Builds tsunami-resilient communities in 7 NEAM countries through awareness, preparedness strategies, local alerting systems, and IOC-UNESCO Tsunami Ready recognition. Protects coastal lives, livelihoods, and property from multi-hazards.

The EAF-Nansen Programme: Supporting the Application of the Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management. FAO-Norway partnership strengthening fisheries policies across 32 African and Bay of Bengal countries using ecosystem approach. Focuses on sustainable management, ocean governance, and Blue Transformation for food security.

Global Fishing Index. Minderoo Foundation develops globally-accepted measure of fish stock health using new technologies to protect seas from over-fishing, promote sustainable wild caught fisheries, and drive improved decision-making and compliance worldwide.

IGIF-Hydro. Operational Framework for Integrated Marine Geospatial Information to facilitate decision-making for sustainable oceans, seas, coastal zones, deltas, tributaries, and inland water bodies across all ocean basins.

EUceano. Documentary filmmakers travel globally to explore ocean-human relationships through diving, sustainable fishing, and ocean literacy. Showcases people defending marine life and reducing plastic pollution to inspire change.

Enhancing Accessibility of OA Reference Materials. Diversifies production of certified reference materials for ocean acidification monitoring. Addresses COVID-19 supply shortage that compromised global ocean carbonate chemistry measurements. All ocean basins. 2021-2026.

Unpath'd Waters. Uses AI to connect UK marine heritage collections, from Bronze Age to WWII wrecks and prehistoric North Sea landscapes. Delivers integrated management tools, simulations, and public co-design for maritime legacy.

OceanWISE: Indigenous Knowledge Alliance. Empowers indigenous communities in territorial ocean management, integrating traditional wisdom for sustainable practices, carbon sequestration, and coastal resilience in Caribbean and South Pacific regions.

MS in Science and Design for MSP. Two-year Master's program at IUAV Venice integrating oceanography, marine sciences, and planning for maritime spatial planning. Trains professionals through theory and practice-based learning for coastal activities.

Forever chemicals in the marine environment. FEARLESS assesses PFAS toxicity & transformation in marine food webs. Studies impact on organisms near firefighting foam sources at Bergen airport & Ekofisk/Eldfisk oilfields in Norwegian waters, 2023-2026.

Belmont Forum Ocean Collaborative Research Actions. International funders develop multilateral calls for transdisciplinary ocean research. Co-designed with scientists, policymakers, communities to generate knowledge for environmental change mitigation. Global scope across all ocean basins.

Enhancing capacity for global coastal resilience. Deltares-led initiative (2025-2029) enhancing coastal resilience globally through technical expertise, capacity building, policy collaboration, and international networks. Provides tools, training, and nature-based solutions.

NSF Convergence Accelerator - Networked Blue Economy. Accelerates convergence research into practice by merging multidisciplinary expertise to address blue economy challenges. Track E focuses on interconnecting ocean research, innovation, and technology for societal impact. Completed 2024.

Coral Reef Restoration Engaging Local Stakeholders Using Novel Biomimicking IntelliReefs. Deploying nanotechnology artificial reefs in Sint Maarten to restore coral after Hurricane Irma. Biomimicking structures provide habitat, attract wild corals, support fish populations, enhance biodiversity.

Atlantic Meridional Transect Omics Network (AMT-Omics). Long-term oceanographic monitoring across Atlantic Ocean (UK to South Atlantic, 100° latitude, 1000m depth). Integrates molecular omics data since 2009 with traditional methods for continuous time-series analysis.

Low-Cost Real-Time Monitoring of Pollutants and Water Quality along the Coral Reefs in Tanzania: Supporting Effective Ocean Management. Deploys water quality monitoring devices at 8 coral reef sites along Tanzania coast measuring temperature, dissolved oxygen, pH. Real-time data logged for 10 years to inform policy on reef protection & climate impact.

Ufukwe Marine Center-Ocean Climate Innovation Hub (UMC). Centre of Excellence in Mombasa fostering ocean-climate research, innovations, and restoration. Advances ocean-based climate solutions in Kenya through collaboration with researchers, entrepreneurs, and local communities in the Indian Ocean.

Plankton Biodiversity Through Remote Sensing and Omics. PETRI-MED monitors microbial plankton biodiversity via satellite & genomics to assess marine health, carbon sequestration & ocean acidification. Combines remote sensing, field data & AI in Mediterranean 2023-2026.

Coastal Resilience Through Knowledge Capacity. CMCC 5-year initiative providing technical expertise for coastal resilience through multi-hazard early warning systems, nature-based solutions, Digital Twins, and AI. Focus on Global South capacity building via workshops and collaboration.

European Knowledge Hub on Sea Level Rise. Why: Support sea level policy decisions. What: Networking platform for 50+ experts. How: Interdisciplinary knowledge exchange on regional sea level rise. When: 2021-2027. Where: Nine European countries.

GIRT Scientific Divers. Trains recreational/technical divers to monitor underwater cultural heritage sites. Citizen science program shares data publicly and with management agencies to protect non-renewable UCH from natural and human threats. Started Australia 2018.

Long-term Observation Program in the Baltic Sea (BalticObs). Five annual cruises monitoring hydrographic, chemical, biological parameters in Baltic Sea. Tracks ecosystem variability, anthropogenic impacts (nutrients, microplastics), climate change effects. Data supports regional cooperation and policy.

Clean Water for Reefs: Tackling Wastewater. Monitors water quality & implements wastewater solutions in Roatán, Honduras. Connected homes to treatment facility, preventing 29M gallons/year from ocean. Reduces fecal bacteria, protects coral reefs & human health. Scaling across MAR region.

SEA2SEE. Blockchain-based seafood traceability system covering Mediterranean & N Atlantic. Tracks fish from catch to consumer, verifying sustainable practices. Runs 2022-2026 to increase trust in sustainable seafood.

WYTEC Blue – Women & Youth Technical Capacity for the Blue Economy. Builds technical capacity for women & youth in Canada & West Africa for sustainable blue economy. Develops ocean innovation content via Ocean School platform in 4 languages. Targets Canadian Arctic & Peru communities.

Plastics as a vector for spread of AMR. Studies how marine plastics carry antibiotic-resistant bacteria from wastewater into oceans. Analyzes biofilms on plastic litter in Mediterranean & North Atlantic to assess AMR spread risks to marine food chains.

MINKA citizen science observatory. Community platform for coastal biodiversity data collection via geolocalized citizen photos. Volunteers document species; experts validate; data shared via GBIF. Aligns with EOVs, supports SDGs 11,14,15,17. 2024-2030.

Acoustic Detection & Protection Tech for Endangered Right Whales. Expands near-real time acoustic surveillance in eastern Canada to detect and locate North Atlantic right whales. Uses sophisticated acoustic tech and aerial surveillance to reduce vessel strikes and fishing gear entanglement.

Integrated Climate Vulnerability Assessments. Develops climate vulnerability assessment tool for American lobster fishery in Northwest Atlantic, incorporating climate exposure, sensitivity data, and habitat models to enable marine resiliency and food provisioning.

Climate Change Impact on Marine Coastal Ecosystem Kerala (C3-eKerala). Indo-Norwegian project assessing climate change impacts on Kerala's 593km coast using satellite data, modeling & machine learning to predict sea level rise, shoreline changes, ecosystem impacts & harmful algal blooms for 2023-2030 mitigation plans

Sustainable Blue Food Futures for People & Planet (BlueFood Futures). Builds on Blue Food Assessment to integrate aquatic foods into global policy. Focuses on understanding blue food potential, policy integration, stakeholder solutions, and capacity building through 2027.

Improvement of Women's Access to Maritime Navigation Training in Togo. Promotes gender equality in maritime sector by enhancing women's access to navigation training in Togo, where only 3 of 50 ship captains are women. Addresses barriers restricting women's participation as captains and deck officers.

Quieting Oceans for a Sustainable Future (BluEcho). BluEcho mitigates underwater noise from shipping & wind farms across Mediterranean, North, Baltic, Norwegian & Polar Oceans. Uses 3D sound mapping, species impact assessment & mitigation strategies to protect marine biodiversity.

NaturCap. Take Care of Cap de Creus. Digital platform promoting cross-sectoral collaboration for blue economy growth amid climate change. Leverages Cap de Creus maritime heritage to drive conservation and pro-environmental behaviors through oceanic justice principles.

Kelp Forests in the Anthropocene. GEcoKelp reveals ocean warming & marine heatwave effects on kelp forests via genomics, experiments & models. Focuses on Norwegian kelp (S. latissima, L. hyperborea) to inform management & restoration strategies.

Nature-Inclusive Designs for Offshore Renewables (NiD4OCEAN). EU-funded project developing nature-inclusive designs for offshore renewable energy in North Sea, Baltic Sea & Western Mediterranean. Balances carbon neutrality with biodiversity restoration through transdisciplinary solutions. 2024-2027.

CoastSnap Community Beach Monitoring. Community-driven beach monitoring using smartphones to track erosion and recovery. Citizens upload photos via cradles, creating accurate coastal change records comparable to GPS surveys for sea level and storm impact management.

Global Coastal Bathymetry Observation. Mapping coastal bathymetry 0-30m depth using satellite data, tidal models, and wave analysis. Cloud-based monitoring system for shallow waters globally where physical surveys are not feasible.

CoastPredict – Observing and Predicting the Global Coastal Ocean. Transforms coastal ocean science by integrating observations with models to predict extreme events to climate impacts on marine ecosystems, biodiversity, and coastal communities globally from river catchments to slope waters.

Decade Coordination Office for Ocean Observing. Coordinates Ocean Decade Challenge 7 to ensure sustainable ocean observing systems across all basins, delivering accessible data to users. Connects actions, fills capacity gaps, transforms GOOS beyond 2030.

Decade Coordination Office for Ocean Data Sharing. Manages ocean data sharing for UN Ocean Decade. Develops capacity, findability, interoperability of ocean data. Creates digital ocean representation. Supports global observing systems & knowledge transfer across regions.

Decade Collaborative Centre for the Southern Ocean Region (DCC-SOR). Coordinates international efforts to protect Southern Ocean through research, stakeholder engagement, and resource mobilization. Addresses pollution, biodiversity, climate, and ocean economy across Antarctic waters (2023-2030).

Polar Pod Expedition. Unprecedented maritime exploration of Southern Ocean (2023-2026) using innovative platform for sustained in situ measurements. Addresses critical data gap in Earth's climate driver and biodiversity reserve.

The Centre for Sustainable Ocean Science. Transdisciplinary research on marine biodiversity & sustainability in Baltic Sea. Focuses on Archipelago Sea & Åland. Uses Living Lab methodology with stakeholders to address ecosystem protection & knowledge sharing challenges.

Under the Pole: DeepLife 2021-2030. 10-year exploration of mesophotic ecosystems (30-200m deep) across all ocean basins to discover biodiversity, species connectivity, vulnerability to climate change, and propose conservation measures for this largely unexplored marine zone.

Mission Ocean Microbiomes (Tara Microbiomes). 5-year research on ocean microbiome, climate impacts & plastisphere. South Atlantic expedition (2020-2022) with AtlantECO, Chile CO2 mission. Research phase 2022-2025, advocacy & capacity building ongoing.

Innovative Applications of Postharvest Fish Losses (WASTE2TASTE). 8 European partners developing commercially viable products from fish waste, by-catch & processing by-products. Creates marine ingredients via green bioprocesses, reducing extraction time & hazardous solvents.

ATLASea: Atlas of Marine Genomes. Sequencing genomes of 4,500+ marine species in French EEZ to monitor biodiversity, discover biotech materials, and support evolution research. Coordinated by CEA/CNRS, data freely available for aquaculture, medicine applications.

Ocean Networks Canada. ONC operates ocean observatories across Canada's 3 coasts & Antarctica, collecting continuous data from deep sea & coastal sensors since 2006. Advances ocean observing, delivers open data products, accelerates climate & sustainability research.

Canada's Coastal Environmental Baseline Program. Collects baseline ecological data in 6 high-traffic Canadian coastal areas (Iqaluit, Vancouver, Prince Rupert, St Lawrence, Saint John, Placentia Bay) via partnerships with Indigenous communities. Data openly shared to support decision-making.

Blue Carbon as a Canadian Climate Change Solution: Modelling the Mitigation Potential of Kelp Under Future Climate Change Scenarios. Quantifies blue carbon potential of Canadian kelp ecosystems. Provides first Canada-wide assessment of kelp forest extent and climate change mitigation potential under future scenarios. Led by University of Victoria.

Blue Carbon Assessment for Seagrass and Kelp. Develops first carbon budget for kelp forests and seagrass beds in eastern Canada to value them as blue carbon habitats, addressing knowledge gaps in carbon export to deep sediments and global sequestration estimates.

Global Ocean Negative Carbon Emission. Evaluates eco-tech interventions for ocean CO2 sequestration: ecosystem restoration, land-sea management, upwelling manipulation, microbial carbon capture. Network of field stations, research, capacity building. 2022-2030.

Ocean Observations of Surface Waters in Galicia (BOGAR). Autonomous coastal observation system in Galicia using mobile infrastructure with biogeochemical sensors to monitor CO2 flows and provide open oceanographic data for climate neutrality by 2050.

EPOS Thematic Core Services TSUNAMI. European consortium providing open access to tsunami data, simulations, and hazard products for researchers and early warning systems in NE Atlantic, Mediterranean, and connected seas. 18 institutions from 11 countries.

ANEMONE Global. Global eDNA biodiversity monitoring network. Empowers partners worldwide to survey marine ecosystems using environmental DNA technology. Establishes regional hubs for standardized long-term monitoring by 2033.

North Atlantic Carbon Observatory. Multinational platform delivering comprehensive ocean carbon measurements across North Atlantic to improve climate forecasts and support marine CO2 removal through integrated observing networks.

A US Ocean and Great Lakes Literacy Strategy. National strategy to foster Ocean Literacy in US through surveys, Blue Schools Network expansion, partnerships, stakeholder forums, and communication. Addresses pollution, climate, behavior change across oceans and Great Lakes.

PROTEUS™, Space Station of the Ocean. Modular underwater habitat in Curaçao with labs & broadcast studio. Focuses on coral reef health, biodiversity, environmental monitoring, human health & robotics. Delivery 2025. Promotes global collaboration.

The Antarctic Monitoring and Assessment Programme (ANMAP). Circum-Antarctic surveillance of organic contaminant pollution and climate-driven ecosystem change. Monitors threats, provides scientific info and government advice for preventative action across Southern Ocean basins.

GEMS Ocean for Ocean and Coasts Programme. Multi-stakeholder partnership providing ocean/coastal data & analysis for policy-making. Addresses erosion, pollution, habitat loss via earth observation & modeling. Supports SIDS capacity building for sustainable marine resource management.

Thalassophile Project: Accessible Ocean Literacy. EU-funded initiative advancing universal accessibility in marine science for d/Deaf and visually impaired communities. Bridges gap in accessible ocean education through multidisciplinary partnership across global ocean basins.

Co-Management Models for Fisheries Ocean Health. Enhances fishermen & stakeholder understanding of co-management through capacity building & knowledge exchange for climate-resilient ocean resource management, supporting small-scale fisheries globally for food security & ecosystem health.

ArtWaves: Fusion of Marine Biodiversity and Art. Artist-in-residence program merging art & marine science to promote understanding of biodiversity change. Creates new formats for science transfer into social/political debates. Focus on ecosystem protection.

Sustainable Aquaculture Industry Waste Valorization through Recycling (SEA-CYCLE). Valorizes aquaculture waste via circular economy: anaerobic digestion, pyrolysis, biochar for nutrient recovery & wastewater treatment. Reduces environmental impact while creating sustainable fertilizers. Norway-based, 2024-2027.

Marine Biodiversity Library & MPA eDNA monitoring. Building Canadian Marine Biodiversity DNA Library for non-destructive multi-species monitoring in MPAs. eDNA metabarcoding surveys baseline species diversity in Pacific/Atlantic regions. 2022-2026.

SPACEWHALE for designating Marine Protected Areas. AI-powered satellite imagery analysis counts whales from space. Mapping 4,000 km² in Indian Ocean to designate Important Marine Mammal Areas & Marine Protected Areas. Supports offshore wind farm assessments.

Deltas associated with large rivers: Seeking solutions to the problem of sustainability (Mega-Deltas). Studies 25 representative river deltas facing erosion, flood risk, and ecosystem loss. Develops blueprints for sustainable delta management through international cooperation. Supports regional development and ecosystem restoration.

Hybrid governance to protect and manage high seas. Protects biodiversity in Thermal Dome & Sargasso Sea high seas. Develops hybrid governance models for ecosystem-based management beyond national jurisdiction, informing UN BBNJ negotiations on regional/global coordination.

Ecosystem Studies of Sub-Arctic and Arctic Seas (ESSAS). Studies how climate change affects Sub-Arctic/Arctic marine ecosystems through comparative research. Working groups tackle physical, chemical, biological oceanography, fisheries. Supports commercial stocks, subsistence fishers, marine life.

Global Ocean Corps and Conveyor. Network of sustained education/research collaborations between global south/north scientists. Hosts summer schools in Ghana/Nigeria, expanding to East Africa 2025-26. Facilitates capacity sharing for ocean research.

Ressoa Oceano Network. Collaborative network improving ocean media coverage & expert communication. 4 axes: content curation, original production, journalist/scientist training, citizen science. Unites stakeholders for sustainable ocean communication in Brazil.

From Global Gazetteer to Global Community. Marine Regions creates open global gazetteer of georeferenced marine/coastal place names with persistent identifiers. Develops vector layers for boundaries/classifications. Engages stakeholders, experts, UN Actions for co-design.

Sailing4Science – Expanding the Capacity for Ocean Observations and Ocean Citizen Science Awareness and Stewardship. Empowers sailing professionals & citizen scientists with low-cost ocean observation tools. Focuses on remote coastal areas & SIDS. Co-creates crowd-sourced data for ocean literacy & stewardship. Global multi-basin project.

Deep Ocean Observation to Predict Climate hazards. DeePCMED strengthens deep-sea research in Mediterranean Sea through Eulerian observation systems. Clarifies extreme events impact on deep habitats stability/resilience to build marine ecological prediction system.

Marine Resource Gathering Infrastructure in Norse North Atlantic (MARGAIN). Interdisciplinary study of marine resources (driftwood, seaweed, shellfish) along Norway's west coast from Viking Age to Early Modern Period using archaeology, ethnohistory, and scientific analysis to understand settlement patterns.

OceanOmics: Monitoring & Protecting Ocean Life. Minderoo Foundation uses genomics, automation & AI to monitor ocean biodiversity. Develops reference genome libraries, eDNA sequencing methods, and integrates genomic data into conservation frameworks for Australian waters.

SMART Subsea Cables for Observing the Global Ocean. Equips transoceanic telecom cables with sensors measuring temperature, ocean bottom pressure, and seismic activity to monitor climate, sea level rise, ocean circulation, and provide tsunami/earthquake early warning across all ocean basins.

Powering the Blue Economy – Global (PBE-Global). International hub for marine energy knowledge sharing. Develops wave, tidal, current energy tech to power coastal industries & communities. Builds capacity for renewable ocean energy adoption globally. 2022-2032.

Chinese Regional Hub for Blue Carbon. Connects science, policy & outreach to advance blue carbon research in China & globally. Informs national policies, promotes ecosystem conservation best practices, enables public participation in blue carbon protection.

Blue Tourism Initiative. Promotes sustainable coastal tourism governance across Mediterranean, Western Indian Ocean & Caribbean. Exchanges knowledge & practices to address environmental, health, socio-cultural & economic challenges. 2022-2026.

Marine Plan Partnership for the North Pacific Coast. Partnership between BC and 17 First Nations developing marine use plans for North Pacific Coast using science and Indigenous knowledge for sustainable development and ecosystem protection. Ongoing since 2015.

St. Lawrence Estuary Research and Observation Plan. Studies hypoxic & acidic bottom waters in St. Lawrence Estuary to understand deoxygenation, acidification & eutrophication interactions. Aims to inform mitigation actions for ecosystem degradation from 2021-2026.

EU Ocean research and innovation. EU Commission program addressing marine pollution, ecosystem restoration & sustainable ocean economy across Arctic, Atlantic, Baltic, Black & North Seas. Research & innovation contribution to Ocean Decade challenges.

Portuguese National Oceanographic Data Centre. NODC-PT gathers, processes & disseminates oceanographic data from Portuguese agencies in North Atlantic. Supports Blue Growth & ocean knowledge through data stewardship. Operational 2023-2030.

Aotearoa New Zealand Marine Carbon Forum. Forum providing evidence-based analysis of nature-based carbon capture in NZ coastal waters. Facilitates collaboration across sectors and with Māori on marine carbon sequestration to inform national strategy and ecosystem resilience.

Brazilian Tropical Estuaries Monitoring. Multidisciplinary biomonitoring of 5 Northern Brazil estuaries affected by 2019 oil spill, integrating geosciences & biosciences to inform policy on hydrocarbon accidents, climate change & biodiversity loss through seasonal modeling & metabarcoding.

Nutrition sensitive marine aquaculture in Africa (AfriMAQUA). Fostering sustainable marine aquaculture in Africa with nutrition-sensitive approach for food security, poverty alleviation, income creation through interdisciplinary partnerships, research, innovation, capacity development.

Sustainability of Marine Ecosystems Through Global Knowledge Networks (SMARTNET). Global knowledge network strengthening ICES/PICES collaboration on climate change, fisheries, ecosystem management, and human dimensions. Emphasizes inclusivity, gender equality, early career engagement, indigenous communities.

GEOTRACES. International program coordinating marine biogeochemical cycles of trace elements and isotopes. Identifies processes controlling ocean distributions, studies nutrients, tracers, contaminants impacting carbon cycle, climate, ecosystems.

Norway-Pacific Ocean-Climate Scholarship Programme. PhD training partnership between U of Bergen & U of South Pacific. 19 candidates from 7 Pacific nations research ocean-climate nexus in marine biology, oceanography, law, social sciences. Joint supervision, bi-institutional degrees.

Observing Air-Sea Interactions Strategy (OASIS). Global program observing air-sea energy, moisture & gas exchanges to improve weather/climate prediction, support blue economy & sustainable ocean health through 2030. Monitors carbon distribution & ocean-atmosphere interactions.

Digital Twin of the Ocean Animal Tracking. Maps marine life movements in North Sea using tracking data to create digital twin. Addresses animal movement component missing from existing DTs. Assesses offshore infrastructure impacts on wildlife for conservation policy.

Global Subseafloor Ecosystem and Sustainability (GSES). Studies microbial life & carbon dynamics in subseafloor via global protocols, investigation tools & ecological indices. Addresses ocean governance gaps, threat mitigation for sustainable blue economy 2024-2030.

Pearl River Delta Estuary Marine Restoration. Coastal ecological disaster monitoring & wetland restoration in Pearl River Estuary, Nansha District, Guangzhou. Addresses ecological challenges in tropical-subtropical transitional estuarine ecosystem along migratory bird flyway.

DNA-based Approaches for Fisheries Monitoring. Atlantic network using DNA methods to monitor marine fish, supporting sustainable fisheries management. Partnerships across Portugal, Cape Verde, Brazil, Guinea-Bissau, Spain. Includes capacity-building workshops.

COST Action Marine Animal Forest of the World (MAF-World). Global network studying Marine Animal Forests (sponges, corals, gorgonians). Unifies protocols for mapping, restoration, ecosystem services to tackle climate change and food crisis. Completed 2021-2025.

One Ocean Hub. International research program bridging law, science & society for sustainable ocean governance. Empowers Indigenous peoples, fishers, women & children through inclusive decision-making integrating multiple knowledge systems.

Tsunami Ready Odisha. Strengthens coastal community resilience in Odisha through tsunami awareness and preparedness. OSDMA implements UNESCO-IOC Recognition Programme in coastal villages with hazard maps and evacuation plans since 2019.

Seabed Mining & Resilience To EXperimental impact. Provides scientific understanding to reduce deep-sea mining risks for polymetallic nodules in Pacific abyss. Evaluates impact and recovery from realistic mining disturbance on decadal scale to assess long-term sustainability.

Partnership for Observation of the Global Ocean (POGO). Global consortium of 55 oceanographic institutions advancing ocean observation through innovation, capacity development, and advocacy. Bridges gaps between developed/developing countries using low-cost tech and supports UN Decade actions.

Marine Management and Climate. Nordic project modeling climate change effects in Nordic seas to 2100, evaluating adaptation solutions including nature-based conservation, MPAs, and offshore wind synergies for ecosystem-based management.

Automated Debris Imaging System of ocean plastic. AI-enabled cameras on cargo ships detect & map ocean plastic >0.5m globally. 500 cameras monitor debris concentrations, sources & transport patterns to improve cleanup solutions. Runs 2022-2032 across all ocean basins.

Preventing ocean plastic in rivers. Plastic Fischer tackles ocean plastic in rivers using low-tech barriers to collect waste before it reaches the sea. Creates local jobs in India & Indonesia while organizing awareness campaigns. Aims to prevent thousands of tons entering ocean.

Reefs Of Hope: Coral-Focused Climate Adaptation. Propagating bleaching-resistant 'super' corals to prevent extinction from marine heat waves. Involves reef communities, tourism, governments across 7 pilot countries. Nature-based solutions building on MPAs. Nov 2023-Dec 2030.

Ocean Decade Programme on Sustainable Ocean Planning. Empowers nations to develop climate-smart, equitable ocean planning using scientific & Indigenous knowledge. Supports transboundary cooperation & capacity building for sustainable ocean use through 2050. Global community of practice.

European Global Ocean Observing System (EuroGOOS). European component of Global Ocean Observing System coordinating sustained ocean observations across Europe's seas. Enhances cooperation, promotes operational oceanography benefits, delivers fit-for-purpose products for marine users.

IOGP Environmental Genomics Joint Industry Programme. Oil & gas industry research using eDNA to detect organisms & estimate biodiversity in offshore/onshore operations. Reduces field time & cost while improving ecological assessment data across global ocean basins.

Demonstration of Chinese estuarine conservation (Est. Project). Mainstreaming estuarine biodiversity conservation in Yellow & Pearl River deltas through protected area networks, wetland restoration, threat mitigation, capacity building & policy development. Addresses ecological degradation.

Indigenous People, Traditional Ecological Knowledge, and Climate Change: The Iconic Underwater Cultural Heritage of Stone Tidal Weirs. Documenting stone tidal weirs as sustainable fishing heritage across ocean basins. Indigenous ecological knowledge guides future marine conservation through ancient shoreline structures that harmonize traditional practices with ecosystem balance.

Ocean Cities Network (OC-NET). Interdisciplinary network of marine cities committed to sustainability and regeneration of marine environments. Combines scientific knowledge and social awareness to transform how coastal cities interact with the ocean.

Ocean Literacy with USA Blue Schools. K-12 schools improving ocean literacy through hands-on stewardship and social action. 50 registered US schools in Global Blue Schools Network. NOAA and NMEA support expansion across North Atlantic and Pacific regions.

BRIDGES Research Program. 10-year transdisciplinary program studying marine spatial planning & conservation networks for biodiversity & sustainable fishing in SW Indian Ocean. Creates observatory, modeling tools & collaborative platforms for researchers & stakeholders.

Integration of Socio-Ecological Aspects into Digital Twins of the Ocean (SEAtwins). Integrates socio-ecological models into European Digital Twin Ocean framework for scenario analysis & ecosystem-based management across European seas. Enables decision support via participatory co-design, advancing sustainable ocean management.

The EMS Centre Model System for Future Oceans. Studies Eastern Mediterranean Sea ecosystem resilience to climate change using observations, experiments, cruises, ROVs, AUVs, gliders, sensors & models. Based in Haifa, trains early career scientists through joint research activities.

Digital REconstruction of Abyssal habitat Map. Maps deep-sea habitats (seamounts, ridges) using AI & underwater vehicles. Enhances observation tech, builds data fusion platform, creates standardized mapping tools. Enriches marine science knowledge 2025-2030.

Serious Game Promoting Maritime Heritage Awareness - CREAMARE. Transnational framework connecting game designers, researchers, cultural institutions to create digital products promoting Underwater Cultural Heritage in Mediterranean. Serious game explores 9 UCH sites teaching preservation.

Posidonia Soundscapes: Conservation Music Ibiza. Ibiza-based project using soundscape analysis & music to conserve Posidonia oceanica seagrass. Combines underwater acoustics, artist residencies, A/V performances & citizen science to restore biodiversity & boost ocean literacy by 2030.

Think Ocean Challenge. Pro-Ocean Behaviour Change Model enabling society's reconnection with Ocean through personal challenge actions. Supports social science research on individual behaviour change to influence communities and decision-making. Active in 26 countries.

The Green Sink Initiative. Addresses liquid waste pollution from construction/building maintenance sectors. Raises awareness, promotes washwater recycling systems to prevent toxic discharge into oceans. Combines education & tech innovation globally.

A Sea of Connections: Valuing Reef Passages. SOCPacific2R studies reef passages as biodiversity hotspots in Pacific Islands. Integrates Indigenous knowledge with science for conservation, documenting management arrangements through participatory dialogue to protect these keystone ecosystems.

Plastic Clever Schools. Global school program by Common Seas empowering youth to combat ocean plastic pollution through education and action. Students learn sustainability, investigate plastic waste, and implement solutions in schools and communities.

Marine Monitor (M2): Ocean Conservation Technology. Vessel monitoring platform using marine radar to track small-scale fisheries globally. Empowers coastal communities to enforce laws and manage resources sustainably. Deployed in 12 countries since 2015.

Marine Heatwaves International Working Group. International scientists study marine heatwaves globally: physical drivers, properties, predictability & socio-ecological impacts. Multi-disciplinary approach informs management & conservation of extreme ocean warming events.

Action Plan for the Ocean. Risk-based ocean action plan: assess/rank risks from ocean change, identify response options, develop local-to-global adaptation plans for sustainable ocean economy and climate nexus. All ocean basins. 2024-2030.

Ocean Accounts for Sustainable Ocean Development. Global Ocean Accounts Partnership implementing standardized ocean accounting frameworks across diverse countries, integrating economic, environmental & social data to support evidence-based ocean policy beyond GDP metrics.

African Ocean Biodiversity Atlas. Develops Fisheries Atlas & Blue Carbon Biodiversity initiative for Africa's coasts. Creates marine species data repository, promotes MPAs, engages indigenous fishermen in ocean sustainability & UN Ocean Decade awareness.

PROCARIBE+: Protect, Restore Ocean Capital and Blue Economies. Wider Caribbean project protecting marine capital through spatial planning, conservation, Blue Carbon, sustainable fisheries & ocean governance. Catalyzes climate-resilient Blue Economy investments via regional coordination.

Mitigation of Natural Incidence To increased Ocean (MoNITOR). Establishes high-res physical-ecological forecasting for ocean disasters: oxygen deficiency, cyclones, acidification, glacier melting. Global partnerships for marine disaster prevention across all ocean basins. 2024-2030.

Sustainable Ocean Management Program. Develops toolkit integrating Maritime Cultural Heritage, Marine Spatial Planning & Climate Science. Trains ocean professionals via summer schools in Baltic, Mediterranean & North Seas. 2024-2027.

DAN.PADI Ocean Literacy Training Program. Training PADI diving instructors globally to teach ocean literacy to youth via free eLearning platform. Covers citizen science, plastic pollution, climate change, underwater archaeology. Builds on Italy's Scuola D'Amare program.

Future Coastal Ocean Climates. FLAME generates high-resolution decadal-centennial projections of coastal ocean climates & impacts on ecosystems, hazards & resources. Targets polar, temperate, subtropical & tropical coasts for climate adaptation solutions.

West and NOC Science Bursary. Financial support for post-graduate marine science students from developing countries to participate in mentoring and seagoing research with UK's National Oceanography Centre scientists. Focuses on capacity development.

Enhance coastal resilience to sea level hazards. CoastWAVE 2.0 scales up tsunami resilience in NE Atlantic & Mediterranean. Builds hazard assessment capacity, installs detection systems, expands Tsunami Ready communities. Engages stakeholders for multi-hazard preparedness.

Carbon Cycles in Huang-Bohai Sea Wetlands. Examines carbon cycling in Huang-Bohai Sea wetland deltas (Yellow, Liaohe, Luanhe, Yancheng Rivers). Develops multidimensional carbon budget model for coastal wetlands to guide blue carbon ecosystem practices globally. Focuses on delta types.

Nature-based Solutions in Conflict-Affected Coastal Communities. NbS climate adaptation in Caribbean coast Colombia. Household surveys, workshops, network analysis assess options. Builds resilience, reduces maladaptation, strengthens networks in conflict-affected vulnerable coastal areas.

SeaTrees. Community-led restoration of blue carbon ecosystems (kelp, mangroves, seagrass, coral reefs) globally. Plants, protects, and restores coastal habitats for carbon sequestration, biodiversity, and sustainable development. 2018-2030.

Global Real-Time Early Alarm for Tsunami (GREAT). Real-time tsunami warning using sound signals to reduce false alarms. Deploys in National Tsunami Warning Centres using deep-sea observations, AI & modelling. Supports SDG 11 for safer coastal cities.

ESB Marine Mammal Observer Training Programme. Builds capacity for marine mammal conservation in Ireland's offshore energy sector. Provides certifications, field experience, mentorship for early career marine professionals. Supports blue economy & Net Zero goals.

Coastal Conservation and Protection Project. Protecting & restoring degraded coastal/marine ecosystems in Nigeria through sustainable ocean practices, climate resilience measures. Preserves habitats, enhances biodiversity, mitigates climate impacts, supports communities.

A New Vision for Coastal Resilience. Empowers coastal communities to co-design resilient futures through interdisciplinary partnership. Addresses barriers to coastal resilience by setting collective vision for long-term social, ecological sustainability vs short-term fixes.

Project 19. Teens (15-18) translate ocean research into creative projects. Analyze science papers, create art/performances. Portugal (2021), expanding to South Africa & EU. Builds ocean literacy & advocacy skills.

Ocean Literacy with All (OLWA). OLWA advances Ocean Literacy through global partnerships, designing transformative research-based activities for diverse stakeholders. Builds capacity and behavior change for sustainable ocean development across all ocean basins.

Ti Whale An Nou: Cetacean Future in the Caribbean. Caribbean-wide cetacean conservation program (2021-2030) enhancing research, education, and policy. Focuses on species identification, threat mitigation, youth engagement, and marine protected areas across Caribbean nations.

Understanding and Addressing Ocean Acidification and Changing Ocean Conditions Through the Development of OA Action Plans. OA Alliance translates ocean acidification knowledge into policy actions across global ocean basins. Develops action plans to increase biodiversity, adaptive capacity, and resilience through government collaboration.

Blue House Fellowship Programme. Building capacity and generating knowledge for kelp forest conservation, cultivation and sustainable management across stakeholders in North Pacific and South Atlantic Ocean basins (2024-2027).

FISHTWIN. Digital twin platform integrating climate adaptation for fisheries management. Simulates marine resources, habitats, human activities to enhance sustainable fisheries, reduce ecosystem impacts, strengthen climate resilience. 2023-2030.

OceanX and OceanQuest Around Africa Mission. Mission around Africa (Mar-Jun 2025) studying ocean circulation, ecosystem health, marine biodiversity. Supports climate research, sustainable management, conservation through data collection and regional capacity building.

Creating Capability, Capacity & Culture Change. Australian fishing/aquaculture workforce development addressing tech transformation. Invests in people, establishes shared values, builds resilience to solve problems and increase ocean health through 2025.

Monitoring CECs Impacts in European Seas. CONTRAST develops monitoring framework for contaminants of emerging concern (CECs) in European seas using Integrated Assessment Framework combining chemical measurements with biological effects, 2024-2027

Ocean Community Challenge: Educating, Innovating. Empowers communities & entrepreneurs to develop sustainable ocean solutions through literacy platform, pre-accelerator programs & community engagement. Targets diverse global audiences including underrepresented regions.

Ghana Ocean Climate Innovations Hub (GOCIB). Collaborates with stakeholders to form task force implementing nature-based ocean solutions for climate remediation in Ghana/West Africa. Compiles and develops ocean carbon removal techniques for climate action.

Climate Resilience for Fishing and Aquaculture. Mitigates climate impacts on Australian fishing & aquaculture. Reduces emissions from fuels, electricity & feeds to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050. Improves adaptation strategies for climate-affected aquatic ecosystems.

Marine forest restoration: a coastal gardening plan. Restores marine forests via coastal gardening. Creates sea gardener profession. Targets shallow to continental shelf areas. Enhances biodiversity, carbon sequestration, coastal resilience. Involves citizens, stakeholders.

Building Adaptive Resilience of Spanish Fisheries (VADAPES-II). Assesses socio-ecological resilience of Spanish fisheries under climate change. Co-designs adaptation plans with fisheries sector to maintain productivity, food security, and prevent maladaptation while preserving ecosystems.

BlueDOT: Divers for Ocean Temperature. Creates open-access database of dive computer temperature data from 0-40m depth to monitor subsurface ocean heatwaves in Mediterranean Sea. Empowers divers as citizen scientists to complement existing monitoring systems for climate mitigation.

Estuarine Ecological Knowledge Network (EEKN). Network utilizing coastal community experiences & traditional knowledge to inform estuarine research & policy. Community observers document ecological conditions, preserving indigenous knowledge for ocean health.

3D Purpose Built Reefs for Marine Restoration (Coast3D Reefs). 3D-printed breakwater structures promoting coral and mangrove habitat creation while protecting coastal communities in Caribbean and Atlantic. Pilots test sustainable designs under real-world conditions through 2030.

Mediterranean Sea Peoples Observatory Data (MedSeaPOD). Citizen science monitoring sea temperature via divers/fishermen in Sardinia & Corsica to study climate impacts on coastal ecosystems. Creates Mediterranean's first coastal thermal map with open data platform (2023-2026).

Offshore kelp cultivation as a carbon sink. 4-year study using offshore giant kelp cultivation in Namibia to measure carbon sequestration capacity. Kelp absorbs CO2, dies, and is buried deep ocean, storing carbon permanently while benefiting biodiversity and ocean health.

Blue Carbon Canada. Partnership quantifying carbon sequestration in Canadian coastal ecosystems (salt marshes, seagrass, kelp, seabeds), assessing fishing impacts, economic value, and biodiversity to inform climate-smart conservation and restoration.

A Caribbean SIDS Pollutants Observatory. Establishes pollutant observatory for Caribbean SIDS using co-design. Creates regional contaminant inventory/database, unifies monitoring programs, develops technical capacity, publishes open-access pollution data to guide stakeholders.

A bridge of oceanic dreams from Asia. Develops marine professionals in Asia-Pacific through education combining traditional knowledge & science (GIS, water quality). Trains youth, fishermen, engineers online & in-person for sustainable ocean economy & conservation. 2022-2031.

Blue Schools Global Network. UNESCO-IOC initiative promoting Ocean Literacy through transformative education. Connects global schools to integrate ocean learning into curricula via interdisciplinary, project-based approach, empowering students on real ocean issues.

Marine Extreme Events & Natural Hazards – mareXtreme. Analyzes marine extreme events, geohazards, biohazards & meteo/oceanographic hazards. Develops prediction tools, risk reduction models & adaptation solutions for coastal social-ecological systems across European seas.

All-Atlantic Floating University Network. Network connecting 42 training-at-sea programs across 27 Atlantic countries to expand opportunities for students and early-career ocean professionals through collaboration and best practices sharing.

Developing Expertise Via Education and Learning (DEVELOP). International training initiative by China's Second Institute of Oceanography to enhance marine professionals' skills in oceanography, marine biology, and sustainability through expert-led courses. Global reach across all ocean basins.

The Internet of Oceans (Oceaneers). AI-driven ocean stewardship program using gamified advocacy tools to accelerate innovation, unite stakeholders, and enhance data accessibility across all ocean basins through digital representation and behavior change.

National Geographic Perpetual Planet Ocean Expeditions. Multi-year exploration of all 5 ocean basins integrating science & traditional knowledge to examine marine system changes, reveal ecosystem diversity & connectivity, and scale solutions to protect & restore ocean ecosystems globally.

SAFE TUNA - System and Application for Excellence. Android app for Indonesian fishers' mental health, marine protection, spatial info, fish prices, health facilities. Pilot in Pangandaran, Palabuhanratu villages. Uses participatory action research. 2025-2028.

Malizia Explorer Science Sailing Vessel. Professional sailing team operates dedicated research vessel across global oceans (2025-2030). Advances climate research, ocean observations, public engagement through expeditions. Mobilizes decision-makers, educates globally.

SSF Curriculum: Youth Voices for Fishful Futures. Youth learning framework exploring SSF Guidelines in coastal/inland fishing communities. Students interview elders, document climate impacts, map value chains. Co-created in Peru, Nigeria, India, Madagascar. Cultivates ocean literacy.

IOI Ocean Academy – Ocean Knowledge for All. Free 20-hour online ocean literacy courses in local languages, delivered by local experts to remove barriers of language, cost & access. Promotes inclusive ocean education globally through 2030.

Da Grouper School. Intergenerational Ocean Science Academy building capacity through youth-elder-professional collaboration. Fills data gaps in Caribbean & East Africa via community science on coral reefs, mangroves, seagrasses. 2025-2029.

An observatory of the North Atlantic Gateway. ALONGate creates synergies between Fram Strait LTER and Icelandic benthic inventories, focusing on deep-sea benthos connectivity and anthropocene impact on Vulnerable Marine Ecosystems in the North Atlantic Gateway to Arctic.

Towards Sustainable Coastal Marine Ecosystems. Evaluates response of coral reefs, seagrass, mangroves to environmental changes in New Caledonia. Uses historical data & innovative tech to elucidate resilience mechanisms, supporting sustainable coastal management decisions.

Sediment upheaval and negative carbon emissions. Studies sediment diffusion and carbon emissions in estuaries through observations and simulations. Reveals water-sediment dynamics coupling mechanisms to enhance carbon sink potential in delta areas. Indian Ocean and North Pacific focus.

Global Tsunami Model Association. Establishes global tsunami community & competence centre for hazard/risk assessment. Develops reference models, probabilistic methods, training programs. Serves all ocean basins for disaster risk reduction aligned with SFDRR & SDGs.

WESTPAC International Marine Science Conference. Triennial conference since 1986 bringing together Western Pacific marine researchers and ocean stakeholders. Serves as UN Ocean Decade Regional Conference promoting multi-disciplinary collaboration for sustainable ocean management.

Edges of Earth: A Driving Force for Change. Multi-year expedition documenting life at Earth's edges, amplifying marginalized voices driving ocean & climate action through immersive storytelling, field documentation & strategic collaborations with communities.

Global Hadal Exploration Programme (GHEP). Explores ocean's deepest zone (6,000-11,000m) studying biodiversity, ecosystems, pollution, geology via global network using HOV, AUV, ROV. Builds capacity for early career scientists, raises public awareness 2025-2035.

ALDEBARAN. Research vessel supporting marine science, education & media since 1992. Specializes in shallow/coastal waters, marine protected areas, climate & biodiversity studies. 100,000+ nautical miles, 250+ expeditions worldwide.

Sustaining Our Oceans. Empowers youth in South-East Asia to combat marine pollution & protect ecosystems. Educates students & teachers on marine litter impacts, conservation skills. Addresses plastic pollution from 6 of world's top 10 polluting countries.

Miniaturwunderland-Ralley. Interactive exhibit at Miniatur Wunderland featuring Monaco section with research vessel ALDEBARAN model. Rally guides visitors through ocean sustainability themes via puzzles and trivia, merging science and entertainment to inspire marine conservati

Shaping an Ocean of Possibilities (SOOP). Innovation platform uniting science, industry & civil society to develop interoperable ocean observation tech, scalable sensors & open standards. Increases ocean data availability on non-scientific infrastructure for Blue Economy 2023-2026.

National Marine Educators Association (NMEA). US-based org advancing Ocean Literacy via education, equity, traditional knowledge. 800+ members, 15 chapters. Hosts UN-endorsed OL Handbook. Restores society-ocean relationship through lifelong learning & outreach.

Convex Seascape Survey. Investigates carbon burial in continental shelf seafloors (where, why, how) and biodiversity's role. 16 global partners study ocean carbon sequestration to inform climate action. Targets 6% of needed carbon drawdown by 2027.

JPI Oceans Joint Call: Changing Marine Lightscapes. Studies coastal darkening & artificial light at night impacts on marine biodiversity, ecosystem functioning & ocean health. Generates knowledge on light changes in oceans/coasts & suggests mitigation measures for maritime planning.

Ocean Science Exhibition. Multimedia exhibition on Cap San Diego museum ship in Hamburg showcasing ocean tech, microplastic solutions, underwater satellites, and marine conservation. Solar-powered learning space for schools during UN Ocean Decade 2022-2030.

Seamount Habitat Oasis Watch (SHOW). Studies seamount biodiversity hotspots in Western Pacific & Indian Ocean. Identifies climate-sensitive habitats, develops conservation tools, and creates ecosystem-based impact assessment frameworks for deep-sea protection.

Decade Collaborative Centre for the Northeast Pacific Ocean (DCC-NEPO). Coordinates research, Indigenous communities, and stakeholders in the Northeast Pacific to support sustainable ocean development. Focuses on elevating Indigenous-led initiatives across Ocean Decade Challenges. Now completed.

Submarine Geological Hazards and Digitization. Digital DEPTH project studying submarine geological hazards through observations, lab analysis, and digital modeling. Creates global data platform for early warning systems and risk management of marine hazards. 2025-2030.

Satellite Observations of Coastal Ocean (SOCO). Enhances satellite observation of coastal ecosystems to understand evolution under human and climate impacts. Monitors water quality, algal blooms, riverine fluxes, CO2. Builds datasets and training platform for sustainable coastal management.

Tides of Innovation: Caribbean Sargassum Solutions. Transforms invasive sargassum seaweed into biodegradable bioplastic in Caribbean. Mitigates environmental damage, creates sustainable economic opportunities. Supports blue economy & fights plastic pollution. 2025-2030.

Decade Coordination Office for Africa. Coordinates Ocean Decade actions across Africa's coastal nations and SIDS. Addresses marine planning, governance, observation gaps. Partners with governments, NGOs to advance sustainable ocean management 2023-2030.

Integrated Coastal Zone Management Working Group. Enhances coastal resilience against hazards by providing scientific knowledge to decision-makers. Uses interactive platforms for disaster risk reduction, climate adaptation, and sustainable coastal governance in South Pacific communities.

ForeSea – The Ocean Prediction Capacity of the Future. International coordination to improve ocean prediction systems science, capacity & efficacy. Builds seamless ocean info value chain from observations to end users for economic & societal benefit across all ocean basins.

Exploring the Potential of Ocean Blue Carbon. Research project investigating ocean-CO2 relationships and blue carbon potential. Studies carbon absorption, storage, sequestration processes, and ocean ecosystem responses to warming, acidification, deoxygenation for climate resilience.

Antarctica International Science & Infrastructure for Synchronous Observation (Antarctica InSync). Collaborative synchronous observation program for Southern Ocean & Antarctica. Preparatory phase 2024-26 establishes alliances & data frameworks. Implementation 2027-30 conducts fieldwork to understand drivers & impacts.

Blue Economy Coalition for Ocean Climate Solutions. Central America & Caribbean coalition uniting public, private, academic sectors for ocean carbon removal, marine tech development, coastal resilience. Drives sustainable blue economy through partnerships and innovation.

Working Group to implement Ocean Literacy in Chile (GT COCEAN). Chilean initiative implementing ocean literacy through 8 activities: curriculum integration, IOC course adaptation, communication plan, public portal, strategic plan, funding identification, content promotion, and monitoring methodology.

The Observatory of Mangrove and its Maretories. Strengthens environmental governance of Amazonian & Peruvian mangroves through citizen science monitoring, participatory GIS, & big data. Creates Mangrove Researchers/Reporters groups to bridge traditional & scientific knowledge.

Joint International Laboratory of Deltas. International collaboration establishing intelligent database and early warning system for coastal water security across deltas in China, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Egypt, Romania. Addresses flooding, erosion, ecological threats.

Team CASPI Climate Innovation Hub. Caspian region climate action hub addressing planetary crisis through youth capacity building, marine carbon removal, ecosystem restoration, pollution monitoring, and coastal resilience (2025-2030).

Marine Research Cruises in Remote Areas (CIMAR Program). Multidisciplinary oceanographic research in southern Chile & oceanic islands studying oceanography, meteorology, biodiversity. Expanding to northern oceanic waters 2024-2030. Creates comprehensive database for sustainable development.

Bougainville Project. Global network monitoring ocean microbiome via students on ships testing frugal sensors in Indian & Pacific Oceans. Tracks invisible organisms regulating climate. 2023-2030, led by Sorbonne University.

PlaSTic On beaches: 3D-distRibution and weathering. Studies fate of beached marine plastic debris on Hawaiian beaches through repeated field surveys and 3D mapping. Tracks plastic aging, fragmentation rates, and transformations near North Pacific Garbage Patch. 2022-2025.

DiadSea: Transnational Cooperation for Diadromous Fish. 9 partners from Portugal, France, Spain, Ireland cooperate to manage & conserve diadromous migratory fish in Atlantic waters. Addresses climate change impacts on species living in fresh & saltwater.

SAILOR – South African Innovation Lab for Ocean-Climate Resilience. South African innovation lab supporting ocean-based carbon sequestration & ecosystem restoration ventures. Focuses on mCDR, decarbonised shipping, sustainable aquaculture. 4-month program: validation, development, scaling.

Institute of Marine Engineering, Science and Technology (IMarEST). Global network of 12,500+ members across 120+ countries advancing ocean science through 12+ endorsed actions including M2M mentoring, marine mammal conservation, and sustainable offshore practices via interdisciplinary collaboration.

Whales and polar bear in a petri dish. Research on contaminant effects on polar bears & whales as top predators. Develops alternative toxicology approaches to understand pollution impacts on marine mammal population dynamics. Arctic, N Atlantic & N Pacific focus.

SEA'TIES: Sharing Solutions with Coastal Cities to Tackle Sea-Level Rise. Global initiative facilitating sustainable adaptation solutions for coastal cities facing sea-level rise. Connects elected officials, urban planners across regions to exchange knowledge and best practices for coastal resilience.

US Tsunami Contributions to IOC Tsunami Pt 1. NOAA supports UN Ocean Decade tsunami detection goals via: drafting 10-yr R&D plan, sharing seismic/GNSS tech, promoting real-time data collaboration, deploying DART tsunameters, building capacity in island/developing states

Hyperspectral Sensing of Coastal Soils. Detecting nano/microplastics in mangrove, dune, coastal soils using hyperspectral sensing. Creates database of marine pollution distribution. Fast, cheap, digital tool for tracking plastic waste in coastal environments. 2023-2029.

China Oceanic Development Foundation. CODF coordinates Ocean Decade programs in China, transforming research into solutions and governance tools. Builds blue partnerships across Arctic, North & South Pacific through multi-stakeholder collaboration. 2025-2030.

Leveraging Our Networks for the Ocean Decade. Sustainable Ocean Alliance facilitates collaboration between Early Career Ocean Professionals regional nodes across Africa, Caribbean, Southeast Asia. Provides training, mentorship, networking through 64 Ocean Solutions Hubs in 42 countries.

Women in blue: gender equity for ocean. Empowers women in ocean science, fisheries & policy across Brazilian coast. Identifies barriers, strengthens networks, fosters leadership in climate & sustainability discussions. Led by Federal Univ of São Paulo, 2021-2026.

A regional coupled atmosphere-ocean model. Kilometer-scale coupled air-sea model simulating waves, sea spray, ocean mixing, and heat/moisture/carbon exchange. Focuses on hurricane development to improve weather and climate modeling. North Atlantic and Pacific basins.

Ogyre - Fishing For Litter. Fishers collect ocean plastic waste, managed via blockchain platform. Recycled/disposed locally. Real-time data tracks marine pollution impact. Supports coastal communities while combating marine plastic pollution globally.

Protecting Marine Life from Toxins. Monitors marine microalgae distribution & ecological role in Korean waters to enhance biodiversity data. Expands MBON network through field surveys, data analysis, institutional collaboration & capacity building. 2023-2030.

Save the Waves Mobile App. Surfing community crowdsources coastal threats data via mobile app. Users photograph development, pollution, sea-level rise, water quality issues. GPS-tagged photos shared with agencies to co-develop solutions. Global coverage.

NEAM-COMMITMENT. Enhances tsunami risk management in North-East Atlantic, Mediterranean & connected seas through hazard mapping, evacuation planning & capacity building. Develops inundation maps for Cyprus, Greece, Spain; pilots multi-hazard approach. 2025-2027.

Ocean Acidification Research for Sustainability (OARS). Global programme addressing ocean acidification impacts on marine ecosystems through enhanced scientific cooperation, regional collaboration, capacity building, observation networks, and policy communication across all ocean basins.

Recovering and reusing ghost nets (NETS FOR THE OCEAN). Collects, cleans & reuses discarded fishing nets from Brazilian coast, transforming them into products & income for communities. Prevents ghost fishing & marine pollution through innovation & social inclusion. 2023-2030.

Cerulean Information Factory (CIF). ESA project using Earth Observation data to support Blue-Green Economy transition in North Atlantic/Arctic. Focuses on shipping, offshore renewable energy, and aquaculture through advanced analytics and decision support platforms.

Decade Collaborative Center Challenge 4 Sustainable Ocean Economy. Barcelona-based DCC enhances global coordination for sustainable ocean economy. Flexible model supports diverse initiatives. Mediterranean hub drives innovation, resilience, equity in ocean development 2025-2030.

Decade Collaborative Centre for the Pacific Islands Region. SPC-led center coordinating ocean science across 22 Pacific island nations. Addresses 10 Decade Challenges for SIDS/LDCs covering 30% of Pacific Ocean. Strengthens collaboration, provides integrated services, develops partnerships 2023-2027.

Remote sensing of Underwater Cultural Heritage. Uses underwater remote sensing to study submerged cultural sites & marine environments. Integrates archaeology, geosciences, biology for UCH protection. Develops Web3D models for digital heritage management in Mediterranean.

1Ocean Ocean Conservation Educator and Action Network. Equips teachers in Tamil Nadu & Kerala with Indian Ocean knowledge on biodiversity, fisheries, livelihoods. Co-creates ocean literacy manual with indigenous communities, trains educators to communicate & take conservation action.

Soneva Foundation Coral Restoration. Maldivian NGO advancing coral reef regeneration through spawning, microfragmentation, photogrammetry & probiotics across 5 islands. Combines research, community stewardship & youth capacity-building for coastal resilience.

Assessing spatiotemporal dynamics in herring population structure under climate change (HERPOPS). Genomic research tracking Atlantic herring populations in NE Atlantic using SNP markers and eDNA to understand climate change impacts, inform sustainable fisheries management, and maintain biodiversity through 2027.

International Platform for Ocean Sustainability (IPOS). Global initiative bridging science, policy & society to accelerate ocean sustainability. Provides accessible knowledge supporting governments in ocean commitments via decentralized structure with regional nodes. Covers all ocean basins.

Whales and Climate. International team from 6 countries studying whale distributions under climate change scenarios, focusing on Southern Hemisphere humpback whales. Develops methods for assessing climate impacts on marine mammals and their role as carbon storage.

ARTPORT_WE ARE OCEAN. Transdisciplinary art project engaging artists, students, scientists, policy makers worldwide to raise ocean awareness. Works with young/underprivileged people on human-ocean interdependence through arts education until 2030.

Projeto TransforMAR. Environmental education for vulnerable youth through scuba diving in Brazil. Combines marine biology training with underwater experiences to promote ocean literacy and conservation in coastal communities. Started 2018, reached 500+ youth.

Seaworthy Collective. Miami nonprofit accelerating BlueTech startups for ocean impact. Supports diverse entrepreneurs in pollution reduction, coastal resilience, and climate solutions. 100 founders, 50 startups, $25M raised since 2021.

FOODIMAR. 3-year project valorising fisheries/aquaculture side-streams into sustainable food. Recovers nutrients, reduces climate impact, diversifies species (jellyfish, whitefish, sea bream), adds value to fish processing waste. 2024-2027.

Bluer Africa. Builds coastal resilience across Africa through ocean literacy, community adaptation, and infrastructure improvements. Empowers vulnerable coastal communities with sustainable practices for marine health and equitable development.

First Nations – Trusted Crowd-Sourced Bathymetry & Capacity Building in British Columbia (FNTCSB&CBBC). Crowd-sourced hydrographic data collection in remote BC coastal areas. Indigenous community capacity building through training and knowledge transfer. Similar to Canadian Arctic project.

The Future of Fisheries and Marine Ecosystems (FishMIP). Global project detecting, attributing & projecting marine ecosystem & fisheries changes under climate change. Co-creates simulation experiments, tests model ensembles & provides future scenarios for all regions.

Synergistic Observing Network for Ocean Prediction (SynObs). Optimizes ocean observation by combining satellite and in-situ data across global, tropical, arctic, and coastal systems. Develops assimilation methods for enhanced ocean/coastal predictions through 2030.

Sea the Value. Interdisciplinary team determining pluralistic values for blue carbon and marine benefits to co-develop green investment options for marine ecosystem restoration and conservation through novel finance mechanisms (2022-2025).

Blue Parks. Accelerates establishment of MPAs meeting Blue Park Standard to revitalize ecosystems & safeguard biodiversity. Awards recognize effective MPAs; Blue Sparks program guides local leaders in planning effective protection globally.

Sistema de Alerta, Predicción y Observación. Expands ocean observing platform in South Pacific to monitor climate impacts, providing data to coastal communities and decision makers to boost resilience and ocean stewardship through 2030.

Digital Twins of the Ocean (DITTO). Digital framework integrating marine data, AI, and modeling to create ocean development scenarios for energy, mining, fisheries, tourism. Enables users to build custom digital twins for local ocean issues using standard workflows.

One Ocean Network for Deep Observation. Global deep-sea observatory network studying ecosystem functioning under climate change, mitigating natural disasters, and engaging citizens. Uses high-tech devices across multiple ocean sites to unveil the unknown deep ocean.

Ocean Citizen Science Project. Water sports enthusiasts collect ocean data via Scuba Schools International partnership, feeding EMODnet portal. Bridges science and public, enhancing ocean literacy and extreme weather predictions globally.

Impacts of Heatwaves and Hypoxia on Shellfish. Examines climate stressor impacts (heatwaves, hypoxia) on Pacific oysters and razor clams in NE Pacific via lab/field trials, develops genetic biomarkers for monitoring, tests mitigation methods. Completed.

Migratory Crossroads: Predicting Dynamics of Great Vertical Migration in Changing Habitat. Studies zooplankton vertical migration in northern Norway waters. Investigates how climate change affects Calanus finmarchicus daily and seasonal movements. Uses simulation models and field data to forecast ecological impacts.

Southern Gulf of Guinea Upwelling System. Climate projection model evaluating future impacts on sGGUS marine productivity, upwelling efficiency, nutrient availability, and fisheries sustainability in eastern tropical Atlantic (2025-2028).

Sustainable Ocean Resilience for African Community. Enhances African coastal community resilience through early warning systems, ocean literacy, and adaptive capacities. Integrates indigenous knowledge with science for sustainable ocean risk management in South Atlantic regions.

Expedition Coastline in the Ocean Decade. Year-long Belgian coastal education project where students conduct beach fieldwork, contribute to scientific databases, and tackle ocean challenges like pollution and biodiversity through action-oriented learning.

The Oceano Vox Initiative: You sail, we care. Participatory ocean monitoring using IoT sensors on leisure boats. Collects real-time coastal data on ocean conditions, climate change & pollution. Promotes ocean literacy & sustainable blue economy. All ocean basins focus.

Building Bridges: Science, Policy and Society. 5-day training workshop on co-design for ocean sustainability in Western Indian Ocean. Brings together communities, scientists, policymakers to solve socio-ecological challenges using transdisciplinary approaches and knowledge systems.

Impacts of Artificial Light at Night on Pelagic Ecosystems in European Seas (ALANIS). Studies how artificial light from coastal activities and shipping affects zooplankton migration and marine ecosystems across European seas, from high latitude to Mediterranean waters, 2024-2028.

Ocean Wise Shoreline Cleanup. Citizen-science program empowering communities in Canada & US to combat plastic pollution through corporate cleanups, municipal partnerships using litter data for policy, and local collaborations to establish baselines.

Fish Biodiversity Facing Global Change - FishGLOB. Global network integrating 95 bottom-trawl surveys across continents to monitor 3,000+ fish taxa. Creates platform for multinational research to understand and predict fish diversity change in rapidly changing oceans.

International Blue Carbon Institute. Advances blue carbon science to address climate change, protect biodiversity, support coastal communities. Develops policy, finance strategies. Global hub for knowledge exchange in Southeast Asian and Indo-West Pacific regions.

Global Artificial Light at Night Network (GOALANN). International network studying marine light pollution impacts on ocean ecosystems. Develops tools, datasets, and policy guidance to manage artificial light emissions into the sea globally. Addresses ecological and societal impacts.

Ocean Literacy Programme for Coastal Communities in Ecuador. Pilot model for sustainable coastal communities through ocean education, resource management. Uses ESRA methodology with blue economy sectors. 8 years: 19k+ participants, 38 communities, 12+ tons garbage collected.

Bow Seat's True Blue Fellowship. Youth fellowship funding 10+ projects annually (ages 13-24) addressing ocean/waterways/climate issues through creative arts. Provides $2,500 USD, mentorship, capacity building. Projects must engage local communities with tangible impact.

EDITO contributing to the DITTO. EU's digital twin of the ocean (EDITO) digitizes ocean data management through interoperable standards for science-policy-private sector exchange. Covers all ocean basins. Runs 2025-2028.

JPI Oceans Joint Call Blue Carbon. Joint call advancing blue carbon ecosystem research across Ireland, Canada, Germany, Malta, Norway, Poland, Greece. Focuses on expanding knowledge, improving measurement protocols, identifying interventions for climate mitigation.

West Coast Ocean Biomolecular Observing Network. Network integrating biomolecular technologies for marine biomonitoring in Southern California. Addresses ocean acidification, harmful algal blooms, fisheries assessments through standardized molecular approaches across platforms.

Computer vision and artificial intelligence-based salmon identification and automated long-term welfare assessment in aquaculture net-pens (cAIge). AI-based computer vision monitors individual salmon welfare in aquaculture farms. Tracks fish health, environmental factors, and farming practices to optimize holding conditions. Norway-led project 2023-2027.

Klimaatlas - The Danish National Climate Atlas. Extends Denmark's climate tool into marine domain. Provides ocean temperature, marine heatwave, salinity, sea ice projections for Danish coastal waters. Supports climate adaptation and ecosystem management 2022-2029.

Advancing Big Data Technologies of Marine Life. Japan-led project utilizing marine big data to understand ecosystems, promote conservation, and address ocean issues through data collaboration and citizen science. Focuses on North Pacific Ocean from 2021-2031.

The Coastal Ocean Environment Summer School in Nigeria and Ghana. Annual week-long summer school since 2015 training 1,000+ scientists in coastal ocean science. Alternates between Nigeria (even years) and Ghana (odd years). Multidisciplinary platform fostering international collaboration and capacity development.

MetaZooGene: Metabarcoding Zooplankton Diversity. Global DNA barcoding of marine zooplankton to monitor ecosystem health, climate impacts, food webs. Creates reference databases, best practices, capacity-building for early career scientists.

FUTURO – Future West African Marine Ecosystem. Studies West African Upwelling System through 2028 field campaign in Mauritania-Senegal region. Co-designs observations integrating stakeholders to enhance understanding and promote sustainable marine resource management.

Deep Blue Voyager 2035 Global Ocean Expedition. Ten-year global ocean expedition advancing frontier research, intelligent technologies, and ocean literacy. Provides vessel resources bridging science, industry, and public for sustainable ocean development across all ocean basins.

OneArgo: An Integrated Global, Full Depth and Multidisciplinary Ocean Observing Array for Beyond 2020. Global ocean observing array tracking physical & biogeochemical state from surface to full depth, including polar oceans. Real-time data sharing enables climate services, ocean productivity forecasting & carbon budget research.

The Future West African Upwelling System. Studies West African upwelling ecosystem dynamics, fisheries sustainability, and climate impacts. Focuses on oceanographic processes affecting coastal communities and marine resources in the region.

BlueMissionAA. EU Mission coordination hub for Atlantic & Arctic basins focusing on marine ecosystem restoration, climate resilience, governance framework, monitoring, innovation ecosystem, and citizen engagement through demonstration sites. Nov 2023-Oct 2025.

SEAWARD Africa. Coordinates Ocean Decade Africa Roadmap implementation across 4 themes: sustainable marine resources, climate/biodiversity, pollution, disaster risk. Includes capacity development, tech innovation, ocean literacy. Pan-African scope.

Thinking Beyond The Tides. 7-month hybrid fellowship empowering Caribbean youth (18-35) as marine conservation champions through nature-based solutions, ecosystem restoration, leadership training, and mentorship for climate resilience.

Protecting Africa's Marine Ecosystems. AFMESI promotes resilient Africa with healthy oceans sustaining livelihoods & biodiversity. Platform for global expert exchange to protect, restore & improve ocean quality across continent. Addresses pollution & sustainable economy.

Seascape Alaska: A Regional Coastal and Ocean Mapping Campaign. High-resolution seafloor mapping of Alaska waters (62% unmapped). Gov & non-gov collaboration for navigation, fisheries & Seabed 2030. Digital ocean representation for stakeholders.

Coral Research & Development Accelerator Platform. Global R&D platform funding coordinated programs to conserve warm/cold-water corals. Accelerates development of scalable solutions for coral restoration, connects international programs, trains scientists in developing countries.

Navigating the New Arctic. NSF convergence research addressing Arctic environmental, social & built system interactions. Studies rapid Arctic changes & local/global effects across disciplines. Arctic Ocean, N Atlantic & N Pacific focus.

Using ocean science to stop IUU fishing. Philippines-US project using science & data to combat illegal fishing through law enforcement, stakeholder compliance & progress tracking. Addresses 63B pesos annual losses from IUU fishing.

The VLE Blueprint Accelerator. Annual program identifying ocean innovators and transforming their visions into fundable Ocean Decade Actions through a 4-week strategic sprint. Builds investment-ready project architecture for marine conservation.

Nature-based Solutions for Mitigation of Watershed pollution: Cross-habitat facilitation by coastal seagrass meadows (SOMWAT). Assessing tropical & temperate seagrass-reef ecotones in Tanzania & South Africa. Studies nutrient/pollutant removal by seagrass meadows to improve water quality for reefs & aquaculture, benefiting local communities' livelihoods.

C&BI – Ocean & Coastal Ecosystems. BNP Paribas Foundation call for projects (Jan-Apr 2025) to protect marine biodiversity, mitigate climate impacts, support sustainable practices across all ocean basins. Focuses on pollution, blue food, ocean-climate nexus.

The Current III: The Mediterranean - Waves Come in Pairs. Transdisciplinary examination of Mediterranean, Pacific & Caribbean through art, science, conservation & activism. Supports projects & collective pedagogies addressing regional challenges for UN Agenda 2030.

Beyond One Ocean Health. Integrates environmental justice, ecohealth, planetary & One Health concepts for ocean domain. Addresses ecosystem health, disease, human well-being, spiritual healing, planetary limits to safeguard modern civilization.

3D sensors for contaminants and marine toxins. Developing 3D printed sensors for in-situ monitoring of emerging contaminants and marine toxins in coastal ecosystems. Protects shellfish/oyster farmers from harmful algae toxins, providing portable, economical solutions.

eDNA Expeditions II. Citizen-science initiative establishing repeated eDNA sampling across marine protected areas globally. Expands biodiversity knowledge in underrepresented regions, integrates data with OBIS, develops indicators, and builds local capacity.

Collaborations for NWP Marine Ecosystem Prediction (COSMEC). Advances understanding of marine ecosystem dynamics in Northwest Pacific using BGC Argo floats, eDNA, AI methods. Supports policy, resource management through real-time data for ESMs. Builds capacity among WESTPAC states.

Global Climate Impacts of Methane Seeps (CliMetS). Global collaboration studying seafloor methane seeps through observation, monitoring, and research. Develops distribution maps, assesses biodiversity, and evaluates environmental impacts of marine methane release across all ocean basins.

Southern Ocean Flux Capability Working Group. Reduces uncertainties in Southern Ocean air-sea exchanges by implementing observing systems for essential ocean variables, developing standardized methodologies, and supporting flux product development. Focuses on storm-related events.

Quantifying Gases in the Ocean Using Acoustics. Develops broadband acoustic tech to detect & quantify seafloor gas bubbles (methane, CO2). Creates numerical models for flux estimation to understand ocean-atmosphere gas exchange & climate impacts. Completed 2019-2025.

Maré de Ciência (Tide of Science). Ocean literacy program bridging science, policy & society through dialogue and engagement. Co-designed with universities, authorities & civil society to integrate SDGs and UN Ocean Decade goals into sustainable behavior change.
