C-SCOPE in Action. Enhances marine carbon observation using Ship-of-Opportunity lines to measure CO2 uptake, connecting BGC-Argo and surface measurements, and developing Open Ocean Science concepts. Contributes to GOA-ON and OARS.

Building capacity to protect marine biodiversity (BAIT). Enhances capacity to observe and monitor marine ecosystems in Cabo Verde through training and practical observation programs. Delivers policy information for sustainable economic growth and poverty alleviation. 2023-2025.

A probabilistic model for plastic clean-up techs. Develops tool for selecting plastic clean-up mechanisms in inland waterways to efficiently collect debris before reaching ocean while minimizing environmental bycatch. Assists policymakers and companies in technology selection based on environmental

Decade Collaborative Centre for Ocean Prediction (DCC-OP). Coordinates global ocean prediction community to achieve predicted ocean through UN Ocean Decade. Develops shared architecture, standards, training. Implements OPERA (sub-Saharan Africa) and OP4CR (Costa Rica) projects.

Forecasting the Argentine Sea. Operational oceanic forecasting system for sea level and waves in Southwestern Atlantic Continental Shelf. Web portal provides free access. Training and co-production with users. Part of Pampa Azul Initiative.

Centers for Oceans and Human Health. NSF & NIH program investigating connections between ocean environment, climate & human health. Studies marine plastics, toxins, harmful algal blooms through interdisciplinary collaborations with researchers & communities.

Blue University of the Brazilian Coast. Multi-institutional ocean literacy network on Brazil's semi-arid coast. Targets public, teachers, students, agencies via social communication and environmental education. Runs Feb 2023-Dec 2026 in South Atlantic.

Building Forward Better by Safeguarding Natural Capital and Ecosystem Services. Samoa project supporting policy, data collection & valuation of marine/coastal ecosystem services for SDGs 14-15, building investment case for ecosystem services' role in human wellbeing (SDGs 1-3).

Recycling on the development of sensor for oceans. Develops sensors from recycled plastic optical fibers to monitor microplastics and water quality in aquaculture systems. Measures ammonia, pH, nitrites, CO2, temperature in South Atlantic. 2023-2026, Brazil.

Gulf of Naples Integrated Pelagic Observatory. Long-term ecological monitoring of Gulf of Naples ecosystem since 1984. Tracks temperature, nutrients, plankton, bacteria using optical and omics tech. Supports understanding marine dynamics and sustainable resource management in NW Mediterranean.

Bertarelli Foundation Marine Science Programme. Advances understanding of large marine protected areas in the Indian Ocean for better management. Focuses on marine biodiversity protection, ocean health, and science-informed conservation through collaborative interdisciplinary projects.

SMART Ocean-SMART Industries (SO-SI): Science/Industry Partnerships for Data Collection and Sharing. Global multi-industry initiative creating partnerships between science and ocean private sector for data collection and sharing. Develops community of practice, clearinghouse, and matchmaking capacity connecting science priorities with industry.

Italian Navy High North Program. Arctic research program by Italian Navy focusing on 3D mapping from satellite to seabed. Three pillars: Exploration, Environment, Education. Supports digital ocean representation through collaboration and coordination.

Healthcheck Activates Sustainability Reporting. CSIRO's Healthcheck ESG system engages fishing/aquaculture industry to identify data gaps and collect environmental, social & governance indicators for comprehensive sustainability reporting and market verification.

Ocean Decade Research Programme on the Maritime Acoustic Environment (OD-MAE). Measures and characterizes underwater acoustic environments globally. Develops technologies and data collection methods using sound to analyze ocean-life systems and support marine conservation.

Better Data for Marine Spatial Planning in the Med. MEDSEAPLAN enhances Maritime Spatial Planning across Mediterranean with 16 EU partners. Develops ecosystem-based tools, addresses data gaps, engages stakeholders for sustainable blue economy. €2.2M budget, May 2024-Apr 2027.

World Ocean Database Cloud. Provides equitable, timely access to historic & recent subsurface oceanographic data via cloud-optimized format. Integrates Open-GTS for near-real-time delivery, enabling ocean time series monitoring from historical to current measurements.

Sustainable Sea-Caring and Protection Technologies. RAISE develops AI & Robotics innovation ecosystems in Liguria for marine/coastal monitoring, preservation & remediation. Transitions from point to widespread environmental monitoring using EcoRobotics systems for sea, air, energy & ecotoxicology.

Mediterranean Green Shipping Centre of Excellence. Hub fostering Mediterranean green shipping community, connecting stakeholders, promoting sustainable maritime transport innovation, facilitating start-ups with investors. Addresses marine pollution and sustainable ocean economy. 2023-2030.

An Ecosystem Approach to Quantifying Behavioural and Energetic Impacts of Anthropogenic Disturbance to Arctic Whales. Quantifying vessel noise & sonar impacts on Arctic whales using drones, biologging tags, & oceanographic sampling. Assessing ship strike risk & developing mitigation strategies for Canadian Arctic whale populations (2022-2026).

Periodic cyclone effects on Gangetic food web. Assesses ecological impacts of cyclone-mediated disruptions on Ganges delta food web. Studies plankton, benthos, fish communities and biogeochemical changes. Supports coastal hazard preparedness for Kolkata and Sundarban communities.

Centre of Excellence on Sustainable Blue Economy. Euro-Mediterranean collaborative project building bridges among institutions to advance blue economy through interdisciplinary research, education, and stakeholder engagement across EU and South Mediterranean states.

The Ocean Matter (TOM). Addresses land-based pollution creating dead zones in Liberian waters. Provides ocean literacy initiatives and develops Liberia Ocean Governance Strategy to prevent chemical compounds and plastic debris impacting marine life.

Tara International Polar Station (TIPS). Floating polar station conducting drift expeditions from 2024 in Central Arctic Ocean to study climate change effects on Arctic region and global ocean through long-term scientific research and monitoring.

Acoustics to Assess the Health Status of Reefs. Uses passive acoustics to assess marine protected areas and mass bleaching events in South Pacific reefs. University of Liège studies reef health through underwater sound monitoring to protect and restore ecosystems.

X-Oceans: Enhancing Ocean Literacy in Youth in Rural Northeastern Nova Scotia. Why: Educate rural communities to value ocean. What: K-12 curriculum. How: Hands-on experiences. When: 2022-2026. Where: Northeastern Nova Scotia, Canada.

The Current V: Ancestral Ocean. Examines Indian Ocean kinships, cultural languages, ancestral memory through art-science collaboration. Focus on island geographies connecting Afrasian pasts/futures across South Asia, East Africa, Gulf. 2026-2028.

MSP4MORE: MSP Tools for Integrating Multiple Sustainability Objectives under Expansion of Offshore Renewable Energy. Optimizes offshore wind farm design across Baltic, North, Mediterranean & Barents Seas to balance renewable energy with marine protection, ecosystem restoration & sea use. Develops stakeholder tools for sustainable maritime spatial planning.

Strategic Management of Ghost Gear in Coastal Land. Retrieves abandoned fishing gear from oceans/shorelines. Establishes Ocean Plastic Depots for collection, processing, recycling. Trains coastal communities. Creates sustainable ghost gear management with industrial hub. 2020-2028.

Aprender Explorando. Educational program connecting sailboat expeditions across Atlantic & Southern Ocean with schools. Uses ocean & polar regions to teach students aged 9-17. Collects plankton data via Plankton Planet partnership for ocean conservation.

Swiss Polar Institute. Swiss national body linking land-locked countries to ocean science. Supports polar research via CASCADES Expedition (2026), educational modules, and global partnerships. Bridges ocean-polar nexus in Ocean Decade.

Multi-use Infrastructure Spatial Concepts for the Blue Economy Leveraging on Sustainable Port Ecosystems through Living Labs (BluePortLab). Transforms European ports into sustainable energy hubs via Living Labs, integrating renewables, biodiversity, multi-use infrastructure for climate-neutral blue economy. 2025-2028.

FAPESP Program on South Atlantic and Antarctica (FAPESP-PROASA). Brazilian research program advancing South Atlantic & Antarctic science to address planetary crises & sustainable development through partnerships, innovation & environmental justice (2024-2029)

Cell-Cultured Octopus Production Through Sustainable Marine Biomass Valorization (SEANERGIES). Develops cultivated octopus meat using regenerative cell lines, algae-based media & seaweed scaffolds to address overfishing & food security. 2025-2028. Led by Wageningen University.

Harmonised ocean data sets for blue sustainable eutrophication management of the North-East Atlantic Ocean and Baltic Sea (CodeBlue). Addresses eutrophication in NE Atlantic & Baltic Sea. Compiles harmonised river data for biogeochemical models to inform policy on nutrient inputs, water quality & sustainable blue food production. Digital Twin test case 2025-2028.

Enhancing Algal Biomass Consumer Acceptance for Food Markets (AlgFlavor). Optimizes cultivation/processing of seaweeds & microalgae to enhance seafood flavor for European markets. Bridges algal producers & food industry, creating sustainable alternatives to reduce pressure on marine stocks. 2025-2028.

Digital Twin of the Ocean for Offshore Wind Energy (DTO4OWE). Develops digital ocean twins for Baltic & North Sea to assess offshore wind farm impacts on marine ecosystems & support sustainable wind energy planning through AI-based forecasting & scenario tools (2025-2028).

Digital Twin for Innovation in Oceanic Visualization and Exploration (DIVE). AI4Ocean paradigm creating digital twin ocean models with what-if/causal exploration tools and intuitive visualizers. Bridges oceanographers and AI scientists via Quadruple Helix framework for sustainable Blue Economy.

EVOLVE - Economically Viable Integrated Floating Energy Islands. Develops floating offshore wind energy islands across European sea basins, integrating renewable energy tech & hydrogen production while balancing marine conservation, fishery & tourism through optimized design & operations (2025-2028)

Microalgal Biomass Valorization for Sustainable Production of Functional Food and Feed Ingredients (BioVal). Develops sustainable microalgae cultivation & extraction for food supplements & aquaculture feed. Uses innovative photobioreactors to produce bioactive lipids (MAGs) & proteins, creating zero-waste biorefinery model. 2025-2028.

BLUESHORES - Developing Hybrid Multifunctional Foreshore Infrastructure. Tests hybrid nature-based coastal infrastructure combining saltmarsh, wooden breakwalls & oyster reefs at Venice Lagoon, Cork Harbour & Scheldt Estuary to mitigate erosion & climate impacts on eroding shorelines 2025-2028

Unlocking the Potential of Seaweeds and Halophytes through Biorefinery for Enhanced Resilience in the Aquaculture, Agri-Food, and Chemical Industries (ReSEAlience). Develops universal biorefinery model for seaweed/halophyte processing via HALOREFINE extraction. Creates sustainable feed, textiles, chemicals from marine biomass in Atlantic/Mediterranean IMTA systems. Zero-waste approach. 2025-2028.

Source to Sea: Bartók 3.0 Connectivity. Bridges freshwater-ocean systems via culturally grounded digital twins across 7 pilots: Danube-Black Sea, Baltic, Adriatic, E Africa, Yellow River, Bay of Bengal, Nile-Mediterranean. Strengthens resilience, heritage safeguarding 2026-2031.

Long-term Deep Indian Ocean Observing Network. Establishes sustained mooring program in western Indian Ocean for deep ocean time-series observation. Shares open datasets to advance understanding of deep ocean processes, climate prediction, and sustainable ocean management.

Korea-Indonesia Coastal Ocean Env. Survey Training. Enhances Indonesia's marine capacity through 2-3 week training on pollution, erosion & biodiversity using Korean tech. Hands-on sessions with advanced equipment at Korea-Indonesia center. 2023-2030.

Global Ecosystem for Ocean Solutions (GEOS). Accelerates collaboration across sectors to build a global community advancing ocean-climate solutions through Innovation Hubs. Supports multidisciplinary projects developing equitable solutions to ocean-climate crisis across all ocean basins.

Formulation of Seaweeds to High-Value Ingredients for Food and Nutraceuticals Markets (ForSea). Develops sustainable seaweed cultivation and processing in Atlantic and Baltic Sea to create nutritional food ingredients via fermentation. Addresses food security through marine biomass innovation. 2025-2028.

Circular Model Coexisting with Coral Reefs. Kikaijima Island project revalues marine heritage through citizen science, art dialogue, community conservation, education, and a Floating University to promote sustainable coexistence with coral reefs threatened by climate change.

Demonstrating Ocean CDR with Hydrogen Production. Equatic Process seawater electrolysis removes atmospheric CO₂ and produces carbon-negative hydrogen. Singapore demonstration validates performance, safety, and monitoring in tropical coastal waters for marine carbon removal.

Mariculture Overview in the Caribbean. Sailing expedition documenting Caribbean mariculture from Florida to Trinidad. Interviews farmers, collects water quality data, creates comprehensive report and documentary to support sustainable aquaculture, food security, and ecosystem restoration.

Decade Coordination Office for the Tropical Americas and Caribbean. Coordinates Ocean Decade actions across Caribbean & Tropical Americas. Addresses marine pollution, ecosystem restoration, sustainable fisheries, coastal resilience. Partners with SIDS, governments, NGOs. 2023-2030.

Ocean Literacy Across Languages. ECOP-led initiative bridging language barriers in ocean knowledge through a global youth-led database and multilingual publication series. Connects scientists, youth, NGOs, and policymakers across cultures for ocean stewardship.

Marine Plastics Abatement Through Hopeful Youth (MPAthy). Experiential learning for coastal youth in Tamil Nadu, India to combat marine plastic pollution through ocean literacy and revival of cultural circular economy practices. Combines science and heritage to empower change agents.

Novel Functional Textiles from Red and Brown Seaweed (SeaWeave). Develops sustainable textile fibers and dyes from Atlantic and Mediterranean seaweed to replace synthetic materials. Uses biorefinery processes to extract polysaccharides and pigments for fashion and furniture industries. 2025-2028.

Offshore Clean Hydrogen Production for Multi-Use Purposes (OCEAN-H2). Pioneering large-scale green hydrogen from offshore renewables via seawater electrolysis. Tackles climate change while minimizing marine ecosystem impacts through rigorous assessments and sustainable practices. 2025-2028.

Advance the production and market viability of red seaweeds in Europe. Diversifying European seaweed farming by domesticating red seaweed species, developing cultivation techniques, and creating quality control tools to expand sustainable blue bioeconomy (2025-2028).

Integrated Coastal Protection Service of RS. Monitoring system for Rio Grande do Sul coast combining in situ data, modeling & education. Addresses climate impacts, erosion, flooding & water quality. Supports municipalities in resilience & sustainable development.

SPEED - Simulation and Prediction of Environment and Engineering for Deep-sea. Builds digital twin systems coupling hydrodynamic, sediment, ecosystem models with satellite/sensor data for deep-sea environmental forecasts. Focuses on Indian Ocean to balance resource extraction with conservation (2026-2030).

Biocatalytic Refining of Seaweed Carbohydrates for Producing Higher Value Polymer Precursors (SEABIOCAT). Develops biorefinery tech to convert brown macroalgae into biopolymers/bioplastics using thermostable enzymes. Targets North Atlantic/Arctic regions. Aims to replace fossil-fuel feedstock, boost coastal economies, create jobs.

VASEACAD - Valorising Seafood Side Streams for Bioactive Protein Hydrolysates. Maximizes value from marine fish biomass waste in Mediterranean/Black Sea aquaculture. Extracts high-value biomolecules from tuna, seabass, seabream for nutraceuticals, feed. Mobile Sealab recovers oil, proteins from fishery waste.

Coastal Corrosion Risk Management through Digital Twin Model for a Sustainable Blue Economy (CorrasBLUE). Digital twin platform integrating sensor data to manage coastal corrosion across Atlantic, Mediterranean & North Sea. Maximizes material sustainability, minimizes ecological risks for marine infrastructure (2025-2028).

SMART Online Multisensory System for Microplastic Quantification and Water Quality Assessment - ROMEO. Low-cost multi-sensor system monitoring aquatic ecosystems from inland to coastal waters. Tracks microplastics, diatoms, water quality. Open database for scientists, policymakers, citizens. EU Marine Strategy compliant.

Development of Modular and Mobile By-product and Wastes Bio-refinery Valorisation Systems and Supporting Structures for Fisheries and Aquaculture SME Industrie (DORIS). Develops mobile biorefinery systems to convert fishery/aquaculture waste into high-value products for EU Blue SMEs. Tests finfish, crustacean, mollusc waste conversion across EU sea basins. Includes funding models & policy support.

Preserving and Upscaling Sama Bajao Indigenous Ocean Heritage in the Visayas. Safeguards Sama Bajao ancestral maritime knowledge through documenting traditional practices, upscaling sustainable fisheries/aquaculture, heritage eco-tourism, and community-led conservation in the Visayas, Philippines (2026-2029).

Upcycling of Bilge Water into Biobased Solutions for Ghostfishing and Oil Spilling (BilgeUP). Converts ship bilge waste into biosurfactants for oil spill cleanup and biodegradable fishing gear. Samples from Mediterranean, Atlantic, Black Sea. Addresses ghost fishing and marine pollution through circular bioprocesses.

The Asia Sea-Level Knowledge Hub. Regional center at CityUHK addressing sea-level rise across Asia through research, monitoring, policy engagement. Fosters collaboration for adaptive coastal resilience strategies. Serves densely populated Asian coastlines.

Global Offshore Aquaculture and Low-Carbon Energy. Integrates offshore aquaculture with floating wind energy across Atlantic, Pacific, Indian Oceans. Designs modular platforms with low-carbon tech, builds capacity through training, co-design with Indigenous knowledge.

Coastal Ocean Resilience Data Collaborative. Enhances resilience in South & Southeast Asia via open digital platform integrating ocean, climate, socio-economic data. Co-created with communities for disaster risk reduction, climate adaptation & blue financing. 2025-2030.

Autonomous samplers and sensors for marine 'omics. TechOmics develops autonomous biomolecular sensors/samplers to map marine life, from deep sea biodiversity to microbiology. Targets waterborne health threats like harmful algae in Mediterranean & N Atlantic. 2025-2031.

Indicators of Changing Lightscapes in Underwater Marine Ecosystems (ISOLUME). Assesses how marine lightscapes changed across European seas over decades/centuries. Combines historical trend analyses with modeling. Investigates intensity, location, timing, spectra. Covers 25-year changes, projects to 2050.

Pampa Azul Bonaerense. Provincial initiative fostering society-nature relationships through strategic planning, territorial management, environmental education. Integrates citizen science, artisanal fishing communities, tourism stakeholders for coastal governance.

SARCE+ (Transformative Intertidal Decade for Rocky Shores Conservation). Latin America & Caribbean network monitoring & restoring rocky shore biodiversity via standardized protocols, eDNA, remote sensing, community engagement & policy integration for resilient coasts (2026-2028).

Empowering MSMEs in Tanzania Blue Economy. Empowers 250 women/youth-led coastal MSMEs in Tanzania through training, creating 750 direct jobs, establishing Blue Economy Centres in Dar es Salaam and Zanzibar, building capacity in business planning and investment readiness (2025-2028)

MiningImpact. Assesses environmental impacts of deep-seabed mining in Pacific (Clarion-Clipperton Zone, Peru Basin) & Atlantic. Studies ecosystem functioning, biodiversity, mining effects, resilience. Informs international regulations.

Blue Economy Network for ECOPs in LAC. Establishes VET network across Latin America & Caribbean to empower Early Career Ocean Professionals through capacity building, ocean entrepreneurship training, innovation events & policy dialogue for sustainable blue economy (2025-2030)

Sea Too. Restores Baltic Sea ecosystems & key species weakened by human stressors. Combines scientific research, local knowledge & citizen science. Workshops explore ecological/cultural sea knowledge. Artists & scientists strengthen human-sea bonds.

GEAR-UP: Towards Sustainable Fisheries. Co-designs climate-resilient fishing gears with stakeholders across Atlantic, Arctic & Mediterranean to reduce bycatch, protect species. Builds capacity for Early Career Professionals in Island States from Cyprus to Macaronesia.

Padjadjaran Oceanographic Data Centre. Open-access portal by Universitas Padjadjaran providing marine/climate data from ships, moorings, platforms. Supports Indonesian Throughflow, coral restoration studies. Democratizes ocean data for sustainable policy in Indonesia/ASEAN.

Methodological Framework for Tsunami Risk in Ports (TSUPORT). Develops comprehensive methodology for assessing tsunami risk in port environments globally. Enhances preparedness for critical port infrastructure, communities & populations. Multidisciplinary approach adaptable to coastal hazards.

Blue Ocean Credits Program. Advances sustainable ocean development through blue carbon ecosystems, coral biodiversity monitoring, and aquaculture. Builds global capacity via workshops and research. Develops credit systems using AI and remote sensing for restoration.

Governing Changing Oceans. Develops marine governance frameworks for ocean-based climate interventions like seaweed-farming and carbon removal. Unites experts to guide governments and stakeholders on governing novel interventions in climate-impacted oceans globally.

VOA – Oceanographic Sailing Vessel. State-of-the-art oceanographic sailing vessel for long-term multidisciplinary ocean monitoring in South Atlantic. Gathers high-quality data while minimizing environmental impact. Focuses on ocean-climate nexus and ecosystem monitoring.

Basin-scale Events and Coastal Impacts (BECI). North Pacific Ocean Knowledge Network collating ocean conditions data, marine ecosystem impacts, and transboundary fish populations. Provides interactive dashboards and synthesis tools for climate-informed decision-making across Pacific Rim.

BlueCraft Africa: Ocean Waste into Coastal Wealth. Empowers African coastal communities by transforming ocean waste into marketable arts and crafts. Provides alternative livelihoods through upcycling hubs, reducing fishing dependence while promoting ocean literacy.

SubRacing Series. Underwater sport racing submersibles to engage people with ocean exploration, collecting data for mapping and monitoring while fostering marine appreciation and blue-economy careers for next generation.

Arctic Sea Ice Management. Researching controlled ice thickening to preserve Arctic sea ice. Field trials since 2023 test autonomous zero-emission tech to slow ice loss, support ecosystems & Indigenous communities. Ice-free summers projected 2030s.

Living Ocean Classroom: From Reefs to Communities. Kuruwitu community trains 4 nearby Kenyan fishing communities in coral restoration and recycling to improve fish habitat, biodiversity, and livelihoods using peer-learning model blending traditional knowledge with best practices.

Marine Data Exchange Heritage Accelerator. Recaptures 20 years of heritage data from seabed surveys for offshore wind development in England's seas. Transfers geophysical/geotechnical survey data to Marine Data Exchange and National Marine Heritage Record databases.

Projeto Cultura Oceânica - Conhecendo o Oceano. Ocean literacy program in Florianópolis schools since 2021. Engages 4th-graders through interactive activities on biodiversity, climate, marine litter. Collected 32kg recyclables. Promotes SDG 14 awareness.

Baltic Climate Resilient Coastal Planning Network. Enhances climate resilience of Baltic Sea coastal municipalities through spatial planning tools, data repository, training & workshops. Integrates extreme weather risks into planning via Sea2Land Navigator & Beach-SOS pathways.

ENDURE; Sustainable preservation of UCH. Preserving 3M+ shipwrecks & submerged prehistoric sites by studying natural/anthropogenic decay, using remote sensing & GIS, determining decay rates, ranking threats via ecosystem modeling, proposing mitigation (2022-2028)

Sustainable Aquaculture Under Climate Change. Assessing climate impacts on aquaculture, developing resilient strains, refining models, and building capacity in vulnerable regions (SIDS/LDCs) to ensure food security through sustainable practices by 2030.

Trilha Translagunar. Trail connecting Blue Flag beaches in Araruama Lagoon (Rio de Janeiro) linking hypersaline lagoon to Atlantic Ocean. Promotes ecotourism, environmental education, Blue Economy through interpretive signage and community participation.

ACCION SHOA Seabed 2030. Chilean Navy's Hydrographic Service shares bathymetric data from surveys along Chilean coast with GEBCO to reduce southern hemisphere seafloor mapping gaps. Data released after 2-year retention. Runs 2025-2030.

Monitoring Coastal Resilience. CREST monitors sandy coast erosion & resilience using satellite imagery & geomorphologic assessment to help coastal managers design climate adaptation strategies. Addresses fragmented monitoring data. 2023-2027.

Coastal Heritage Resilience Network. Safeguards cultural heritage of small-scale fishing communities while strengthening climate resilience. Integrates oral histories, traditional knowledge into digital platforms. Fishers document ecological changes, preserving heritage.

AQUASPECT - Advancing Quality Assessment of Spatial Patterns and Ecosystem Characteristics through Technological Advancement. AI-driven Digital Twin project assessing coastal ecosystems through phyto/zooplankton monitoring. Combines data collection, ecological modelling, and new sensors to improve ocean biological/biogeochemical knowledge at regional scale.

Ocean Prediction for Costa Rica. Strengthens Costa Rica's ocean prediction capacities for sustainable marine management. Develops digital tools for Cocos Island MPA monitoring and plans Ocean Prediction Service Center establishment. 2-year project.

Coastal Resilience ECOPs Worldwide. Global network of Early Career Ocean Professionals across 130+ coastal sites engaging communities in ocean literacy & citizen science. Toolkit covers social-environmental, morphological, seawater, biodiversity & atmospheric aspects.

ICTs4SSF: Building Capacity for Coastal Resilience. Empowers small-scale fishers in SIDS/LDCs as ocean science contributors via digital tools, training in environmental monitoring, sustainable co-management, and climate adaptation through ABALOBI platforms and KU Leuven partnership.

Vox Maris – Zero Nets in the Sea. Community initiative recovering abandoned fishing nets via citizen science, creative engagement. Partners with coastal communities, scientists, artists to regenerate ecosystems, prevent pollution through circular economy models.

Regenerative Tides: Sailing for Solutions. Grassroots citizen science mapping abandoned fiberglass boats in Brittany, testing environmental samples, co-creating advocacy tools. Blends science, art, storytelling to expose aquatic pollution and influence regenerative policies.

RIVIERADE - Delivering Climate Services for European Seas. Develops high-resolution climate predictions for Baltic, Black & Mediterranean Seas (2026-2029). Multi-model framework produces downscaled projections for ocean health, blue economy & coastal risk at basin to local scales.

Guardians of Gaia – Mare Nostrum. Transdisciplinary initiative bridging Indigenous knowledge, marine science & youth education to regenerate Mediterranean coastal ecosystems via sailing expeditions with eDNA research, traditional knowledge sharing & restoration projects.

Climate Resilience for Sustainable Ocean Planning. Develops open-source climate vulnerability assessment tool for MPAs globally. Pilots in 2 MPAs (Global North/South), focuses on marine biodiversity resilience, indigenous community participation, and 30% ocean protection by 2030.

Shisiwani-Eco 2030. Community-led marine conservation in Shisiwani National Park, Anjouan, Comoros. Ecological monitoring, capacity building, inclusive governance to protect coral reefs. Engages fishers, schools, women, youth for ocean stewardship.

Sail for Impact – an action-based sailing initiative for ocean impact. Global sailing platform for ocean research, restoration & education. Scientists, NGOs & communities co-create missions from Arctic kelp surveys to racing campaigns. Blends fieldwork with storytelling for systemic change.

Empowering Women for the United Nations Decade of Ocean Science for Sustainable Development. Enhances capacity for women's empowerment and gender equality in ocean science. Yachts for Science (YSF). Global platform matching marine scientists with private yacht owners to overcome vessel access bottleneck. Transforms underutilized yachts into cost-effective research platforms for scientific discovery and conservation across all ocean basins.

Strengthening Tsunami Early Warning. Enhances tsunami early warning in NW Indian Ocean through regional cooperation. Builds community capacities for UNESCO-IOC Tsunami Ready Programme in India, Iran, Maldives, Pakistan, Sri Lanka. Aims 100% preparedness by 2030.

Branding of Research Vessels with Oceandecade Logo. German research vessels SONNE, METEOR, ALKOR, MARIA S. MERIAN support marine research globally in biology, geology, geophysics, oceanography. Contribute to Ocean Decade challenges on ecosystem protection, ocean-climate, capacity development.

Strategies, technologies and social solutions to manage bycatch in tropical Large Marine Ecosystem Fisheries (REBYC-III CLME+). Mainstreaming Sustainable Marine Fisheries Value Chains into the Blue Economy of the Canary Current and the Pacific Central American Coastal Large Marine Ecosystems. Supports FIPs, value chains, Blue Economy across 6 countries via GEF funding.

Managing and conserving marine, coastal and terrestrial ecosystem services in Seychelles through Ridge-to-Reef approach. GEF-funded integrated coastal management project.

Pacific Tuna SAP Implementation. Pacific tuna fisheries management across 14 island nations. Implements Strategic Action Programme for sustainable tuna stocks. Regional cooperation for oceanic resource conservation. 2020-ongoing.

Increasing the resilience of the Mediterranean marine and coastal areas to climate change impacts. GEF-funded project endorsed Feb 2020.

Expanding and Consolidating Madagascar's Marine Protected Areas Network. Tripling Madagascar's MPAs to conserve coral diversity, marine species & fish stocks. Strengthens MPA management & fisheries resources through ministerial cooperation, addressing habitat destruction & unsustainable fishing.

Enhancing capacity for the adoption and implementation of EAF in the shrimp and groundfish fisheries of the North Brazil Shelf Large Marine Ecosystem. Advances Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries in shrimp/groundfish fisheries of North Brazil Shelf LME. Supports Guyana, Suriname, Trinidad & Tobago implementing CLME+ SAP for sustainable marine resource management.

Sustainable Management of Fisheries, Marine Living Resources and Habitats in the Bay of Bengal. Contributes to sustainable fisheries & marine resource management in Bay of Bengal region. Benefits coastal states & communities through improved governance of marine habitats & living resources across 8 countries.

Parliamentary Conservation Caucus for Blue Economy and Large Marine Ecosystems. Leverages Parliamentary Conservation Caucus model to raise awareness amongst legislators on blue economy opportunities and LME Strategic Action Programmes, facilitating regional cooperation for transboundary marine governance in LAC, East Africa, Sou

Building and Enhancing Sectoral and Cross-sectoral capacity to support sustainable resource use and biodiversity conservation in marine areas beyond national jurisdiction. Enhance awareness of ABNJ governance for sustainable resource use and biodiversity conservation in marine areas beyond national jurisdiction through strengthened cross-sectoral capacity building.

Effectively Managing Networks of Marine Protected Areas in Large Marine Ecosystems in the ASEAN Region (ASEAN ENMAPS). Develop and improve management of marine protected area networks and corridors in ASEAN LMEs for biodiversity conservation, sustainable fisheries, and ecosystem services. Focus on Tubbataha Reef and regional sites.

Canary Current Large Marine Ecosystem Strategic Action Programme Implementation. Creates enabling conditions for implementing the Canary Current LME Strategic Action Programme across West African coastal nations. Addresses marine ecosystem management in Cape Verde, Gambia, Guinea-Bissau, Morocco, Senegal.

Strengthening Locally Managed Marine Areas in Fiji. Strengthen & integrate Locally Managed Marine Areas into Fiji's MPA system through improved institutional & local capacity, management planning & monitoring. Budget: $4.3M USD, GEF allocation: $805K.

Implementation of the Strategic Plan of Ecuador Mainland Marine and Coastal Protected Areas Network. Improve conservation and sustainable use of marine and coastal biodiversity through an effective coastal and marine protected areas network in mainland Ecuador. Strengthens MPA management and connectivity.

Gulf of Guinea Large Marine Ecosystem Regional Governance and Ecosystem-Based Management. Strengthens regional governance and ecosystem-based management of GCLME. Builds capacity for SAP implementation on transboundary fisheries, biodiversity conservation, pollution reduction across 15 West African nations.

Chile Marine Coastal Project. Marine and coastal conservation project in Chile. GEF-funded initiative focused on marine ecosystem protection and sustainable coastal management. Total budget $26.8M with $3.5M GEF allocation.

Conserving globally significant coastal biodiversity in South-East China through integrated seascape planning and threat management. Conserve coastal biodiversity in SE China through integrated seascape planning, threat management, MPA network expansion and strengthened operations. Total budget $25M with $2.7M GEF allocation.

Enhancing the resilience of Djibouti's marine biodiversity. Enhance resilience of Djibouti's marine biodiversity by increasing institutional capacity, enhancing financial sustainability and management effectiveness of MPA system, and mainstreaming marine biodiversity into key maritime sectors

Ecosystem-based Fisheries Management in the Humboldt Current System. Facilitates ecosystem-based fisheries management and restoration in Humboldt current system for sustainable delivery of goods/services from shared marine resources. Chile-Peru collaboration implementing SAP.

Improving Conservation and Sustainable Use of Coastal and Marine Biodiversity in Montenegro. GEF-funded project.

Conservation and Management of Marine Protected Areas in Haiti. Improve conservation and management of Grosse Caye/Zone humide d'Aquin and Olivier/Zanglais MPAs in Haiti through enhanced fishery management and climate change mitigation via ecosystem restoration.

Invasive Alien Species Management in Marine and Coastal Ecosystems - Turkey. Strengthening capacities and investment in prevention, detection, control and management of Invasive Alien Species to ensure resilience of marine and coastal ecosystems in Turkey.

Addressing Marine Plastics - A Systemic Approach. Global project to address marine plastic pollution using systemic approach. Builds on knowledge of plastic sources, pathways & impacts to inform GEF 7 Strategy. Focuses on waste management with gender perspectives in Asia.

Strengthening multilateral cooperation in ecosystem-based management of the Antarctic Large Marine Ecosystem. Mainstreaming Biodiversity Conservation in Panama's Coastal Marine Areas. Mainstream biodiversity conservation into production landscapes/seascapes for integrated environmental management of coastal marine areas, benefiting coastal populations in Panama through sustainable use practices.

Restoring Ecological Balance of the Adriatic Sea through Ecosystem Approach and Marine Spatial Planning. Restore Adriatic Sea ecological balance via Ecosystem Approach & Marine Spatial Planning in Albania & Montenegro. Implements sustainable marine resource management, MSP guidelines, & ecosystem assessments. 2018-2021.

Integrated Management of Coastal and Marine Areas of High Biodiversity Value in Ecuador. Develops integrated management for Ecuador's coastal/marine biodiversity through conservation areas, mangrove concessions, and fisheries management. Protects high-value coastal ecosystems and marine resources.

Strengthening systemic and institutional capacity for reducing multiple threats to globally significant marine ecosystems and achieve sustainable blue growth in Cape Verde. Strengthens Cape Verde's capacity to reduce threats to marine ecosystems and achieve sustainable blue growth through systemic and institutional improvements. GEF-funded project with $26.2M total budget.

Realizing the Inclusive and Sustainable Development in the BCLME Region through the Improved Ocean Governance and the Integrated Management of Ocean Use and Marine Resources. Conservation and sustainable use of Benguela Current Large Marine Ecosystem across Angola, Namibia, South Africa. Implements first LME-based legal framework for ocean governance, focusing on integrated management and rehabilitation.

Conservation of biodiversity through expansion of marine and coastal protected areas in Honduras. Promotes biodiversity conservation by expanding effective coverage of marine and coastal protected areas in Honduras. Focuses on marine protected areas in Caribbean and Pacific coastal ecosystems.

Conservation of Marine Biodiversity through Participative Protection of Marine Turtle Habitat. Participatory protection of marine turtle habitat in Congo to conserve marine biodiversity through community engagement and protected area management

Expansion of Marine and Coastal Protected Area System in Brazil. Expands Brazil's Marine and Coastal Protected Area system to create globally significant, representative, effective conservation network with sustainable financing mechanisms. Protects marine ecosystems and biodiversity.

Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine and Coastal Biodiversity in Guatemala. Promotes conservation of marine/coastal biodiversity through effectively managed MPAs in Guatemala to improve economic welfare. Focuses on protected areas in coastal ecosystems and Large Marine Ecosystems.

Strengthening the Conservation, Protection and Management of Key Marine Biodiversity Areas in the Philippines. GEF-funded project to strengthen conservation, protection and management of key marine biodiversity areas in the Philippines through marine protected areas. Total budget $34M with $8M GEF allocation.

Strengthening management capacities and protection of marine biodiversity in environmentally significant areas in Argentina. Creates new Marine Protected Areas and applies Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries to strengthen management capacities and protect marine biodiversity in Argentina's environmentally significant coastal areas.

Global Sustainable Supply Chains for Marine Commodities. Transforms seafood markets by mainstreaming sustainability in value chains of key commodities from developing countries through corporate purchase policies, FIPs, and improved fisheries administration to combat overfishing.

Improving the Management Effectiveness of Azerbaijan's Coastal and Marine Protected Area System. Strengthens Azerbaijan's coastal/marine protected areas through improved management effectiveness, ecosystem representation, and ecological/institutional/financial sustainability. GEF-funded initiative for Caspian Sea coastal ecosystems.

Implementation of the Strategic Action Program of the Gulf of Mexico Large Marine Ecosystem. Improve water quality, rehabilitate coastal/marine ecosystems, avoid depletion of marine resources in Gulf of Mexico LME. SAP implementation through Mexico-US partnership focusing on ecosystem restoration and sustainable resource management.

LME Governance - Ecosystem-based Management of Large Marine Ecosystems. Global project improving ecosystem-based governance of Large Marine Ecosystems through knowledge generation, capacity building, public-private partnerships, and south-to-south learning. Focuses on LME coastal management.

ABNJ Deep Sea and Biodiversity Conservation Project. Enhances sustainability of deep-sea resources & biodiversity in Areas Beyond National Jurisdiction through ecosystem approach. Improves policy frameworks, reduces impacts on vulnerable marine ecosystems, enhances fisheries management.

Establishing an Expanded and Functional System of Protected Areas in the Union of Comoros. Establishes expanded protected area system in Comoros representing country's biodiversity. Creates marine protected areas with sustainable management. GEF-funded initiative for biodiversity conservation in island nation.

Lake Bizerte Wastewater Management and Pollution Reduction. Reduce land-based pollution in Lake Bizerte & Mediterranean Sea via inter-ministerial dialogue, capacity building & infrastructure investment. Targets pollution hotspot connected to Med Sea & Ramsar/UNESCO wetland.

Enhancing Capacity and Performance of Investments in Sustainable Development of LMEs and Coasts in the East Asian Seas Region. Enhances capacity for sustainable development of Large Marine Ecosystems and coasts in East Asian Seas through knowledge sharing, portfolio learning, and networking across China, Indonesia, Philippines, and Vietnam.

Vietnam Coastal and Fisheries Sustainable Management. Improve sustainable management of coastal fisheries in Vietnamese provinces through marine spatial planning. Targets provinces: Binh Dinh, Ca Mau, Ha Tinh, Khanh Hoa, Phu Yen, Soc Trang, Thanh Hoa.

Huai River Basin Pollution Reduction to Bohai Sea. Demonstrates innovative pollution reduction in Dongying City to reduce land-based nutrients/pollutants to Bohai Sea via wetland construction, water gate optimization, farmer associations, and wastewater treatment. 2009-2019.

Caribbean Large Marine Ecosystem Plus (CLME+). Ecosystem-based fishery management in Caribbean Sea. Delivered regional governance framework, transboundary diagnostic analyses, spiny lobster closed seasons across 6 countries, flyingfish management plans. 2013-2020.

Mainstreaming Biodiversity Conservation into Production Sectors in Sindhudurg Coastal and Marine Ecosystem. Mainstream biodiversity conservation into production sectors impacting Sindhudurg coastal/marine ecosystems. GEF-funded project in India's coastal region to integrate conservation with economic activities.

Enhancing Long-term Sustainability of Protected Area Networks in the OECS Region. Establishes sustainable financing, strengthens marine protected area networks, and deploys regional monitoring systems across OECS Caribbean islands. Targets long-term sustainability of protected areas.

Consolidation of Costa Rica's Marine Protected Areas. Consolidate Costa Rica's MPAs by increasing ecological representation, ensuring effective management and financial sustainability. GEF-funded project enhancing marine conservation through protected area expansion and management.

Mainstreaming Marine Biodiversity Conservation into Coastal Management in Aqaba Special Economic Zone. Mainstream marine biodiversity conservation into coastal management framework in Aqaba Special Economic Zone (ASEZ), Jordan. Integrates ecosystem protection with economic development in Red Sea coastal area.

Enhancement of Marine and Coastal Protected Areas in Venezuela. Enhances representation and management of marine/coastal ecosystems in Venezuelan Protected Areas system by 2014, protecting marine/coastal biodiversity of global importance through improved conservation strategies.

PAS Strengthening Coastal and Marine Resources Management in the Coral Triangle of the Pacific. Promotes conservation & sustainable use of coastal/marine resources in Coral Triangle through integrated ecosystem-based management in 5 Pacific countries: Fiji, Micronesia, PNG, Solomon Islands, Vanuatu.

Mainstreaming Coastal and Marine Biodiversity Conservation in the East Godavari River Estuarine Ecosystem. Mainstream coastal and marine biodiversity conservation into production sectors in East Godavari River Estuarine Ecosystem, India. Integrates conservation with economic activities in estuarine environment.

Conservation and Sustainable Use of Coastal and Marine Biodiversity in Colombia. Colombia project to design and implement a financially sustainable National Subsystem of Marine Protected Areas (SMPA) for conservation and sustainable use of coastal and marine biodiversity in Caribbean and Pacific regions.

Inter-jurisdictional System of Coastal-Marine Protected Areas (ISCMPA) Argentina. Develops framework for effectively managed, financially sustainable coastal-marine protected areas system in Argentina. Focuses on conservation and sustainable use of coastal marine biodiversity through inter-jurisdictional cooperation.

Sustainable management of marine and coastal biodiversity and habitats through policy and legislative development and mainstreaming in Lebanon. Develops policy & legislation for sustainable marine/coastal biodiversity management in Lebanon. Mainstreams conservation through integrated coastal management. GEF-funded project targeting LME & sea ecosystems.

Coral Triangle Initiative Support Project. Supports Coral Triangle countries (Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines) in marine conservation through ecosystem-based fisheries, MPA management, climate adaptation, and turtle protection across Southeast Asian waters.

Promoting inter-sector approaches to BD conservation through tourism and fisheries sectors. El Salvador project promoting biodiversity conservation through integrated approaches in tourism and fisheries sectors within Large Marine Ecosystem. GEF-funded initiative for sustainable coastal resource management.

Integrated Planning and Management of Marine and Coastal Ecosystems in Costa Rica. Promotes integrated planning in Golfo de Nicoya and Pacífico Sur MUMAs to conserve biodiversity, maintain ecosystem services, and support sustainable tourism and artisanal fishing in Puntarenas Province.

Albania - Improving Coverage and Management Effectiveness of Marine and Coastal Protected Areas. Expands marine protected areas in Albania's Adriatic/Ionian coasts. Creates strategic MPA plan, Cross-Sectoral Forum for governance, policy enforcement. Addresses overfishing, habitat degradation, industrial pollution. 2013-2019.

Strengthening Marine and Coastal Biodiversity Conservation in Mauritania. Strengthens policy, legislative, financial instruments and capacity of government, civil society, and oil/gas industry to protect marine and coastal biodiversity in Mauritania. GEF-funded project with $950k allocation.

Conservation of Marine and Coastal Biodiversity in Ecuador. Improve marine/coastal biodiversity conservation in Ecuador via network of representative, well-managed protected areas & targeted actions for threatened marine species. GEF-funded $4M of $21.5M total.

Expanding Protected Area Coverage of Globally Significant Marine Biodiversity in the Bahamas. Expands marine protected area coverage across Bahamian archipelago to protect globally significant marine biodiversity and increase management effectiveness of national MPA network. GEF-funded project with $10M total budget.

Catalyzing the institutional and financial sustainability of Djibouti's system of marine protected areas. Strengthening Djibouti's marine protected area system through institutional capacity building and financial sustainability mechanisms. Focuses on LME ecosystem conservation and MPA management in the Red Sea/Gulf of Aden region.

Expansion and Improved Management of Marine and Coastal Protected Areas in Russia. Facilitates expansion of Russia's national system of marine and coastal protected areas and improves management effectiveness. Focuses on LME and sea ecosystems. Total budget $13.5M with $4M GEF allocation.

Protection of the Canary Current Large Marine Ecosystem (CCLME). Reversing fisheries depletion & conserving habitat in Canary Current LME through regional collaboration, sustainable transboundary fisheries management, ecosystem approach, pollution control in coastal areas. West Africa.

Southern Archipelagos Marine Protected Areas Network - Cuba. Conserve marine biodiversity through extended, strengthened network of coastal/marine protected areas in Cuba's Southern Archipelagos region. Integrates MPAs for sustainable use of marine ecosystems.

Humboldt Current Large Marine Ecosystem (HCLME). Advances ecosystem-based management in Humboldt Current through coordinated framework for improved governance and sustainable use of marine resources between Chile and Peru. Focuses on anchovy fisheries and biodiversity.

Western Indian Ocean Marine Highway Development and Coastal and Marine Contamination Prevention Project. Protects Western Indian Ocean coastal/marine environments from ship pollution & illegal resource exploitation. Increases navigation safety, builds capacity for pollution control & surveillance, strengthens regional cooperation. 2010-2016.

Regional Activities of the Strategic Partnership for a Sustainable Fisheries Investment Fund in the Large Marine Ecosystems of Sub-Saharan Africa. Strengthens regional coordination for sustainable fisheries management in Sub-Saharan Africa LMEs. Promotes learning exchange, governance reforms, and capacity building for trans-boundary resource management and poverty reduction.

Sustainable Management of Fish Resources - Strategic Partnership for a Sustainable Fisheries Investment Fund in the Large Marine Ecosystems of Sub-Saharan Africa. Sustainable Management of the Shared Living Marine Resources of the Caribbean Large Marine Ecosystem (CLME) and Adjacent Regions. Manages shared marine resources across Caribbean LME. Benguela Current Large Marine Ecosystem - Strategic Action Programme Implementation. Implements SAP for Benguela Current LME across Angola, Namibia, South Africa. Addresses fish stock decline, water quality, habitat loss via Benguela Current Commission. Capacity building, monitoring, governance reforms. 1999-ongoing.

Integrated Assessment and Management of the Gulf of Mexico Large Marine Ecosystem. Transboundary project analyzing Gulf of Mexico ecosystem issues, implementing pilot projects for mangrove restoration, fisheries management, and marine protected areas. Developed TDA and SAP for ecosystem-based management.

Industrial Water Pollution Control in the Gulf of Guinea Large Marine Ecosystem. Controls industrial water pollution in Gulf of Guinea LME through regional cooperation. Addresses marine ecosystem degradation from industrial discharge across West African coastal nations.

Governance reforms supporting sustainable marine fisheries in African Large Marine Ecosystems. Develops governance reforms for sustainable fisheries in African LMEs. Targets Comoros, Mauritania, Mozambique, Tanzania. Addresses environmental, economic, social sustainability through policy adoption and implementation.

Mediterranean Sea Partnership - Investment Fund for Pollution Reduction. GEF-funded investment fund facilitating Mediterranean basin countries to implement pollution reduction and habitat protection measures, reversing ecosystem degradation through catalytic investments in transboundary priorities.

Sustainable and integrated ecosystem-based management of the West Bering Sea Large Marine Ecosystem. Ecosystem-based management of West Bering Sea LME addressing climatic variability and change impacts. Integrated coastal management approach for sustainable marine resource use in Russian Federation waters.

Sustainable Development of Large Marine and Coastal Ecosystems of East Asia and Pacific. Promotes sustainable development of large marine/coastal ecosystems in East Asia-Pacific. Reduces pollution, promotes sustainable fisheries, ICM and ecosystem-based management to improve local livelihoods.

World Bank/GEF Partnership Investment Fund for Pollution Reduction in the Large Marine Ecosystems of East Asia. Covers 12 countries with ICM programs, reducing nutrients 10-50% in demos. 2010-2020.

East Asia Land-Based Pollution Reduction Investment Fund Project. Reduces marine degradation from land-based pollution in East Asia's Large Marine Ecosystems. Co-finances public/private pollution-reduction investments in hot-spots, targeting secondary cities, agriculture, industrial sectors.

Strategic Partnership for a Sustainable Fisheries Investment Fund - Sub-Saharan Africa LMEs. 10-year partnership to reverse fisheries depletion in 5 Sub-Saharan African LMEs through ecosystem-based management, marine protected areas, policy reform, and sustainable fishing practices. Coalition of WWF, FAO, World Bank.

Caribbean Large Marine Ecosystem Project. Regional marine ecosystem management across 17 Caribbean nations. Addresses transboundary water issues, sustainable fisheries, pollution reduction, and habitat protection in the Caribbean Large Marine Ecosystem.

Strategic Partnership for a Sustainable Fisheries Investment Fund - Sub-Saharan Africa LMEs. 10-year partnership to reverse fisheries depletion in 5 Sub-Saharan African LMEs through ecosystem-based management, habitat protection, and policy reforms. Coalition of WWF, FAO, World Bank supporting coastal countries.

Caribbean Regional Oceanscape Project. Strengthens ocean governance and coastal/marine geospatial planning capacity in Caribbean countries (Dominica, Grenada, St Kitts & Nevis, St Lucia, St Vincent & Grenadines). GEF-funded regional initiative for sustainable marine management.

Strengthened management of Madagascar's marine biodiversity and productivity. GEF-funded project to strengthen marine biodiversity management and productivity in Madagascar through integrated coastal management. Aims to improve conservation and sustainable use of marine ecosystems.

Caribbean Sea LME Conservation Project. UNEP-led marine ecosystem conservation in Caribbean Sea LME covering Colombia, Jamaica, Panama. Focuses on protecting Caribbean marine ecosystems through regional partnership. Budget: $34.5M total, $7M GEF allocation.

Maximize the effectiveness, efficiency and sustainability of GEF-7 investments in the Common Oceans ABNJ program. GEF-7 program enhancing effectiveness of Common Oceans ABNJ investments for sustainable management of areas beyond national jurisdiction through FAO coordination

Seaweed Aquaculture Value Chain Development in South China Sea. Develops seaweed farming in Vietnam & Philippines to enhance food security, remove nutrients from water, create coastal livelihoods, and mitigate climate change through sustainable aquaculture value chains in South China Sea ecosystems.

Blue Nature Alliance - Global Ocean Conservation. Catalyzes conservation of 1.25B hectares of ocean ecosystems globally to safeguard biodiversity, build climate resilience, promote human well-being, and enhance ecosystem connectivity through marine protected areas.

Improving Management of Priority Fisheries in Madagascar. Improve management of priority fisheries at regional, national & community levels in Madagascar. Increase access to alternative livelihoods for targeted fishers. GEF-funded project.

Improving management of marine areas and fisheries in targeted zones and strengthening fisheries value chains in the Seychelles. Enhances marine area management and fisheries in Seychelles through targeted zone interventions and value chain strengthening to improve sustainable fishing practices and coastal ecosystem protection.

SWIOFish 1 - Southwest Indian Ocean Fisheries Governance and Shared Growth Project. Improve management effectiveness of priority fisheries at regional, national and community levels in Southwest Indian Ocean through governance and shared growth initiatives. 2015-2020.

Western Indian Ocean LMEs (SAPPHIRE Project). Achieve long-term ecosystem management in Western Indian Ocean LMEs through Strategic Action Programme implementation across 9 countries. Focuses on marine spatial planning and private sector engagement.

Strengthening Coastal Ecosystem Management in the Pacific Islands. Strengthens coastal ecosystem management in Pacific Islands (Marshall Islands, Solomon Islands, Tuvalu) and sustainably finances conservation of 3+ large Pacific marine protected areas. GEF-funded regional project.

ABNJ Ocean Partnerships for Sustainable Fisheries and Biodiversity Conservation. World Bank project addressing sustainable fisheries & biodiversity in Caribbean, Bay of Bengal, Pacific islands. Focuses on billfish, tuna management, recreational fisheries, RFMO development through incentive-based tools.

Implementation of the Strategic Action Programme for the Protection of the Western Indian Ocean from Land-based Sources and Activities. Reduces land-based pollution impacts in Western Indian Ocean through mangrove/seagrass restoration, wastewater treatment, marine litter control, and environmental flows management across 8 nations.

Western and Central Pacific Ocean Transboundary Oceanic Fisheries Management. Pacific SIDS implement global/regional arrangements for conservation and management of transboundary oceanic fisheries to increase sustainable benefits from tuna and other oceanic fish stocks in Western and Central Pacific Ocean

Ocean Awareness Through Film and Education. Global ocean awareness project disseminating OCEANS film and educational media to raise awareness on ocean ecosystem health and status. UNEP-led initiative with $10.95M budget, $650K GEF allocation.

Enhancing the Effectiveness of Conservation of Dugongs and their Seagrass Ecosystems Across the Indian and Pacific Ocean Basins. Conserves dugongs and seagrass ecosystems across Indian and Pacific Oceans through multi-country collaboration in Indonesia, Madagascar, Malaysia, Mozambique, Solomon Islands, Sri Lanka, Timor-Leste, and Vanuatu.

CTI West Pacific-East Asia Oceanic Fisheries Management Project. Strengthens national capacities & international cooperation for conservation & management of highly migratory fish stocks (tuna) in West Pacific-East Asia. Enhances fishery data collection, stock assessment, monitoring.

Portfolio Learning in International Waters with a Focus on Oceans, Coasts and Islands and Regional Asia/Pacific and Coral Triangle Learning Processes. Improved management of coastal and marine ecosystems through efficient and effective inter- and intra-regional adaptive learning processes in the Coral Triangle region. Focus on knowledge management, sustainable finance, and ecosystem services.

Support for Regional Oceans Training Programmes. Built capacity in developing countries to manage ocean resources through 4 IOI training centres in Colombia, India, Fiji, Senegal. Trained scientists/officials on integrated marine management, exclusive economic zones, ecosystem protection.

Applying an Ecosystem-based Approach to Fisheries Management: Focus on Seamounts in the Southern Indian Ocean. Develops conservation framework for seamounts in Western Indian Ocean beyond national jurisdiction. Assesses fishing impacts on Coco-de-Mer Seamount chain & Mascarene Ridge. Creates management plan for sustainable harvest & biodiversity protection.

Common Oceans - Sustainable utilization and conservation of biodiversity in areas beyond national jurisdiction. Develop capacity for sectoral and cross-sectoral cooperation among national, regional and global institutions in conservation and sustainable use of marine biodiversity in areas beyond national jurisdiction (ABNJ).

Southwest Indian Ocean Fisheries Project (SWIOFP). GEF-funded project addressing fisheries management in SW Indian Ocean. Generated scientific knowledge, built regional capacity, established SWIOFC for fisheries governance. Covered Agulhas, Somali currents across 9 countries.

Pacific Islands Oceanic Fisheries Management Project. Improve understanding of transboundary oceanic fish resources in Western and Central Pacific. Create regional institutional arrangements for conservation and management of oceanic fisheries. Support Pacific SIDS participation in WCPF Convention.

Western Indian Ocean Islands Oil Spill Contingency Planning. Protects Western Indian Ocean biodiversity from oil spills by helping Comoros, Mauritius, Madagascar, Seychelles comply with OPRC. Establishes legal frameworks, contingency plans, response capacity, financing. 1999-2013.

Land-Ocean Interactions in the Coastal Zone (LOICZ). Global research project studying coastal zone nutrient cycles, carbon fluxes, and land-ocean interactions. Analyzed governance responses to ecosystem change and integrated coastal zone modeling from 1996-2010.

Coral Gardeners. Dedicated to restoring dying coral reefs by growing and outplanting climate-resilient corals. The organization leverages technology like the ReefOS geospatial dashboard and community advocacy to revitalize these valuable marine ecosystems.

Pollution & contamination. Monitoring marine plastic and microplastic waste, studying its fragmentation, movement, and impacts on biodiversity. Provides essential data for national and international public policy action plans to mitigate marine pollution.

Évènements extrêmes. Study of extreme algal blooms, a phenomenon where rapid multiplication of phytoplankton and colored microalgae during spring and summer leads to visible marine water discoloration.

Biodiversité marine & écosystèmes. L'Ifremer étudie les prises accidentelles de dauphins dans les filets de pêche et déploie des technologies innovantes (drones, ADN) et des répulsifs acoustiques pour comprendre leurs habitats et réduire ces captures.

Pêche & aquaculture. Assessment of fish stock health in French waters, monitoring populations like hake, sardines, and monkfish across the Atlantic, North Sea, and Mediterranean to track population status and support sustainable fisheries management.
Océan & climat. IFREMER studies the consequences of human-induced climate change and the greenhouse effect on marine biodiversity, ocean currents, and water temperatures.

Qualité sanitaire. Ifremer deploys monitoring networks to detect pathogenic bacteria and toxic microalgae in seawater and filter-feeding shellfish. This research prevents public health risks and guides authorities on halting contaminated oyster sales.

Énergie & matériaux. Recherche et développement sur les énergies marines renouvelables, exploitant les vents, vagues, courants et la température de l'eau pour la production d'électricité, le chauffage et le refroidissement.

Ressources minérales. Exploration et cartographie des ressources minérales sous-marines pour étudier les écosystèmes associés et analyser les impacts environnementaux potentiels de l'extraction minière océanique.

Clean Water for Reefs. Mitigating coastal water pollution by educating residents and tourists about the impacts of cesspool wastewater on marine environments, providing actionable guidance to improve water quality and protect vulnerable coral reef ecosystems.
Habitat Protection. Engaging coastal resorts in Hawai'i to evaluate their operations and implement best practices to protect shoreline ecosystems and nearby coral reefs from land-based impacts.
Sustainable Fisheries. Evaluates the socioeconomic status of artisanal fishers to understand current governance systems and inform the application of sustainable fishing management tools.

Global Coral Bleaching Response Network. Creating a worldwide system to ground-truth satellite-detected reef degradation. Verifying data with scientists and EcoDivers strengthens early detection programs, informs policy, and aids in mitigating climate impacts on marine ecosystems.

Listening to the Ocean. A global bioacoustics programme using underwater sound to monitor marine biodiversity, evaluate ecosystem conditions, and assess human pressures within Hope Spots to support local conservation efforts.

Charting the Blue. Global biodiversity mapping programme utilizing eDNA science, repeat sampling, and data visualization to provide conservation-ready evidence supporting Hope Spot Champions and local conservation efforts.

Florida. Addresses critical threats to Florida's ocean and coasts, including harmful algal blooms, sea level rise, coral disease, and plastic pollution. Initiatives focus on grassroots advocacy, coastal resilience, and marine habitat conservation.

Blue NDC Challenge. A global initiative urging Paris Agreement Parties to integrate ocean-based climate solutions into their NDCs, promoting ecosystem restoration, responsible marine renewable energy, and the decarbonization of maritime industries.

Laboratoire d'Océanographie Physique et Spatiale. Develops in situ instruments, remote sensing systems, and software for massive data processing and numerical modeling to observe, analyze, understand, and predict the physical state of the global ocean.

Laboratoire d'Océanographie Physique et Spatiale. Conducts physical and space oceanography research, managing various oceanic data including numerical models, satellite imagery, and SNO Argo observations.

Laboratoire d'Océanographie Physique et Spatiale. Provides higher education and research training in marine physics, ocean and climate dynamics, and ocean data science to equip future researchers and engineers with the skills needed to address global marine and climatic challenges.

SNO Argo France. The French contribution to the global Argo program, maintaining autonomous floats to measure ocean temperature, salinity, and biogeochemistry. This real-time data is critical for monitoring climate change and large-scale ocean circulation.

Ocean Initiative. The Packard Foundation's Ocean Initiative aims to ensure a healthy ocean for nature and people by supporting conservation efforts, championing climate solutions, and investing in scientific innovation to protect marine ecosystems globally.

ACTNOW. Provides mechanistic understanding and forecasts of interacting drivers on European marine biodiversity to deliver decision-support tools for EU regulators, improving ecosystem monitoring and environmental status assessments.

AfriMAQUA. Collaborative research network uniting African and French scientific institutions to advance marine biodiversity research, fisheries management, and sustainable aquatic resources across the African continent.

AAPLi. Development of artificial bait prototypes for pelagic longline fisheries to replace natural baits, aiming to improve food security and reduce the incidental bycatch of vulnerable marine megafauna like sea turtles, seabirds, and sharks.

ADNeIA. Utilise des robots sous-marins autonomes pour collecter de l'ADNe et cartographier les fonds marins afin d'inventorier la biodiversité, comprendre ses dynamiques écologiques et modéliser son évolution face aux pressions climatiques et humaines.

AquaExcel 3.0. Integrates European aquaculture research infrastructures for transnational access. The project advances sustainable marine aquaculture through biotelemetry, germ cell preservation, and energy budget modeling for sea bass and oysters.

ADAPT. Develops integrated modeling and participatory approaches to balance marine biodiversity conservation, fisheries sustainability, and socio-economic viability under future climate change scenarios, evaluating MPA networks and adaptation strategies.

30x30 Ocean Accelerator. Mobilizes financial and technical resources to create 1 million square kilometers of new marine protected areas globally and enhance the inclusive, effective management of over 130 existing marine ecosystems by 2030.

Coastal Dolphins. Mitigating conservation challenges for whales and coastal dolphins through acoustic monitoring, satellite tracking, marine protected area designation, and reducing human-caused threats like bycatch and ocean noise across global habitats.

Coral Reef Conservation. A global initiative to safeguard climate-resilient coral reefs through on-the-ground conservation, water pollution mitigation, actionable science, and policy reform, ensuring the survival of vital marine biodiversity and coastal ecosystems.

WCS Community Fisheries Program. Empowers coastal communities globally to co-manage small-scale fisheries, securing fishworkers' rights, enhancing food security, and restoring marine biodiversity through inclusive, science-based equitable management strategies.

Area-Based Conservation. Supports the establishment and effective management of MPAs and OECMs across 26 countries to achieve the 30x30 ocean protection goal, utilizing scientific data, community involvement, and marine technologies for enforcement.

WCS Marine Conservation Program. Designs and implements global ocean solutions using applied science, policy, and finance. Focuses on MPAs, coral reefs, marine mammals, sharks and rays, and equitable small-scale fisheries to protect marine wildlife and habitats.

UMR DECOD Projets de Recherche. Portfolio of marine research projects focusing on fish stock assessments, fisheries management adaptation to climate change, trophic interactions, and eco-evolutionary dynamics in aquatic environments like the Bay of Biscay.

Geo-Ocean. Geo-Ocean is a joint research unit within the Carnot MERS institute that supports maritime industries in developing sustainable economic activities through advanced marine research, technological innovation, and exceptional test sites.

Geo-Ocean. Geo-Ocean is a joint research unit focusing on marine hazards, coastal and littoral system dynamics, biogeochemical cycles, sedimentary archives, and geodynamics through advanced observation and remote sensing technologies.

Geo-Ocean Ressources. Resource portal for the Geo-Ocean Joint Research Unit (UMR 6538), providing access to oceanographic campaigns, observatories, software, instrumentation, and marine scientific data.

Geo-Ocean Unité Mixte de Recherche 6538. Recruitment and academic portal for the Geo-Ocean Joint Research Unit (UMR 6538), providing information on university courses, internships, and career opportunities in ocean sciences.

Science pour tous. A public outreach initiative by Geo-Ocean sharing marine geosciences and oceanography research. It offers educational videos, interactive games, and resources on deep-sea ecosystems, hydrothermal vents, submarine canyons, and geological hazards.

Projets en cours - Laboratoire LEMAR. Portfolio of ongoing marine environmental research projects conducted by the Laboratoire des Sciences de l'Environnement Marin (LEMAR), covering topics such as oceanography, climate change, marine biodiversity, and pollution.

Laboratoire LEMAR UMR 6539 - Projets terminés. Archive of completed marine environmental research projects conducted by the Laboratoire des sciences de l'Environnement MARin, spanning topics like biodiversity, ecotoxicology, microplastics, and pelagic ecosystems.
